ingredients: 6 large potatoes rinsed 4 cloves garlic peeled 4 tablespoons olive oil 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cumin 1 1/2 teaspoons mild curry powder 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander 1 teaspoon chilli flakes [optional] 4 teaspoons chickpea flour [gram or channa flour] salt black pepper
directions: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Cut the unpeeled potatoes into slim, even wedges. Put the wedges into a sealable microwave cooking bag, or a glass dish. Add a single garlic clove, roughly sliced, and a good pinch of salt. Close the bag's seal tightly (or cover with a lid). Microwave for 6-8 minutes, on high, or until the wedges are just tender on the outside. Allow to stand for a minute. Pour the olive oil into the bag (or dish). Crush the three remaining garlic cloves directly into the bag or dish. Add the cumin, curry powder, coriander, chilli flakes and chickpea flour. Reseal the bag and toss its contents around gently so that every wedge is completely coated. Tip the wedges onto a baking sheet, making sure that they are skin-side down, and season with salt and pepper. Bake at 200°C for 25-35 minutes, or until they are very crisp and golden. Season with more salt, if necessary, and serve piping hot, in cones of newspaper.

title: Chicken Soup
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb. leg quarters, cut up 4 stalks celery, cut up 2 bay leaves 1 onion, cut up 8 c. water 3 carrots, peeled and shredded 1 1/2 c. fine egg noodles 2 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. pepper
directions: Boil chicken, celery, bay leaves and onion in water until tender. Remove chicken from broth and cool. Remove bay leaves and add carrots, noodles, salt and pepper. Boil 10 minutes. Remove chicken from bone. Add to soup and heat until boiling.

title: Helen'S Pasta Faggioli
ingredients: 6 pieces Pepperoni slices cut up or 3 strips of cut up raw bacon) 1 tablespoon Olive oil 1 Medium yellow onion 1 Garlic clove, diced 8 ounces Can of tomato sauce 8 ounces Water 2 15.5 oz. cans of cannellini beans with liquid Salt & Pepper to taste 8 ounces Spaghetti broken into 3rds or other small pasta Red Pepper Flakes to taste
directions: Heat the olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat Saute pepperoni in the olive oil for 2 minutes or until a little crisp Add the diced onion & garlic to the pepperoni & saute another 2 minutes Add tomato sauce, water, beans, salt & pepper Cook 30 minutes, lowering heat and stirring occasionally Boil a pot of water for the spaghetti or whatever pasta you are using. Add a bit of salt to the pasta water. Break spaghetti into small pieces. Cook as directed on package and drain reserving about a cup of the pasta water. Add to beans & eat! ** Add spaghetti water to beans if soupy consistency is favored.

title: Blueberry Pancakes
ingredients: 1 14 cups flour 2 tablespoons sugar 2 12 teaspoons baking powder 1 14 cups milk 3 tablespoons oil 1 egg 12 cup blueberries
directions: Mix together flour,sugar,baking powder and salt. Beat egg well. Add milk, oil and blend together. Add wet ingredients to dry. Mix together until all dry ingredients, wet do not over mix. Add blueberries and fold into batter. Use lightly oiled frying pan and heat. Fry each pancake until cooked.

title: Garlic Chive Chicken
ingredients: a handful chopped chives 4 to 5 cloves garlic, minced 1 stick margarine salt and pepper chicken, whole or cut-up
directions: Melt margarine. Add chives and garlic; saute briefly. Place chicken in baking pan. Season with salt and pepper generously. Pour chive mixture over it and bake as usual.

title: Granny'S Caramel Nut Slices
ingredients: 1 c. soft shortening (part butter, margarine or Crisco) 2 c. brown sugar 2 eggs 3 1/2 c. flour 1/2 tsp. soda 1 c. hickory nuts or pecans
directions: Mix sugar, shortening and eggs. Stir in flour, salt and soda last. Then add nuts. Form into rolls (about 4) and chill overnight. Slice in 1/8-inch slices. Bake on ungreased cookie sheets at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes approximately 12 dozen.

title: Mamma'S Italian Meatloaf
ingredients: 1/4 c olive oil 1/2 red pepper, chopped 1/2 green pepper, chopped 1/2 onion, chopped 1/2 bunch green onions, chopped 1 garlic clove 2 eggs 1 c canned crushed tomatoes w/juice 1 c grated pecorino Romano cheese 1 c unseasoned breadcrumbs 1 1/2 tsp kosher salt 1 tsp black pepper 1 tbsp chopped parsley 2 lbs ground beef 1 cup Pomodoro sauce
directions: 1) Preheat oven to 400 deg F 2)In small saute pan, heat olive oil over medium heat, add bell peppers and onion. Cook, stirring occasionally, for about five minutes or until soft. 3) In mixing bowl, combine remaining ingredients except sauce. Add cooled vegetables and mix well. Form a loaf and place in baking dish. 4) Place meatloaf in oven and cook for 15-20 minutes, until nice and brown. 5) Pour sauce over loaf, cover with foil, reduce temperature to 350 deg F and bake another 30-45 minutes, or until internal thermometer reads 150-160 deg F. 6) Let rest for 15-30 minutes. Alternative: substitute 1 lb pork for beef

title: Summer Afternoon Snack Mix
ingredients: 6 c. Kellogg's Crispix cereal 1 c. raisins 1 c. peanuts 2 c. mini-pretzel twists
directions: Combine all ingredients. Store in airtight container. Yields 10 cups.

title: Filet of Sole San Clemente
ingredients: 6 large sole fillets 5 tablespoons butter 2 cups mushrooms chopped 1/2 pound crab meat 1 tablespoon cracker crumbs 1 tablespoon capers 1/4 teaspoon dill weed 1 teaspoon seasoned salt optional 1 each lemon sliced 1 cup white wine dry 1/2 cup water 1 tablespoon cornstarch 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream 1 each eggs
directions: Wipe filet of sole well. Melt 4 tablespoon butter in a small skillet; saute mushrooms until lightly browned. Remove from heat; stir in crab or shrimp meat, cracker crumbs, capers and dill weed. Spoon mixture onto center of filet of sole, distributing evenly, and roll, skewering with toothpicks. Place in large skillet. Sprinkle with seasoned salt, add lemon slices, wine and water. Cover and poach 20 minutes. Remove fish filets and lemon to a heated serving platter. Stir cornstarch into cream. Blend into pan juices until thickened. Beat egg in a small bowl; beat in a little hot mixture. Return to skillet stirring constantly until blended. Serve over fish at once.

title: Peach Crunch
ingredients: 3 c. sliced peaches 1 Tbsp. lemon juice 1 c. self-rising flour 1 egg 6 Tbsp. melted butter
directions: Place peaches in baking dish and sprinkle with lemon juice. Mix flour, sugar and egg until lumpy. Spread this mixture over peaches. Pour melted butter over top of this. Bake at 375° for 30 or 35 minutes.

title: Parmesan Potatoes
ingredients: 6 large potatoes, peeled and quartered 1/4 c. flour 1/4 c. Parmesan cheese, grated salt and pepper 1/3 c. oleo, melted in flat, uncovered pan
directions: Combine flour, cheese, salt and pepper in a bag. Moisten the potatoes with water and shake a few pieces at a time in the bag, coating them well. Place in melted oleo and bake 1 hour at 375°.

title: The $25,000 Apple Pie
ingredients: 6 large apples, Braeburn 5 medjool dates, pitted and chopped 1/2 cup chopped walnuts 1/2 cup sugar 1/4 cup flour, reserved 1 lemon, juice of 2 tablespoons lemon zest 2 tablespoons flour 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg 1/8 teaspoon ground ginger 1 double crust pie crust (see my master crust recipe) 1/4 cup half-and-half
directions: Preheat oven to 450˚ Fahrenheit. Juice lemon into large bowl, zest one-half and reserve. Add 1/4 cup of flour to a small bowl. Pit and chop dates into 1/4 inch pieces and toss to coat with flour. Sift to remove excess flour. Chop walnuts and add to dates. Core and peel apples. Quarter and cut into 1/4 inch slices starting at stem end working toward blossom end. As apples are sliced add them into the lemon juice and toss to coat. Mix sugar, flour, cinnamon, nutmeg, ginger, and lemon zest together. Sprinkle half over apples and mix well, add balance and mix again. Refrigerate until crust is rolled and placed in pie pan. Place apple mixture in prepared crust and cover with second crust. Cut vents to allow steam to escape. Optionally, cut apple leaf shapes from crust trimmings and add to top securing with daub of water. Brush top of pie with half and half, sprinkle with very light dusting of sugar. Bake at 450˚ for 15 minutes, reduce heat to 350˚ and finish for 40 to 45 minutes or until bubbly. If crust starts to brown too soon cover loosely with aluminum foil and remove for last 8 to 10 minutes of baking.

title: Applesauce Cake
ingredients: 3/4 c. Crisco 1 1/2 c. sugar 2 eggs, well beaten 3 c. self-rising flour 1 1/2 c. applesauce 1 tsp. vanilla 1 tsp. cinnamon 1/2 tsp. nutmeg 1/2 tsp. allspice 1 c. raisins 1 c. black walnuts
directions: Combine all ingredients; blend well. Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Easy Cranberry Relish
ingredients: 1 cup water 1 cup sugar 2 tablespoons orange juice 1 (12 ounce) bag frozen cranberries orange zest
directions: Mix all ingredients in pot,except for the zest,bring to a boil,turn heat down to low. Let simmer , stirring frequently,about 10 minutes or until it thickens up some.Sprinkle zest on top. Let it cool at room temperture.Refridgerate before serving.

title: Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, broken in small pieces 1 head lettuce, finely cut shredded Colby, Monterey cheese to taste crumbled crisp bacon to taste 1 green pepper, cut small 1 onion, cut small
directions: Mix all together with lite Miracle Whip (do not thin). Chill and serve.

title: Peanut Butter Cup Mousse Cake
ingredients: COCO CHIFFON CAKE: Position rack in center of oven. Preheat to 350°. Butter bottom and sides of a 9-inch round cake pan. Line with a circle of baking parchment. Dust side of pan with flour and tap out excess. Stir together flour, 1/2 cup sugar, cocoa, baking powder & salt in medium bowl. In large bowl, whisk together 2 whole eggs, oil & vanilla until frothy. Sift flour mixture over egg mixture and stir until smooth. Mixture will be stiff. In a grease-free medium mixer bowl, with the whisk attachment, beat egg whites until frothy. Gradually increase speed to medium-high & continue to beat until they start to form soft peaks. Add remaining sugar, 1 teaspoon at a time. Continue to beat until egg white mixture forms a stiff, shiny meringue. Gently fold 1/3 egg white mixture into the egg-flour mixture to lighten it. Fold in remaining egg white mixture. Do not over mix batter. Scrape into prepared pan and spread evenly with a spatula. Bake for 15 minutes or until cake springs back when gently touched in center. Cool cake in pan 5 minutes. Invert to wire rack and cool completely.
directions: PEANUT BUTTER MOUSSE: Put peanut butter chips into large bowl. In small saucepan, heat milk to a gentle boil. Pour hot milk over peanut butter chips. Let stand 30 seconds. Whisk until smooth and add peanut butter and vanilla. Let stand 5 minutes or until tepid. In chilled bowl, beat cream and confectioner's sugar just until soft mounds barely start to form and cream is still pourable. Do not over beat cream. Gently fold 1/3 whipped cream mixture into peanut butter mixture to lighten. Fold in remaining whipped cream. Do not over mix mousse or it will become grainy. ASSEMBLE CAKE: Lightly oil bottom and side of a 9-inch fluted tart pan with removable bottom. Line bottom and sides of pan with plastic wrap. Scrape peanut butter mousse into pan and spread it in an even layer, filling in all fluted indentations in side of pan with mousse. Place cake on top of mousse in tart pan and gently press into place. Cover layer of cake with plastic wrap. Freeze for 3 hours or until firm. Remove plastic wrap from cake and invert onto a plate. Lift off side and bottom of tart pan, using a thin bladed knife if necessary. Peel off plastic wrap from peanut butter mousse layer. CHOCOLATE GLAZE: Put chocolate in medium bowl. In small saucepan heat cream to a gentle boil. Pour hot cream over chocolate. Let mixture stand for 30 seconds. Whisk until smooth. Stir in vanilla.. Cool glaze until it starts to thicken slightly. Place cake on a wire rack over baking sheet. Pour chocolate glaze over cake, covering it completely. Refrigerate on wire rack for 5 minutes or until glaze is set. Sprinkle cake with chopped peanuts and refrigerate until serving.

title: Thin White Sauce
ingredients: 4 Tbsp. butter 2 to 4 Tbsp. flour 1 tsp. salt 1/2 tsp. pepper 4 c. milk
directions: Melt butter in saucepan over low heat. Blend in flour, salt and pepper. Cook over low heat, stirring, until mixture is thick and bubbly. Remove from heat. Stir in milk. Heat to boiling, stirring constantly. Boil and stir 1 minute. Makes 4 cups.

title: Tagliatelle Ai Funghi
ingredients: 1 pound tagliatelle egg pasta 1 ounce dried porcini mushrooms 1/2 pound white mushrooms sliced 1/2 pound crimini mushrooms or sliced brown 4 tablespoons butter 1 shallot minced 2 cloves garlic minced 1 cup heavy whipping cream 4 tablespoons chopped parsley freshly salt to taste grated Parmesan cheese freshly, to garnish
directions: Before making the dish, you need to reconstitute the dried porcini mushrooms. Soak the mushroom in a bowl of very hot water for at least 30 minutes. Then, remove the mushrooms, towel dry, and slice into smaller pieces. Strain and reserve the liquid for later. While you are preparing the mushrooms, put a large pot of salted water to boil. Most egg pasta cooks really quickly, less than 5 minutes, so plan accordingly. In a large skillet, heat the butter until bubbly, then add the shallot and garlic. Saute for a few minutes until they soften. Next, Add the mushrooms, both fresh and the porcinis. Salt to taste. Saute over medium high heat for 10-15 minutes. The mushrooms should be nicely browned. When mushrooms look just about done, drop your pasta into the boiling water and cook to desired doneness, it should be al dente. Drain the pasta, and add it to the skillet with the mushrooms, shallot, garlic. With the heat still at medium to medium high, add the parsley and heavy cream. Stir until all the ingredients are well blended. Let the cream reduce. If liquid is absorbed too quickly, add some of the porcini mushroom liquid, or additional cream if you wish. The sauce should coat the pasta nicely, but it should not be thick at all. Serve your pasta with a sprinkling of parmesan cheese, and some fresh parsley. In terms of wine, I like a dry lambrusco with this dish. Your favorite red would surely be great, too. ENJOY!!!!!

title: Roast Pheasant With Wild Mushroom Duxelles and Roasted Vegetables
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons olive oil 2 cloves garlic, peeled and minced 2 1/2 cups mixed wild mushrooms, like shiitake, cremini and portobello 1 tablespoon chopped Italian parsley 1/2 teaspoon salt, plus more to taste Freshly ground pepper to taste 2 pheasants, wing tips removed 2 heads roasted garlic 8 medium-size carrots, peeled, halved crosswise and quartered lengthwise 4 small baking potatoes, peeled and cut into 6 pieces 6 small onions, peeled and quartered
directions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees. Place 1/2 teaspoon of the olive oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add the garlic and cook for about 15 seconds. Add the mushrooms and cook, stirring frequently, until the mushrooms have given off their liquid and most liquid has evaporated, about 10 minutes. Stir in the parsley, 1/2 teaspoon of salt and pepper to taste. Use your fingers to carefully loosen the skin over the breasts on each pheasant. Place some of the mushroom duxelle under the skin of each bird. Place 1 head of roasted garlic into the cavity of each bird. Rub the remaining teaspoon of olive oil over the skin of the pheasants. Season with salt and pepper. Tie the legs together. Place in a large roasting pan and surround with the carrots, potatoes and onions. Roast for 15 minutes, stopping once to run a spatula under the pheasants to prevent them from sticking. Lower the oven temperature to 350 degrees. Roast until the juices run slightly pink when pricked with a fork in the thickest part of the leg, about 30 minutes longer. Let stand for 10 minutes. Remove the string. Season the vegetables with salt and pepper. Cut the pheasants in half and serve with the roasted vegetables.

title: Best Green Salad
ingredients: 1 batch pale endive 1 batch watercress 1 batch butter lettuce 1 batch frisee 1 batch endive 1 batch minced shallots bathed in cold water 1 cup sherry vinaigrette 1 tablespoons honey 1 tablespoons warm water 1 batch Love
directions: Wash each of the five varieties of lettuce in three different temperatures of water. Make vinaigrette, and layer in between lettuce (don't toss). combine lettuce, and layer vinaigrette

title: Strawberry Jam In A Slow Cooker
ingredients: 4 pints fresh strawberries 2 tablespoons fresh squeezed lemon juice 1 (1.75 ounce) package powdered fruit pectin 3 cups white sugar
directions: Crush strawberries completely with a potato masher; pour into the crock of a slow cooker. Pour lemon juice over strawberries. Sprinkle pectin over strawberries. Let mixture stand 10 minutes. Stir sugar through the strawberries. Cook on Low for 2 hours, stirring twice while it cooks. Increase heat to High and continue cooking until jam thickens to desired consistency, 2 to 3 hours.

title: Honey Balsomic Argula Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons balsomic vinegar 1 teaspoon honey 6 cups arugula, chopped 2 tablespoons olive oil 1 tablespoon minced shallot 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard 14 teaspoon salt 14 teaspoon black pepper 1 garlic clove, crushed 14 cup sliced red onion 14 cup shaved parmesan cheese 2 tablespoons walnuts
directions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl, except for onions,argula, walnuts, and stir well with a whisk. Add argula, onions, and walnuts, and toss gently.

title: White Chocolate Cake
ingredients: 1/4 pound dipping chocolate or real 1 cup margarine 2 cups sugar 4 large eggs 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 18 teaspoon salt 2 1/2 cups cake flour 1 teaspoon baking powder 1 cup buttermilk 1 cup pecans chopped 1 cup coconut
directions: Mix all cake ingredients, adding baking soda and flour last. Don't over- beat after adding flour and buttermilk. Pour into two 9-inch or one 9x12-inch cake grease and floured cake pan. Bake at 350F (180C) 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Applesauce French Toast
ingredients: 2 eggs 3/4 cup milk 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon 2 tablespoons white sugar 1/4 cup applesauce 6 slices bread
directions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the eggs, milk, cinnamon, sugar and applesauce; mix well. Soak bread one slice at a time until saturated with liquid. Cook on a lightly greased skillet or griddle over medium/high heat until lightly browned on both sides. Serve hot.

title: Chocolate-Peanut Butter Blossoms (With Peanut Butter Cups)
ingredients: 1 13 cups all-purpose flour 23 cup unsweetened cocoa powder 1 teaspoon baking soda 12 teaspoon salt 12 cup unsalted butter, softened 34 cup creamy peanut butter 12 cup brown sugar, packed 12 cup sugar 2 eggs, beaten 1 teaspoon vanilla 24 miniature peanut butter cups, chilled dry roasted peanuts, crushed
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper. Whisk together flour, cocoa, baking soda and salt. Beat butter and peanut butter with a mixer on medium speed until blended, about 1 minute. Add brown sugar and sugar and beat until light and fluffy, 3-5 minutes. Add eggs and vanilla, beat to incorporate. Add the flour mixture to peanut butter mixture and beat until just combined. chill 30 minutes. Scoop dough with a #40 scoop (about 1 1/2 Tbs. ), roll into balls, then roll in the crushed peanuts. Arrange dough balls on prepared baking sheets, spaced 1" apart. Bake cookies until edges are set, 12-15 minutes. Let cookies cool on baking sheets 5 minutes, then press one peanut butter cup into center of each cookie.

title: Sausage Balls
ingredients: 1 lb. sausage 3 c. Bisquick 1/2 c. Parmesan cheese parsley flakes to taste
directions: Mix together all ingredients and roll into balls about the size of a quarter. Place under broiler for 12 to 15 minutes or until brown.

title: Salad On A Board
ingredients: 2 pkg. crescent rolls 12 oz. cream cheese 1 tsp. dill weed 1 Tbsp. chopped onion 2/3 c. mayo chopped broccoli chopped cauliflower chopped green peppers chopped celery grated cheese grated carrots
directions: Lay flat crescent rolls on a cookie sheet and bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool. Mix and spread dill weed, onion, cream cheese and mayo over rolls. Top with chopped vegetables, then sprinkle carrots and cheese on top. Refrigerate and cut into finger-eating size pieces with a pizza cutter.

title: Pon de Rings that You Can Easily Roll Up By Hand
ingredients: 200 grams Bread (strong) flour 80 grams Shiratamako (mochiko) 10 grams Sugar 5 grams Salt 10 grams Skim milk powder 70 grams Silken tofu 15 grams Butter (or margarine) 150 ml Water 1 tsp Dried yeast
directions: Make the dough. Place everything into the bread maker bowl, knead for about 15 minutes, cover with plastic wrap, and let sit for 30 minutes. Then start bread maker pizza course! Divide the completed dough into about 40g portions roll it up, cover with a cloth, and let sit for 15 minutes. Divide into six balls. If you pinch just a small amount of the balls together, then they won't break apart so easily when fried. Lightly coat the joints with water, reinforcing them. It takes time to roll these up, so in order to keep the dough from drying out after rolling them up, cover with a cloth, or use the fermentation function on your oven. Fry at 160C until they are nice colored. Use whatever toppings you like! You can also divide it into 6 balls and just fry it like that! This is what it looks like when you fry it at half portions of the 6 pieces. I stuck the centers together thoroughly so that they won't fall apart.

title: Sausage Balls
ingredients: 1 lb. sausage 1 lb. shredded cheese 3 c. biscuit mix
directions: Mix all ingredients. Shape into small balls. Bake 15 minutes at 350°. May be stored in freezer and baked as needed.

title: Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1 c. real mayonnaise 1/4 c. sugar 2 tsp. vinegar 1 c. sunflower seeds 1 c. raisins 10 strips bacon, fried crisp and crumbled 1 bunch green onions, chopped 1/3 c. Parmesan cheese 2 bunches broccoli, cut small
directions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate.

title: Chocolate Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup butter or margarine 4 (1-ounce) squares unsweetened chocolate 1 (16-ounce) package powdered sugar, sifted 1 (13-ounce) can evaporated milk
directions: Melt butter and chocolate in top of a double boiler; stir in powdered sugar and evaporated milk. Cook over medium heat, stirring until sauce is smooth. Serve warm over ice cream.

title: Fluttering Butterflies
ingredients: 1/4 c. finely chopped nuts 48 small twisted pretzels 1/2 (14 oz.) pkg. (about 25) vanilla caramels 1 Tbsp. milk 1 Tbsp. butter or margarine 48 inches red or black shoestring licorice, cut into 1-inch long pieces 1/2 (6 oz.) pkg. semi-sweet chocolate pieces
directions: Butter a large baking sheet. For the base of each butterfly, sprinkle about 1/2 teaspoon nuts in a small circle on a baking sheet. Measure 2 inches between circles. Make each butterfly's wings by arranging 2 pretzels together on top of nuts. Set aside baking sheet.

title: Chicken Sub
ingredients: 1/2 cup honey Dijon dressing 1 (8-ounce) French bread loaf, split and toasted 1/2 pound thinly sliced cooked chicken 4 (1-ounce) slices colby cheese, halved 1 carrot, shredded 1/2 cup (2 ounces) shredded mozzarella cheese 4 green onions, sliced 2 cups shredded lettuce
directions: Spread dressing on cut sides of bread. Layer chicken and remaining ingredients on bottom half of bread; cover with top. Cut sandwich into 4 pieces.

title: Pumpkin Pie
ingredients: 2 c. pumpkin 3 eggs, separated 1 c. brown sugar 1/4 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. grated nutmeg 1/2 tsp. ginger 1/2 tsp. allspice 1/4 tsp. cinnamon 3 c. scalded milk 1 unbaked pie shell
directions: Combine pumpkin, egg yolks, brown sugar, salt and spices; add milk. Beat 3 egg whites until stiff; fold into pumpkin mixture. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 450° for 10 minutes. Reduce temperature to 325°; bake for 30 minutes longer or until pie tests done.

title: Hominy Bake
ingredients: 2 cans yellow hominy 2 cans white hominy 1 c. sour cream 1 c. green chilies, chopped 1 1/2 c. Jack cheese, grated 2 1/2 c. Cheddar cheese, grated salt and pepper to taste
directions: Mix all ingredients together (reserve 1/2 cup Cheddar cheese for top) and put in casserole. Bake 30 minutes at 300°.

title: Low-Fat Low Sugar Bran Pineapple Muffins
ingredients: 1 cup all-bran cereal (I use AllBran) 1/2 cup whole wheat flour 2 teaspoons baking powder 2 egg whites 1/2 cup nonfat milk 1/4 cup sugar substitute 1/4 cup pineapple chunk
directions: Combine milk and bran cereal and set aside for 5 minutes. Combine flour, baking powder, and salt. Add to bran, then add egg white. Mix in pineapple chunks. Divide into 6 sprayed muffin cups. Bake at 400°F for 18 minutes or to test.

title: Baked Mussels Recipe
ingredients: 3 doz mussels 1/2 c. Crushed tomatoes 2 c. Bread crumbs 4 Tbsp. Grated cheese 3 x Garlic cloves, diced 2 Tbsp. Parsley, minced
directions: Scrub mussels with a brush, pull off beards. Prepare a fry pan with a tight fitting lid which will hold all the mussels. Add in 3-4 Tablespoons extra virgin olive oil, 1/3 c. water, salt, and pepper. Cover pan, let mussels steam over medium heat to open. Meanwhile combine bread crumbs, grated cheese, and garlic cloves, to use as stuffing. Remove mussels to cold and reserve liquid. Don't use unopened mussels. Remove mussels and open shells to lay flat. Don't break apart. Place one mussel in each shell, cover with prepared stuffing. Squeeze 1 Tablespoons of crushed tomatoes on each mussel. Sprinkle with minced parsley. Drizzle with extra virgin olive oil and remaining liquid from steam process to moisten bread crumbs. Bake at 375 degrees till golden, about 15-20 min. Serve warm.

title: Pasta With Chicken And Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 pkg. fettucine 2 lb. chicken, cubed 1 onion, chopped 1/4 c. sun-dried tomatoes 2 Tbsp. oil 1 tsp. fennel 2 carrots, cut in toothpick strips
directions: Saute onion, tomatoes, carrots and fennel in oil. Brown chicken. Fold into each other. Mix into prepared fettuccine. Enjoy.

title: Egg Noodle Tuna Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 pkg. egg noodles 1/2 can tuna fish 1 can cream of mushroom soup 1/2 can peas 1/2 c. milk 1/2 tsp. salt dash of pepper 1/4 tsp. paprika
directions: Cook egg noodles according to package directions. Separate tuna into flakes. Mix with cream of mushroom soup, milk, salt and pepper. Combine cooked noodles and tuna mixture in baking dish. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake in moderate oven (375°) for 25 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Lois' Cheese Ball
ingredients: 2 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese, softened 1 c. crushed drained pineapple 1/4 c. grated onion 1/2 c. chopped green pepper 1 c. chopped pecans (1/2 c. in mixture; 1/2 c. on outside)
directions: Mix together the first 4 ingredients and 1/2 cup pecans. Form a ball. Cover with 1/2 cup pecans. Chill. Serve with crackers.

title: Three-Onion Saute
ingredients: 1/4 cup olive oil 2 leeks, halved, sliced 2 medium red onions, halved, sliced 1 medium onion, halved, sliced 1/2 cup chicken stock or canned chicken broth 3 tablespoons Sherry vinegar 2 tablespoons sugar 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves
directions: Heat oil in heavy large skillet over medium heat. Add leeks and onions. Cover and cook 10 minutes. Uncover and cook until tender, stirring occasionally about 30 minutes. Add stock, vinegar, sugar and cloves. Simmer until liquid is syrupy, stirring constantly, about 7 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Manhattan Clam Chowder
ingredients: 1 medium onion, chopped 2 Tbsp. butter 6 potatoes, cubed 2 cans clams (with juice), minced or chopped 1 can tomato soup salt and pepper to taste
directions: Saute onions in butter until transparent, not brown. Add cubed/washed potatoes in cooked onions. Cover with water only to top of potatoes. Cover and cook on medium heat until potatoes are soft (keep checking). Add cans of clams (minced or chopped) with the juice to the potato/onion mixture. Stir. Now add tomato soup, salt and pepper; stir again and heat through until hot. Easy and delicious! Serves 4 to 6.

title: Pistachio And Cranberry Biscotti
ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour 3/4 cup sugar 1 teaspoons baking powder 3 eggs 3 tablespoons brandy or rum 1 teaspoons vanilla extract 3/4 cup roasted, unsalted pistachios, coarsely chopped 1/2 cup chopped dried cranberries
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Mix dry ingredients (except the nuts and dried cranberries) together in a medium bowl. In a separate bowl mix the liquids together, then add to the dry ingredients and mix until combined (the dough will be fairly stiff). Stir in the nuts and cranberries. Shape the dough into 2 flattish logs, making the ends as square as possible. Place the logs on a buttered cookie sheet. Bake for 20 minutes at 350°F, or until done through. Remove from the oven and let cool to the touch. Using a serrated knife, slice the biscotti on a slight diagonal into 3/4-inch pieces. Place the pieces back on the cookie sheet cut side down. Bake again for 15 minutes until the cookies are a golden brown. Store in a tight tin. Cookies store well for weeks.

title: Western Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 can Bush baked beans with molasses 1 lb. hamburger 1 medium onion, chopped 1/2 c. catsup 1/4 c. mustard
directions: Brown meat and onion. Add beans, mustard and catsup. Mix well. Cover and cook until bubbly and hot, about 20 minutes. Very quick and easy. Freezes well.

title: Genuine Italian Pizza Dough
ingredients: 2 c. flour 1 pkg. dry yeast 1 c. hot water 3/4 Tbsp. oil
directions: Put hot water and oil in large bowl, then add yeast. Stir until dissolved. Add flour slowly to make paste, then a soft dough. Dough should be oily. Use well-greased hands to pan dough.

title: Shrimp And Papaya Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. medium-sized raw shrimp 1 Tbsp. minced parsley 1 recipe handmade mayonnaise 1 papaya, peeled and seeded salt 1 head bibb lettuce, washed and dried
directions: Bring a pot with enough water to cover the shrimp to a boil. Add the shrimp and cook only until pink (about 5 minutes). Drain, rinse with cold water, peel, shell and remove any black vein, then chill in the refrigerator. Mix the parsley into the mayonnaise. Cut papaya in slices or large cubes. Toss the shrimp and papaya in the mayonnaise until well coated. Add salt to taste. Arrange the shrimp mixture on lettuce leaves.

title: Chocolate-Glazed Doughnut Cookies
ingredients: 1-1/2 cups butter, softened 1 cup sugar 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 3-1/2 cups all-purpose flour 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1/4 teaspoon salt 1/2 cup butter, cubed 1/4 cup half-and-half cream 1 tablespoon light corn syrup 2 teaspoons vanilla extract 4 ounces bittersweet chocolate, chopped 2 cups confectioners' sugar Sprinkles and chopped nuts, optional
directions: In a large bowl, cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in vanilla. In another bowl, whisk flour, cinnamon and salt; gradually beat into creamed mixture. Divide dough in half. Shape each into a disk; wrap in plastic. Refrigerate 30 minutes or until firm enough to roll. Preheat oven to 350°. On a lightly floured surface, roll each portion of dough to 1/2-in. thickness. Cut with a floured 3-in. doughnut-shaped cookie cutter. Place 1 in. apart on ungreased . Bake 12-14 minutes or until edges begin to brown. Cool on pans 2 minutes. Remove to wire racks to cool completely. For glaze, in a small saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Stir in cream, corn syrup and vanilla. Reduce heat to low. Add chocolate; whisk until blended. Transfer to a large bowl. Gradually beat in confectioners' sugar until smooth. Dip tops of cookies into glaze. Decorate as desired with sprinkles and chopped nuts. Let stand 30 minutes or until set. Place wrapped disks in resealable plastic freezer bag; freeze. To use, thaw disks in refrigerator until soft enough to roll. Prepare, bake and decorate cookies as directed.

title: Red and Green Bell Pepper Relish
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups finely shredded green cabbage 3 large red bell peppers, cut into 1/2-inch dice 1 large green bell pepper, cut into 1/2-inch dice 1 small onion, finely chopped 1 celery rib, finely chopped 1 tablespoon minced jalapeno 1 cup white vinegar 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt 1 1/2 teaspoons yellow mustard seeds 3/4 teaspoon turmeric 1/2 teaspoon celery seeds 1/4 cup sugar
directions: In a large stainless-steel saucepan, toss the shredded cabbage with the bell peppers, onion, celery and minced jalapeno. Add the vinegar, salt, mustard seeds, turmeric, celery seeds and sugar; bring to a boil. Cover, reduce the heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables just soften, about 20 minutes. Transfer the relish to glass jars and let cool, then cover and refrigerate for 1 week before serving.

title: Easy Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 whole chicken, cut up 1 small pkg. Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing 1 egg 2 c. chicken broth 1 small onion, diced 1/2 stick butter salt and pepper to taste 1 can cream of chicken soup 1 can cream of celery soup
directions: Cook chicken and debone. Layer chicken on bottom of a greased casserole dish. Combine cream of celery soup and cream of chicken soup; spread over chicken. Combine the stuffing, egg, chicken broth, onion, margarine, salt and pepper; spread over the top of chicken. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: For Those on a Diet Super-Delicious Natto & Tofu Salad
ingredients: 1 pack Natto (3 pack set) 1 pack Tofu (3 pack set) 1/4 Lettuce 1/4 Cucumber 1 Salt Dressing (or your choice of dressing) 2 leaves Shiso leaves (optional) 1/4 Tomato (optional) 1 dash Mayonnaise (optional)
directions: Shred the cabbage with your hands and chop the cucumber into chunks. Refer to user Kaborin's "Kabo-Style Lettuce Salad"for details. Add the natto, tofu and shiso leaves (if you have them) into the salad from Step 1 and mix in the dressing. Use whatever dressing you like. Once the salad has been mixed it's ready to serve. If you want a low-calorie salad, eat this version. If you don't mind the extra calories, try dressing the salad with some mayonnaise and adding some tomatoes. Then top the salad with some more shiso leaves if you like.

title: Fried Squid With Red Pepper Mayonnaise
ingredients: 1 ancho chili 1 red bell pepper 2 to 3 tablespoons lemon juice 1 egg yolk About 1 cup peanut oil 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil Coarse salt and freshly ground pepper to taste 2 pounds squid, cleaned and sliced (see above) Peanut or vegetable oil 1 cup flour Coarse salt and freshly ground pepper to taste
directions: Make the mayonnaise. Tear the ancho chili into strips and soak it in half a cup of hot water for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, preheat broiler. Cut the pepper in quarters or eighths and remove the seeds. Place the pepper strips skin side up on a broiling rack. Broil until the skin becomes charred. Place the strips in a sealed paper bag for a couple of minutes, then peel off the skin. Combine the chili, pepper strips, lemon juice and enough chili soaking liquid to make a smooth puree in the food processor. Blend until smooth. Either make the mayonnaise by hand, first beating the egg yolk with a fork, then adding the peanut and olive oils little by little and beating them in until you have a smooth emulsion. Or make the mayonnaise in a food processor. Stir in the pepper puree and correct the seasoning. Place in a small bowl. Heat enough peanut or vegetable oil to come about an inch up the sides of the pan. Lightly dredge the squid in seasoned flour and fry quickly, for a couple of minutes on each side, turning once and removing with a slotted spoon to drain on paper towels. Do not crowd the pan. Fry in batches, if necessary. Serve immediately with the mayonnaise on the side.

title: Peanut Butter And Jelly Oatmeal Pancakes
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups quick cooking oats 3/4 cup all-purpose flour 1 teaspoon baking soda 1 teaspoon white sugar 1 teaspoon salt 2 cups skim milk 2 egg, lightly beaten 3 tablespoons natural peanut butter 2 tablespoons melted butter cooking spray 1/4 cup strawberry jam
directions: Combine oats, flour, baking soda, sugar, and salt in a large bowl. Set bowl aside. In a separate bowl, whisk together the skim milk, eggs, peanut butter, and melted butter. Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients and stir in the wet ingredients, being careful not to over mix the batter. Heat a large skillet over medium heat, and coat with cooking spray. Pour 1/4 cupfuls of batter onto the skillet, and cook until bubbles appear on the surface. Flip with a spatula, and cook until browned on the other side, about 2 minutes per side. Serve with strawberry jam.

title: Caesar Dill Cold Slaw
ingredients: 1/2 heads Cabbage 1 cup Mayonnaise 1 Tablespoon Anchovy Paste 1/4 cups Chopped Dill 1 teaspoon Dijon Mustard 1/2 Lemon, Juiced 1 clove Garlic, Minced 1 teaspoon Salt 1/4 teaspoons Pepper
directions: Grate the cabbage with a box grater and set aside. In a large bowl, add the mayo, anchovy paste, dill, Dijon mustard, lemon juice, garlic and salt and pepper. Mix well and add cabbage. Toss until mixed together. Set in the fridge for one hour so the flavors can marry.

title: Italian Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef 1/2 lb. ground pork 3/4 c. bread crumbs 2 eggs 1 medium onion, grated 1 Tbsp. crushed garlic 1/2 tsp. basil 1/2 tsp. parsley 1/4 c. Parmesan cheese 1 tsp. fennel seed salt and pepper
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix well with hand. Form into balls, drop into sauce and cook until done.

title: Chicken Lasagna
ingredients: 1 green pepper 12 large onions or 1 medium onion minced garlic 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 cup half-and-half cream 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese 2 cups diced chicken breasts 14 cup chicken broth tomatoes 8 ounces ricotta cheese (or more if you like it a lot) 1 cup additional shredded cheddar cheese lasagna noodle 14 cup shredded parmesan cheese
directions: chop onion and green pepper. saute in the olive oil. Add the garlic. Cook lasagne noodles. When cooked, add the the half and half. Don't boil. It will become creamy. Add the 1st cup of shredded cheddar, and a little chix broth if it becomes too thick. chop up tomato. spread a little of the sauce on the bottom of the pan. layer as follows:. lasagne noodles. ricotta. sauce. tomato. a bit more cheddar. once all layered, sprinkle cheddar and parmesan on top. Cook at 350 for 25 minutes covered. Uncovered, cook for another 10.

title: Dilly Fries
ingredients: 32 oz McCain's frozen french fries 4 tbsp dill pickle juice 1 large egg white 1 1/2 tsp dill weed 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp salt
directions: preheat oven 450 in a bowl large enough to hold the bag of fries...whisk all but the fries until well combined add fries and coat well with dill pickle mixture place in a single layer on baking sheet bake 20 - 25 minutes till golden and lightly crispy, turning half way through

title: Chocolate Cake Icing
ingredients: 1 stick butter 1 1/4 cups sugar 3 1/2 Tbsp. cocoa 1/2 cup evaporated milk
directions: Melt butter on medium heat and add all other ingredients. Mix well. Continue to cook on med-high heat until mixture comes to full rolling boil. Cool slightly before frosting cooled cake.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lb. defrosted hash browns 1/2 c. butter, melted (I use 1/4 c.) 1 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. pepper 1/4 c. chopped onion 1 can cream of chicken soup 2 c. milk 1 c. sour milk 1 1/2 c. grated cheese
directions: Mix butter, salt, pepper, onion, soup, milk, sour cream and cheese. Add potatoes and place in two 2-quart casserole dishes. Bake 1 hour at 350°. Buttered crumbs on top are optional.

title: Tamale Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef 1/2 c. chopped onion 1/2 c. chopped green pepper 1 (15 oz.) can tamales, cut in 1-inch chunks 1 (1 lb.) can red kidney beans, drained 1 (1 lb.) can cream-style corn 2 (8 oz.) cans tomato sauce 4 oz. wide noodles, cooked and drained 2 Tbsp. chili powder 1/2 c. shredded Cheddar cheese 2 Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
directions: Brown ground beef in a large skillet. When meat begins to turn color, add onion and green pepper. Saute until meat is well browned. Combine tamales, kidney beans, corn, tomato sauce, noodles, Worcestershire sauce, chili powder and meat mixture in large 3-quart casserole. Mix well. Top with cheese. Bake at 375° for 35 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Loaded Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 5 lb. potatoes, peeled and cubed 3/4 c. sour cream 1/2 c. milk 3 Tbsp. margarine salt and pepper 3 c. (12 oz.) shredded cheese 1/2 lb. sliced bacon, cooked and crumbled 3 green onions, sliced
directions: Cook potatoes, covered with water. Bring to boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer until tender. Drain and place in mixing bowl. Add sour cream, milk, butter, salt and pepper. Beat on low to medium speed until light and fluffy. Stir in 2 cups cheese, bacon and onions. Transfer to 3-quart dish. Top with remaining cheese. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes or until heated through and cheese is melted.

title: Corn Chowder
ingredients: 6 slices bacon 1 small onion bacon grease about 6 medium potatoes water salt and pepper to taste 1 can white creamed corn about 1 qt. sweet milk
directions: Fry bacon until real crisp. Take up. Saute onion in the bacon grease. Peel potatoes and cube. Boil the potatoes in water and salt and pepper to taste until about done. Put all of this together with creamed corn. Add sweet milk and let simmer about 20 minutes.

title: Sizzling Pork Sisig
ingredients: pork belly As needed, twice-cooked, diced canola oil As needed red onion As needed, small diced ginger As needed, minced Anaheim chiles As needed, minced vinegar As needed lemon juice As needed salt To taste pepper To taste
directions: 1. In a hot saute pan, saute red onions, ginger and chilis in canola oil 2. Add diced pork belly, and cook until heated through 3. Finish with vinegar, lemon juice, salt and pepper to taste 4. Serve on a sizzling cast iron skillet

title: Mexican Lasagne
ingredients: 1 lb. hamburger meat 1 chopped onion 1 can enchilada sauce 1 c. milk 1 can cream of chicken 1 can cream of mushroom 12 small corn tortillas 1 c. grated cheese (mild Cheddar)
directions: Brown hamburger and onions. Drain grease. Add enchilada sauce, milk and both cream soups. Stir well until fully blended. Simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Crunchy Wedges (Pita Chips)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter, melted or 2 tablespoons olive oil 4 small pita breads
directions: Use pita breads that are about 6 inches in diameter. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Lightly brush each bread, on both sides, with either melted butter or olive oil. Cut each pita into 8 wedges. Seperate wedges so you have 2 thinner pieces from each wedge. Place wedges, rough side down, in a single layer on a baking sheet. Sprinkle with seasonings of your choice: salt, pepper, dried herbs, etc. Bake, stirring once for 10 to 15 minutes until golden brown and crisp. Cool slightly before using. Store in an airtight container on counter or freeze in ziploc bags. To recrisp if necessary, place on baking sheet and heat at 300 degrees for 5 minutes.

title: Afghan Dumplings With Lamb Kofta And Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: 4 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil, divided 1 large yellow onion, finely chopped 2 cloves garlic, minced 1 pound ground lamb 1 cup tomato sauce 1 1/2 teaspoons paprika 1 1/2 teaspoons ground coriander 3 teaspoons kosher salt, divided 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper 1 pound scallions, washed 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes 1 package wonton wrappers 1 teaspoon white vinegar 1 cup plain, whole milk yogurt 1/2 teaspoon dried, ground garlic 1 tablespoon dried mint
directions: In a large pan, saute the chopped onion over medium heat in 3 tablespoons of the olive oil until tender and translucent. Add the garlic and saute another minute. Add the lamb and saute until cooked through, breaking it up like finely minced taco meat. Add the tomato sauce, 1 1/2 teaspoons of the salt, the paprika, coriander and black pepper. Cook over low heat, stirring regularly for 20 minutes. Set aside. While the meat is cooking, trim the root off the scallions and finely chop, using the entire onion (both white and dark green parts). A food processor is useful here. Heat the remaining tablespoon of olive oil in a saute pan over medium heat and add the green onions, 1 teaspoon of the salt, and the crushed red pepper. Turn heat to low and saute until tender, 10 minutes. Set aside. To assemble the dumplings, fill a small bowl with water and put it at your work station. Set a won ton wrapper on your work surface and dip your finger into the water. Moisten the edges along two connecting sides of the wrapper. The water will serve as glue for the dumpling. Put about a teaspoon of sauteed green onions in the center of the wrapper. Fold the dough in half over the green onion in the shape of a triangle. Use the tip of your finger to firmly press the edges of the dough together to form a tight seal. Next, lift the two longest points of the triangle and press them together, creating a little circle over the dumpling. It will look like a fancy napkin fold. While you are assembling the dumplings, bring a large pot of water to a gentle boil. Add the vinegar. Once all of the dumplings are done, immerse them in the water and boil according to directions on the won ton package (about 4 minutes). While the dumplings are boiling ,quickly make the yogurt sauce. Stir together the yogurt with the garlic and the remaining 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Gingerly scoop the cooked dumplings out of the water with a slotted spoon, a few at a time, and arrange on a large platter. Spoon the yogurt over the dumplings and the ground meat on top of that. Sprinkle with dried mint and serve immediately.

title: Spicy Red Juice Recipe
ingredients: 1/2 cup (4 ounces) fresh carrot juice from about 2 large carrots 1 teaspoon fresh garlic juice from 2 cloves garlic 3/4 cup (6 ounces) fresh red bell pepper juice from about 1 very large or 2 medium-sized red bell peppers 1/2 cup (4 ounces) fresh cherry tomato juice from about 1 dry pint cherry tomatoes 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice from 1 lemon 1 teaspoon freshly grated horseradish root 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt, plus more for rimming glasses Lemon wedges, for serving (optional)
directions: Rim two juice glasses with salt: fill 1 saucer with water and sprinkle 1 saucer with kosher salt. Dip glasses into water then immediately into salt, turning glasses in salt to coat rims evenly. Stir juices together, add horseradish and salt, and stir thoroughly. Divide between two glasses, garnish with lemon wedges, if desired, and serve immediately.

title: cheese cake
ingredients: 1 packages biscuits 1 envelope gelatin 5 cup cream cheese 3 cup whipped cream 1 envelope cherry jello 1 cup butter
directions: crumble the biscuits in to small peices. melt the butter and mix it with the biscuits to make a solid base and put it in the freezer for 5 minutes. melt the gelatin in 1/2 cup of water. mix the cream cheese and the whipped cream with the gelatin and put it as 2nd layer on the top of biscuits and put it in the freezer for 4 hours. finally, put the cherry jello on the top of the cake and keep it in the fridge.

title: Basic Potato Bread, Haygood's Recipe
ingredients: 3 med potatoes or possibly 1 c. mashed 1 Tbsp. active dry yeast 2 1/2 c. water 100-115 degrees 8 c. all-purpose flour about 1 1/2 Tbsp. salt 1/2 Tbsp. seeds (Caraway, sesame, etc.)
directions: Scrub potatoes; boil till very tender. Drain, and mash well leaving all skins. Allow to cold. Dissolve yeast in 1/2 C water, mix well with 3 Tbs. of the flour in a LARGE bowl. Let stand 30 min. Add in remaining 2C water, salt, and most of the seeds. Add in remaining flour and potatoes and mix well. * Note: it is best to add in thepotatoes first and mix them with the water. Then, while stirring, fold in the flour slowly as to avoid any unmixed areas) Knead on a floured board 12-15 minutes. * Don't add in more than a sprinkle of flour to board while kneading. Shape into ball, and place in a well oiled bowl. Turn bowl over onto kneading board (or possibly plate), and let rise in hot, draft place for about 1-2 hrs; or possibly till doubled in bulk. Remove dough and punch down, kneading a few min more. Slice in half, and make into two round loaves.Pour on all other seeds over tops of loaves, making sure to press down gently into dough. Place on well oiled baking sheet. Let rise rise 30-35 minutes. Bake in pre-heated 400 degree oven for about one hour. Bake no longer than 1:20.Allow to cold, enjoy with hummus or possibly Plochman's whole grain mustard! !

title: Molasses Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. molasses 1 c. lard 2 tsp. soda 1 c. sugar 1 c. sour milk 1 egg 4 c. flour 1 tsp. salt 1 tsp. ginger 1 tsp. cinnamon
directions: Heat molasses and lard to melt lard. When lard is melted, mix in soda. Mix sugar, sour milk and egg and add. Mix remaining ingredients well and add. Cool overnight. Roll out and bake for 10 minutes in a 350° oven. I use round cutters sometimes and also Christmas and Easter cutter designs such as rabbits, crosses, birds, stars, bells and Santa's boots. You can sprinkle top of cookie with sugar or frost.

title: Mini White Chocolate Chip, Orange And Cranberry Muffins
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups self-rising flour 1/2 cup granulated sugar 4 1/2 tbsp butter, melted 3/4 cup milk 1 None large egg 2 tsp finely grated orange zest 1/4 cup orange juice 4 oz white chocolate chips 2 oz dried cranberries -1 None Glace Icing 1 1/2 cups powdered sugar 1/2 tsp vegetable oil None None pink, blue, green and yellow food coloring
directions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line 4 (12-cup) mini muffin pans with paper liners. Sift flour and sugar into a medium bowl. Whisk together butter, milk, egg, orange zest and orange juice. Mix into dry ingredients until just combined. Fold in chocolate chips and cranberries. Distribute between paper liners and bake for 10 mins, until a skewer inserted in the center comes out clean. Let cool in pans for 2 mins then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely. Meanwhile, to make the glace icing, sift powdered sugar into a small heatproof bowl. Stir in oil and enough water (around 1-2 tbsp) to make a paste. Stir over a small saucepan of simmering water until icing is spreadable. Divide into 4 small bowls and tint each with 1 of the 4 food colorings. Spread over cool cupcakes.

title: Homemade Chili
ingredients: 1 lb. hamburger meat 1 lb. Polish sausage 1 large onion 1 pkg. Chili-O mix 1 small can tomato sauce 2 (15 oz.) cans kidney beans 1 lb. cooked leftover pinto beans jalapeno peppers 1 large can tomatoes
directions: Cook hamburger meat and sausage. Add them to kidney beans and pintos. Cut up onion; add to mixture. Add tomato sauce, tomatoes and Chili-O mix. Simmer for 2 hours.

title: Baked Fennel With Potatoes Recipe
ingredients: 2 x Fennel bulbs 1 1/2 Tbsp. Virgin extra virgin olive oil 30 gm Butter 2 med Potatoes 2 Tbsp. Minced fresh parsley
directions: When baked the fennel becomes deliciously sweet.This dish is a good accompaniment for chicken or possibly fish. To trim fennel, remove hard base and any bruised outside leaves. Cut into thin lengthwise slices then rinse in cool water. Scatter over the base of a buttered baking dish. Drizzle with 1 Tbsp. oil and dot with butter. Bake in a warm oven (200 deg C) for 20 min, turning fennel over with a spatula 1/2 way through cooking. Meanwhile, peel potatoes and cut into thin slices. Add in to baking dish and mix with fennel. Drizzle with more oil then season with salt and freshly milled black pepper. Cover with foil and bake for a further 30 to 45 min, removing foil during last 15 min. Serve warm sprinkled with minced parsley. Serves 4.

title: Banana Pickles
ingredients: 1 c. vinegar 1 c. water 3 c. sugar 1 tsp. salt 1 tsp. celery seed 1 tsp. turmeric 1 tsp. mustard seed 9 large cucumbers
directions: Peel and slice cucumbers longways. Cut out the seed. Slice enough to fill 3 quarts; pack in the jars. Boil rest of ingredients to dissolve sugar and salt; pour over pickles and seal. Cold pack 10 minutes.

title: Old-Fashioned Egg Nog
ingredients: 6 eggs 1/2 c. sugar 3 c. milk 1 1/2 tsp. vanilla extract 1 c. whipping cream salt to taste ground nutmeg cinnamon sticks
directions: Separate eggs and beat yolks until blended. Slowly add 1/4 cup sugar and beat at high speed. Stir in milk, vanilla and salt. Chill. Whip cream and set aside. In a large bowl beat egg whites until light peaks form. Add 1/4 cup sugar and beat to stiff peaks. Fold in yolk mixture and whipped cream into egg whites. Serve immediately. Garnish with nutmeg and cinnamon sticks. Makes 7 (8 ounce) servings.

title: Egg Nog(12 Servings)
ingredients: 6 eggs, separated sugar (separated 1/2 c. and 1/4 c.) 1 c. Jack Daniels 1/8 c. rum 2 c. heavy cream 2 to 3 c. milk nutmeg (as a sprinkling)
directions: Beat egg yolks until stiff and light yellow. Slowly add 1/2 cup sugar, beating well. Add alcohol. Mix well and pour into punch bowl.

title: Shanna'S Jiffy Mix Cornbread Made Better!
ingredients: 1 (8 1/2 ounce) box Jiffy corn muffin mix 1/3 cup milk 1 egg 4 tablespoons butter, room temperature aluminum foil (to cover pan)
directions: Preheat oven to 400°F Mix Jiffy, milk, and egg in a small bowl. Mix until all ingredients are well blended but not over beaten/mixed. Place into an 8x8 baking dish (or cake pan) and bake for 15-20 minutes. (This step is all from package directions). Remove from oven and immediately spread the butter over top of cornbread until butter is melted and bread is fully coated on top. Immediately cover with aluminum foil, creating a tight seal around the pan. Wait 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving. The foil steams in the butter and makes a normally gritty cornbread nice and smooth and creamy. The leftovers (if any), also keep better as it retains it's moisture. Simply microwave any leftover slices for about 20 seconds and serve!

title: Pork Steaks
ingredients: pork steaks 1/2 c. vinegar 1/2 c. ketchup 9 oz. can crushed pineapple 1 tsp. soy sauce 3 Tbsp. brown sugar 1/2 tsp. salt
directions: Fry chops; brown. Combine ingredients. Pour over chops. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes, covered. May need to add a little water.

title: Potato-Cheese Soup
ingredients: 2 potatoes, sliced thinly 1 to 2 stalks celery, chopped 1/2 large onion, chopped 1 3/4 c. boiling water 1/4 c. margarine 2 1/2 Tbsp. flour 1 1/8 tsp. A. 1. sauce 1/2 tsp. mustard powder 1 1/2 c. milk 6 oz. sharp Cheddar cheese 1 (16 oz.) can tomatoes pinch of parsley or dill weed
directions: Cook vegetables in boiling water until soft. Set aside.

title: Perfect Pear Salad
ingredients: 10 slices thick-cut bacon, cut into large dice 6 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar 1/4 teaspoon coarse sea salt 1/8 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 4 cups (loosely packed) baby spinach leaves 1 Anjou pear, peeled, cored, and cut lengthwise into 1/4-inch-thick slices 3/4 cup coarsely grated Asiago cheese (about 5 ounces) 1/2 cup red bell pepper, cut into fine dice 2 tablespoons shallot, minced
directions: 1. In a large skillet over moderately high heat, saute the bacon, stirring occasionally, until crisp, 10 to 12 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer to a paper-towel-lined plate to drain. Set aside. 2. In a medium bowl, whisk together the oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper. In a large bowl, toss the spinach with half the dressing. 3. Divide the spinach among 4 plates. Top with the pear slices. Sprinkle the bacon, cheese, red pepper, and shallot over each plate. Drizzle with the remaining dressing and serve immediately.

title: Garlic Roasted Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 1 chipotle pepper, dried 3 heads garlic, tops trimed 2 russet potatoes, peeled and chopped 1 gallon water 12 teaspoon chopped fresh oregano 12 teaspoon salt 18 teaspoon black pepper 12 cup buttermilk
directions: Preheat oven to 375, trim the garlic and chipotle, then roast until garlic is golden brow about 20-25 minutes.Bring the water to a boil and add potatoes,oregano,salt and black pepper, boil about 25 minutes or until potatoes are soft enough to pur'ee. Drain potatoes in a colander, transfer to a large mixing bowl whip yo puree' adding the butter milk slowly.Squeeze the garlicfrom each cloce into the potatoes. Mince chipotle, adding as much as you like, the more you add, the spicy it will be. Season to taste.

title: Mary'S Plain Old Simple Ham And Cheese Sandwich
ingredients: 2 slices whole wheat bread or flax bread for low carbohydrate diet 4oz thinly sliced ham (Nieman ham slice cut diagonally ) 2 oz sharp cheddar cheese (Neal's Yard is good) 1/2 FRESH tomato, sliced 1 tbs mayonnaise 1 tbs pesto , preferably home made, but otherwise your favorite store bought
directions: On the first slice of bread spread the pesto Slice the ham thinly and pile on the slice with the pesto. Grate the Cheddar and mix it with the mayo...it makes it easier to handle and put on the other slice of bread. Thinly slice the tomato and place it on top of the cheddar./mayo mixture. Place the slice of bread with the mayo/cheddar mixture and tomato slices on the top of the other slice with the pesto and ham. Using a frying pan toast it on low heat until the cheese melts and the bread toasts to your taste. Turn it over once to evenly toast both sides of the sandwich. Slice the sandwich your favorite direction . Serve.

title: Saucy Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1 lb hot dog, chopped 1 teaspoon yellow mustard 1 cup American cheese, shredded 1 tablespoon onion, chopped 1 teaspoon Worcestershire sauce 1/4 cup tomato soup 12 hot dog buns
directions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Combine all ingredients except buns. Spoon mixture evenly into buns. Wrap individually in foil. Warm in oven 10-15 minutes. Let cool for 5 minutes, unwrap, and enjoy!

title: Reese Cup Cookies
ingredients: 1 roll Pillsbury cookie dough snack-size Reese's cups
directions: Cut roll of dough into 1/4 inch slices. Put each slice into tart pan lined with mini muffin cups.

title: Mackerel Salad With Horseradish Creme Fraiche
ingredients: 11 ounces baby or new potatoes 4 ounce bag salad leaves, like spinach or mache 1 head chicory 9 ounce package cooked beets (comes in a vac pack from the fruit and veg section of the supermarket) 1/4 cup capers 1 Granny Smith apple 1/2 lime 11 ounce package hot smoked mackerel (with or without peppercorns) 1/4 cup roasted hazelnuts (available from supermarkets ready-roasted) Freshly ground black pepper Small handful fresh dill 4 tablespoons horseradish sauce 2 tablespoons low- or full-fat creme fraiche 1 lime Squeeze or dab of honey (optional) Salt and freshly ground black pepper
directions: Put the kettle on to boil. Meanwhile, make the dressing for the salad. Pick and finely chop the dill leaves and add half to a mug or small bowl (reserving the rest for later). Mix in the horseradish sauce, creme fraiche, enough lime juice to taste and honey (if using). Season to taste with salt and pepper and set aside. Wash the potatoes, put in a medium saucepan over a high heat with a little salt and cover with the now-boiled water. Leave to bubble away for about 15 minutes. Put the salad leaves on each of four serving plates or one large serving platter. Trim the end off the chicory, separate the leaves and scatter them over, discarding any damaged outer leaves. Drain the beets and cut into small wedges. Rinse and drain the capers. Quarter and core the apple and then slice it into matchsticks. Toss it in a small bowl with the lime juice and then scatter it over the leaves with the beets and capers. Peel the skin from the back of the mackerel, remove the dark brown meat and then break the flesh into large chunks and arrange on top of the salad. Check that the potatoes are now tender, then drain them well and leave to cool for a moment. Roughly chop the hazelnuts and scatter over the salad. Nestle the potatoes in now also. Drizzle the dressing back and forth over the salad, scatter the remaining dill on top with a twist of black pepper and serve.

title: Gluten Free Corn Spaghetti With Garlic, Red & Yellow Tomatoes, Spinach, Feta & Mint
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups gluten free corn spaghetti 3 cloves garlic peeled& finely minced 1 cup feta drained sheep's, pieces, marinated in oil& herbs, Keep the marinated oil! 6 tablespoons oil this marinated 6 2/3 cups spinach leaves fresh young, cleaned, washed& drained 4 3/8 tablespoons fresh mint leaves cleaned& finely minced 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar a good 2 tomatoes large red, washed, dept dry on kitchen paper, h 3 yellow tomatoes medium, they are more orange,...I used home grown, cleaned, hulled& cut into wedges tomatoes I f you don't have home grown, use another colour then the red salt Herbamare
directions: Cook the pasta according to the packet instructions. Meanwhile, heat a large non stick pan on medium high heat. Add 2 tablespoons of the reserved marinated oil to the pan. When hot & sizzling, add the garlic pieces. Fry for about 1 to 2 minutes. Add the chopped tomatoes & fry for about 2 to 3 minutes or until the tomatoes begin to soften. Add some Herbamare salt, but not too much. Stir gently. Adjust the heat if necessary. Remove the garlic & tomato mix from the pan to a cooking pot with fitting lid. In the same pan add 3 to 4 tablespoons of the marinated oil & heat up. Add the spinach leaves & let it get nearly wilted. Now, add the drained feta pieces, 2 tablespoons of the red wine vinegar & re-add the garlic & tomato mix. Stir gently around. Taste! It has to taste fab! Now, add the finely miced fresh mint & gently stir it around the pan. If necessary, add some Herbamare, according to your taste! Meanwhile, drain the spaghetti, but keep just a bit of the cooking water. Take your spaghettti plate & fill it with pasta. Top with the veggie & feta mix & enjoy with a loved one! Stir the veggies in & under the spaghetti & eat it like this!!

title: Effortless Five-Hour Stew
ingredients: 2 lb. lean stewing beef, cut in bite size pieces 12 small white boiling onions 1 c. chopped celery 2 potatoes, cut in 1-inch pieces 1 slice white bread, cubed 2 (8 oz.) cans tomato sauce with cheese 1 c. water 1 1/2 tsp. salt 1/8 tsp. pepper
directions: Combine all ingredients in large casserole. Cover and bake at 250° for 5 hours. No stirring.

title: Almond Peach Butter
ingredients: 1/2 cup butter, softened 1/3 cup peach preserves 1/2 tsp almond extract 1/2 tsp confectioners sugar
directions: Whip butter with an electric mixer in a small bowl until smooth and fluffy. Gradually add peach preserves, almond extract, and confectioners sugar. Store in an air tight container in refrigerator.

title: Machboos Or Fooga  (Traditional United Arab Emirates Dish)
ingredients: 4 cups water 4 chicken bouillon cubes or 5 teaspoons chicken stock powder 2 tablespoons olive oil 8 -10 bone-in chicken pieces, skin removed (if it is the breast pieces, cut those in half since they are very large) 2 whole dried limes (loomi) 1/8 teaspoon saffron 1 large onion, chopped 1 large tomatoes, chopped 1 garlic clove, minced 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1 1/2 teaspoons ground turmeric 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cumin 1 1/2 teaspoons curry powder 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper (optional) or 1/2 teaspoon chili powder (optional) 3/4 - 1 teaspoon salt 2 cups basmati rice, rinsed and drained
directions: Preheat oven to 375°F and grease a 9x13 baking dish. Bring water to boiling and add chicken bouillon cubes, lower heat and add dried limes and saffron and let simmer till bouillon is dissolved --keep it hot. Sprinkle chicken with half the spices (except the garlic). Heat the olive oil in a large skillet on med-high to high heat and fry the chicken till both sides are brown, lower heat to medium and remove the chicken to a plate. In that same skillet saute the onions for 2 minutes, add tomatoes, garlic and remaining spices and saute another 2 minutes, then turn off the burner. Add the rice and stir for about 30 seconds to 1 minute, till well coated. Spread rice in the baking dish and place the chicken pieces over the rice. Gently press the dried limes on the sides of the pot to distribute flavor in the broth and then poor on the rice and chicken (the whole thing including the dried limes) and cover tightly with foil. Bake for 40-45 minutes--do not open the foil cover at all until the time is up. If you want to eat this the authentic way, you can lay newspaper on the floor (for easy cleanup of spills), put all of this on a very large platter or on a couple large sheets of aluminum foil laid on the newspaper and everyone sits around and eats with their right hand!

title: Ham and Cheese Croquettes
ingredients: 1 cup leftover potatoes from Parsnip-Potato Mash recipe or plain mashed potatoes 1/4 cup all-purpose flour, plus more as needed 1/2 cup finely shredded Gruyere cheese, about 1-ounce 1/2 cup very finely diced cooked ham or country ham, about 2 ounces Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper 1/4 cup vegetable oil, for frying
directions: In a bowl, mix the potatoes, 1/4 cup flour, cheese, and ham with a large rubber spatula until combined. Season with salt and pepper, to taste and divide the mixture into 8 equal portions. Rub your hands with a small amount of flour and form the portions into small flat disks about 1/2-inch thick. Use just enough flour to keep the potatoes from sticking to your hands, but do not coat them completely. Heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-low heat. Shallow-fry the croquettes, turning once, until golden brown, about 4 minutes per side. Remove from the oil and drain on a paper-towel lined plate. Let the croquettes cool for about 5 minutes before serving. Cook's Note: This recipe doubles easily if you have enough leftover potatoes.

title: Pumpkin Spice Pancakes
ingredients: 2 Tablespoons Olive Oil 1 cup Buttermilk 1/2 cups Plain Yogurt 1/2 cups Milk 1/2 teaspoons Vanilla Extract 2 Tablespoons Unsalted Butter, Melted, Plus More For Making Pancakes 1 cup Whole Wheat Flour 1 cup All-purpose Flour 1/4 teaspoons Salt 1 Tablespoon Brown Sugar 2 teaspoons Baking Powder 1 teaspoon Baking Soda 1/8 teaspoons Cinnamon 1/8 teaspoons Nutmeg 1/8 teaspoons Allspice 1/8 teaspoons Mace
directions: In a big glass measuring cup (or something similar), whisk olive oil, buttermilk, yogurt, milk and vanilla extract to mix. Slowly whisk in melted butter. In a big mixing bowl, whisk all dry ingredients together. Once mixed, add wet ingredients to dry ingredients. Mix to combine, making sure to not over-mix. Let pancake batter sit for 10 minutes before preparing into pancakes. This batter will be thicker than your usual pancake batter but do not worry, the pancakes will turn out just fine. Heat a medium skillet (or if you have the electric pancake-making gadget, you can use that, too) over medium heat. Add about 1/2 tablespoon unsalted butter to the skillet. In my opinion, butter is the ideal fat to use while making pancakes, and please do not skimp on butter. Butter is what gives the pancakes those crisp edges that make soft and fluffy pancakes all the more desirable. Use a 1/4 cup measure to pour pancake batter to the skillet and lower heat to medium low. Using a 1/4 cup measure helps to make all the pancakes the same size. Cook pancake until tiny bubbles appear on the surface. Flip the pancake, add butter around the edges, and cook for another minute. This batter will make about 8 to10 pancakes (1/4 cup measure size). Enjoy with maple syrup and fresh seasonal fruits! Notes: 1. If not eating pancakes right away, keep them warm in a 200°F oven in a foil-lined cookie sheet until ready to serve. 2. Store leftovers wrapped in foil in the refrigerator for a couple of days. Reheat in the toaster oven before eating. 3. The pancakes can be frozen-stack, separate with sheets of parchment, wrap in foil, and store in freezer bags. 4. You can use 1/2 teaspoon pumpkin spice mix instead of the spices listed. 5. If using only buttermilk, use 2 cups. 6. If using only yogurt and milk and no buttermilk, use 1 cup each of yogurt and milk.

title: Baked Egg Meringue
ingredients: 2 egg yolks 2 egg whites 1 dash salt 1 dash black pepper
directions: Separate egg yolk from egg white Season egg white then Beat egg white till peak Lightly butter the baking pan then add beaten egg white Make 2 cavity then pour egg yolk onto the cavity Bake it at 200 C or 392 Ffor about 10 minute or till top are lightly brown BELOW ARE FEW EGG RECIPE ,I AM GLAD TO SHARE WITH YOU

title: Mexican Dip
ingredients: 1 large can fried beans 1 lb. ground beef taco seasoning nacho cheese dip large jar salsa or taco sauce Monterey Jack or Mozzarella cheese
directions: First layer in dish is the beans. Second layer is ground beef and taco seasoning cooked together. Third layer is nacho cheese dip. Fourth layer is salsa or taco sauce. Fifth layer is the cheese. Cook about 20 minutes or until hot all the way through. Serve on chips.

title: Poppy Seed Roll(Polish Dessert)
ingredients: 3 1/2 c. unsifted flour 1/4 c. sugar 1 tsp. salt 1 pkg. yeast 1/2 c. milk 1/2 c. water 1/4 c. butter 1 egg
directions: Combine 1 cup flour, sugar, salt and yeast. Heat milk, water and butter to 120°. Add to dry ingredients. Beat for 2 minutes at medium speed. Add egg and 1/2 cup flour. Beat at high speed 2 minutes. Stir in enough flour to make a soft dough.

title: Best Ever Bread And Butter Pickles
ingredients: 4 qt. cucumbers 1/2 c. salt 2 qt. sliced onions 1 qt. vinegar 4 c. sugar 1 tsp. celery seed 2 tsp. mustard seed 1 tsp. ground turmeric 1/2 tsp. white pepper
directions: Stir salt in thinly sliced cucumbers. Cover with ice cubes. Let stand 2 or 3 hours. Drain. Add onions. Mix remaining ingredients. Bring quickly to a boil. Boil 10 minutes. Add cucumbers and onions. Bring to a boiling point. Pack loosely into hot jars and seal.

title: Pronto Vegemite Pasta
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter 1 tablespoon vegemite 1 tablespoon tomato paste 400 g spiral pasta, cooked and drained 1/4 cup shaved parmesan cheese
directions: Combine butter, Vegemite and tomato paste in a saucepan over medium-low heat until butter melts. Add hot pasta and mix well until combined. Serve topped with parmesan cheese. VARIATION: Cook chopped bacon and or sliced mushrooms until golden, stir through pasta with fresh herbs.

title: Pudding Bundt Cake
ingredients: 3 c. Bisquick baking mix 1 c. water 4 eggs 1 c. sugar 1/2 c. Crisco oil 1 pkg. instant pudding (any flavor)
directions: Grease and flour Bundt pan. Beat all ingredients 4 minutes. Bakes 40 to 45 minutes or until done.

title: Apple Custard Bars
ingredients: 3 cups flour 1 teaspoon salt 1 cup cold butter 6 cups peeled sliced tart apples 1 2/3 cups sugar 2 teaspoons cinnamon 2 cups evaporated milk 2 eggs
directions: FOR CRUST:. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Combine flour and salt. Cut in butter until crumbly. Press into bottom and up sides of a 13"x9"x2" cake pan. Put in apples. Combine 2/3 cup sugar with cinnamon. Sprinkle over apples. Bake for 20 minute. Remove from oven. FOR CUSTARD:. Whisk milk, eggs, and rest of sugar until smooth. Pour over apples. Bake 25-30 minutes longer or until knife in center comes out clean. If you're worried the crust will be too browned, whatever is showing up above the custard, just put foil all the way around the edges.

title: Not My Mama Biscuits
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups flour 2 tablespoons baking powder 1/4 cup yogurt 3/4 cup milk 1 teaspoon salt 1/2 cup butter, cold
directions: whisk together the flour, baking powder and salt. work in the butter until pea-sized. stir together the yogurt and milk and add it to the flour mixture, stir until dough forms. on a lightly floured surface flatten into a rectangle fold like a business letter, repeat 3-4 times. on the last turn roll out and cut out your biscuits. brush with milk. bake at 425F for about 15 minutes in a cast iron skillet.

title: Southern Style Spareribs
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. water 2 Tbsp. spicy prepared mustard 1/2 tsp. hot pepper sauce 2 lb. ribs, cut into single ribs 1 envelope Shake 'n Bake for barbecue
directions: Combine water, mustard and pepper sauce; brush on ribs. Empty seasonings and coating mixture into shaker bag. Shake 1 or 2 ribs at a time.	Arrange ribs close together, sides touching in 13 x 9-inch pan. Cover with foil. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes. Uncover and bake 20 minutes longer. Makes 4 servings.

title: Refried Black Bean Burritos
ingredients: 2 cans (15 1/2 Oz. Size) Black Beans 1/4 Green Pepper, Left Whole 1 teaspoon Minced Garlic 1 teaspoon Ground Cumin 1/2 teaspoons Black Pepper 4 whole Flour Tortilla Shells 1 cup Shredded Cheese
directions: Mix beans, pepper, garlic, cumin, and black pepper together in a saucepan. Bring to a slow boil and turn the heat down very low. Let simmer for approximately 20 minutes. Stir to keep the mixture from burning and sticking to bottom of the pain. Discard green pepper before serving (this was used strictly for flavoring purposes). Warm tortillas in microwave for a few seconds and divide the beans evenly among the four tortillas. Top with cheese. Enjoy!

title: Fat Free Dip
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) frozen asparagus spears 3/4 c. picante sauce 1/2 c. tomatoes 1 tsp. oregano 1 1/2 tsp. fat-free cream cheese 1 1/4 Tbsp. cilantro 1/8 tsp. garlic powder dash of garlic salt dash of chili powder 1 pkg. dry butter buds
directions: Blend together with blender for 20 to 30 seconds.

title: Impossible Pie
ingredients: 4 eggs 1/2 c. flour 2 c. milk 1 c. coconut (optional) 1/4 tsp. salt 1 tsp. vanilla 1/2 stick oleo 4 c. sugar
directions: Oleo should be sliced to soften it. Grease a 9-inch pie pan with oleo and sprinkle with sugar. Combine all ingredients in blender and put on mix for 1 minute. Pour in filling. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

title: Five Day Coconut Cake
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) pkg. coconut 1 (16oz.) carton sour cream 2 c. sugar 1 tsp. vanilla 1/2 lb. butter 3 c. sugar 6 eggs 1/4 tsp. soda 1/2 pt. sour cream 3 c. plain flour 1 tsp. vanilla
directions: Mix together coconut, 16 ounce sour cream, 2 cups sugar and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Place	in refrigerator overnight. Next day, cream butter and	3 cups sugar until fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each egg. Stir soda into 1/2 pint of sour cream; add to eggs and sugar alternately with flour. Add vanilla and blend thoroughly.

title: Italian Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts 1 (8 oz.) can tomato sauce 1 pkg. spaghetti sauce mix 1 c. grated Mozzarella cheese 2 c. Italian salad dressing 1/2 c. grated Parmesan cheese
directions: Marinate chicken breasts in Italian salad dressing for 2 to 4 hours.

title: Pear & Coffee Frappe
ingredients: 2 teaspoons instant coffee 2 tablespoons sugar or 2 tablespoons preferred artificial sweetener 1 tablespoon hot water 34 cup water, chilled 2 tablespoons cream 14 cup pear juice, chilled crushed ice
directions: Dissolve instant coffee and sugar in hot water. Combine in shaker or blender with remaining ingredients. Shake or blend until frothy. Pour into serving glasses. Top up with extra ice and garnish with a slice of pear.

title: Rotini With Zucchini and Cannellini
ingredients: 3 teaspoons minced garlic 1 -2 teaspoon red pepper flakes (to taste) 2 tablespoons olive oil 1 lb zucchini, thinly sliced 1 12 cups vegetable broth 12 cup fresh parsley, chopped 1 grated lemon, zest of 1 (12 ounce) can cannellini beans, drained 12 teaspoon salt (optional) 14 teaspoon pepper (to taste) 1 lemon, juice of 2 large tomatoes, coarsely chopped 1 (16 ounce) package rotini pasta, cooked al dente, drained and kept warm 1 cup fresh basil, chopped grated parmesan cheese
directions: In a large skillet over medium heat, saute garlic and red pepper flakes in oil 1 minute. Add zucchini, turn heat to high and stir fry 1 minute. Add broth through lemon zest, turn heat back to medium and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in cannelini and heat through (about 1 minute). Remove from heat, season with salt and pepper, and stir in lemon juice. Add tomatoes, cooked rotini, and basil; toss to mix thoroughly. Transfer to bowls and top with grated parmesan.

title: Pistachio Cake
ingredients: 4 Eggs 8 oz. Sour Cream 1 bx. Yellow Cake Mix 1/2 c. Vegetable Oil 1/4 c. Water 1 bx. Instant Pistachio Pudding
directions: 1. Grease tube or bundt pan and coat with a mixture of cinnamon and sugar (This mixture can be made to your own taste). 2. Pour batter in and sprinkle remaining cinnamon mixture on top of cake. 3. Bake in preheated 325° oven for approx 1 hour (Use knife check).

title: Gemelli with Garlic, Herbs, and Bocconcini Mozzarella
ingredients: 1 pound dried gemelli or fusilli 2 large garlic cloves 2 cups packed fresh basil leaves 1 cup packed fresh flat-leafed parsley leaves 1/2 pound lightly salted bocconcini mozzarella (see note, above) 1/2 teaspoon dried hot red pepper flakes 1/4 cup extra-virgin olive oil 2 tablespoons red-wine vinegar, or to taste 1 cup packed small arugula leaves
directions: Fill a 6-quart pasta pot three fourths full with salted water and bring to a boil for pasta. Mince garlic and chop herbs. Quarter large bocconcini and halve smaller ones. In a large bowl toss cheese with garlic, herbs, red pepper flakes, oil, and salt to taste. Cook pasta in boiling water, stirring occasionally, until al dente and ladle out and reserve 1/4 cup pasta water. Drain pasta in a colander. Stir vinegar and arugula into cheese mixture and add hot pasta and 1/4 cup reserved pasta water, gently tossing (and adding more pasta water as needed if mixture becomes dry) until combined well.

title: Dirt Dessert
ingredients: 1 lb. Oreos, crushed 8 oz. cream cheese 1 c. powdered sugar 1 small instant vanilla pudding 1 1/2 c. milk 1 tsp. vanilla 1 (8 oz.) Cool Whip
directions: Blend Oreos, cream cheese and sugar together. Mix until thick the pudding, milk and vanilla. Add the Cool Whip. Layer in a bowl, cookie mixture, then pudding mixture and repeat ending with cookie mixture.

title: Microwave Peach Crisp
ingredients: 2 medium peaches, sliced (about 3 cups) or (15 ounce) cans peaches, drained 3/4 cup Bisquick (tm) 1/2 cup quick-cooking oats 1/2 cup packed brown sugar 3 tablespoons butter or 3 tablespoons margarine, softened 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
directions: Place peaches in a square 8 X 8 X 2 microwave safe dish. Mix remaining ingredients until crumbly and then sprinkle over the peaches. Microwave uncovered on 100% power for 6 minutes. Rotate dish 1/2 turn. Continue to microwave uncovered until peaches are tender, 4-6 minutes longer.

title: *Russian Tea
ingredients: 1/2 c. Tang 1/3 c. instant tea 1/4 c. sugar 1/2 tsp. cinnamon 1/8 tsp. cloves
directions: Mix all ingredients. For each cup of hot water, use approximately 1 level tablespoon or to taste. For pot, use ingredients listed and add to 10- cups of hot water; heat. Serves 10 cups.

title: Grilled Halibut With Korean Bbq Sauce
ingredients: 4 tablespoons olive oil, divided 2 garlic cloves, minced 1 1/2 teaspoons minced serrano chilies, with seeds 1/3 cup soy sauce 1/4 cup dark brown sugar, packed 3 tablespoons rice vinegar 3 tablespoons water 1 tablespoon sesame oil 8 baby bok choy, halved lengthwise 4 medium Japanese eggplants, halved lengthwise 4 (6 ounce) halibut fillets 2 green onions, thinly sliced
directions: Heat one tbsp olive oil in heavy small saucepan over medium heat. Add garlic and chili; saute until fragrant and lightly golden, about 3 minutes.
