directions: In a large kettle, add the beans and pour in water. You want the water to cover with enough water about 2 inches above beans. Cover and let stand overnight. Bring beans to a boil for 2 minutes. Remove from heat and cover for 1 hour or until tender. Drain the beans and add the 8 cups of water. Then add ham, onions, and garlic. Bring the water to a boil and cook the bean for 10 minutes. Then reduce the kettle's heat to low and simmer for 2 hours. Then remove the ham. Allow the ham to cool, then cut into 1/2- inch pieces. Return ham to the kettle. You add the cumin, oregano, cilantro, and pepper next. Continue to simmer for an additional 1 hour. The beans should be very tender and with little liquid. If the beans become too dry, add a little water. If the beans are too soupy, continue to cook. Now is the time to add the salt. Cut limes into wedges and squeeze into beans.

title: Nutty Peach Crisp
ingredients: 1 (29 ounce) cansliced undrained peaches 1 (18 1/4 ounce) package yellow cake mix 12 cup melted butter or 12 cup margarine 1 cup flaked coconut 1 cup chopped pecans
directions: arrange peaches in an ungreased 13 inch x 9 inch x 2 inch baking dish. sprinkle dry cake over the top. drizzle with melted butter. sprinkle with coconut and pecans. i mixed the two together and then sprinkled over cake. bake at 325 degrees for 55-60 minutes or until golden brown. let stand for 15 minutes before serving. serve warm or cold.

title: Canned Okra
ingredients: 1 gal. cut up okra 2 1/2 Tbsp. canning salt 7 or 8 Tbsp. apple cider vinegar
directions: Cover with water. Let it come to a boil (not over 1 minute). Put in jars and seal. Be sure to use canning salt and vinegar. When you open a jar to cook, drain and rinse well with cold water. Let drain well, then batter and fry or put in stews.

title: Homemade Coconut Pittu
ingredients: 1/2 pounds, 7/8 ounces, weight Rice Flour 7 ounces, weight Grated Coconut 2 teaspoons Salt To Taste 3 tablespoons, 1 teaspoon, 2-1/3 pinches Water
directions: Sift the rice flour and put it to a bowl. Add grated coconut, salt and mix well. Slowly pour in the water, mixing with your fingers as you do so until the mixture resembles bread crumbs. Place the mixture in a pittu mold and steam for about 7 minutes until cooked (when steam emerges from the pittu mold). Transfer to a plate and cut into pieces. Serve with curry. Enjoy.

title: Any Time Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1/2 lb. tender beefsteak 2 Tbsp. cornstarch, divided 3 Tbsp. Kikkoman soy sauce, divided 1/2 tsp. sugar 1 clove garlic, minced 1 lb. fresh broccoli 2 Tbsp. vegetable oil, divided 2 stalks celery, cut diagonally into 1/4-inch thick slices 1 medium onion, chunked 1 clove garlic, minced salt
directions: Cut meat into thin, narrow strips. Combine 1 tablespoon each: cornstarch, soy sauce, sugar and 1 clove garlic. Stir in meat; let stand 30 minutes.

title: Chicken a La Charlie
ingredients: 8 -10 chicken pieces 1 teaspoon garlic powder 34 teaspoon poultry seasoning 14 teaspoon pepper 12 cup chopped brown onion 12 cup fresh sliced mushrooms 1 cup sour cream 1 (10 ounce) can cream of mushroom soup 1 (10 ounce) can cream of chicken soup 34 cup dry white wine (no Chardonnay)
directions: Place chicken in oblong pan and sprinkle with garlic powder, poultry seasoning and pepper. In large bowl blend soups and sour cream with wire whisk. Add wine slowly until blended, pour over chicken and bake 50 minutes. Remove chicken and stir in onions and mushrooms. Return to oven and bake an additional 25 minutes. Serve over your favorite rice or noodles.

title: Buttermilk Pancakes
ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour 2 tablespoons white sugar or 2 tablespoons brown sugar 4 teaspoons baking powder 1 teaspoon salt 2 large eggs, room temp 1 cup buttermilk, at room temp 1/2 1/2 cup butter or 1/2 cup oil, melted 1/2 - 1 cup whole milk or 1/2-1 cup additional buttermilk
directions: In large bowl,combine dry ingredient . In med bowl, combine wet ingredients except for the whole milk! Stir wet ingredients into dry ingredients. At this point the batter will be very thick and lumpy. Take a little of the whole milk at a time and stir in just enough so that the batter is profitable, but not to thin. The batter should be a little lumpy. Pour about 1/4c. batter onto a lightly greased, hot griddle, but not to hot otherwise the pancakes will not be done on the inside. Turn when bubbles form on top of pancakes and the sides of pancake will be dull. Cook until golden brown. DO NOT FLATTEN THE PANCAKES TO SEE IF THEY ARE DONE!

title: Sautéed Chicken Breasts With Cherry-Port Sauce
ingredients: 2 teaspoons olive oil 1/2 cup chopped red onion 1/2 teaspoon curry powder 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon 4 (4-ounce) skinned, boned chicken breast halves 1/4 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon black pepper 1/3 cup ruby port or other sweet red wine 1/4 cup fat-free, less-sodium chicken broth 1/4 cup cherry preserves or seedless raspberry jam
directions: Heat olive oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add onion, curry, and cinnamon; saute for 2 minutes. Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper, and add to skillet. Saute for 2 minutes on each side. Add the port, broth, and preserves, stirring until preserves melt. Cover, reduce heat, and simmer for 10 minutes or until the chicken is done.

title: Local Clams With Herb Butter
ingredients: 1 cup unsalted butter, softened 1 1/2 teaspoons whole coriander seeds, toasted and crushed, or 1 teaspoon ground coriander 2 red jalapeno chiles, seeded and diced 2 garlic cloves, minced 1/4 cup lime zest 1/3 cup fresh lime juice 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro 1/2 cup chopped fresh parsley 1/3 cup sliced green onions 24 clams in shells, scrubbed 1 1/4 cups water, divided 1 baguette, sliced 1 lime, sliced Garnishes: chopped fresh cilantro, green onions
directions: Combine butter and next 8 ingredients in a large bowl; chill until ready to use. Combine clams and 3/4 cup water in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Bring to a boil, cover, and simmer 5 minutes or until clams open. Discard clams that remain closed. Drain; return clams to pan. Add butter mixture and remaining 1/2 cup water to pan. Cook over medium-high heat 2 minutes or until butter melts. Grill bread and lime slices 1 to 2 minutes on each side. Arrange bread on platter, top with clams and butter sauce, and serve with grilled lime slices. Garnish, if desired. Serve immediately.

title: Ham Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) pkg. sliced, boiled ham 1 (3 oz.) pkg. cream cheese, softened Ranch salad dressing
directions: Mix the cream cheese with enough Ranch dressing to make it spreadable. Spread a thin layer on the ham and roll it up lengthwise. Chill for about 30 minutes and then slice into bite size pinwheels and skewer with a toothpick, then serve. This is excellent with most any type of cracker.

title: Pumpin Cranberry Muffins!
ingredients: 2 12 cups unbleached flour 1 tablespoon baking powder 12 teaspoon salt 2 teaspoons cinnamon 1 teaspoon ginger 12 teaspoon nutmeg 13 cup soymilk 14 cup olive oil 12 cup pure maple syrup 1 teaspoon stevia 2 teaspoons grated orange zest (zest from one orange) 15 ounces pumpkin puree (fresh or from a can) 2 teaspoons vanilla 1 12 cups fresh cranberries, lightly chopped
directions: Preheat oven to 400F. Spray muffins tins with non stick cooking sparay or lightly grease them with margarine or oil. I don't suggest using paper liners, they tend to stick to them. Sift together flour, baking powder, salt and spices. In a seperate bowl, wisk together pumpkin, maple syrup, brown rice syrup, oil, soymilk and vanilla, until well emulsified. Add orange zest to this mixture. Pour wet ingredients into dry and combine with a large wooden spoon or a stiff spatula. Fold in cranberries. The batter will seem too thick, but it's fine. Fill muffin tins (with an ice cream scooper, if you have one). You want to over fill them so they puff out all nice and big. Bake 20 - 24 minutes.

title: Creamy Roasted Broccoli And Caramelized Onion Soup
ingredients: roasted vegetables Leftover chicken broth thyme milk
directions: Simply take your roasted vegetables, and cover with chicken or vegetable broth. I usually add enough to cover the veggies, adding another inch or two in the pan. Add your favorite herb (thyme is always good), and bring to a boil for five minutes until veggies are very tender. Transfer to a blender and puree. Remember! Hot liquid in a blender can explode, so take care to blend on a low speed and lightly cover to allow steam to escape. Once veggies are soup consistency in the blender, add 1 cup low fat milk (more or less, depending on how thick or thin your soup is) to add that creamy color and texture to your soup.

title: Avocados With Honey (Cape Verde Islands) Abacates Com Mel
ingredients: 2 large avocados 14 cup honey (to taste) avocado leaves or lettuce
directions: Carefully cut each avocado in half lengthwise and remove the pit. Scoop the flesh from the avocado, leaving the 2 shell halves intact. Place the avocado meat in a bowl and sweeten it with honey to taste. Replace the sweetened avocado in the shells, cover them with plastic wrap, and chill them. Serve them cold on a bed of avocado leaves, if available, or use a bed of lettuce.

title: Blueberry Belle Crunch
ingredients: 4 cups blueberries 1 cup sugar 3 tbsp flour 4 tbsp lemon juice 2 cups oatmeal 2 cups flour 1 cup brown sugar 1 cup margarine 1/2 tsp salt 1 tsp vanilla
directions: Mix first four ingredients and put in bottom of 9x13 pan. Mix remaining ingredients over top of blueberry mixture. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes.

title: Pesto
ingredients: 2 packed c. basil leaves, washed and dried 2 cloves garlic, peeled, chopped 1/2 c. good quality olive oil 1/4 c. pine nuts (heaping) 1 Tbsp. freshly grated Parmesan or Romano cheese
directions: Blend basil, garlic and olive oil in blender or food processor until smooth. Add pine nuts and cheese; blend until smooth. When ready to use, add more cheese if desired.

title: 5 Ingredients Slow Cooker Beef Burritos
ingredients: 1 (2 lb) london broil beef 1 (1 1/4 ounce) package taco seasoning mix 1 cup chopped onion 1 tablespoon white vinegar 1 garlic clove, minced cooking spray
directions: Rub London broil with taco seasoning. Spray slow cooker with cooking spray. Place onion in slow cooker top with meat. Sprinkle with vinegar. Cook on low for 8 hours. Serve with flour or corn tortillas and your favorite burrito or taco toppings. Re: lettuce, cheese, tomatoes, sour cream and salsa.

title: Coffee Coke (Low Calorie) Copycat - Coca Cola Blak
ingredients: 2 teaspoons instant coffee 1 teaspoon unsweetened dutch cocoa 2 teaspoons sugar (or substitute) 2 tablespoons hot water 1 cup Diet Coke (or other brand) 2 tablespoons skim milk (whole milk tastes better)
directions: Add first three ingredients to a heat proof glass or large cup. Add the hot water and mix well. Fill glass up with coke. Add milk and stir well. Enjoy!

title: Chicken Italiano
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil 12 medium onion 3 garlic cloves, minced 2 (14 ounce) cans Italian plum tomatoes 12 teaspoon pepper 12 teaspoon basil 12 teaspoon oregano 4 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley parmesan cheese 8 boneless skinless chicken breasts 2 eggs 4 tablespoons milk flour (for dredging) 8 tablespoons butter
directions: For the sauce: Heat the oil in a frying pan; add the onion, sliced thin and separated into crescents, and the minced garlic. Stir over medium heat until the onion is golden and translucent. Drain the tomatoes; chop in a blender for three seconds only. Slowly pour the pureed tomatoes into the frying pan, stirring constantly. Add the seasonings; mix well and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. For the chicken: Cut the chicken breast in half half horizontally by placing one hand firmly on top of the meat while carefully cutting the meat with a small, sharp knife. Place the thin fillets in a bowl with one egg white and stir gently with a fork to coat all the meat lightly. Set aside. Melt about 4 T of butter in a skillet over medium-high heat. Salt and pepper the meat lightly; dip into the flour to coat lightly. In a shallow bowl beat together the remaining egg yolk, the whole egg, and the 4 T of milk. Dip each piece of floured chicken into the egg mixture and carefully place in the hot butter. Saute each fillet about 2-3 minutes on each side. They will be a golden color. Remove to a plate and keep warm as you saute the remaining chicken. Add remaining butter as needed. To serve: Arrange the Pasta Verde (see Recipe #53245) on a large serving platter making a trench down the center. Place the sauteed chicken down the center in an overlapping row. Pour some of the sauce over the chicken and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Serve the remaining sauce in a small dish at the table.

title: Wiener Sausage and Egg Flower For Bento
ingredients: 1 few Wiener sausage 1 Egg 1 dash Salt 1 dash less than 1/2 teaspoon Katakuriko 1 dash less than a teaspoon Water
directions: Cut the wiener sausages to your desired length, then make three shallow slices horizontally and vertically into one end. Brown in a skillet. Mix together the egg, salt, katakuriko, water (mix the katakuriko with the water first). Make 1 sheet of usuyaki tamago. Cut the fried egg sheet to the same length as the wiener sausages. Cut slices into one end to create a fringe. Wrap the wieners with the egg and secure with a toothpick to finish.

title: Q’S Pig ‘N Potato Soup
ingredients: 3/4 pounds Bacon 2 cloves Garlic, Minced 1 Tablespoon Onion, Finely Diced 10 cups Water 5 teaspoons Chicken Bouillon (or 5 Cubes) 1/2 teaspoons Black Pepper 1/2 teaspoons Smoked Paprika 1/2 pounds Cubed Ham 6 whole Medium Potatoes, Sliced Into 1/4 Inch Slices And Quartered 1-1/2 cup Heavy Cream Shredded Cheddar Cheese And Chives For Garnish
directions: 1. Cut 1/2 pound of bacon into about 1/4 inch pieces prior to cooking. Saute 1/2 pound of the bacon with the garlic and onion over medium heat for 10-15 minutes. Set aside. 2. Fry remaining 1/4 pound of bacon and once it's crispy, remove from grease to cool. Once it's cooled, crumble it to be used as garnish. 3. Combine water, bouillon, pepper and paprika in an 8 quart stock pot and heat to boiling. 4. Add bacon from step 1 and potatoes and cook until potatoes are soft (about 20 minutes). 5. Add cream and heat on low until heated through (do not boil). 6. Serve with a garnish of cheddar cheese, bacon (from step 2) and sprinkled with chives.

title: Chewy Chocolate Cookies
ingredients: 1 1/4 c. butter 2 c. sugar 2 eggs 2 tsp. vanilla 2 c. flour 3/4 c. cocoa 1 tsp. baking soda 1/2 tsp. salt 1 c. nuts or chips
directions: Cream the butter and sugar in a large mixing bowl. Add eggs and vanilla; blend well. Combine flour, cocoa, baking soda and salt in another bowl. Blend into creamed mixture. Stir in nuts or chips. Drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 8 to 9 minutes. Cookies will puff during baking and flatten upon cooling. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Buffalo Shrimp With Fettuccine & Bleu Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 10 ounces dry fettuccine or 10 ounces pappardelle pasta 1 tablespoon olive oil 3/4 lb medium shrimp, peeled and deveined 2 garlic cloves, minced 1 tablespoon butter 1 tablespoon hot sauce, to taste (I prefer Chohula's) 1/2 teaspoon paprika 3 tablespoons chopped fresh chives or 3 tablespoons parsley fresh chives (to garnish) or parsley (to garnish) For Bleu Cheese Sauce 1/4 cup finely chopped onion 2 teaspoons olive oil 2 garlic cloves, minced (or more to taste) 1/2 teaspoon sugar 1 cup half-and-half 4 ounces crumbled blue cheese (about 1 cup)
directions: First, make the Bleu Cheese Sauce: Combine the onion, oil, garlic and sugar in a medium saucepan. Cook, stirring, over medium heat until the onion is tender, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from the heat and stir in the blue cheese until nearly melted. Now, cook the pasta according to package directions. While the pasta cooks, prepare the shrimp. Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat. Add the shrimp and cook, stirring occasionally, until nearly pink, about 1 1/2 minutes. Stir in the garlic, butter, and hot sauce and cook until the shrimp is just opaque in the center, about1 1/2 minutes longer. Remove from the heat and stir in the paprika; set aside. Drain the pasta well and put it in a large bowl. Stir in the warm blue cheese sauce. Gently mix in the chopped chives or parsley. Spoon the pasta onto individual plates. Top with the shrimp and sauce. Garnish as desired.

title: Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 1 small shell macaroni (16 oz. box) 1 can tomato soup 3/4 c. sugar 3/4 c. vinegar 3/4 c. oil 1 small onion 1 small green pepper 4 oz. chopped pimento
directions: Boil shells according to package and drain. Chop onion and green pepper. Mix all ingredients and marinate overnight, stirring occasionally. Serves 20.

title: Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen vegetables 1 c. chopped celery 1 c. green peppers 1/2 c. chopped onions 1 can kidney beans, washed 1/2 c. vinegar 1/2 c. sugar 1 Tbsp. dark prepared mustard 1 tsp. salt 1 Tbsp. cornstarch
directions: Cook and cool frozen vegetables. When cool, add celery, green peppers, onions and kidney beans. Cook the following: vinegar, sugar, prepared mustard, salt and cornstarch. Cook until thick. Let cool and add vegetables. Refrigerate several hours or overnight.

title: Lemon Tarragon Green Beans
ingredients: 2 pounds green beans, trimmed 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil 3 tablespoons fresh lemon juice, or to taste 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh tarragon leaves, or to taste Garnish: tarragon sprigs
directions: In a large kettle of boiling salted water blanch beans in 2 batches 2 to 3 minutes, or until just tender. With a slotted spoon transfer beans as blanched to a large bowl filled with ice and cold water. Drain beans well and pat dry, Beans may be prepared up to this point 1 day ahead and chilled covered. Just before serving, in a large bowl toss together beans, oil, lemon juice, tarragon, and salt and pepper to taste. Serve beans garnished with tarragon sprigs.

title: Pumpkin Chocolate Chip And Caramel Bars
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups flour 2 teaspoons cinnamon 1/2 teaspoon baking soda 1/4 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice 1 cup butter melted 1 cup brown sugar 1/2 cup granulated sugar 1 egg 1 teaspoon vanilla 1 can pumpkin puree 3/4 cup semi sweet chocolate chips caramel sauce
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Line a 9x13-inch baking dish with parchment paper or spray with non-stick cooking spray. In a bowl, combine the flour, cinnamon, baking soda, salt, and Pumpkin Pie Spice. In another bowl, combine the butter, brown sugar and granulated sugar. Stir in the egg and vanilla, then add in the pumpkin. Add in the dry ingredients and stir just until combined. Fold in the chocolate chips. Bake for 30-40 minutes or until cooked through. Top with caramel.

title: Quick Pasta & Sauce
ingredients: Pasta of your choice
directions: Place pasta in a frying pan with enough cold water to cover plus 1/2 inch; Cook pasta - remove from water; Remaining water can be spiced, thickened etc. for sauce of your choice.

title: Sugar Free Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients: 2 cups all purpose flour 1 teaspoon baking soda 1/2 teaspoon salt 1 cup butter which is 2 sticks 1/3 cup brown sugar Splenda 1/3 cup granulated sugar Splenda 2 teaspoons vanilla 2 eggs 1 1/3 cups sugar free chocolate chips 8 oz. pkg 1 cup chopped nuts optional
directions: Heat your oven to 375 degrees. Stir together flour,baking soda and salt. Beat your butter, granulated sugar, brown sugar and vanilla in a large bowl until creamy. Add your eggs one at a time and beat well. Gradually add your flour mixture while you beat well. Stir in your chocolate chips and nuts, if you desire. Place a tbsp worth of rounded batter onto a non-greased cookie sheet. Bake for 7-9 minutes or until edges are lightly browned. Cool slightly, remove from the cookies sheet to a wire rack or I use a cooling plate. Cool completely . Makes about 4- 1/2 dozen depending on how big you make your cookies when you drop them on the pan.

title: Brainy Bran Muffins
ingredients: 8 tablespoons butter room temperature 1/2 cup brown sugar 1/4 cup honey 2 large eggs 113 cups flour, all-purpose 1 1/2 teaspoons cinnamon ground 1/2 teaspoon salt 1 1/2 cups bran flakes cereal cereal 1 1/2 cups buttermilk 1/2 cup raisins, seedless
directions: Place paper liners inside muffin tin. Preheat oven to 375~. Combine butter and sugar in mixing bowl and cream together until smooth. Add honey and blend. Add eggs and blend on low speed. Mixture will look soupy. Add 1/2 the flour, all of the baking soda, cinnamon and salt. Add bran flakes and blend. Add 1/2 the buttermilk and blend. Then add the remaining flour, followed by the remaining buttermilk. Blend until smooth. Stir in raisins. Spoon batter into muffin tin until 3/4 full. Bake for 25 minutes. Let muffins cool for 10 minutes, then remove from pan. Cool completely before wrapping in plastic wrap to freeze. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Apple Cake
ingredients: 1 c. sugar 1/4 c. butter 1 egg 1 c. flour 1 tsp. soda 1 tsp. cinnamon 2 c. apples 1 c. nuts
directions: Mix the first 3 ingredients. Add flour, soda, cinnamon, apples and nuts. Bake 45 minutes at 350°. Top with whipped cream.

title: Impossible Quiche
ingredients: 12 slices crumbled bacon 1 c. Swiss cheese or Cheddar cheese (4 slices) 1/3 c. chopped onions 2 c. Bisquick 4 eggs 1/4 tsp. salt pepper to taste
directions: Sprinkle bacon, cheese and onions onto bottom of lightly greased pie plate. Beat remaining ingredients on high speed for 1 minute. Pour into pie plate. Bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes.

title: Chicken Rice Dish
ingredients: 1 fryer chicken, cut up 1 can cream of mushroom soup 1 pkg. dry onion soup 1 c. rice 1 soup can water 1 soup can white wine
directions: Put uncooked rice in bottom of a 9 x 12-inch Pyrex baking dish. In a separate bowl, mix the mushroom soup, water and wine together and pour over rice. Roll cut pieces of chicken in dry onion soup and place on top of rice mixture. Cover with lid or foil. Bake in a 375° oven for 30 minutes. Uncover and check to see if liquid still in dish as some rice takes more liquid than others. Finish baking, uncovered, 30 minutes or until chicken is tender. Good leftover just adding water. Cover and warm up 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Sweet Golden Cornbread
ingredients: 2 cups yellow cornmeal 2 cups all-purpose flour 1/2 cup sugar 8 teaspoons baking powder 1 teaspoon salt 2 eggs 2 cups milk 1/2 cup cooking oil
directions: Sift dry ingredients together in a large mixing bowl. Mix together egg, milk, and cooking oil in a small bowl. Slowly stir the liquid mixture in with the dry ingredients until fairly smooth. Pour into greased 9x12 pan. Bake in pre-heated 425 degree oven for 20-25 minutes.

title: Sesame and Green Onion Skewered Beef
ingredients: 1 tablespoon brown sugar 60 ml sesame oil 60 ml soy sauce 2 tablespoons ginger, finely grated 1 garlic clove, finely chopped 500 g filet of beef, cut into 2 cm (3/4 inch slices) 4 green onions, halved crossways and cut into 2 inch strips 4 tablespoons coriander leaves, to serve
directions: Place sugar, sesame oil, soy sauce, ginger and garlic in a shallow, non-metal bowl. Add beef, cover and chill for minimum of 1 hour or overnight. Thread beef and onionsonto skewers (pre-soaked, if using wooden). Lightly oil a barbecue grill and head to medium high. Cook skewered beef, turning once, for 6 minutes (or to desired done-ness), occasionally basting with marinade. Serve with extra sesame oil and soy sauce and coriander leaves.

title: Ultimate Banana Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups butter, softened 2 1/2 cups sugar 1 (3 ounce) package banana instant pudding 6 bananas 4 eggs 2 teaspoons vanilla extract 2 teaspoons baking soda 4 cups flour 1 1/2 teaspoons salt 1 cup 2% low-fat milk 2 teaspoons vinegar (let sit in milk for 5 minutes before adding to recipe)
directions: Cream butter, sugar and pudding mix in mixing bowl. Hand mash bananas and add to butter mixture. Stir in milk + vinegar. Gradually add eggs, flour vanilla, baking soda and salt. Pour batter evenly into 6 mini loaf pans or 4 larger loaf pnas. Bake approximately 45 minutes - 1 hour depending on oven and altitude. Bread is done when toothpick comes out clean.

title: Smoked Salmon Chowder With Dried Cherries
ingredients: 14 lb salt pork (ground) 2 medium onions, peeled and medium dice 3 carrots, peeled and medium dice 3 stalks celery, medium dice 2 cups chicken stock 2 tablespoons tomato paste 3 cups milk 1 cup dried cherries 3 -4 large russet potatoes, peeled and medium dice 1 cup heavy cream 1 cup frozen corn, thawed 8 ounces smoked salmon, flaked 2 teaspoons dried thyme 1 12 tablespoons chopped fresh chives
directions: Heat a large heavy bottom pot over medium/high heat. Add the bacon or salt pork and stir until it renders and begins to brown. Add the onion, carrot, and celery and saute until the vegetables start to soften, about 3 minutes. Add the stock, tomato paste and milk and bring to a simmer. Add the cherries, potatoes, cream and corn and simmer for about 15 minutes - be careful not to let it boil! Add the salmon and thyme and simmer for about 15 minutes more. Garnish with the chives and taste and adjust the seasoning with salt and white pepper.

title: Pizza Rice Casserole
ingredients: 2/3 c. rice (or 2 c. leftover rice) 1/4 t. garlic salt dash pepper 1 t. parsley flakes 1 lb. ground beef 2 c. tomato sauce 1 t. sugar 1/4 t. oregano 1 1/2 c. cottage cheese
directions: In large skillet brown the ground beef and onion. Add tomato sauce, garlic, sugar, pepper, oregano, parsley flakes. Cover and simmer for 15 min. Cook rice and combine with cottage cheese, 1/4 t. oregano, and 1/2 t. Italian seasoning. Put 1/2 of rice mixture in a buttered 2 qt. casserole. Top with 1/2 of meat-tomato sauce. Alternate layers, ending with tomato sauce. Sprinkle with 1/2 c. shredded cheese and parmesan cheese as desired. Bake at 325 degrees for 30 min.

title: Crunchy Carrot Ball
ingredients: 1 (3 ounce) package cream cheese 1/2 cup shredded Cheddar cheese 2 teaspoons honey 1 1/4 cups shredded carrot 1/2 cup wheat and barley nugget cereal (e.g. Grape-NutsTM) 2 tablespoons dried parsley
directions: Beat together cream cheese and Cheddar cheese. Stir in honey and carrots. Refrigerate the mixture until cooled. When the mixture is cool, shape it into balls. Combine the cereal and parsley. Roll the balls in the cereal-parsley mixture and serve.

title: Caesar Salad Nicoise
ingredients: 3 cups tightly packed torn mixed salad greens 1 cup halved trimmed fresh green beans, cooked, cooled 1 cup grape tomatoes 1/4 cup slivered red onions 1/4 cup small pitted black olives 1/4 cup KRAFT Caesar with Bacon Dressing 1 pouch (2.6 oz.) chunk albacore tuna in water 1 hard-cooked egg, sliced 2 Tbsp. KRAFT Shredded Parmesan Cheese
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients in large bowl. Add dressing; toss to coat. Place on 2 salad plates. Top with tuna, eggs and cheese.

title: Taylor's Shrimp with Spaghetti in Garlic-Butter Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons unsalted butter 1 clove garlic, chopped 3 large shrimp, peeled and deveined 1 cup cooked spaghetti Large lettuce leaf, for garnish 2 lemon wedges
directions: Heat the butter in a skillet over medium heat until melted. Add the garlic. Cook for a few seconds, and then add the shrimp and cook for 4 minutes. Add the spaghetti and cook until just heated through. Lay the lettuce on a plate and top with the spaghetti and shrimp. Squeeze lemon juice over the top and garnish with the remaining wedge. This recipe was created by a contestant during a cooking competition. The Food Network Kitchens have not tested it for home use, therefore, we cannot make any representation as to the results.

title: Crock Pot Sausage And Peppers
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs mild Italian sausage 2 (14 ounce) cans stewed tomatoes 1 (24 ounce) jar spaghetti sauce (I use Prego Traditional, but you can use your favorite) 3 -4 bell peppers, sliced (red, orange, yellow) 1 onion, sliced
directions: Place onions and peppers, then sausage in crock pot. Pour the stewed tomatoes on top of the sausage, then the spaghetti sauce. Sometimes I add a touch of water to make more sauce. Cook in crock pot for 6-8 hours on low, 3-4 hours on high.

title: Spinach Squares
ingredients: 3 eggs, beaten 1 c. flour 1 c. milk 1 tsp. baking powder 1 tsp. salt 1 lb. shredded Cheddar cheese 2 pkg. chopped spinach, well drained
directions: Melt 1/2 stick margarine in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix ingredients together and spread in pan. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes. Cut in squares when cool.

title: Jeremiah Sweeny'S Broccoli Soup
ingredients: 1 pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed 2 cans cream of mushroom soup 1 can cream of celery soup 1 can Cheddar cheese soup 2 soup cans milk 1 soup can water 1 stick margarine celery salt and onion flakes
directions: Combine all soups, thawed broccoli, milk and water. Heat thoroughly, but do not boil. Add stick of margarine and season with celery salt and onion flakes to taste. Add more liquid if you prefer a thinner soup.

title: A-M's One Pot Pasta
ingredients: 3 14 cups pasta, eg farfalle 3 cups water 2 teaspoons chicken flavoured vegetable stock powder 7 ounces basil pesto 2 medium tomatoes, chopped 15 ounces cannellini beans, cooked 13 cup parmesan cheese, grated ground black pepper, to taste
directions: Combine pasta, water and stock powder in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil. Cook, stirring frequently, for 8 to 10 minutes or until pasta is tender and broth has reduced to about 1/2 cup; do not drain. Reduce heat; add pesto. Cook, stirring frequently, until sauce has reduced slightly. Stir in tomatoes and beans. Cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through. Sprinkle with cheese before serving. Season with ground black pepper.

title: Picadillo
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef 1 medium onion, chopped 2 garlic cloves, minced 1 can (14-1/2 ounces) diced tomatoes, undrained 1 medium tart apple, peeled and chopped 1/3 cup raisins 1 tablespoon chili powder 3/4 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin 1/4 teaspoon allspice 1/4 teaspoon pepper
directions: In a large skillet, cook beef, onion and garlic over medium heat until meat is no longer pink; drain. Add the tomatoes, apple, raisins and seasonings; mix well. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes.

title: Capellini With Hot Garlic Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil 4 cloves garlic, minced 12 cup minced onion 12 red bell pepper, thinly sliced 12 yellow bell pepper, thinly sliced 3 teaspoons crushed red pepper flakes 1 cup dry white wine fresh ground black pepper 1 dash salt (optional) 6 cups hot cooked capellini 14 cup parmesan cheese 14 cup minced Italian parsley
directions: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the garlic and onion and saute for 5 minutes. Add the peppers and saute for 5 minutes. Add the crushed red pepper and wine and bring to a boil. Simmer for 5 to 7 minutes. Season with pepper and salt and toss with the hot capellini. Garnish with parmesan cheese and parsley.

title: Coconut Crunch
ingredients: 2 c. flour 2 c. coconut 1/2 c. brown sugar 1 c. oleo (room temperature) 2 (5 1/2 oz. each) pkg. vanilla pudding (instant) 9 oz. carton Cool Whip
directions: Crumb flour, cocoa, oleo and brown sugar and brown in a 350° oven until golden brown. Cool. Place half of the mixture in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Prepare instant vanilla pudding and pour over crumbs. Put the rest of the crumbs on top of the pudding. Spread the Cool Whip on top.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. vegetable oil 2 c. sugar 3 c. flour 2 tsp. cinnamon 3 c. diced apples 3 eggs 2 tsp. vanilla 1 tsp. soda 1/2 tsp. salt 1 c. chopped nuts
directions: Beat together oil, sugar and vanilla. Sift together flour, soda, cinnamon and salt. Add this to the first mixture. Add apples and nuts. Bake in tube pan for 1 1/2 hours at 325°. Cool pan before turning cake out.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 c. shortening 3/4 c. peanut butter 1 1/4 c. firmly packed brown sugar 3 Tbsp. milk 1 Tbsp. vanilla 1 3/4 c. flour 3/4 tsp. salt 3/4 tsp. baking soda
directions: Preheat oven to 375°. Combine shortening, peanut butter, brown sugar, milk and vanilla. Beat until well blended. Add egg. Beat until blended. Combine flour, salt and baking soda. Add to cream mixture. Mix until just blended. Drop by tablespoons onto a cookie sheet. Flatten slightly in a criss-cross pattern with a fork. Bake for 7 to 8 minutes, or until beginning to brown. Cool 2 minutes on cookie sheet. Remove and cool completely.

title: 7-Up Cake
ingredients: 1 box yellow cake mix 4 eggs 1 box vanilla instant pudding 3/4 c. vegetable oil 1 (10 oz.) bottle 7-Up
directions: Mix ingredients until light and fluffy. Add 7-Up. Bake at 350° until done.

title: Five-Spice Chicken
ingredients: 4 small chicken leg quarters (1-1/2 lb./675 g) 1/4 cup Kraft Original BBQ Sauce 2 Tbsp. brown sugar 2 Tbsp. reduced-sodium soy sauce 1 Tbsp. rice vinegar 1 tsp. five-spice powder 8 Bibb lettuce leaves
directions: Bring large pan of water to boil. Add chicken; return to boil. Drain; set chicken aside. Mix next 5 ingredients in large bowl. Add chicken; toss to evenly coat. Refrigerate 30 min. to marinate. Heat oven to 400 degrees F. Remove chicken from marinade; discard marinade. Place chicken in single layer in shallow foil-lined pan. Bake 30 min. or until chicken is done (170 degrees F). Serve on lettuce-covered platter.

title: Hot Rolls
ingredients: 2 pkg. dry yeast 2 1/4 c. water 1 c. oleo 3/4 c. sugar 2 eggs, beaten 7 c. sifted flour 2 tsp. salt
directions: Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup water; set aside. Melt oleo in 1 cup boiling water. Add sugar, then 1 cup cold water. Add eggs; mix well. Stir in yeast mixture; mix well and set aside. In large mixing bowl, combine flour and salt. Add yeast mixture; blend well. Knead in bowl. Store dough in covered, greased bowl in refrigerator. Make rolls as desired. Let rise about 2 hours or doubled in bulk. Dough keeps 3 days in refrigerator. Bake at 350° until brown.

title: Rice Pudding
ingredients: 1 c. rice 1 1/2 c. sugar 8 c. milk (2%) raisins to taste almonds to taste, chopped
directions: In a food processor, blend rice in coarse pieces. In a large saucepan on medium heat, boil milk and on low heat, reduce the milk to 1/2 the original quantity. Add rice and 2 cups water to milk. Continue cooking on low heat for another 20 to 25 minutes. Add raisins and almonds and cook another 5 minutes. Cool and serve in bowls.

title: Pakistani Style Vegetables
ingredients: 1 tsp. Olive Oil 1 1/2 Onions (chopped) 3 tbsp. Garlic (minced) 2 Whole Black Peppercorns 1 tsp. Ginger (grounded) 1/2 tsp. Garam Masala Powder OR five spice powder 1/2 tsp. Ground Turmeric 1 tsp. Paprika 1 1/2 tsp. Red Pepper Flakes (crushed) Salt (to taste) 1 cup Water (divided) 1/2 medium head of Cabbage (chopped) 2 medium to large Potatoes (peeled & chopped) 2 medium Tomatoes (sliced) 1 1/2 cups Green Peas (frozen)
directions: Heat olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat, and stir in onions, garlic, and peppercorns. Saute until onions are tender. Mix in ginger, garam masala , turmeric, paprika, red pepper flakes, and salt. Stirring constantly, cook until onions are thoroughly coated with the seasonings. 2) Stir 1/4 cup water into the saucepan. Mix in cabbage, potatoes, tomatoes, and remaining water. Increase heat to medium-high. Continue to cook, stirring often, until all vegetables are tender, about 20 minutes. Stir in the peas during the last 5 minutes of cooking. Garnish with chopped green cilantro.Serve with boil rice or chapati.

title: Heavenly Fried Pies
ingredients: 78 cup Crisco shortening 3 12 cups all-purpose flour 12 teaspoon salt 2 34 teaspoons powdered sugar 78 cup buttermilk 12 teaspoon baking soda 18 teaspoon coconut extract
directions: Add flour, salt and powdered sugar into bowl. Cut in shortening until the mixture is incorporated well. Add baking soda to buttermilk. Add to flour mixture, stirring just until moistened. Roll dough into a ball and chill for 25 minutes. Roll out onto floured surface and cut into 6" circles. Fill with your favorite pie filling. Fry until golden brown and delicious.

title: Braised Chicken With Capers And Parsley
ingredients: 4 T olive oil, divided 1 large onion, minced 2 lbs skin-on chicken thighs 1/2 c minced flat-leaf parsley 1/3 c capers 2 c chicken broth 1/3 c wine vinegar Freshly ground black pepper
directions: Heat 2 T oil in a large heavy skillet over medium heat. Add onion and cook until softened. Transfer onions to a bowl; wipe skillet clean. Add 2 T oil to skillet and increase heat to medium-high. Season chicken with salt. Add to skillet and cook until golden brown on both sides, 10-12 minutes. Transfer chicken to a plate. Add reserved onion, parsley and capers to skillet. Cook for 1 minute. Stir in broth and vinegar. Add chicken with any juices. Reduce heat to medium-low; cover and simmer until meat is tender, about 45 minutes. Transfer chicken to a large platter. Season sauce with salt and pepper and spoon over chicken. Garnish with parsley.

title: Potato Wedges
ingredients: 4 to 5 medium potatoes 1/4 lb. cheese, grated (Cheddar or American) 1 stick butter 1 Tbsp. Mrs. Dash seasoning
directions: Slice potatoes into wedges. Melt butter; mix with Mrs. Dash. Dip potatoes in mixture. Lay potatoes out on pan. Bake 1/2 hour at 350°. Turn potatoes over; bake an additional 20 minutes. Cover with cheese.

title: Pilaf aux fruits de mer (Molded rice with seafood)
ingredients: 5 tablespoons, plus one teaspoon, butter 1 cup finely chopped onion 1 1/2 cups raw rice 2 1/4 cups water Salt to taste, if desired 2 pounds well-scrubbed mussels, about six cups 1/2 cup dry white wine 4 sprigs fresh parsley 1/2 pound raw shrimp, shelled and deveined 1/2 pound raw scallops, preferably bay scallops - if sea scallops are used, cut them into quarters 1/4 cup finely chopped shallots 3 tablespoons flour 1/2 cup, plus two tablespoons, heavy cream 2 tablespoons finely chopped chives
directions: Melt two tablespoons of the butter in a saucepan and add onehalf cup of the onion. Cook, stirring, until the onion is wilted. Add the rice, water and salt, and stir. Bring to the boil. Cover closely and simmer 17 minutes. Meanwhile, put the mussels in a small kettle and add the remaining onions, wine and parsley. Cover closely and bring to the boil. Let cook two minutes, shaking the kettle, until the mussels open. Drain and reserve the cooking liquid. There should be about one and one-half cups. Let the mussels cool. Pour the reserved mussel liquid into a saucepan, and add the shrimp and scallops. Bring to the boil and let simmer, stirring, about one minute. Remove the shrimp and scallops with a slotted spoon and strain the liquid. There should be about one and three-quarter cups. Set the seafood aside. When the mussels are cool enough to handle, remove the meat and discard the shells. There should be about one and one-half cups. Melt two tablespoons of butter in a saucepan and add the shallots. Cook until the shallots are wilted. Add the flour and stir, using a wire whisk. When blended, add the reserved one and one-half cups of cooking liquid, stirring rapidly with the wire whisk. Add one-half cup of heavy cream and bring to the boil. Spoon the remaining two tablespoons of heavy cream into a small skillet and add the seafood mixture. Stir just to heat through. Cook just to rid the food of excess liquid. Add half a cup of the sauce to the seafood and stir to blend. Add half of the chives and stir. Butter a six-cup mold with one teaspoon of butter. Spoon about three-quarters of the rice into the mold. Make a hollow in the center of the rice while building up the rice around the inside of the mold, pressing firmly to make it adhere. Spoon the seafood, plus one-half cup of sauce, into the center of the rice. Cover with as much of the remaining rice as possible. Press down firmly on the rice to make it adhere. Carefully unmold the rice mold onto a round platter. To the sauce in the saucepan, swirl in the remaining one tablespoon of butter and the remaining chives. Bring to the simmer. Spoon a small amount of the sauce around the rice mold. Serve with the remaining hot sauce.

title: Five Spice Pork And Vegetable Stir Fry
ingredients: 16 oz fresh Hokkien noodles 2 tbsp vegetable oil 10.5 oz ground pork 1/2 tsp five-spice powder 4 oz baby corn, halved lengthwise 1 None small carrot, cut into matchsticks 5 oz snow peas, halved 1/2 cup oyster sauce 1/2 tsp sesame oil 2 None spring onions, thinly sliced diagonally
directions: Place noodles in a heatproof bowl. Cover with boiling water and stir with a fork to separate strands. Drain. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Cook pork for 4 mins, or until browned, breaking up any large lumps. Add spice mix and cook for 1 min, or until fragrant. Transfer to a heatproof bowl. Add remaining oil to wok. Stir-fry corn and carrot for 1 min. Add snow peas and stir-fry for 1 min. Return pork to wok along with noodles and stir to combine. Add oyster sauce and sesame oil. Stir-fry for 1 min, or until hot. Distribute stir-fry between serving bowls and sprinkle with spring onions.

title: Winter Spice Muffins
ingredients: 2 cups Whole Wheat Flour 1 teaspoon Baking Soda 1/2 teaspoons Salt 1 teaspoon Ground Ginger 1 teaspoon Cinnamon 1 teaspoon Mixed Spice 1 cup Brown Sugar 1 can (15 Oz. Size) Pumpkin 1/2 cups Vegetable Oil 2 whole Eggs 1/4 cups Black Treacle 1/4 cups Walnuts, Crumbled 1/4 cups Pumpkin Seeds 1/4 cups Sultanas
directions: Preheat your oven to 350°F/170°C and lightly spray 12 muffins cups with cooking spray (the only time I use it!). Sift the flour, baking soda, salt and spices gently into a large bowl. In another bowl, whisk together all the wet ingredients (sugar, pumpkin, oil, eggs and treacle). Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir well to combine. Fold in the nuts, seeds and sultanas. Spoon into muffin cups and bake for 25-30 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean.

title: Chipotle Lime Chicken Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 Tablespoons Olive Oil 1- 1/2 pound Chicken, Cut Into Bite Size Pieces 1/2 teaspoons Salt 1/4 teaspoons Pepper 1/2 cups Lime Juice 1/4 cups Orange Juice 1/4 cups Brown Sugar 1/2 teaspoons Granulated Garlic 1/2 teaspoons Ground Chipotle 1 Tablespoon Butter 1 whole Medium Onion, Thinly Sliced 1/2 cups Mayonnaise 1 teaspoon Cumin 1/2 teaspoons Chili Powder 1/4 teaspoons Sea Salt 1 Tablespoon Cilantro, Finely Chopped 6 whole Hamburger Buns Or Sandwich Rolls
directions: Add olive oil to a large skillet over medium-high heat. When oil is hot, add chicken and season with salt and pepper. Stir chicken occasionally until chicken just starts to brown. While chicken is cooking mix lime juice, orange juice, brown sugar, garlic, and chipotle together. When chicken starts to brown stir in lime mixture and lower heat to medium. Stir chicken and continue to cook until liquid is reduced and chicken is completely coated. In a separate small skillet melt butter and add onions, cooking over medium-high heat until caramelized. Stir together mayo, cumin, chili powder, sea salt and cilantro and set aside. Lightly toast rolls and spread about a teaspoon of mayo mixture on each. Layer on chicken and a few sauteed onions and cover with top side of roll. Enjoy! Miss

title: Triple Chocolate Amish Friendship Bread
ingredients: 1 cup Amish Starter (see My TastyKitchen Recipe Box For The Starter Recipe) 3 whole Eggs 1 cup Oil 1/2 cups Milk 1/2 teaspoons Vanilla 1 cup Sugar 1-1/2 teaspoon Baking Powder 1/2 teaspoons Salt 1/2 teaspoons Baking Soda 2 cups Flour 2 Tablespoons Unsweetened Cocoa Powder 5-1/8 ounces, weight Instant Chocolate Pudding 1 cup Dark Chocolate Chips Optional For Topping: Powdered Sugar And/or Cocoa Powder
directions: Preheat oven to 325F. In a large bowl mix starter, eggs, oil, milk and vanilla. In another bowl add dry ingredients, mixing well. Add the dry ingredients (except chocolate chips) to the wet, mixing well. Then stir in chocolate chips. Grease 2-3 bread pans, depending on size. Pour batter evenly into pans, so they are 3/4 full. Bake for 1 hour or until a tooth pick inserted comes out clean. Let cool. Dust with powdered sugar and cocoa.

title: Cornbread Ring
ingredients: 1 (8 1/2 oz.) pkg. corn mix 2/3 c. biscuit baking mix 2/3 c. milk 1 egg spray-on vegetable coating 3 Tbsp. cornflake crumbs
directions: Mix corn muffin mix and biscuit baking mix in large mixing bowl. Blend in milk and egg. Spray inside of 9 x 2-inch round glass dish and outside of 6-ounce glass cup with spray-on vegetable coating. Cook in oven on full power for 3 to 4 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Hanger Steaks with Wilted Spinach and Gorgonzola Sauce
ingredients: Two 1-pound hanger steaks Salt and freshly ground pepper 3 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil Two 5-ounce bags baby spinach 1 cup heavy cream 1/4 pound Gorgonzola cheese, cut into 1-inch pieces
directions: Season the steaks generously with salt and pepper. In a large cast-iron skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of the olive oil until shimmering. Add the steaks and cook over moderately high heat until well-browned and crusty, about 4 minutes per side for medium-rare. Transfer the steaks to a cutting board and let rest for 5 minutes. Meanwhile, in the same skillet, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil. Add the spinach one handful at a time and cook over moderately high heat, stirring and scraping up any browned bits, until wilted, about 2 minutes. Transfer the spinach to plates. Add the cream to the skillet along with any accumulated meat juices and bring to a simmer over moderately low heat. Whisk in the Gorgonzola cheese and simmer gently until the sauce is slightly thickened, about 2 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Thinly slice the steaks across the grain and arrange on the plates with the spinach. Spoon the Gorgonzola sauce on the steaks and spinach and serve immediately.

title: Raspberry Sauce
ingredients: 2 c. frozen raspberries, thawed 1 c. sugar 1 Tbsp. fresh lemon juice
directions: Combine all ingredients in food processor or blender. Force sauce through fine strainer to remove seeds. Chill before serving.

title: Chocolate Christmas stars with nuts and cranberries
ingredients: 300 grams white chocolate packs, broken into chunks 75 millilitres double cream 50 grams pistachio nuts shelled, roughly chopped 50 grams almonds flaked 100 grams cranberries, dried pack
directions: Line a 20 x 30cm airtight container/ metal tin with baking parchment, leaving some overhanging the edges, which will act as a handle later on. Bring a pan of water to the boil over a high heat. Place the chocolate and cream in a large bowl. Remove the pan from the heat and place the bowl over the pan, making sure that it does not touch the water. Leave to stand for 10 to 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chocolate mixture has completely melted. With the bowl still over the pan of water, stir the pistachios, almonds and cranberries into the melted chocolate and mix thoroughly to coat. Spoon the mixture into the prepared container or tin and level the surface with the back of the spoon. Cover with cling film and place in the fridge. Leave for 1 hour or until completely set. Remove the set chocolate from the container using the overhanging parchment 'handle' and place on a board. Use a metal star cutter (about 5cm across) to stamp out 12 shapes. Keep in the fridge until ready to eat.

title: Creamy Chicken And Cheese Enchiladas
ingredients: 1/2 c. chopped onion 1 clove garlic, minced 1 Tbsp. oil 2 c. chopped cooked chicken 1 (4 oz.) can chopped green chilies 1/4 c. chicken broth 2 tsp. chili powder 1 tsp. ground cumin 4 oz. light cream cheese, cubed 6 flour tortillas (6-inch) 1/4 Velveeta cheese, cubed (use Mexican mild flavor) 2 Tbsp. milk 1/2 c. chopped tomato, divided
directions: Microwave onion, garlic and oil in 2-quart dish on High for 2 to 3 minutes. Stir in chicken, chilies, broth and seasoning. Microwave on High 4 minutes. Add cream cheese; stir until melted. Spoon 1/3 cup chicken mixture into each tortilla. Roll up and place seam side down in 8-inch square dish. Microwave Velveeta, milk and 1/4 cup tomato on High for 2 to 3 minutes. Stir after each minute. Pour sauce over tortillas; top with remaining tomatoes. Microwave on High for 6 to 8 minutes. Turn after 3 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Breakfast Corn Griddle Cakes Recipe
ingredients: 8 ounce Plain flour 1 1/2 tsp Baking pwdr 1/4 tsp Paprika 1/2 tsp Salt 6 ounce Fresh sweet corn kernels, cut from the cob 1 x Egg, beaten 4 fl ounce Lowfat milk 2 Tbsp. Melted butter
directions: Sift the dry ingredients into a bowl. Combine the corn, egg and lowfat milk, add in to the flour mix and mix well. Then add in the butter. Spoon onto a warm griddle, using 2 to 3 Tbsp. of the mix for each cake. Cook till bubbles show on the surface, then turn the cakes over and cook the other sides till golden. Serve with crisp rashers of bacon and maple syrup.

title: Strawberry Salad
ingredients: 2 boxes strawberry gelatin 2 c. boiling water 2 small or 1 large box frozen strawberries 1/4 c. drained, crushed pineapple 2 bananas, mashed 8 oz. cream cheese 1 c. powdered sugar 1 tsp. vanilla 1/2 pt. whipping cream 1 c. chopped nuts
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add strawberries, pineapple and bananas. Mix well and let congeal. Soften cream cheese; add sugar and vanilla, then set aside. Whip the cream and slowly add to cheese mixture. Spread on congealed mixture and sprinkle with nuts.

title: Zucchini Bread
ingredients: 3 eggs 2 c. brown sugar 1 c. safflower oil 3 c. flour (2 whole wheat, 1 unbleached white) 1/2 tsp. sea salt 1 tsp. baking powder 1 tsp. baking soda 3 tsp. cinnamon 1 c. nuts 2 tsp. vanilla 2 c. zucchini
directions: Beat eggs, oil and sugar until creamy. Add dry ingredients. Add zucchini. Grease bread pan. Bake 1 hour and 20 minutes at 350°. Check after 1 hour.

title: Ceviche
ingredients: 1 lb. fish- sea bass, Red Snapper, or cod 1/2 cup lime juice, 5-6 limes 1 large tomato, seeded diced 1 or 2 avocado(s) diced 3 green onions. thinly sliced 1/2 cup each sliced ripe olives (black and green)(hint-a small can of black olives) 2 TBL chopped green chili-Serrano (add more for more heat) 1 or 2 garlic clove(s) 2 TBL Italian Dressing 2-4 Tbl chopped cilantro 1 1/2 tsp oregano or 1/2 tsp dry Salt and Pepper to taste 1 bag tortilla chips (with a hint of lime)
directions: 1. Marinate fish (cut in small cubes) in a glass bowl overnight. 2. Drain the lime juice and rinse the marinated fish in water. Squeeze the fish to eliminate as much water as possible. 3. Add all ingredients to the fish. I start with the spices (garlic, salt & pepper, oregano, cilantro, green onions, olives, Italian dressing, Serrano chiles, tomatoes, and avocado(s)). After each addition I mix the ingredients together. 4. Finally, add more pepper and salt to taste. 5. Serve with chips. (recommend the lime flavored chips and cold Mexican beer)

title: Irish Soda Bread
ingredients: 3 c. sifted flour 1 Tbsp. baking powder 1 1/2 c. raisins 1 3/4 to 2 c. buttermilk 2 Tbsp. melted shortening 2/3 c. sugar 1 tsp. baking soda 2 beaten eggs
directions: Sift flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt. Stir in raisins. In separate bowl, mix eggs, buttermilk and shortening. Add liquid to dry ingredients; mix until moistened. Turn into greased loaf pan (5 1/4 x 9 1/2-inch). Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Remove from pan immediately.

title: Barley Burgers
ingredients: 1/2 c. barley in 2 1/2 c. water 1 onion 1 c. chopped walnuts 4 oz. can mushrooms 4 slices bread crumbs 4 pkg. George Washington broth 5 eggs 4 Tbsp. flour
directions: Mix all ingredients well and fry into patties. Great in pita bread.

title: Pineapple Pie
ingredients: 1 can crushed pineapple 1 container Cool Whip 1/2 tsp. lemon juice
directions: Mix together. Pour into graham cracker crust and chill. Ready to eat in 30 minutes.

title: Low-Fat Rice Pudding
ingredients: 1 qt. low-fat milk 1/2 c. uncooked white rice 1/2 c. raisins 1 large egg whites from 2 large eggs 1/3 c. sugar 1 c. evaporated skim milk 1 1/2 tsp. vanilla nutmeg
directions: In large heavy saucepan, combine milk, rice and raisins. Bring to boil over medium heat. Reduce heat and boil gently, uncovered, about 20 minutes, stirring often until rice is almost tender. Meanwhile, in medium bowl, whisk egg, egg whites, sugar and evaporated milk until blended. Gradually add egg mixture to rice mixture, stirring constantly. Cook over medium-low heat about 5 minutes or until mixture is slightly thickened. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla. Pour into shallow 6-cup dish. Serve warm or cold sprinkled with nutmeg. One-half cup serving has 190 calories (2 grams fat, 30 mg cholesterol).

title: Whiskey Butterscotch Sauce Recipe
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups packed light brown sugar 1/3 cup light corn syrup 2 tablespoons unsalted butter 1 teaspoon flakey sea salt, such as fleur de sel 3/4 cup heavy cream 3 tablespoons whiskey 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
directions: Combine light brown sugar, corn syrup, butter, salt, and 1/4 cup of water in medium pot. Bring to a simmer and cook until sugar dissolves, 2 to 3 minutes. Add cream and continue to simmer until sauce is thick and syrupy, about 12 minutes. Stir in whiskey and vanilla extract. Simmer three minutes more. Allow sauce to cool to room temperature. Transfer to jars. Sauce will keep for up to one month in the refrigerator.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 box Pre Seasoned Breaded Flour 4 large green tomatoes vegetable oil salt and pepper
directions: Wash and dry tomatoes. Slice evenly. Salt and pepper to taste. Place Breaded flour in a ziploc bag and add tomatoes a few at a time. Shake off excess batter and place in hot oil. Turn heat down to med-high and cook for about 6-8 minutes, turning frequently. Drain on paper towels. Enjoy!

title: Baked Chicken With Tarragon And Fennel
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts, skinned 1 tsp. tarragon 1/4 tsp. fennel seed, crushed 1/8 tsp. cardamom salt and fresh ground black pepper to taste
directions: Place chicken breast on foil-lined baking pan. Sprinkle with seasonings. Cover loosely with foil to help retain moisture. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes, until cooked through.

title: Slow Cooker Green Chile Stew
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds boneless pork loin, cut into 3/4-inch cubes 1 (14.5 ounce) can diced tomatoes, drained 2 (7 ounce) cans diced green chiles 2 yams, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch pieces 1/2 onion, coarsely chopped 5 cloves garlic, minced 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cumin 1 teaspoon dried oregano 1 teaspoon salt ground black pepper to taste 1 tablespoon hot pepper sauce 1 cup frozen corn 1/2 cup shredded Cheddar cheese
directions: Combine the pork, tomatoes, green chiles, yams, onion, garlic, cumin, oregano, salt, black pepper, and hot pepper sauce in a slow cooker. Cover, and cook on Low until the pork is very tender, 6 to 7 hours. Stir in the frozen corn, recover, and cook until the corn is hot, 10 to 15 minutes. Sprinkle with shredded Cheddar cheese to serve.

title: Twice Baked Jalapeño Potatoes
ingredients: 6 medium potatoes 2 jalapeno peppers 1 tablespoon sour cream 1 tablespoon plain yogurt 2 tablespoons cream cheese 1/4 cup shredded colby-monterey jack cheese 2 tablespoons bacon bits 3 tablespoons butter 1 tablespoon milk 6 slices swiss cheese
directions: Wash potatoes and poke holes in them on the top for venting. Microwave until a fork can be easily inserted into them. When removed, let cool until barely warm so it is more easy to scoop out the potato into your mixing bowl, saving your potato skins. Scoop out your potato and mix on all ingredients. (Your Jalapeno peppers should be de-seeded and diced.). Scoop back into your potato skins. Top with pre-sliced Swiss cheese. Bake at 400 degrees until cheese is slightly browned on top.

title: Chocolate Cheesecake Squares
ingredients: 1 cup (250 mL) graham wafer crumbs 2 tbsp (25 mL) granulated sugar 2 tbsp (25 mL) vegetable oil 1/2 tsp (2 mL) ground cinnamon 1 package (10.25 oz/290 g) silken soft tofu 2 eggs 2/3 cup (175 mL) granulated sugar 1/3 cup (75 mL) unsweetened cocoa powder 2 tsp (10 mL) vanilla 1/2 tsp (2 mL) salt Sliced strawberries (optional) 8-inch (2 L) square cake pan, lined with parchment paper
directions: Preheat oven to 350F (180C). In a small bowl, stir together graham wafer crumbs, sugar, oil and cinnamon. Press onto bottom of prepared pan. Using a sieve, drain tofu. In a medium bowl, using an electric mixer, beat together drained tofu, eggs, sugar, cocoa, vanilla and salt until smooth. Pour into pan. Bake in preheated oven for 35 to 40 minutes, or until firm. Let cool on a wire rack. Cut into 16 squares and garnish each piece with strawberry slice (if using).

title: Caldo  Verde
ingredients: 1 pound Sweet Sausage 1/2 whole Onion, Chopped 2 cups Chicken Broth 1 cup Milk 4 cups Half-and-half 1/2 teaspoons Oregano Salt To Taste Pepper To Taste 1/2 teaspoons Red Chili Flakes 8 whole Potatoes-cooked And Sliced 1 bunch Kale, Cleaned, Stemmed And Torn Into Pieces
directions: In a large pot over medium heat, brown sausage. Add onions and continue until onions are cooked thoroughly. Drain as much fat as possible then add chicken broth, milk, half-and-half, oregano, salt, pepper and crushed red chili flakes to the pot. Bring to a boil and simmer for 15 minutes. Add potatoes and kale, cover and simmer for at least 20 minutes. Taste and enjoy.

title: Onion Roasted Potatoes
ingredients: 1 envelope Lipton onion soup mix 2 lbs. all-purpose potatoes, cut into large chunks 1/3 cup olive or veg oil
directions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. In large plastic bag or bowl, add all the ingredients. Close bag and shake, or toss in bowl, until potatoes are evenly coated. In 13x9" baking pan arrange potatoes; discard bag. Bake uncovered, stirring occassionally, for 40 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Rhubarb & Strawberry Crisp
ingredients: 1 lb. rhubarb, sliced in 1 in. pieces 2 pints strawberries, hulled, sliced in half Zest and juice from 3 blood oranges (or whatever oranges you have on hand) 1/4 cup flour 1/4 cup sugar Topping: 1 stick butter, chilled, cubed 3/4 cup all purpose flour 1/2 cup brown sugar 1/2 cup oats Pinch of salt 1/4 cup toasted hazelnuts, skins removed, chopped coarsely
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease an 8 x 11 baking dish and set aside. In a bowl combine sliced rhubarb, strawberries, zest and juice from the oranges, flour and sugar. Toss gently to incorporate flour and sugar throughout. Pour into prepared baking dish. For the topping I like to use a food processor, but a pastry cutter, fork or even your fingers work as well. Combine chilled, cubed butter, with the flour, sugar and salt, pulse a few times until butter is the size of small peas. Add oatmeal and pulse once or twice, just enough to get it mixed through, but not chopped too small. Crumble mixture over the top of the strawberry rhubarb mixture. Top with the roasted hazelnuts and bake for 45 minutes until the top is browned nicely and the mixture is bubbling through the cracks. Serve warm with freshly whipped cream or vanilla ice cream.

title: Special Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 medium onion, chopped 1 green pepper, chopped 1 1/2 lb. ground beef 2 cans tomato sauce 1 tsp. sugar dash of garlic powder salt and pepper to taste 6 green onions, chopped fine 1 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese 1 (8 oz.) carton sour cream cheddar cheese, grated 1 large pkg. egg noodles
directions: Saute onion and pepper with meat and brown. Add tomato sauce, sugar, garlic powder, salt and pepper. Cook 15 minutes. Mix green onions with cheese and sour cream, using a mixer. Layer the cooked noodles and cheese mixture, then top with the tomato sauce mixture. Put grated cheese on top and bake until cheese melts and casserole is hot.

title: Grilled Wild Mushroom Sausage
ingredients: 6 ounces chicken breast, boned and skinned, cold 1 egg 2 ounces heavy cream, cold 3 ounces creminis 3 ounces portobellos 3 ounces shiitakes 3 ounces button mushrooms 1/2 ounce fines herbs (parsley, tarragon, chives, chervil) 1 ounce shallots, chopped Salt and pepper Butter
directions: For the chicken mousse: Puree chicken in a food processor until smooth. Add salt and pepper and the egg. Pulse just to combine and scrape the sides. While food processor is running, add cream gradually through the feed tube. Chill and reserve. Wash and slice the mushrooms. In a hot saute pan, cook the mushrooms with butter. When mushrooms are brown, add shallots and herbs. Remove from the pan and chill. Fold together mushrooms and chicken. Lay out plastic wrap on a table. Down the center, spoon a 1-inch pile of the mushroom mixture. Roll the plastic into a log. Tie the ends with a string and tie into links. Poach in simmering water for 10 minutes. Shock the links in ice water. This can be done up to 3 days ahead. To serve, remove the sausage from the plastic and grill or roast it until it is hot throughout (about 10 minutes). Slice the sausage and serve it with a tossed salad.

title: Golden Beet And Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 pound golden beets (1 3/4 in. wide, greens trimmed before weighing) 1 pound red thin-skinned potatoes (1 1/4 in. wide), scrubbed and cut in half 2 tablespoons sour cream 2 tablespoons mayonnaise 1 tablespoon rice vinegar 2 tablespoons finely chopped red onion 2 tablespoons chopped parsley 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish 1 clove garlic, peeled and minced Salt and pepper 8 ounces watercress (2 qt.) Crumbled browned bacon
directions: In a 6- to 8-quart pan over high heat, bring 3 quarts water to a boil. Add beets, reduce heat to medium-high, cover, and cook for 10 minutes. Add potatoes to the beets, cover again,and cook until both are tender when pierced, about 10 minutes longer. Drain and let cool. Peel beets, then slice into 1/4-inch-thick half-moons. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, whisk together the sour cream, mayonnaise, vinegar, onion, parsley, horseradish, and garlic. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Mix dressing into the potatoes. Rinse watercress. Pick tender sprigs from tough stems and cut into 3- to 4-inch lengths. Arrange sprigs on a platter. Top with potatoes, then arrange beets over mixture. Sprinkle with crumbled bacon.

title: Almond Butter and Apricot Jam on Sourdough Recipe
ingredients: 2 (1/2-inch-thick) slices sourdough bread 1 tablespoon almond butter 2 teaspoons apricot jam
directions: Spread almond butter on one slice of bread and apricot jam on the other. Close the sandwich and enjoy!

title: German Chocolate Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 1/4 c. chocolate wafers or cracker crumbs (18) 2 Tbsp. sugar 3 Tbsp. margarine, melted 2 (8 oz.) + 1 (3 oz.) pkg. cream cheese 1 c. sugar 1/4 c. cocoa 2 tsp. vanilla 3 eggs
directions: Press evenly into ungreased pan first 3 ingredients. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Beat cream cheese in 3-quart bowl. Add sugar and cocoa gradually. Beat in eggs, one at a time. Pour in vanilla. Pour into spring-form pan. Bake at 300° until center is firm, about 1 hour. Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours. Prepare topping. Spread over cake; loosen sides and remove.

title: Chocolate-Pecan Brownies
ingredients: 1/4 c. flour 1/4 tsp. soda 3/4 c. sugar 1/3 c. butter or oleo 2 Tbsp. water 12 oz. chocolate chips 1 tsp. vanilla 2 large eggs 1/2 c. chopped nuts
directions: To make Chocolate-Peanut Butter Brownies, add 1/2 cup peanut butter (and omit pecans, optional).

title: Warm Apple Pocket
ingredients: 3 sweet apples -- peeled, cored and thinly sliced 2 tablespoons sugar 2 tablespoons flour pinch of salt 1 teaspoon apple pie spice 1 tablespoon vanilla extract 1 (15 ounce) package prepared, unbaked pie crust, thawed milk 1 egg, beaten
directions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). In a bowl, toss apple slices together with sugar, flour, salt, apple pie spice, and vanilla extract until evenly coated. Lay pie dough flat on a lightly greased baking sheet. Pile apples on one side of dough, leaving a 1 inch border. Brush border and opposite half side of dough with milk. Fold dough over apples, being careful not to over-stuff or the dough will tear. Fold over edges and pinch together to seal. Cut several small slits in the top of the pocket with a sharp knife, then brush top with beaten egg. Bake in the preheated oven for 40 minutes, or until flakey and golden brown. Serve warm, or at room temperature.

title: Gold Chanterelles with Sun Dried Tomato Pesto
ingredients: 1 large onion 2 teaspoons olive oil 1 pound fresh chanterelles 1 ounces dry white wine, plus 1 ounce 1 large red bell pepper 3 ounces pitted, brined, black olives 2 to 3 cloves garlic 1 ounce Marsala 1 teaspoon tamari 6 tablespoons sundried tomato pesto, or approximately 1/3 cup rehydrated sundried tomatoes French bread rounds Grated Parmesan
directions: Chop the onion into small pieces. Preheat pan or skillet, add 2 teaspoons olive oil to heat, add onions, and begin to saute. While onions are cooking, clean the chanterelles (preferably without water, by using a brush, paring knife, and damp cloth), and cut into small pieces. Keep an eye on the onions, adding 1 ounce of wine as they begin to stick. Clean and chop the pepper, drain, rinse, and chop the olives and peel and chop (or use press) the garlic. After about 1/2 hour of cooking, the onions will be partially caramelized. Add the garlic to the onions, then mix in the chanterelles, with a splash of wine. Stir the mushrooms frequently. They should begin to release their own natural moisture into the pan after a few minutes of cooking. If the liquid builds up more than 1/2 inch in the pan, carefully pour off the excess liquid, reserving it for later use. Simmer for about 10 minutes, then add the pepper and olives and 1 ounce of marsala. If there's extra chanterelle liquid, add it back at this time. Cover and simmer another 5 minutes. Everything should be tender. Add tamari and sun dried tomato pesto, mix well, and serve over small French bread rounds. Garnish with grated Parmesan.

title: Banana Nut Oatmeal
ingredients: 1/2 cups Water 1/2 cups Skim Milk 1 cup Old Fashioned Oats 1/2 teaspoons Cinnamon 2 Tablespoons Walnuts, Chopped 1 whole Small Banana, Chopped
directions: Place water and milk in a small saucepan and turn the burner on just shy of high heat. Add oats, cinnamon and half of the walnuts and half of the banana. Stir occasionally, until the oats begin to bubble. Remove from heat, pour into serving bowls and top with remaining walnuts and bananas.

title: Korean Kimchi Burgers
ingredients: 3 cups finely shredded napa cabbage 1/2 cup thinly sliced green onion, divided 3 tablespoons seasoned rice vinegar 4 teaspoons minced garlic, divided 4 teaspoons minced fresh ginger, divided 1 tablespoon toasted sesame oil, divided 1 1/2 teaspoons asian chili-garlic sauce, divided (Sriracha) 1/4 cup mayonnaise 1 1/2 lbs ground chuck (80-20) 2 tablespoons soy sauce 4 hamburger buns, split (I like sesame seeded)
directions: Heat grill to high (450° to 550°). Mix cabbage, 1/4 cup green onions, the vinegar, 1 teaspoons each garlic and ginger, 2 teaspoons sesame oil, and 1/2 teaspoons chili sauce in a large bowl. Set relish aside, stirring occasionally. In another bowl, mix mayonnaise with remaining 1 teaspoons chili sauce. Combine beef, soy sauce, and remaining 1/4 cup green onions, 1 tablespoons each garlic and ginger, and 1 teaspoons sesame oil. Shape into 4 patties, each about 1/2 inches thick. Don't over mix or the burgers will be tough. Oil cooking grate, using tongs and a wad of oiled paper towels. Grill burgers, covered, turning once, 7 to 8 minutes total for medium. In the final minutes, toast buns. Spread bun bottoms with chili mayonnaise. Set burgers on buns. With a slotted spoon, put some cabbage relish on each. Serve with remaining relish.

title: Bread Pudding With Corn
ingredients: 1 tablespoon corn oil 1 bunch scallion, sliced using only half of the green parts 4 cups corn kernels, fresh recommended can use frozen 1/2 teaspoon paprika or 1/2 teaspoon red chili pepper, plus extra paprika or red chili pepper, to sprinkle on top 1/3 cup chopped fresh parsley, can use cilantro 1 tablespoon chopped dill, can use basil 4 eggs 2 cups milk 5 cups cubed bread, without crusts 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated 1/2 cup half-and-half or 1/2 cup milk
directions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Butter a 3 qt gratin dish or casserole. Heat oil in a wide skillet over med high heat. Add the scallions, corn and paprika (or red chile) and cook until the scallions have softened and the corn is heated through, about 4 minutes. Season with 1/2 tsp salt and stir in the parsley or dill. Whisk the eggs and milk with 1/2 tsp salt and pour it over bread in a bowl. Add the corn mixture and cheese and transfer the mixture to the prepared casserole dish. Pour over the half and half or milk. Bake until puffed and browned about 45 minutes. Add dash of paprika or chile to the top and serve.

title: Raspberry Cordial Cupcakes
ingredients: You Favorite Cupcake Recipe Or Box Mix 1 package (3 Oz. Package) Raspberry Gelatin 1/2 containers (8 Oz. Container) Whipped Topping 1 cup Raspberries (Fresh Or Frozen)
directions: Dissolve gelatin in water as instructed on the box. Chill for about 1 hour until slightly set. Fold in whipped topping and raspberries. Chill until set. Spoon the mousse over your favorite cupcakes. Top with extra whipped cream and drizzled chocolate. More directions on the related blog post link.

title: Egg Custard
ingredients: 5 eggs 1 c. sugar 4 Tbsp. melted butter or margarine 2 c. milk 1/2 tsp. nutmeg 1 tsp. vanilla flavoring
directions: Beat eggs. Add margarine and sugar. Add nutmeg and vanilla flavoring. Beat well. Add milk. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 350° until done. Remove at once.

title: Dinner Tonight: Squash Gnocchi With Meat Sauce Recipe
ingredients: 1/2 pound ground beef 1/2 pound ground pork 1 tablespoons olive oil Salt and pepper 1 onion, chopped 1 28-ounce can peeled whole tomatoes, chopped 1 butternut squash, quartered and seeds removed 2 eggs 1 cup flour
directions: Preheat the oven to 350. Place the squash in a roasting pan, cover with foil, and place in the oven. Cook for an hour. Meanwhile, toss the pork and beef into a large skillet over medium heat. Cook, breaking up the chunks with a wooden spoon, until browned. Meanwhile, the oil into a large pot over medium heat, add the onion, and cook until soft, about 20 minutes. Dump the tomatoes with the juices, then reduce the heat and simmer. Pour off as much fat from the meat as possible and then add it to the pot. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. When the squash is done, scoop out the flesh and place in a large bowl. Mash with a potato masher for a few minutes. Add the eggs and mash some more. Add the flour and work it in with your hands, until it forms a soft dough. With a tablespoon, sccop up some batter and use a second tablespoon to scrap the dough off into the boiling water. Cook until the gnocchi rise to the top of the water and transfer to a warm platter. Repeat with the rest of the dough. Serve the sauce over the gnocchi and season with salt.

title: Lemon Pound Cake
ingredients: 1/4 tsp. baking soda 3 c. and 6 Tbsp. cake flour 3 c. granulated sugar 2 sticks of butter or margarine 1 pint of sour cream 6 eggs 1 Tbsp. lemon flavoring 1 tsp. butter flavoring 1/4 tsp. almond flavoring
directions: Grease and flour a tube pan. Cover bottom of pan with waxed paper. Preheat oven to 325. Cream together butter and sugar. Add one egg at the time to the mixture, beating after each one. Add flavorings and baking soda. Beat well. Alternate flour and sour cream in 3 to 4 additions, beginning and ending with flour. Pour into pan. Bake at 325 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Crusted Chicken with Tomato and Asparagus Pasta
ingredients: 4 small boneless skinless chicken breasts (1 lb./450 g) 1 pouch Shake'N Bake Classic Herb & Parmesan Crust Coating Mix 1 pkg. (375 g) fettuccine 1 can (19 fl oz/540 mL) diced tomatoes, undrained Safeway 1 lb For $1.29 thru 02/09 8 oz. (225 g) asparagus spears, cut into 2-inch lengths 1/2 cup Cracker Barrel Finely Shredded 100% Parmesan Cheese
directions: Preheat oven to 400F. Coat 4 small boneless skinless chicken breasts (1 lb./450 g) with 1 pouch Shake 'N Bake Classic Herb & Parmesan Crusted for chicken, fish or pork; place on baking sheet. Bake 20 min. or until cooked through (170F). Meanwhile, cook 1 pkg. (375 g) fettuccine as directed on package. While pasta is cooking, cook 1 undrained can (19 fl oz/540 mL) diced tomatoes in large saucepan on medium-high heat 5 min. Add 1/2 lb. (225 g) asparagus spears, cut into 2-inch lengths; cook 5 min. or until crisp-tender. Drain pasta; toss with asparagus mixture. Place on four serving plates; sprinkle with 1/2 cup Kraft 100% Parmesan Shredded Cheese. Serve with sliced chicken.

title: Vienna Tarts
ingredients: 1/2 c. butter or margarine 3 oz. Philadelphia cream cheese 1 c. sifted flour 1 egg yolk 2 Tbsp. milk 1/4 c. chopped nuts
directions: Cream butter and cream cheese until blended and fluffy. Add flour and knead to smooth dough. Wrap in wax paper and chill for several hours. Roll 1/8-inch thick into rectangle. Cut into 2-inch squares. Place 1/4 teaspoon jelly in center of each; fold corner over and seal together tightly. Brush with egg yolk, mixed with milk and sprinkle with chopped nuts. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake in a 400° oven for 10 to 12 minutes. You may use fruit or nut filling.

title: Mom's Spice Cake
ingredients: 1 cup butter, softened 4 eggs 1 12 cups sugar 1 teaspoon baking soda 12 teaspoon baking powder 1 teaspoon cinnamon 12 teaspoon clove 2 12 cups flour 1 cup buttermilk
directions: Cream butter, sugar and eggs. In another bowl mix baking soda, baking powder, cinnamon, cloves, and flour. Alternate adding the flour mixture, and buttermilk to sugar mixture. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted comes out clean.

title: Cream Puff Ring Recipe
ingredients: 1 c. water 1/2 c. butter 1 c. flour 1/4 teaspoon salt 4 Large eggs 2 (8 ounce.) pkg. cream cheese, softened 1 1/2 c. powdered sugar 1 teaspoon vanilla 1 c. whipping cream, whipped 1 (1 ounce.) sq. unsweetened chocolate, melted 1 tbsp. lowfat milk
directions: Bring water and butter to boil. Add in flour and salt; stir vigorously over low heat till mix forms a ball. Remove from heat. Add in Large eggs, one at a time, beating well after each one. Drop 10 1/2 cupfuls of dough on greased cookie sheet to create a 9 inch ring. Bake at 400 degrees for 50-55 min or possibly till golden. Remove from cookie sheet and cold. Combine cream cheese, 1 c. sugar and vanilla till well blended. Reserve 1/2 c. cream cheese mix. Fold whipped cream into remaining mix. Chill. Carefully cut top from ring; fill with cream cheese mix. Replace top. Add in remaining sugar, chocolate and lowfat milk. To reserve cream cheese mix; mix well. Spread over ring.

title: Killer Baked Calico Bns
ingredients: 1 (15 ounce) can dark red kidney beans 1 (15 ounce) canlight red kidney beans 1 (15 ounce) can white kidney beans 1 (15 ounce) canlarge butter beans 1 (15 ounce) can baby butter beans 1 (15 ounce) can great northern beans 30 ounces bushed baked beans, with onions 12 cup brown sugar 12 cup granulated sugar 12 cup catsup 12 cup barbecue sauce 12 lb bacon 12 lb ground beef 2 tablespoons molasses 2 tablespoons chili powder 12 teaspoon dry mustard 1 medium sweet onion
directions: drain all of the beans except the Bushes and put all in a crock pot. dice the onion and saute in the pan as you brown the beef. cut bacon in 1 in strips and cook until crisp. drain the beef and the bacon. add meat and onions to the beans and stir. add the ketchup and the barbeque sauce and molasses and stir. add all of the dry ingredients and stir. cook on high for at least 3 hours. serve hot.

title: Naked Pumpkin Cake With Caramel Buttercream
ingredients: 1 cup granulated sugar 6 tablespoons unsalted butter softened 1/2 cup heavy cream 1 teaspoon coarse sea salt optional 2 cups all-purpose flour 2 teaspoons baking powder 3/4 teaspoon baking soda 1 teaspoon salt 1 1/2 teaspoons cinnamon 1 teaspoon ground ginger 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves 1 1/2 cups brown sugar packed 4 large eggs room temperature 3/4 cup vegetable oil 15 ounces pumpkin puree 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 1/2 cup milk room temperature 1 cup unsalted butter at room temperature 4 cups powdered sugar sifted 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 3 tablespoons heavy cream 1/4 cup caramel sauce homemade, plus more for topping, recipe above
directions: In a 3.0-Quart Saucepan from the KitchenAid(R) Stainless Steel 10-Piece Set, melt sugar over medium high heat. When sugar starts melting, whisk until all the sugar melts. Sugar will clump in whisk but keep whisking. Once all the sugar is melted, stop whisking and let sugar get to a deep amber color. You can swirl the pan to mix. Keep your eye on the caramel, as it will easily burn at this stage. Whisk in the butter and mix until completely melted. Remove pan from heat and gradually add in the heavy cream. Whisk until smooth. Whisk in the sea salt until dissolved (if using). Transfer caramel immediately into a glass jar and let cool completely. Preheat KitchenAid(R) 30-Inch 5-Element Electric Convection Slide-In Range to 325 degrees F. Butter and flour three 8-inch round cake pans. Line with parchment rounds and grease parchment. In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, and cloves. In the bowl of your KitchenAid(R) Stand Mixer, beat the brown sugar and eggs until light and fluffy. Gradually add in vegetable oil and mix until just combined. Beat in pumpkin puree and vanilla extract. Alternate the dry ingredients and milk, in three batches, and beat until combined between each addition. Divide batter equally into prepared pans. Bake cake 40 to 45 minutes, until a cake tester inserted into the center comes out clean. Let cakes cool in pan for at least 10 minutes before inverting onto a wire rack. Let cool completely before frosting. In the bowl of your KitchenAid(R) Stand Mixer, beat butter on medium high until smooth about 2-3 minutes. Reduce speed to low and add sugar, one cup at a time. Beat until combined. Add vanilla, heavy cream and caramel sauce and beat to combine. Increase speed to medium and beat frosting until smooth and fluffy. Place one layer of cake onto a cake board or plate. Spoon about half of the frosting onto cake. Top with second layer of cake and the rest of the frosting. End with the last layer of cake. Top cake with caramel sauce.

title: Ham, Artichoke, And Potato Gratin
ingredients: 1/4 cup (1/2 stick) butter 4 cups thinly sliced leeks (white and pale green parts only; about 4 large) Coarse kosher salt 3 pounds russet potatoes, peeled, thinly sliced (1/8 to 1/4 inch thick) 1 1/2 pounds 1/8-inch-thick ham slices 2 8-ounce boxes frozen artichoke hearts, thawed, halved lengthwise 2 1/2 cups (packed) coarsely grated Comte cheese (about 10 ounces) 1 1/2 cups low-salt chicken broth 1/2 cup dry white wine 1 1/2 tablespoons all purpose flour 1 teaspoon coarse kosher salt 1 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
directions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Butter 13x9x2-inch glass baking dish. Melt 1/4 cup butter in heavy large skillet over medium heat. Add leeks; sprinkle with coarse salt and pepper and cook until tender, stirring occasionally, about 12 minutes. Set aside.
