title: My Best Blueberry Muffins
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups flour 3/4 cup sugar 1/2 teaspoon salt 2 teaspoons baking powder 1/3 cup oil veggie 1 eggs 1/3 cup milk 1 cup fresh blueberries 1/2 cup brown sugar 1/3 cup flour 1/4 cup butter 1 1/2 teaspoons cinnamon
directions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Grease muffin cups. Combine flour, sugar, salt and baking powder. Add oil, egg and milk. Fold in blueberries. Fill cups to the top; sprinkle with crumb topping. Bake 20-25 minutes.

title: Cheesy Red Potato Mash
ingredients: 4 Medium Size Red Potatoes 1/2 teaspoons Salt, For The Boiling Water 1-1/2 teaspoon Butter 1/4 teaspoons Garlic Powder 1/4 teaspoons Ground Black Pepper 1/4 teaspoons Salt (or Salt To Taste) 1/4 cups Sour Cream 1 cup Shredded Sharp Cheddar Cheese 2 Green Onions, Chopped
directions: Cut the potatoes in quarters (leave the skin on) and add them into a pot of boiling water. Add 1/2 teaspoon of salt to the water. Boil until fork tender (about 15 minutes depending on the size of the potatoes) then drain out the water. Add the butter to the bottom of the pan and pile some of the potatoes on top of it so it melts. Then add the garlic powder, pepper, salt and sour cream. Using a potato masher, mash the potato mixture leaving some of the potatoes in pieces. Add the potato mash into a microwave safe serving dish and just before serving, top with the cheese and warm it up in the microwave (should only take a minute or two; long enough to heat it and melt the cheese). Then top with the green onions. Alternatively, add the potato mash into an oven safe serving dish and just before serving, top with the cheese and warm it up in the oven. Then top with the green onions. Serve while hot.

title: Cabbage and Noodles With Bacon
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, cored and cut up in to nice pieces 1 large sweet onion, diced but not to small 3 garlic cloves, chopped 1 lb bacon 12 cup butter 1 lb kielbasa
directions: fry up the bacon crispy (put off to the side for later). in the bacon grease add the onion and garlic and cook for about 5 minutes. then add the cabbage and butter cooking over medium heat coverd. cut the kielbaska into 1/4" thick slices and fry up in a seperate pan. when the cabbage is soft and about to turn brown on the edges take the bacon and crumble it into the frying pan and stir around you can mix in the kielbaska or put it on the side.

title: Chocolate Pancakes
ingredients: 1 egg 1 c. flour 1 c. milk 1 1/2 Tbsp. sugar 1 Tbsp. baking powder 1/2 tsp. salt 1 Tbsp. cocoa
directions: Mix all ingredients. Pour 1/4 cup batter on hot griddle. Cook pancakes until puffed. Turn and cook other sides until golden brown. Dust with powdered sugar. "Tastes just like a chocolate donut." Christine Walsh.

title: Jello Pound Cake
ingredients: 1 box yellow cake mix 1 small box lemon Jell-O 2/3 c. Wesson oil 2/3 c. water 1 tsp. lemon flavoring 4 eggs
directions: Mix and cook in a tube pan. Bake at 325° about 1 hour.

title: Beau Monde Seasoning
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ground cloves 1 1/4 teaspoons ground cinnamon 1 tablespoon salt 1 tablespoon bay leaf powder 1 tablespoon ground allspice 2 tablespoons ground black pepper 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg 1 teaspoon ground mace 1 teaspoon celery seed 2 tablespoons white pepper
directions: Grind the bay leaf and celery seed in a coffee grinder . Sieve the bay leaf and celery seed in to a bowl. Place all ingredients in to a jar with lid and shake to mix. Will keep for some time especially if not exposed to air.

title: Susie'S Salad
ingredients: cauliflower broccoli radishes carrots purple onions 1 c. Miracle Whip (lite) 1 (8 oz.) sour cream (lite) 1 pkg. Good Seasons Italian seasoning mix
directions: Cut up vegetables and marinate overnight all together in a closed container. When ready to serve, mix together Miracle Whip, sour cream and Italian seasoning mix. Mix vegetables and seasoning mixture. Serve.

title: Carrot Cake Ix
ingredients: 2 cups self-rising flour 2 teaspoons ground cinnamon 2 cups white sugar 1 1/2 cups vegetable oil 4 eggs 3 cups grated carrots 1 cup chopped walnuts 1 (8 ounce) package cream cheese 1/2 cup margarine, softened 1 pound confectioners' sugar 1 cup chopped walnuts 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
directions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease two 9 inch round cake pans. In a medium bowl, stir together the flour, cinnamon and sugar. Add the oil and eggs, mix until blended, then stir in the carrots and nuts. Divide the batter evenly between the two prepared pans. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes in the preheated oven. A toothpick inserted into the cake should come out clean. Cool cakes on wire racks before removing from pans. To make the frosting, use the second set of ingredients. In a medium bowl, cream together the butter and cream cheese, add the sugar and cream well. Stir in the nuts and vanilla. Use to fill and frost the cooled cake layers.

title: Green Tomatoes Parmesan
ingredients: 3 green tomatoes, sliced 1/4 in. thick salt 1/4 c. cornmeal 1/4 c. grated parmesan cheese 2 Tbsp. all purpose flour 3/4 tsp. garlic salt 1/2 tsp. oregano 1/8 tsp. pepper 1 egg, beaten 1/4 c. vegetable oil
directions: Lightly sprinkle tomatoes with salt and drain on paper towels for 1 hour. Meanwhile, combine cornmeal, parmesan, flour and seasonings in a shallow plate. Dip each tomato slice in egg, then into cornmeal mixture. Fry tomatoes a few at a time in hot oil for 2 minutes per side or until golden. Drain on a paper towel lined rack. Serve hot. Four to six servings.

title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. chopped celery 1 c. chopped onion 1 stick margarine 2 (10 oz.) pkg. chopped broccoli 1 can cream of chicken soup 1 (8 oz.) jar Cheez Whiz 1 c. rice, cooked
directions: Saute celery and onion in margarine. Add broccoli and stir until thawed. Add soup, Cheez Whiz and rice. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or microwave at 50% power for 25 minutes.

title: Bob'S Version Of Northamptonshire Chocolate Pudding
ingredients: 5 fluid ounces milk 4 ounces soft white breadcrumbs 4 ounces best plain dark chocolate 4 ounces sugar 5 drops vanilla essence (optional) 2 large eggs, separated 3 ounces butter
directions: Warm the milk and butter until the butter melts. Add the chocolate ( use best eating dark chcolate of at least 70% coca solids )and stir over gentle heat until that has melted. Fold in the breadcrumbs and vanilla ( if used - optional ) and stir over gentle heat 5 - 10 minutes until smooth and glossy, with all the oiliness absorbed. Set aside until it has cooled to hand hot, then stir in the egg yolks and sugar until smooth again. Beat the egg whites until thick, then fold them in very gently, about 1/4 at a time. Lightly butter a pudding basin, put a disc of buttered greaseproof paper in the bottom of it to prevent sticking, and gently pour in the mixture. Cover basin tightly with foil, steam or place in a covered pan of hot water at a gentle boil for 2 - 21/2 hours. A knife inserted in the centre should be slightly coated with gooey cakey mix for perfection. Turn out, serve with cream.

title: Spicy Hot Ham and Cheese Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 tbsp. horseradish mustard 2 tbsp. onion, finely chopped 2 tsp. poppy seeds 1/4 cup margarine, softened 4 slices ham, fully cooked 4 slices cheese of your choice 4 buns
directions: Combine mustard, onion, poppy seeds and margarine. Spread on buns. Layer ham and cheese on buns. Wrap each sandwich in foil and place on high rack of grill for approximately 10 minutes.

title: Pineapple Banana Shake
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can unsweetened crushed pineapple, undrained 1 c. skimmed milk 1 medium banana, cut in chunks 1/2 tsp. vanilla extract 2 ice cubes fresh strawberries (optional) 1 1/2 c. uncooked oats 1/4 c. vegetable oil 1/2 c. flour 1/2 c. vegetable broth
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°. Mix the ingredients well. Put flour on your hands and take a small piece of the dough. Make it into a shape, make sure to keep it thin. Put the biscuits on a greased cookie sheet. Place them in the oven for 30 to 35 minutes. After baking, let the biscuits cool for 30 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Drop Cookies
ingredients: 4 eggs 1 c. margarine 1 c. shortening 4 c. oatmeal 4 c. plain flour 2 1/2 c. sugar 1/2 tsp. soda 1 tsp. vanilla 1 box raisins 10 Tbsp. raisin liquid 1 c. nuts
directions: Pour water over raisins. Bring to a boil and then simmer for 3 minutes. Drain, reserving liquid. Cool. Mix shortening, margarine, sugar, vanilla and eggs. Blend until well mixed. Add raisin liquid. Blend. Add raisins; stir by hand. Mix in flour and soda, then add oats. Mix well. Drop by teaspoonful on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake in a 350° oven about 15 minutes or until done.

title: Roast
ingredients: beef roast flour seasoning vegetable (onion, carrots, potatoes) water
directions: Any cut of beef roast can be used. Flour and season roast. Brown both sides in frying pan. After browning, place roast in 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Add vegetable as preferred. Add water to almost cover meat. Cover baking dish with foil and bake at 200° for 2 to 3 hours.

title: Rachael Ray's Pasta Shells with Swordfish
ingredients: 1 pound medium pasta shells, farfalle or penne 1/4 cup extra-virgin olive oil 1 1/2 pounds skinless swordfish steaks, sliced 1 inch thick and cut into 1-inch cubes Salt and freshly ground pepper 1 medium zucchini, halved lengthwise and sliced crosswise 1/4 inch thick 1 pint grape tomatoes 4 garlic cloves, thinly sliced 6 scallions, chopped 1/4 cup chopped mint 1/4 cup chopped parsley 1/2 cup dry white wine
directions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the pasta shells and cook, stirring often, until al dente. Drain the shells and return to the pot. Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a large, deep skillet. Add the cubed swordfish, season with salt and pepper and cook over moderately high heat until lightly browned all over, about 4 minutes. With a slotted spoon, transfer the swordfish to a large serving bowl. Add the zucchini, tomatoes and garlic to the skillet and cook over moderately high heat for 3 minutes, stirring. Add the scallions and cook until the tomato skins pop, 2 minutes longer. Return the swordfish and any accumulated juices to the skillet and stir in the mint and parsley. Add the wine and pasta and season with salt and pepper. Transfer to the large bowl and serve.

title: Zucchini Bread
ingredients: 3 eggs, beaten 2 c. sugar 1 c. grated zucchini (raw) 2 Tbsp. vanilla 3 c. plain flour 1 tsp. soda 1 tsp. baking powder 1 tsp. cinnamon
directions: Mix together eggs, sugar, zucchini and vanilla; set aside. Sift remaining ingredients together, then add egg mixture. Add 1 cup chopped nuts, if desired. Bake in 350° preheated oven for 1 hour or until done. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix(Great Christmas Gift)
ingredients: 1 (2 lb.) box Nestle Quik 1 (1 lb.) box confectioners sugar 1 (11 oz.) jar Coffee-mate 1 (8 qt.) box powdered milk
directions: Mix ingredients together. Store in gallon jar. To serve, fill cup 1/2 full with chocolate. Mix and add boiling water.

title: Crock Pot Sweet And Sour Chicken
ingredients: 2 stalks celery, chopped 1 green pepper, thinly sliced 1 onion, thinly sliced 4 tablespoons tapioca, quick-cooking 4 chicken breasts, deboned and chunked 8 ounces pineapple chunks 1/2 cup dark brown sugar or 1/2 cup light brown sugar, packed 2/3 cup pineapple juice 4 tablespoons soy sauce or 4 tablespoons light soy sauce 2 garlic cloves, crushed 1/2 teaspoon ginger, ground (If you have fresh just dice a little and add it)
directions: CROCK POT: Put vegetables in bottom of crock pot. Sprinkle tapioca over vegetables. Place chicken next. Combine all other ingredients and Pour over chicken. Cover crock pot and turn to low and cook for 8-10 hours. OVEN: Put vegetables in bottom of a greased pan. Sprinkle vegetables with tapioca. Add chicken to pan. Combine all other ingredients. Pour over chicken. Cover pan tightly with foil. Bake in 300 deg. oven for 2 hours. The above are basic and easy to do. You can add the cherries or mandarin oranges for flavor and attractiveness.

title: Mixed Mushroom and Goat Cheese Panini
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil, extra-virgin plus more for drizzling 3 cloves garlic minced 3 tablespoons thyme freshly chopped 1 pound mushrooms mixed and finely chopped, such as button, cremini, shiitake or oyster 1/2 pound goat (chevre) cheese soft or other soft fresh cheese 2 tablespoons - truffle oil, optional 1 small focaccia 1 bunch arugula (roquette) small bunch
directions: Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a saute pan over medium-high heat. Add the garlic and 2 tablespoons thyme and cook for 1 minute. Add the mushrooms and cook, stirring frequently, until they are browned and soft, about 10 minutes. Remove from the heat and let them cool for about 20 minutes. Scrape them into a bowl. Crumble in the goat cheese and add the remaining thyme. Pour in the truffle oil, if desired, and toss well to combine. Cut the focaccia into 4 pieces, slice them horizontally, and drizzle with olive oil. On the bottoms place 1/4 of the mushroom mixture and top with some arugula. Put the tops on and gently press each sandwich to flatten it slightly. Drizzle some more olive oil over the tops. Arrange each sandwich on a preheated panini press and grill until the bread is toasted and the cheese begins to melt, about 5 minutes. Alternately, preheat a dry cast iron or non stick pan. Place the sandwich in the pan and weight it down with another pan or a clean brick wrapped in foil. Grill 5 minutes, turn the sandwich over, re-weight it, and grill for another 5 minutes. Serve and enjoy.

title: Mexican Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 lb. Velveeta block cheese, diced 1 small box Velveeta Mexican cheese, diced 1 lb. hamburger Tabasco sauce milk
directions: Cook hamburger, seasoning with salt and pepper to taste; drain grease. In crock-pot, combine hamburger, both cheeses and Tabasco (to taste). Cover and let melt, stirring occasionally and adding milk as needed. Serve with chips.

title: Grain-Free Apple-Pomegranate Breakfast Crumble
ingredients: FOR THE FILLING: 2 whole Large Tart Apples (or 3-4 Small/medium Ones), Cored And Cut Into Bite-sized Cubes 1 cup Pomegranate Arils 2 Tablespoons Honey 2 Tablespoons Freshly Squeezed Lemon Juice (for 2 Tablespoons You'll Need About 1/2 A Lemon) 1 Tablespoon Arrowroot Powder (see Note) 1 teaspoon Cinnamon FOR THE TOPPING: 1/4 cups Melted Coconut Oil, Divided 1 cup Almond Flour 1/2 cups Shredded Unsweetened Coconut 1/2 cups Chopped Nuts, Any Kind 1/4 teaspoons Ground Ginger 1/4 teaspoons Ground Nutmeg 1 Tablespoon Honey FOR THE OPTIONAL YOGURT TOPPING: 1 cup Plain, Whole Milk Yogurt 2 Tablespoons Real Maple Syrup 1/4 teaspoons Cinnamon 1/4 teaspoons Vanilla Extract
directions: Preheat oven to 375 F. For the filling: Place apples and pomegranate arils in a 2 quart baking dish. Drizzle with honey and lemon juice. Sprinkle the arrowroot powder and cinnamon, and give it a stir. Pour 1 tablespoon of the coconut oil (in the topping list) evenly over the top. For the topping: In a small bowl, whisk together the almond flour, coconut, chopped nuts, ginger and nutmeg. Combine the remaining 3 tablespoons coconut oil and the honey in a small bowl or cup then stir it into the dry mixture. You should have a thick, crumbly mixture. Spread the topping evenly over the fruit. Cover dish with foil and bake for 25 minutes. Uncover and bake for an additional 10 minutes or until the top is golden brown and the apples are tender. If you plan on making the yogurt topping, just combine all ingredients into a bowl and stir well. Serve the breakfast crumble with a spoonful or two of yogurt drizzled on top. Note: Arrowroot powder is a grain-free substitute for flour or cornstarch and works like a thickener. If you don't have or can't find it, either leave it out or substitute an equal amount of cornstarch or double the amount of all-purpose flour.

title: Sticky Gooey Cake
ingredients: 1 yellow cake mix 1 stick margarine, softened 2 eggs 1 (8 oz.) cream cheese 1 box powdered sugar 2 eggs 1 c. chopped nuts
directions: Mix and pat first 3 ingredients in a 13 x 9-inch greased pan. Mix next four ingredients and pour over cake. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Spiced Pecans
ingredients: 1/4 c. sugar 1/8 tsp. ground cloves 1 Tbsp. cinnamon 1/8 tsp. nutmeg
directions: Mix in a small bowl. In another bowl, beat slightly 1 egg white. Add, a few at a time, 1 cup pecans. Rub the pecans in the egg white with your fingers to coat them thoroughly. Drop into the bowl of sugar and spices and coat each nut completely. Place on a buttered cookie sheet. Bake 30 minutes at 300°. Check last few minutes to avoid scorching.

title: Lemonade Tea
ingredients: 1 can frozen lemonade 2 c. iced tea fresh mint
directions: Prepare lemonade as directed on can. Stir in tea. Serve over ice. Garnish with mint.

title: Motichoor Laddoo
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups gram flour 1 cup sugar 1 cup water 3/4 teaspoon cardamom powder 1/2 cup raisins and cashews 1 teaspoon ghee oil As required
directions: Sieve the gram flour and then prepare a batter by mixing it with water. Dissolve one cup of sugar in 1 cup of water and prepare the sugar syrup to a single string consistency. Now add the cardamom powder and the food color (orange color) . Heat oil in a pan on medium heat, pour the batter over the ladle to form small balls . Don't let it turn crispy. Drain it from oil and immediately drop them into the sugar syrup. Leave it in the sugar syrup for few minutes and drain it. Repeat the same process for the whole batter. Now heat little ghee in a pan and fry the raisins followed by the cashews , add it to the boondi. Let it cool for few minutes.

title: Crock Pot Chow Mein Recipe
ingredients: 2 pound round steak, cubed & browned 1 can mushrooms, liquid removed 1 onion, diced 4 stalks celery, diced 2 cans Chinese vegetables with juice 6 tbsp. soy sauce 4 tbsp. molasses 1 1/2 teaspoon salt 6 tbsp. tapioca
directions: Add in all ingredients to cubed and browned round steak in order given in crock pot. Cook 4 hrs at 275 degrees.

title: Pork Medallions with Charcuterie Sauce
ingredients: 12 slices pork tenderloin, each 1/2-inch thick Extra-virgin olive oil, for liberal drizzling Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper 4 tablespoons butter 2 shallots, finely chopped 3 tablespoons flour A splash sherry or white wine 2 cups chicken stock 2 tablespoons grainy mustard 12 cornichons, halved or thinly sliced Sliced baguette, for serving
directions: Drizzle the pork with extra-virgin olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the pork in 2 batches, about 2 to 3 minutes per side. Arrange the pork on a platter and cover with foil to keep warm. Reduce heat under the pan and add the butter to melt. Add the shallots, season with salt and lots of coarse pepper, and cook for 2 to 3 minutes. Sprinkle in the flour and stir 1 minute. Add a generous splash of sherry, and then whisk in the stock and thicken. Stir in the mustard and cornichons. Serve 3 medallions on each plate with lots of sauce, with bread alongside.

title: Egg Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 24 large fresh mushrooms, about 1 1/2 inches diameter 6 hard-boiled eggs, finely chopped 1/4 cup fine dry breadcrumb 1/4 cup crumbled blue cheese (1 oz) 2 tablespoons finely chopped green onions, with tops 2 tablespoons dry white wine or 2 tablespoons chicken broth 2 tablespoons butter, melted 1 tablespoon snipped fresh parsley or 1/2 tablespoon parsley flakes 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt paprika
directions: Preheat oven to 450°F. Remove stems from mushrooms and set aside for another use. In medium bowl, stir together eggs, crumbs, cheese, onion, wine, butter, parsley, and garlic salt until well combined. Fill each mushroom cap with 1 rounded tablespoon of egg mixture. Place filled caps on lightly greased baking sheet. Bake until heated through, about 8 to 10 minutes. Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Wyoming Whopper Cookies
ingredients: 2/3 c. margarine 1 1/4 c. packed brown sugar 3/4 c. sugar 3 eggs, beaten 1 1/2 c. chunky peanut butter (Jif) 6 c. old-fashioned oats 2 tsp. baking soda 1 1/2 c. raisins 2 c. (12 oz.) semi-sweet chocolate chips
directions: If using another brand of peanut butter, add several tablespoons of water to mixture. In a large saucepan, melt butter over low heat. Blend in sugars, eggs and peanut butter. Mix until smooth. Add oats, baking soda, raisins and chocolate chips (dough will be sticky). Drop on greased baking sheet using large spoon. Flatten slightly. Bake at 350° about 15 minutes. Cool on wire rack. Yields 2 dozen.

title: Scalloped Hash Browns
ingredients: 1 large bag frozen hash browns, thawed 1/2 pt. sour cream 1 can cream of chicken soup 1/2 c. onion, sauteed in 1/2 c. butter 2 c. Cheddar cheese
directions: Mix all ingredients together and place in an oblong casserole. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Black-Eyed Peas And Ham Hocks
ingredients: 3 c. black-eyed peas 12 c. water 3 lb. smoked ham hocks 1 1/4 c. chopped onion 1 c. chopped celery 1 tsp. salt 1/8 tsp. cayenne 1 bay leaf 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen okra
directions: Bring all ingredients, except okra, to a boil. Then simmer until meat is tender (about 1 1/2 hours). Add okra 30 minutes before cooking is completed. Serve over hot rice.

title: Speedy Chicken Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 lb boneless chicken breast, cubed 1 (10 3/4 ounce) can cream of chicken soup 1 cup chunky salsa 8 (6 inch) flour tortillas 1 (10 3/4 ounce) can cheddar cheese soup
directions: COOK chicken in nonstick skillet until browned and done, stirring often. Add chicken soup and 1/2 cup salsa. Heat through. SPOON about 1/3 cup chicken mixture down center of each tortilla. Roll up tortilla around filling and place seam-side down in 2-qt. microwave-safe baking dish. MIX cheese soup and remaining salsa and pour over enchiladas. Cover. MICROWAVE on HIGH 5 minute or until hot.

title: How To Prepare Fresh Cucumbers
ingredients: 3 medium-size fresh cucumbers 1/4 cup butter or margarine
directions: To Clean: Fresh garden cucumbers may be washed for cooking or for salads without peeling. Large, waxed, out-of-season cucumbers should be peeled since the skin is unpleasant to eat, and seeds should be scraped out with a spoon. Cucumbers maybe cut into halves, or quarters, or thinly sliced, as directed in recipe. To Saute: Cut cucumbers into 1/4-inch-thick slices. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add cucumbers and saute, stirring constantly, until just tender. Season with salt, pepper, and additional butter, if desired. Serve immediately. Other Cooking Methods: Parboil, and then stuff and bake; batter and deep-fry; steam. Serving Suggestions: Sauteed cucumbers may be served with any hollandaise, sour cream, or white sauce. Fresh cucumbers may be thinly sliced and served raw with any of the following: Basil Vinegar, Chive Vinegar, Cream Mint Spread, Dill Sauce, French Dressing, Homemade Mayonnaise, or Oil and Lemon Sauce.

title: Fregola with Clams and Mussels
ingredients: 3 cups chicken stock 3 cups water 1 tablespoon kosher salt, plus more for seasoning 1 pound (3 1/4 cups) fregola pasta 1/4 cup plus 3 tablespoons olive oil 1 medium onion, chopped Freshly ground black pepper 2 garlic cloves, chopped 1 cup dry Marsala wine or dry sherry 1 cup (about 6 ounces) grape or cherry tomatoes 12 little neck clams, cleaned 12 mussels, cleaned 1/2 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
directions: In a large pot, combine the chicken stock, water, and 1 tablespoon salt, and bring to a boil over high heat. Add the pasta and cook until tender but still firm to the bite, stirring occasionally, about 8 to 10 minutes. While the pasta is cooking: Heat 1/4 cup of the oil, over medium-high heat, in a large Dutch oven. Add the onion, season with salt and pepper, and cook until soft, about 5 to 7 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute longer. Add the Marsala wine and grape tomatoes, and cook for 1 minute, scraping the brown bits that cling to the bottom of the pan with a wooden spoon. Add the clams and mussels to the pan. Cover the pan with a tight-fitting lid and cook until all the shellfish have opened, about 5 to 8 minutes. Discard any unopened shellfish. Using tongs, remove the shellfish from the pan and reserve. Drain the pasta and transfer to a large serving bowl. Pour the shellfish cooking liquid over the fregola. Add the remaining olive oil and 1/4 cup of the parsley and toss. Place the reserved shellfish on top of the fregola and garnish with the remaining parsley.

title: Spinach Cheese Swirls
ingredients: 1 sheet pepperidge farm frozen puff pastry (1 sheet - 1/2 package) 1 egg 1 tablespoon water 1/2 cup shredded muenster cheese or 1/2 cup monterey jack cheese 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese 1 green onion, chopped 1/8 teaspoon garlic powder 1 (10 ounce) package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and well drained
directions: Thaw pastry sheet at room temperature 30 minute Preheat oven to 400°F Mix egg and water. Set aside. Mix Muenster cheese, Parmesan cheese, onion and garlic powder. Unfold pastry on lightly floured surface. Brush with egg mixture. Top with cheese mixture and spinach. Starting at short side, roll up like a jelly roll. Cut into 20 (1/2") slices. Place on baking sheet. Brush with egg mixture. Bake 15 minute or until golden. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Chiles Rellenos
ingredients: Chiles 1/4 lb swiss cheese or 1/4 lb monterey jack cheese, cut into strips 8 ounces canned whole green chilies, drained 3 eggs, separated 3 tablespoons flour oil (for deep frying) Sauce 1 (1 lb) can stewed tomatoes 2 tablespoons finely chopped onions 1 chicken bouillon cube 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano 1 dash pepper 1/4 cup grated sharp cheddar cheese sour cream
directions: Insert a strip of cheese into each chile. In a medium sized bowl, beat egg whites until they form soft peaks. In a small bowl, beat egg yolks slightly. Gently fold into egg whites. Add 3 tablespoons flour, and fold in just until blended. In a heavy saucepan or deep fryer, slowly heat 1 1/2 to 2 inches vegetable oil to 400 degrees. Roll the chiles in flour. With a large slotted spoon dip the floured chiles into the egg mixture, coating liberally. Gently place in hot oil, 2 at a time, and cook until golden brown on both sides, about 3 to 4 minutes. Preheat oven to 350. In medium saucepan, combine all remaining ingredients except the shredded cheese and sour cream. Simmer, stirring occasionally, about 10 minutes. Place chiles in a 13x9 glass casserole or baking pan. Spoon the sauce on top of the chiles. Sprinkle the cheddar cheese on top. Bake, uncovered, for 20 mintes, until cheese is melted and chiles are heated through. Serve with sour cream.

title: Dk'S Carne Guisada
ingredients: 1 (3 lb) roast, cut into cubes 1 medium onion, diced 1/2 cup flour 1 teaspoon garlic powder 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin (I use more) 1 (28 ounce) can diced tomatoes with juice 2 cups water salt and pepper 4 large jalapenos, chopped (remove seeds and membrane for milder taste)
directions: Brown meat and onions together. Add small amount of oil if needed. Add flour and stir well. Add tomatoes and water. Stir and add spices and peppers. Salt and pepper to taste. Let simmer several hours until meat is tender and has a thick sauce.

title: Chocolate Fudge Pie
ingredients: 1 3/4 sq. Baker's chocolate 1/4 lb. butter 2 eggs 1 c. sugar 1/4 c. flour 1 tsp. vanilla
directions: Melt chocolate with butter. Beat eggs, sugar and flour. Add chocolate mixture and vanilla. Bake in a buttered pie pan for 25 minutes at 350°.

title: Australian Fish(Servings:  4)
ingredients: 1/2 lb. fresh mushrooms 2 Tbsp. butter 1 Tbsp. oil 1/2 c. Parmesan, Cheddar or Cheshire 1 1/2 lb. fillet of sole or any white fish 1/4 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. pepper 4 Tbsp. green pepper, chopped 6 Tbsp. white wine 2 tsp. fresh lemon juice 1 Tbsp. fresh parsley, chopped
directions: Melt butter in skillet over low heat. Add mushrooms and saute over medium heat until tender. Rub oil over shallow 4-quart baking dish and sprinkle with grated cheese. Place fish on cheese. Sprinkle fish with salt and pepper. Add onions and top with mushrooms. Pour wine over fillets. Bake at 450° for 20 minutes or until fish flakes. Sprinkle with lemon juice and parsley.

title: Caramel-Chocolate Cream Puffs
ingredients: 16 cream puffs (such as Belgian Mini Cream Puffs) from a 13.2-ounce box of frozen cream puffs 1 12.25-ounce jar caramel sauce 1 16-ounce jar hot fudge or dark-chocolate sauce
directions: Defrost the cream puffs according to the label directions. In a small saucepan, over medium-high heat, bring 3/4 of the caramel sauce to a boil. Boil for 1 minute or until the sauce thickens into a chewy glaze. Holding a cream puff with tongs or speared on a fork, dip one side of the puff into the caramel, then place on a dessert plate. Repeat with the remaining puffs, arranging 4 on each plate. A few minutes before serving, warm the hot fudge sauce over low heat. Spoon it around the plated cream puffs. For a Valentine's Day touch, drop 3 small dollops of the remaining unboiled caramel sauce into the hot fudge sauce on each plate. With a toothpick, draw a line through the drops to form hearts (see photo).

title: Crazed Chocolate Biscuits
ingredients: 125 g dark chocolate, finely chopped 23 cup plain flour 14 cup cocoa powder 1 teaspoon baking powder 1 pinch salt 60 g unsalted butter, at room temp 34 cup packed light brown sugar 1 egg, large 12 teaspoon vanilla extract 2 tablespoons milk 12 cup caster sugar 12 cup icing sugar
directions: Melt the chocolate in the microwave (750 power) on low, or in a basin over hot water. Stir until chocolate is melted, then cool. Sift the flour, cocoa, salt and baking powder together. Beat the butter and brown sugar together until light and fluffy. Add the egg and vanilla, and mix well. Mix in the cooled melted chocolate. Reduce speed to low and add the flour mixture in two batches, alternating with the milk. Wrap the dough in cling wrap and refigerate until the dough is firm. (This will take at least 2 hours). When about to bake, preheat the oven to 175c (fan forced 155c). Line the trays with baking paper. Roll the dough into 2-5cm balls and roll in the caster sugar to coat then. toss the balls in the icing sugar and place balls on the lined trays about 5cm apart. Bake biscuits fior about 15 minutes or until the surfaces crack. Remove from oven and cool on tray.

title: Homemade Subs
ingredients: 4 rolls Pillsbury French loaf Italian seasoning 1 lb. deli ham, sliced thin 1 lb. roast beef, sliced thin 1 lb. deli white American cheese 1 (8 oz.) Kraft Zesty Italian dressing lettuce tomatoes
directions: Place bread on baking sheet and spray bread with cooking oil and sprinkle with Italian seasoning. Bake as directed. Let cool. Slice bread open and pour Italian dressing on both sides of bread, then layer ham, cheese, roast beef, lettuce and tomato. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cut into 4 pieces. Makes about 16 subs. May also use your favorite meats.

title: Georgia Peach Cobbler
ingredients: 2 c. fresh or frozen peaches, sliced 2 c. sugar 1/2 stick Parkay 3/4 c. flour 3/4 c. milk
directions: Mix 1 cup of the sugar with peaches. Melt the oleo in glass baking dish in microwave. Mix together remaining sugar, flour and milk. Pour this into center of dish containing oleo. Do not stir. Next, pour in the sliced peaches. Put generous amount of sugar on top and sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Green Bean Salad With Pine Nuts And Feta
ingredients: 400 g green beans, blanched 2 minutes 50 g pine nuts, toasted (optional) 200 g feta cheese, crumbled 1 bunch flat leaf parsley, chopped 100 g olives olive oil 1 garlic clove, crushed 1 lemon, juice of salt and pepper 1 pinch chili powder (optional)
directions: Grab a bowl throw in all of the above, and mix--how easy is that! Enjoy!

title: Peanut Butter And Chocolate Eyeballs
ingredients: 1/2 cups Butter 1-1/2 cup Peanut Butter 1 Tablespoon Vanilla 1 pound Powdered Sugar 1 pound White Chocolate 40 pieces Mini Chocolate Chips Red Food Gel
directions: Mix the butter and peanut butter together until creamy. Add the vanilla. Add the sifted powdered sugar, and mix well. Form balls, approximately 1 inch (or .6-.7 ounce if you have a digital scale) and refrigerate until firm. Melt the white chocolate and keep warm over a double broiler. Insert a toothpick into the center of a ball and dip into the white chocolate until all but a bit of peanut butter is covered. Shake off excess chocolate and place on a wax-paper lined cookie sheet to firm up. Add a mini chocolate chip, tip side down, into the hole of each eyeball. Decorate with red food gel to make them bloodshot.

title: Catherine'S Slush
ingredients: 3 c. water 2 c. sugar 12 oz. frozen orange juice with 1 can cold water 1 large can crushed pineapple 6 large bananas 1 jar cherries
directions: Bring water and sugar to a boil. Add frozen orange juice, cold water and crushed pineapple. Mix thoroughly. Remove from heat. Slice bananas and chop whole jar of cherries and add to liquid mixture. Stir mixture and pour into plastic container with a top. Put in freezer until frozen.

title: Lemon Poppy Seed Cookies
ingredients: 2 cups All-purpose Flour 1 teaspoon Baking Powder 1/4 teaspoons Salt 1/4 teaspoons Baking Soda 1 Tablespoon Poppy Seeds 1/2 cups Butter, Softened 1/2 cups Sugar 1/2 cups Brown Sugar, Packed 1 whole Egg 1/2 teaspoons Vanilla 1 whole Lemon (just The Zest) 1/4 cups Buttermilk
directions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. In a medium bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, salt, baking soda and poppy seeds. Set aside. In a large bowl, cream the butter and sugars together until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes. Add the egg, vanilla and lemon zest and mix well. Add into the creamed mixture the dry ingredients and the buttermilk. Mix well. Drop the dough by small tablespoonfuls onto a greased or lined baking sheet. Bake for 10-12 minutes, until the edges are set. The cookies should be puffy and fairly light in color when they are finished baking. Remove from the oven and let cool for 1-2 minutes on the baking sheet. Move the cookies to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Low-Fat Finger Lickin' Good Chicken
ingredients: 4 Tbsp. low sugar apricot jam juice of 1/2 orange 1/4 tsp. rosemary 1/2 tsp. minced garlic 1/8 tsp. cinnamon 1/4 c. raisins black pepper to taste 4 skinless chicken breasts (6 oz. each)
directions: Preheat oven to 400°. Combine all ingredients except chicken in a glass baking dish. Coat chicken in apricot mixture and lay flat in dish. Bake at 400° for 10 minutes. Turn chicken over. Reduce heat to 325°. Bake another 30 minutes until done. Serve with steamed carrots. Makes 4 servings. Calories 337; cholesterol 144 mg., fat 6 grams; sodium 114 mg.

title: Chocolate Roulage with Bourbon Cream
ingredients: Softened unsalted butter, for greasing baking sheet 5 egg yolks 1 cup granulated sugar 3 ounces bittersweet chocolate, chopped 3 ounces semisweet chocolate, chopped 1 tablespoon espresso or strong black coffee 2 teaspoons vanilla extract 5 egg whites 2 cups heavy cream 2 teaspoons confectioners' sugar 1/2 cup bourbon Seeds from 1/2 vanilla bean 1 cup cocoa powder, plus more for dusting Fresh berries, for garnish
directions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F. Butter a rimmed jelly roll/baking sheet and line with parchment paper. Butter the top of the paper as well, especially the corners. In a stand mixer with the whisk attachment, beat the egg yolks and granulated sugar on medium speed until fluffy and the sugar is not gritty, 10 to12 minutes. While the eggs are beating, put the chocolate in a bowl and melt over a double boiler. When the chocolate is melted, remove from the heat and let it cool a bit. Sit the bowl in some cool water for a few minutes if necessary. Incorporate the egg mixture into the chocolate by adding a little at a time to temper the mixture, so you don't cook the eggs. Add the espresso and 1 teaspoon vanilla extract. In a clean bowl, with the whisk attachment, beat the egg whites until stiff peaks form. Incorporate one-quarter of the egg whites into the chocolate mixture; make sure no white streaks remain. Carefully fold in the remaining whites into the chocolate, taking care not to deflate the whites but making sure not to have any white streaks in the batter. Spread the batter in the prepared pan and bake, 10 to 12 minutes. Remove from the oven and spread a dampened tea towel or several dampened paper towels over the top of the cake and let it sit for 30 minutes. In a clean bowl, with the whisk attachment, whip the heavy cream, confectioners' sugar, bourbon, vanilla bean and the remaining 1 teaspoon vanilla extract on medium speed until stiff peaks form. Carefully turn the cake out onto clean parchment paper, making sure to have 4 to 5 inches of excess paper at the end to help you roll the cake. Using a fine sieve or sifter, sprinkle 1/2 cup cocoa powder over the top of the cake. Spread the whipped cream mixture over the top, leaving 1/4-inch on each side. Using the edge of the parchment paper, carefully roll the cake creating a jellyroll effect, tuck and roll as you go, peeling back the paper along the way. Put the rolled cake seam-side down and dust the whole cake with the remaining 1/2 cup cocoa powder. Chill 2 hours before serving. You might even put the cake in the freezer for an hour before serving so that it is easy to slice. To serve, slice cake with a serrated knife and place on chilled plates. Garnish with a light dusting of cocoa powder and fresh berries. This recipe was created by a contestant during a cooking competition. The Food Network Kitchens have not tested it for home use, therefore, we cannot make any representation as to the results.

title: Strawberry Bavarian Cream
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen sliced strawberries 1 c. boiling water 1 pkg. strawberry flavored gelatin 1 c. chilled whipping cream
directions: Drain strawberries keeping syrup in a cup. Pour water over gelatin in bowl, stirring until dissolved. Add enough cold water to syrup to make one cup. Stir into gelatin. Chill until almost set.

title: Strawberry Banana Delight
ingredients: 2 cup Flour 2 stick Margarine 1 1/4 cup Powdered Sugar 16 oz Coolwhip 2 can Strawberry Pie Filling 2 Bananas 2 cup Powdered Sugar
directions: Preheat oven to 425F Add flour and 1/4 cup powdered sugar to a large mixing bowl Add softened Margarine to bowl and stir until dough is formed. Spread dough into 9x13 inch pan and place in oven until golden brown. Should take about 15 minutes. While crust is cooking, in a separate bowl, add pie filling, powdered sugar, and bananas and gently mix. Set aside. When crust is finished let cool completely. Pour the Strawberry Banana mixture onto crust, smooth evenly. Pour cool whip on top of Strawberry Banana mixture. Cover and place in refrigerator until ready to serve.

title: Tossed Salad With Pine Nuts In Dill-Garlic Dressing
ingredients: 2 heads romaine lettuce 1/4 c. red wine vinegar 2 tsp. Dijon mustard 1 c. heavy cream 1/4 c. salad oil 2 garlic cloves, mashed 2 tsp. dried dill weed 3/4 c. pine nuts, lightly toasted
directions: Remove bottom core (about an inch or more) from each head of romaine and discard any outer leaves that are very dark green or heavy. Wash lettuce thoroughly and tear into bite-size bits. (At this point you can spin salad dry or wrap in clean kitchen towel and store in refrigerator until ready to serve.)

title: Creamed Corn
ingredients: 20 oz. frozen corn 8 oz. whipping cream 8 oz. milk 1 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. Accent 6 tsp. sugar 2 Tbsp. melted oleo 2 Tbsp. flour
directions: Combine all ingredients except oleo and flour. Bring to a boil and simmer 5 minutes. Blend oleo and flour; add to corn. Cook until desired thickness is reached. Yummy!

title: Apfelküchlein (Deep Fried Apple Cookies)
ingredients: 4 -5 sour apples (e.g. Jonathan or Boskop) 4 tablespoons sugar 1 lemon, juice of 4 ounces white flour (120 g) 1 1/2 ounces ground hazelnuts (40 g) 1/2 teaspoon salt 2 teaspoons vanilla sugar 5 fluid ounces apple cider (1 1/2 dl) 2 eggs, separated 1 teaspoon oil deep-frying oil confectioners' sugar or cinnamon sugar, for dusting
directions: Peal the apples and remove the core. Cut each apple into rings, each about 1/2-inch (1 cm) thick; set aside. Add 3 tablespoons of sugar to the lemon juice, brush the lemon/sugar mixture over the apples and set them aside for about 30 minutes. In a bowl, mix together flour, hazelnuts, salt, one tablespoon of sugar and the vanilla sugar. Add apple cider and stir well. Add both egg yolks and one teaspoon oil, and mix well. Leave the dough alone for about 30 minutes. Add a pinch of salt to the egg whites and beat until stiff. Carefully mix it with the dough. Heat the dry-frying oil in a frying pan to 375°F (190°C). Dip one coated ring of apple at a time into the dough and fry it immediately in the oil on both sides until lightly browned. Drain off excess oil. Dust cookies with confectioner's or cinnamon sugar while still warm, and serve them immediately. But they also taste good cold, especially if served with warm vanilla sauce.

title: Baked Brie En Croute
ingredients: 1 brie round 2 sheets puff pastry 4 ounces any pesto sauce 1 loaf ciabatta 3 sprigs rosemary 2 eggs
directions: Place brie on one sheet of pastry and spread pesto over the top of the brie. Do not get oil on pastry because it may cause the pastry sheet to come apart during baking. Cut the other sheet of pastry into a circle shape and place on top of the brie. Using egg wash, seal the pastries together and trim any excess dough. Use the extra pieces of dough and the rosemary sprigs to make a garnish on the top. Apply egg wash over the garnish, too. Bake in a 400 degree oven until golden brown. Cut bread into wedges and serve with the Baked Brie en Croute.

title: Cucumber-Honeydew Cooler
ingredients: 1/4 English cucumber 1/2 c. diced honeydew ice Cucumber peel
directions: Puree cucumber and honeydew in a blender until smooth. Strain and chill. Pour into a shaker and shake with ice. Strain into a martini glass and garnish with cucumber peel. Looking for cocktail recipes? Try our top fruity drink recipes, retro cocktails, or punch recipes.

title: Nana's Reese Cup Dessert
ingredients: 1 (11 ounce) box vanilla wafers 12 cup oleo 8 ounces fat free cream cheese 2 (12 ounce) containers Cool Whip 1 (6 ounce) box chocolate instant pudding 3 cups milk 1 (10 ounce) peanut butter cups
directions: Layer in order given. Bottom Layer (Crust). Crush Vanilla Waffers and mix with melted oleo. Spread into 9x13 dish. 2nd Layer (White Layer). Soften Cream Cheese and beat in Cool Whip with electric mixer. Spread over cookie crust. 3rd Layer (Reese Layer). Spread out chopped Reese Cup candies. 4th Layer (Chocolate Layer) Prepare pudding with 3 cups milk. Spread over Reese Cup layer. 5th Layer. Spread all the remaining cool whip over the pudding layer and sprinkle with a few reese cup pieces. Cover and let sit in refrigerator over night.

title: Jackfruit Gyros
ingredients: 1 Tbs. vegan margarine 1 large onion, halved and thinly sliced (2 cups) 1 20-oz. can young jackfruit in brine, rinsed, drained, and pulled apart into shreds 3/4 cup low-sodium vegetable broth 4 Tbs. lemon juice, divided 2 tsp. dried oregano 1 tsp. low-sodium soy sauce 3/4 tsp. ground coriander
directions: Heat margarine in skillet over medium heat until sizzling. Add onion, and saute 3 to 4 minutes, or until softened. Add jackfruit, and cook 20 minutes, or until browned and caramelized. Add broth, 2 Tbs. lemon juice, oregano, soy sauce, and coriander, and season with salt and pepper, if desired. Simmer 10 to 15 minutes, or until liquid has almost completely evaporated. Stir in remaining 2 Tbs. lemon juice.

title: Pitcher Of Frozen Margarita'S
ingredients: 4 ounces tequila 1 ounce triple sec 1 (12 ounce) can frozen limeade concentrate 3 cans crushed ice 1/4 cup water For Serving lime juice magarita salt lime wedge
directions: Add first 5 ingredients to a blender and liquify. Add extra water if needed to keep blender moving. Dip rims of glasses in lime juice then salt. Place a lime wedge on glass rim. Serve.

title: Jalapenos Stuffed with Chorizo and Cream Cheese
ingredients: 1 tbsp. vegetable oil 1 tbsp. finely minced onion 1 clove garlic, finely minced 3 oz. chorizo sausage 2 oz. cream cheese, softened 1 tbsp. sour cream Salt, to taste 12 Jalapenos, seeded, halved and deribbed
directions: Heat oil in a skillet; saute onion and garlic over medium heat 2-3 minutes, until transparent. Add chorizo and cook 5 minutes, breaking up meat with a fork as it cooks. When fully cooked, remove skillet from heat and cool slightly, then stir in cheese and spor cream, season with salt and spoon into jalapenos.

title: Turkey Hash With Chorizo
ingredients: 3 whole Medium Sized White Potatoes 1/4 cups Diced Purple Onion 1 clove Garlic, Peeled And Minced 1/4 cups Diced Red Pepper 2 Tablespoons Diced Anaheim (or Other Mild) Pepper 2 teaspoons Olive Oil (or More, If Necessary) 4 ounces, weight Chorizo Sausage 1 cup Leftover Roasted Turkey, Diced 1 pinch Salt And Pepper, to taste 4 whole Soft Fried Eggs (optional, But Encouraged)
directions: 1.	Scrub potatoes before cutting into 1-inch cubes. Place the cubes into a medium saucepan. Add water to the pan, until the water comes 1 inch above the potatoes. Boil potatoes until they are fork-tender, about 8 to 10 minutes. Drain. 2.	Dice the purple onion, garlic, red pepper, and Anaheim pepper; set aside. 3.	In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the chorizo, breaking apart and cooking until done. 4.	Add the diced vegetables to the chorizo in the skillet, sauteing until they are soft. 5.	Once vegetables are soft, stir the potatoes and leftover turkey into the pan. Continue stirring until entire mixture is warmed. 6.	Season with salt and pepper, to taste. 7.	Serve as is, or transfer to a large bowl and tent with foil to keep warm while your fry up a few soft fried eggs in the skillet. Then divide the hash among four plates, and serve with a soft fried egg on top.

title: Sopa De Enchilada (Mexican Enchilada Soup)
ingredients: 5 corn tortillas, cut into thin strips 1/4 cup vegetable oil 2 tablespoons vegetable oil 1 yellow onion, chopped 1 tablespoon garlic, minced 1 red bell pepper, chopped 1/2 cup corn 5 cups chicken stock 1 (15 ounce) can tomato puree 1/2 teaspoon coarse salt 1 1/4 teaspoons chili powder 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper 1 1/4 teaspoons sugar 3/4 teaspoon tapatio hot sauce 1 teaspoon Worcestershire sauce 4 teaspoons flour 1/2 cup water 2 1/2 cups cooked chicken, shredded 1/2 cup heavy cream 1/4 cup sour cream 1 cup mild cheddar cheese, shredded 1/2 cup black beans, drained rinsed 1/4 cup fresh cilantro, chopped (garnish)
directions: Heat 1/4 cup vegetable oil in a 10-inch skillet. When oil is hot, add tortilla strips and stir until golden and crisp, 2 to 3 minutes. Drain on paper towels and set aside. Cook onion in remaining 2 tablespoons oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat until translucent. Add garlic, bell pepper and corn; cook for about 2 minutes. Stir in chicken stock, tomato puree, salt, chili powder, pepper, sugar, hot sauce, and Worcestershire sauce; bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Whisk flour and water in a small bowl and stir into soup. Bring to a boil, then simmer 4 minutes. Add chicken and bring back to a simmer. Stir in cream, sour cream, shredded cheese, and black beans. To serve, garnish with fried tortilla strips and cilantro.

title: The Meditteranian Panini
ingredients: 2 slices of hearty sourdough bread. 1 oz. - Pesto (Prepared) 6 - Red Onion Rings 1 - Small handful black olives 4 - Slices red tomato 1 oz. (approx) feta cheese
directions: Spread the pesto on the bottom slice of sourdough. Layer the onions, olives, and tomato on top of the pesto. Sprinkle the feta on top of the tomato. Top with 2nd slice of sourdough. Place on a heated panini grill, spray with Butter-Flavored Cooking Spray, and cook for 4 minutes or until golden brown. Cut in half, and serve with an organic spring greens salad topped with feta cheese, diced tomato, onion, black olives, and a Greek Roasted Garlic Viniagrette.

title: Spicy Italian Beef Open Face Sandwich
ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast (3 to 4 pounds) 1 jar (12 oz) pepperoncini 1 can (14 oz) beef broth 1 (12oz) beer 1 med. onion, minced 2 Tbls Italian seasoning French Bread or Focaccia slices Provolone cheese (optional)
directions: 1. Trim fat from beef and discard. Cut beef to fit in 4.5 quart slow cooker, if necessary. 2. Use about 10 pepperoncini, pull off stems, discard. ADD pepperoncini, broth, beer, onion and herb blend to slow cooker, do not stir. Cover cook on LOW 8 to 10 hours. 3. Remove beef from cooker, shed with 2 forks. Return shredded beef to cooking liquid mix well. 4. Slice bread to desired thickness. Butter one side and toast butter side down in heavy pan on medium heat until crisp. 5. Preheat broiler. Place toast soft side up on oven proof plate. Top with beef, sauce, pepperoncini and cheese slices. Broil until cheese melts. Serve immediately.

title: Country Cobbler
ingredients: 1 (21 ounce) can apple pie filling 1 (16 ounce) cansliced pears, drained 13 cup dried cranberries 23 cup orange juice 2 teaspoons cornstarch 12 teaspoon nutmeg 1 12 cups reduced-fat baking mix 23 cup 2% milk 2 tablespoons sugar sugar, and 14 teaspoon nutmeg, for topping
directions: Heat the oven to 400 degrees F. Combine the pie filling, pears and cranberries in an 8-inch square baking dish. Mix the orange juice, cornstarch and nutmeg until smooth, and gently stir into the fruit. Stir the baking mix, milk, sugar and butter in a bowl just until blended to make a biscuit dough; spoon on top of the fruit in 6 equal portions, spacing slightly apart. For the topping, mix sugar and nutmeg; sprinkle over the cobbler. Bake for 45 minutes or until the fruit is bubbly and the biscuit topping is browned and cooked through. Cool on a rack for at least 30 minutes. Serve warm or at room temperature. Servings: 6. Nutritional Information Per Serving:. Calories 360; Total fat 7g; Saturated fat 3g; Cholesterol 10mg; Sodium 410mg; Carbohydrate 73g; Fiber 3g; Protein 4g.

title: Hush Puppies
ingredients: 1 egg 2 c. buttermilk 2 c. corn meal 1 1/2 tsp. baking powder 1 tsp. salt 2 Tbsp. flour 1 Tbsp. baking powder cayenne pepper to taste 6 Tbsp. fat (for deep frying)
directions: Beat eggs and buttermilk together and set aside. Mix all dry ingredients. Add chopped onions. Blend in buttermilk. Heat fat to 375°. Drop hush puppies a few tablespoons at a time into the fat. Fry about 2 to 3 minutes or until evenly browned. They will float to the surface when cooked. Drain on absorbent paper and serve at once.

title: Bistro Grilled Chicken Sandwich
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts 1/2 cup Italian dressing 2 teaspoons italian seasoning 4 leaves romaine lettuce (optional) 1 tomatoes, sliced (optional) 4 slices provolone cheese 4 jumbo hamburger buns 1/2 cup mayonnaise 1 teaspoon italian seasoning 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder
directions: If chicken is frozen, thaw before beginning. Combine mayonnaise, 1 tsp Italian Seasoning, and 1/4 tsp garlic powder. Place chicken on one half of cellophane and cover with the other half. Tenderize with a mallet until entire piece of chicken is close to the same thickness throughout. Rub Italian dressing on both sides of chicken, then sprinkle Italian seasoning on one side only. Let marinate for approximately 15 minutes. Preheat frying pan or griddle to 325 degrees (or medium heat). Cook chicken until no longer pink in the center. Prepare lettuce and slice tomato. Thinly spread mayonnaise on bottom and top bun. Place chicken on bottom bun. Add cheese on top of chicken. Then place tomato and lettuce on top bun and put sandwich together. To complete this healthy dish, add a nice salad on the side.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
ingredients: 3 chicken breasts, cooked and cubed 1 (16 ounce) can Veg-All 1 (10 ounce) can cream of potato soup 12 cup milk 1 egg, beaten 2 pie crusts
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine first four ingredients. Pour mix into piecrust. Cover with 2nd piecrust. Brush on beaten egg. Bake 45 minutes or until crust is golden brown.

title: Fruit Cake Cookies
ingredients: 4 eggs 1 stick butter or margarine 3 1/2 c. flour 1 c. light brown sugar 1 tsp. vanilla 1 tsp. baking soda 1 tsp. baking powder 1/2 tsp. allspice 1/2 tsp. nutmeg 1 lb. candied pineapple 1 lb. candied cherries 1 lb. pecans, broken in small pieces 1 lb. (1 box) golden raisins 1 large jigger bourbon 3 large Tbsp. buttermilk
directions: Cut cherries and pineapple into small pieces. Mix together well. Add brown sugar and butter or margarine. Mix well. Beat eggs lightly with fork and add to mixture. Add vanilla, buttermilk and bourbon. Mix well. Combine baking soda, baking powder, allspice and nutmeg in small bowl. Add to mixture. Add raisins and pecans and mix well. Add flour and mix thoroughly. Let stand 30 or 40 minutes. With teaspoon drop on ungreased baking sheets with cookies not touching one another. Bake in preheated 350° oven 12 to 15 minutes. Place in container and cover. When all are baked, leave tightly covered until next day, then put in airtight container and freeze until Christmas.

title: Pineapple Casserole
ingredients: 1 large can crushed pineapple with heavy syrup 1/2 c. sugar with 7 Tbsp. self-rising flour, combined 1 c. grated Cheddar cheese 1 stick Ritz crackers, crushed 1 stick margarine, melted
directions: Pour pineapple into casserole dish; sprinkle flour mixture over it. Put cheese over this, then crackers. Drizzle melted margarine over all. Cook at 350° for about 20 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Country Potato Soup
ingredients: 2 qt. chicken broth 4 to 5 medium potatoes, sliced or diced 1/2 c. chopped onion 1 stick butter or margarine 1 c. half and half 1/2 c. milk salt to taste dash of pepper
directions: Cook potatoes in chicken broth until done. Saute onion in butter or margarine. Add to potatoes. Then add half and half, milk and salt and pepper. Makes enough for 12 to 14 people.

title: Snow Ice Cream
ingredients: large bowl snow (approx. 5 qt.) 1 can sweetened condensed milk 1 c. sugar 2 tsp. vanilla
directions: Mix until blended, eat with spoon.

title: Granddad'S Meatballs
ingredients: 3 pounds lean ground beef 1 teaspoon Worcestershire sauce 1 cup milk 2 cups oats 1 teaspoon pepper 2 eggs 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt 1 teaspoon salt 1 tablespoon dried onions 1/2 teaspoon chili powder Sauce: 1 1/2 cups brown sugar 2 cups catsup 1 teaspoon mustard 1 teaspoon chili powder 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon Worcestershire sauce
directions: Mix meatball ingredients together. Shape into balls. Mix sauce ingredients together and pour over meatballs. Cover with foil and bake at 350 for 1 hour.

title: Squash Casserole
ingredients: 3 c. cooked yellow squash 1/2 c. onion, chopped 1 c. grated carrots 1 can cream of mushroom soup 1 c. sour cream 1 tsp. salt 1 tsp. pepper 1 c. cracker crumbs 1 c. grated mild Cheddar cheese
directions: Mix all together in order given. Put in 2-quart baking dish. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. (Preheat oven.)

title: Mexican Chicken and Beans
ingredients: 1 lb chicken breast, strips 1 (1 1/4 ounce) package reduced-sodium taco seasoning mix 1 (15 ounce) can pinto beans, rinsed 1 (11 ounce) can corn mixed with chopped peppers, undrained
directions: COAT a lorge nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Add cicken; cook and stir on medium-high 4 to 5 minutes or until no longer pink. Stir in taco seasoning mix, beans, corn and 1/4 cup water. Cook 8 to 10 minutes; stir frequently or until sauce is slightly thickened.

title: Crispy Bbq Chip Tenders
ingredients: 1 cup sour cream 1/4 cup minced fresh chives 2 garlic cloves, minced 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/4 cup all-purpose flour 2 tablespoons light brown sugar 1 teaspoon ground mustard 3/4 teaspoon pepper 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper 2 eggs, lightly beaten 2-1/2 cups coarsely crushed barbecue potato chips 1-1/2 pounds chicken tenderloins Cooking spray
directions: Preheat oven to 400°. In a small bowl, mix sour cream, chives, garlic and salt. Refrigerate until serving. In a shallow bowl, mix flour, brown sugar and seasonings. Place eggs and potato chips in separate shallow bowls. Dip chicken in flour mixture to coat both sides; shake off excess. Dip in eggs, then in potato chips, patting to help coating adhere. Place on a rack in a 15x10x1-in. baking pan; spritz with cooking spray. Bake until coating is golden brown and chicken is no longer pink, 12-15 minutes. Serve with sauce.

title: Smoked Salmon and Lentil Salad
ingredients: 2 cups OSCAR MAYER Bacon, chopped Rite Aid 2 For $7.00 thru 02/06 2 cups onions, chopped King Sooper's 1 lb For $0.99 thru 02/09 2-1/2 qt. dry lentils 3 gal. water 1-1/2 qt. smoked salmon, sliced 1 qt. cherry tomatoes, quartered 2 cups KRAFT Golden Italian Dressing 1 cup sour cream
directions: Cook bacon in 2-gallon stockpot (or 3-quart saucepan for trial recipe) 4 to 5 minutes or until slightly browned, stirring occasionally. Add onion; cook 4 to 5 minutes or until tender, stirring occasionally. Add lentils and water. Bring to boil. Reduce heat to medium-low; simmer 1 to 1-1/2 hours or until lentils are soft, yet still firm to the bite. Drain; discard liquid. Place lentil mixture in refrigerator to cool. Mix lentil mixture, salmon and dressing. Spoon sour cream into squeeze bottle. Squeeze sour cream, in spider-web design, over individual servings of salads.

title: Easy Manicotti With Cheese
ingredients: 3 1/2 c. (32 oz.) spaghetti sauce 1 c. water 1 (8 oz.) box manicotti, uncooked 1 to 2 c. Ricotta cheese (8 to 16 oz.) 2 c. Mozzarella cheese 1/4 c. Parmesan cheese 1/2 tsp. salt 2 Tbsp. parsley, chopped 1/4 tsp. pepper
directions: Heat spaghetti sauce with water to boil. Reduce and simmer. Mix cheeses together with parsley, salt and pepper. Spoon into uncooked manicotti. Pour 1 cup sauce on bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Arrange filled manicotti in single layer over sauce. Cover with remaining sauce. Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 400° for 50 minutes.

title: Glazed Lemon Flute Cake
ingredients: 1 package yellow cake mix (regular size) 1 package (3 ounces) lemon gelatin 4 large eggs, room temperature 2/3 cup water 2/3 cup canola oil 1 cup confectioners' sugar 3 tablespoons lemon juice 1 teaspoon grated lemon zest
directions: In a large bowl, combine the cake mix, gelatin, eggs, water and oil. Beat on low speed for 1 minute. Beat on medium for 2 minutes. Pour into a greased and floured 10-in. fluted tube pan. Bake at 350° for 38-42 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Cool for 10 minutes before removing from pan to a wire rack. Combine glaze ingredients; drizzle over warm cake. Cool completely before cutting.

title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 2 cans cream of chicken soup 1 can crescent rolls 2 cans Veg-All, drained 2 c. cooked chicken or more
directions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into a casserole dish. Top with crescent rolls. Bake at 350° until golden brown.

title: Pan Roasted Chicken With Maple Syrup And Tomatoes
ingredients: 1/3 cup maple syrup 1 tbsp Dijon mustard 1/2 tbsp olive oil 2 tbsp butter 2 None zucchinis, quartered 8 cloves garlic, unpeeled 2 stalks rosemary 8 None chicken thighs with bone and skin 1/2 lb cherry or grape tomatoes None None crusty bread, to serve None None green salad, to serve
directions: Preheat oven to 425°F. For the glaze, place the maple syrup and mustard in a small bowl and stir with a fork to combine. Heat the olive oil and butter in large ovenproof frying pan or Dutch oven over high heat. Cook the zucchini, garlic and rosemary 4 mins, until beginning to color. Remove from pan and set aside. Season the chicken thighs and cook skin-side down in pan 5 mins, until golden and crisp. Drain off excess fat. Turn chicken skin-side up and drizzle with glaze. Nestle zucchini, garlic, rosemary and tomatoes between the chicken thighs in the pan. Season and roast 25-30 mins until chicken is cooked through. Cool 3-4 mins and serve with bread and salad.

title: Malaysian Mango Chicken Curry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil 1/2 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast, cubed 1/2 cup chicken stock 1 tablespoon soy sauce 1 tablespoon cider vinegar 1 1/2 tablespoons brown sugar 1 teaspoon curry powder 1 tablespoon cornstarch 1/2 onion, diced 1 green bell pepper, sliced 1 red bell pepper, sliced 2 teaspoons minced fresh ginger root 1 mango, peeled and cubed
directions: Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and stir in the chicken breast. Cook the chicken breast until no longer pink in the center. Transfer cooked chicken to a plate. Meanwhile, whisk together the chicken stock, soy sauce, vinegar, brown sugar, curry powder, and cornstarch. Set aside. Using the same skillet, cook and stir the onion over medium heat until the onion has softened and turned translucent, about 5 minutes. Stir in the green and red bell peppers and cook for 2 minutes, then add the ginger and cook for another minute. Stir in the chicken stock mixture and the cooked chicken breast. Cook until the sauce has thickened. Drop mango in and cook until the mango is heated through.

title: Chili-Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1/2 c. finely chopped onion 1 Tbsp. butter 2 medium tomatoes, peeled, seeded and chopped 1 (4 oz.) can green chili peppers, rinsed, seeded and chopped 1/4 tsp. salt 1 1/2 c. shredded Cheddar cheese milk tortilla chips
directions: In a 1-quart casserole, combine onion and butter. Cook at High for 2 minutes until tender, stirring once. Stir in tomatoes, chili peppers and salt. Cover and cook at High for 5 minutes. Add cheese, a little at a time, stirring until melted. Stir in a little milk, if mixture becomes too thick. Cook on High for 45 minutes. Stir. Serve with tortilla chips. Makes 1 3/4 cups.

title: Hot Sausage And Cheese Hors D'Ouevres
ingredients: 3 c. biscuit mix 1 lb. hot Italian sausage 10 oz. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
directions: Split open sausages and scrape out contents. Mix sausage with biscuit mix and cheese. Form into balls and bake on a cookie sheet at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes. Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Cloud 9 Ambrosia Salad
ingredients: 3 c. mini marshmallows 1 c. plain nonfat yogurt 1/2 c. flaked sweetened coconut 20 oz. can crushed pineapple, drained 20 oz. can chunk pineapple, drained 11 oz. can mandarin oranges, drained
directions: Lightly combine all ingredients until well mixed. Chill at least 1 hour.

title: Crispy Buttermilk Chicken(Ultra Low-Fat)
ingredients: 3/4 c. low-fat buttermilk 1/2 tsp. Lawry's garlic salt 2 cloves garlic, pressed black pepper to taste 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts 2 c. cornflakes, crushed
directions: Mix together buttermilk, garlic salt, garlic and black pepper. Dip chicken breasts in mixture and roll in cornflakes. Bake on baking sheet sprayed with nonstick cooking spray at 350° for 25 to 35 minutes. Makes 4 servings. Calories per serving, 260; fat per serving, 4.5.

title: Turkey Honey Mustard Pita Pocket
ingredients: 1 12 ounces of lean smoked turkey breast, sliced 2 teaspoons reduced-calorie mayonnaise 12 teaspoon mustard 12 teaspoon honey whole wheat pita bread lettuce tomatoes, sliced
directions: Mix the mayonnaise, mustard and honey together and spread it all inside the pita pocket for such good flavor. Stuff the pocket with the turkey, lettuce and tomato.

title: Sausage Soup
ingredients: 1/2 lb. hot sausage 1 lb. sweet sausage 2 chopped onions 1 chopped green pepper 4 c. beef broth 1 1/2 c. red wine 1 (8 oz.) can tomato sauce 1 (28 oz.) can tomato puree 1 tsp. garlic powder 1 Tbsp. oregano 1 Tbsp. basil 1 Tbsp. parsley Salt and pepper to taste 1 (8 oz.) box cork-screw pasta Parmesan cheese
directions: Remove skin from sausage. Crumble and saute in a large pot until browned. Drain. Add onions and green peppers. Saute until tender. Add broth and wine, bring to a boil and add tomato sauce, puree, garlic powder, oregano, basil, parsley. Salt and pepper to taste. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and cook uncovered for 1 hour. Pasta may be added the last 15 minutes. If a thinner soup is desired, pre-cook pasta and add just before serving. Serve with grated cheese. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Rose Royale
ingredients: 4 candied rose petals 1 12 teaspoons rose vodka 23 cup rose champagne, chilled
directions: Place candied rose petals in a Champagne flute. Add rose vodka and Champagne.

title: Persimmon Pudding
ingredients: 2 c. pulp 3 eggs 1 3/4 c. milk 2 c. flour 1/2 tsp. cinnamon 1/2 tsp. nutmeg 1 1/2 c. sugar 3 Tbsp. melted butter or margarine 2 tsp. coconut or vanilla flavoring
directions: Mix flour, cinnamon, nutmeg and sugar together well. Add to this eggs, milk, butter and flavoring after they have been mixed in a separate bowl. Next add persimmon pulp to all of the ingredients; mix well and pour into a 9 x 12 pan and bake at 350° until a knife inserted comes out slightly moist. Eat after cooled to room temperature or after refrigerated. Keep in refrigerator to store.

title: Porterhouse Steak with Hoisin Barbecue Sauce and Rosemary and Garlic Fingerling Potatoes
ingredients: 1 tablespoon peanut oil 1/2 medium red onion, finely diced 2 cloves garlic, minced 6 plum tomatoes, coarsely diced 1/4 cup ketchup 2 tablespoons Dijon mustard 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar 6 tablespoons hoisin sauce 2 tablespoons cider vinegar 2 tablespoons soy sauce 1 tablespoon honey 1 teaspoon cayenne 1 tablespoon ancho chile powder 1 teaspoon pasilla chile powder 1 tablespoon Worcestershire 2 (2 1/2 pound) porterhouse steaks Salt and freshly ground pepper, to taste 1/2 pound red potatoes B size, blanched 1/2 pound Yukon gold B size, blanched 1/2 pound purple potatoes B size, blanched 1/2 cup olive oil 2 tablespoons minced garlic Salt and pepper 4 sturdy rosemary branches 1/3 cup lemon juice 1 teaspoon honey
directions: In a large saucepan, over medium high heat, place the oil, onions and garlic and heat them until browned. Add the tomatoes and cook for 15 minutes. Add the ketchup, mustard, sugar, hoisin sauce, vinegar, soy sauce, honey, cayenne, chile powders and Worcestershire sauce and cook 15 minutes. Puree the mixture in a food processor. Pour into a bowl and allow to cool at room temperature. This makes about 5 cups. Marinate the steaks in the hoisin barbecue sauce for 1 hour. Remove the steaks from the marinade and season with salt and pepper. Grill the steaks over a medium heat wood fire for about 5 minutes on each side while basting with the sauce. Split potatoes in half and place in medium size bowl. Add 2 tablespoons oil and the garlic. Season with salt and pepper. Strip the leaves, except at the top, of the rosemary. Mince 1 tablespoon of rosemary leaves and add to the potatoes. Starting with the thicker part of the rosemary stem, skewer the potatoes. Alternate 1 red, 1Yukon gold and 1 purple potato, dividing the potatoes equally among the 4 rosemary branches. Grill the skewered potatoes over medium heat for 25 minutes until skins blister. Remove from heat. Mix lemon juice, remaining oil, honey, and salt and pepper to taste and pour over the potatoes while they are still hot.

title: Italian Spinach Dip
ingredients: 1 cup Kraft Mayo Real Mayonnaise 1 cup Knudsen Sour Cream or Breakstone's 1 envelope Good Seasons Italian Salad Dressing Mix 1 frozen chopped spinach thawed, well drained, 10 oz. 1/2 cup red pepper Chopped, optional 1 can water chestnuts drained, chopped, optional, 8 oz. 1 inch round sourdough bread or serve hollowed-out
directions: Mix mayo, sour cream and salad dressing mix until well blended. Add spinach and red pepper; mix well. Refrigerate. Serve with bread pieces and assorted cut-up vegetables or chips. Serve in round sourdough bread. Cut slice from top of bread loaf; remove center, leaving 1-inch thick shell.

title: Blue Star
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons gin 3 teaspoons dry vermouth (he recommends Noilly Prat) 1 1/2 teaspoons blue curacao 1 1/2 tablespoons orange juice orange slice, for garnish
directions: In a cocktail shaker filled with ice, add all ingredients except for the orange slice. Shake well. Strain into a cocktail glass full of finely crushed ice. Garnish with the orange slice.

title: Cinnamon Lemon Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 cup butter 1 cup white sugar 1 egg 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cinnamon 1 teaspoon baking powder 1/2 teaspoon lemon zest 1/4 teaspoon salt 1/2 cup white sugar 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon
directions: Beat butter and 1 cup sugar with an electric mixer in a large bowl until smooth. Beat egg and vanilla extract into the butter until completely blended. Add flour, cinnamon, baking powder, lemon zest, and salt; continue mixing until flour is just incorporated. Cover bowl with plastic wrap; refrigerate until firm, about 2 hours. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Stir 1/2 cup sugar and cinnamon together in a bowl; spread onto a flat surface. Divide dough into about 60 small balls. Roll balls in cinnamon-sugar mixture to coat. Arrange onto baking sheets. Bake in preheated oven until edges are lightly browned, about 10 minutes.

title: Heavenly
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. gelatin 1/2 c. cold water 1/2 c. sugar 1/2 c. water 1 c. crushed pineapple (small) 1/2 lb. marshmallows 1 pt. whipped cream (whip with 2 Tbsp. sugar) 1 c. chopped pecans
directions: Combine and let stand 5 minutes the gelatin and 1/2 cup cold water. Combine and bring to boil the sugar and 1/2 cup water. Add gelatin and stir. Cool and add pineapple and marshmallows. Chill, then fold in whipped cream and pecans. Take vanilla wafers and put in layers in loaf dish, then filling, then more vanilla wafers; have filling on top.

title: Sweetened Condensed Milk
ingredients: 1 c. plus 2 Tbsp. instant dry milk 1/2 c. warm water 3/4 c. sugar
directions: Place warm water in a bowl. Add the dry milk; mix well. Add sugar and mix until smooth.

title: Curried Bay Scallops Risotto
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil or clarified butter 1 teaspoon cumin seeds 1/2 teaspoon black mustard seeds 1/2 teaspoon fennel seeds 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric 3/4 cup finely chopped onion 1 teaspoon finely minced fresh ginger 1 1/4 cup Italian arborio rice 2 finely chopped fresh plum tomatoes 4 cups (approximately) hot fish stock or water Juice of 1/2 lemon 1 pound bay scallops Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste 1 tablespoon chopped fresh coriander
directions: Heat the oil or butter in a heavy three-quart saucepan, preferably nonstick. Add the cumin seeds, mustard seeds and fennel seeds and cook until the seeds start to pop. Stir in the turmeric, onion and ginger and saute over medium heat until the onion is soft. Stir in the rice and cook, stirring, about three minutes. Stir in the tomatoes, then gradually add the hot fish stock or water, about half a cup at a time, stirring constantly and adding more liquid as the rice absorbs it. After 15 minutes the rice should be almost tender and all, or nearly all, the liquid should be used. Stir in the lemon juice and scallops. Cover and cook about two minutes, then uncover and stir a few seconds longer, until the scallops are just cooked through. You will see them start cracking around the edges. Season the risotto with salt and pepper to taste, fold in the coriander and serve at once.

title: Sizzling Ponzu Fajitas
ingredients: 2 lbs beef flank steak 2/3 cup Kikkoman Lime Ponzu Sauce 1 lime, juiced flour tortilla, warmed fresh cilantro Peppers N Onions 1 large red pepper 1 large green pepper 1 onion
directions: Combine flank steak, ponzu and lime juice in a large plastic bag, seal well and turn over several times to blend, refrigerate for at least one hour or overnight. Grill steak to desired doneness. Slice and serve with tortillas and Peppers N Onions. For Peppers N Onions: Cut 1 large red pepper, 1 large green pepper and 1 onion in 1/4 inch thick strips. Saute vegetables in 1 tablespoons cooking oil with 2 cloves of crushed garlic in a large skillet over high heat 4 minutes or until tender. Garnish with cilantro.

title: Lemon Pudding Cookies
ingredients: 1 cup buttermilk baking mix 1 3.4-ounce package instant lemon pudding 1 large egg, beaten to blend 1/4 cup vegetable oil Sugar
directions: Preheat oven to 350F. Grease 2 large cookie sheets. Mix first 4 ingredients in large bowl until dough forms. Roll dough into 1-inch balls. Place balls 2 inches apart on prepared cookie sheets. Dip flat-bottom glass into sugar. Press glass onto dough ball and flatten into 1/4-inch-thick cookie. Repeat with remaining cookies. Bake until just golden brown on edges, about 10 minutes. Transfer to racks and cool completely. (Can be prepared 3 days ahead. Store cookies in airtight container.)

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 (3 1/2 oz.) can flake coconut, lightly toasted (1 1/3 c.) 3 Tbsp. melted margarine 1 (17 oz.) can fruit cocktail, well drained 1 (14 oz.) Eagle Brand milk 1 c. miniature marshmallows 1 c. chopped pecans 1 (8 oz.) sour cream 3/4 to 1 c. chopped maraschino cherries 1/2 c. lime juice from concentrate 1 (4 oz.) container frozen nondairy whipped topping (1 3/4 c.)
directions: Line 9 x 5-inch loaf pan with aluminum foil, extending foil above sides of pan. Combine coconut and margarine. Press firmly on bottom of prepared pan. In large bowl combine remaining ingredients except whipped topping, mix well. Fold in whipped topping. Pour into prepared pan. Freeze 6 hours or until firm. To serve, remove from pan, peel off foil. Slice to serve. Freeze leftovers.

title: Mincemeat Pastry Squares Recipe
ingredients: 2 1/2 c. sifted flour 1 tbsp. sugar 1 teaspoon salt 1 c. shortening 1 egg, separated Lowfat milk 3 c. mincemeat pie filling 1 c. confectioners sugar 2 tbsp. lemon juice
directions: Sift together flour, sugar, and salt; cut in shortening with pastry blender or possibly 2 knives till mix resembles coarse meal. Beat egg yolk in measuring c. and add in sufficient lowfat milk to make 1/2 c.. Add in to flour mix; mix just sufficient so dough shapes into ball. Roll out half to 15 x 11 inch rectangle; transfer to baking sheet. Spread proportionately with filling to within 3/4 inch of edges. Roll out rest of dough for top crust; place over filling. Seal edges. Beat egg whites till stiff; spread on top crust. Bake at 400 degrees for 25-30 min. Mix confectioners sugar and lemon juice. Drizzle over top of crust while warm. 12-14 servings.

title: Sherry'S Pecan Pie
ingredients: 6 eggs 1-1/2 c. sugar 1-1/2 c. Griffin's Syrup (1/2 Crystal White, 1/2 Waffle) 1/4 c. butter, melted 2 tsp. Griffin's Vanilla 1 tsp. butter flavoring 2 c. pecan halves
directions: Beat eggs and sugar until lemon color, add syrup and melted butter. Fold in pecans and flavoring. Bake at 350° for 55-60 minutes. Do not overbake or underbake. Pie should be light golden brown.

title: Chewy Squares
ingredients: 1 box yellow cake mix (not with pudding) 1/2 c. brown sugar 4 Tbsp. butter, softened 2 large eggs 3 Tbsp. water 4 Tbsp. flour 1 tsp. vanilla 1/2 c. semi-sweet chocolate chips 1/2 c. nuts, finely chopped
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Mix cake mix and brown sugar in large mixing bowl. Add butter, eggs, water, flour and vanilla. Blend all ingredients well (batter will be stiff). Stir in chocolate chips and nuts by hand. Spread batter in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes. Cut into squares. Makes 30 bar cookies.

title: Cream Of Red Cabbage Soup
ingredients: 7 1/8 cups red cabbage coarsely sliced 2 onions finely chopped 1 clove garlic finely chopped 3 1/2 tablespoons butter 2 1/8 cups water 1 soup cube 1 cup red wine 1 tablespoon wine vinegar 1/2 teaspoon cumin 1 pinch ground nutmeg 1 pinch ground cloves 1 pinch ground cinnamon salt pepper 1 tablespoon sugar 4 teaspoons sour cream
directions: Chop cabbage in a mixer (blender). Saute onions and garlic in butter in a soup pan (or pot). Add cabbage, simmer briefly. Add 250ml of water together with the crumbled soup cube, bring to a boil. Reduce flame and cook over low heat for 20 minutes. Add the rest of the water with wine, vinegar, sugar and spices. Stir. Cook over low heat, half-covered, about 10 minutes. Cool the soup slightly, then mix in a blender until smooth and creamy. Whisk in sour cream just before serving.

title: Atole
ingredients: 1/2 cup masa harina 5 cups milk 4 tablespoons brown sugar 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon or 1 cinnamon stick, finely slivered 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
directions: Put the Masa Harina in a bowl and whisk in the milk, little by little. Pour the milk mixture into a pot and add the brown sugar and cinnamon. Bring to a boil and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring constantly, to keep it from becoming lumpy. Stir in the vanilla extract. Serve in mugs. Variations: Pineapple Atole. Follow the basic recipe, but omit the cinnamon. After the mixture has thickened and has been removed from the heat, add 1 small can crushed pineapple, undrained. Strawberry Atole. Follow the basic recipe, but omit the cinnamon. After the mixture has thickened and has been removed from the heat, add 2 cups fresh strawberries that have been hulled, washed and crushed.

title: Tropical Punch
ingredients: 1 (46 oz.) can red Hawaiian fruit punch 1 (6 oz.) can frozen lemonade concentrate 1 (6 oz.) frozen orange juice concentrate 6 c. water 1 (12 oz.) ginger ale, chilled 1 (6 oz.) can frozen grape juice concentrate
directions: Combine punch, lemonade, orange juice and grape juice concentrates. Add water. Mix well. Pour into large punch bowl. Resting bottle on rim, carefully pour in ginger ale. Add ice or frozen mixture of 7-Up with orange and/or lemon slices. Yields approximately 35 servings.

title: Dangerous Souffle Cheesecake
ingredients: 200 grams Cream cheese 200 ml Heavy cream 2 medium Egg 80 grams Granulated sugar 20 grams Cake flour 2 tsp Lemon juice 1 Apricot jam for the glaze
directions: Soften the cream cheese on a double boiler or on low in a microwave. Add half of the granulated sugar and mix to get rid of lumps. Add 2 egg yolks into Step 1 and mix. Add heavy cream into Step 2 and mix. Add the lemon juice. Whip the egg whites lightly with a hand mixer, and add the rest of the granulated sugar. Whip on high until peaks form, when the tip flops over, it's done. Sift in the cake flour into Step 3 and mix in. Add half of the egg whites from Step 4 into Step 5 and mix. When well mixed, add the remaining egg whites. You can use a spatula or whisk. Pour the batter into parchment paper lined pans. Rap the pan against your workspace to pop trapped air bubbles. Bake about 50 minutes in a water bath in a 160C oven. It will rise to double in size, but will deflate back its original size when it has cooled. Leave it to cool in the mold, cover with plastic wrap and chill in the refrigerator for half a day. Brush the surface with jam, and chill before enjoying. It will fall apart if you cut it with a knife, so be careful! It might be better to slice it with a string. Or just enjoy as is. It will take about 55 minutes to bake in an 18 cm round pan. Just in case. It will be best to use cream cheese that is made only of milk and cream. Don't use flavored ones or the type with other ingredients mixed in.

title: Stuffed Rolled Eggplant Parm
