Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat until fairly hot and pour it over the garlic mixture. Mix and allow to stand 10 minutes. Whisk in the orange juice and sherry vinegar. Season with salt and pepper to taste and set aside until ready to use. For the hearts of palm slaw: Mix together the hearts of palm, jicama, red and yellow bell peppers, Scotch bonnet chile, onion and scallions in a large bowl and set aside. Mix together the olive oil, orange juice, coriander, sugar, pepper and salt to taste in a bowl and pour over the vegetables. For the Scotch bonnet tartar salsa: Put the egg yolks in a blender and beat until pale. (Alternatively work by hand.) With the blender running, add the vinegar and pickle brine. Slowly add the olive oil and canola oil and blend until completely incorporated. If using a blender, remove the mixture to a bowl so the vegetables dont get overly processed. Add the sweet butter pickles, red onion and chiles. Stir in the hard-cooked egg. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Cover and refrigerate. For the stuffed shrimp: Place the panko, flour and egg wash in separate shallow bowls. Pat the shrimp dry of any excess water. Combine the mashed yuca with the chile, garlic and salt and pepper to taste. Stuff the cavity (butterfly cut) of each shrimp with about 3/4 tablespoon of the yuca mash, packing it firmly into place. Dust the shrimp first in the flour, then dip in the egg wash and then the panko. Set aside. Heat the peanut oil in a large heavy deep skillet or French fryer to 350 degrees F. When the oil is hot, lay the shrimp in it and cook until golden and cooked through. Remove the shrimp to a plate with absorbent toweling. Spoon a small dollop of the Scotch Bonnet Tartar Salsa to go under each shrimp on to the plates. Lift some of the Hearts of Palm Slaw onto the center of the plates. Spoon or ladle some of the "Mo J." directly onto each shrimp. Serve. This recipe was provided by a chef, restaurant or culinary professional and may have been scaled down from a bulk recipe. The Food Network Kitchens have not tested it for home use and therefore cannot make any representation as to the results.

title: Curry Cheese Ball With Chutney Recipe
ingredients: 8 ounce. cream cheese, room temperature 2 tbsp. mayonnaise 1/4 teaspoon curry Garlic salt or possibly pwdr to taste 1/2 (3 ounce.) pkg. slivered almonds 1 bottle chutney
directions: 1. Form all ingredients except chutney into a ball. 2. Place on serving platter. 3. Pour 1/2 bottle of chutney over ball. 4. Put remaining almonds over top. 5. Serve with crackers.

title: Cheddar Mustard Dip
ingredients: 12 ounces Velveeta cheese (cubed) 4 ounces cream cheese (cubed) 2/3 cup beer 1/2 cup Dijon mustard 1/3 cup chopped green onion chopped red pepper (to garnish)
directions: In medium saucepan over low heat, heat cream cheese and Velveeta until melted and smooth. Slowly blend in beer and mustard. Stir in green onion and blend well. Pour into serving dish and garnish with red pepper.

title: Smoky Barbecue Brisket
ingredients: 1 (4- to 6-lb.) beef brisket, trimmed 1 bottle (5-oz.) Liquid Smoke 1 bottle (12-oz.) Worcestershire sauce 2 tsp. onion powder 2 tsp. garlic powder 1 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. pepper 1/2 tsp. dried summer savory seasoning 1 bottle (12- to 18-oz.) smoke-flavored barbecue sauce
directions: Place brisket in a large shallow roasting pan. Pour Liquid Smoke and Worcestershire sauce over brisket. Sprinkle evenly with onion powder, garlic powder, summer savory, salt and pepper. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Cumin Caraway Potatoes
ingredients: 6 potatoes, peeled and chopped to bite size 5 garlic cloves, chopped (may use less if you are not as big fans of garlic as we are) 1 tablespoon butter 1 tablespoon lard (or use 2 tablespoons butter if omitting the lard) 1 teaspoon ground cumin 12 teaspoon caraway seed 1 teaspoon celery salt
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees (F). Place chopped potatoes and garlic in baking dish. Make sure it is a baking dish that has a lid. Sprinkle seasonings over potatoes and garlic, then toss a bit to spread them out. Divide butter and lard into smaller bits and lay them on top. Cover dish with lid and put in oven. Cook in oven for 45 minutes, tossing once at about 20 minutes in, to further combine the ingredients once the butter and lard have melted. Now serve it and listen to all the mmmmm's around the table!

title: Freezer Fry-Up with Sunny Side-Up Eggs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons salted butter 1 small yellow onion, diced 1 red bell pepper, stemmed, seeded, and diced 1 teaspoon ground cumin 1 teaspoon chili powder Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper 1 medium sweet potato, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubes (about 8 ounces) 1 cup frozen corn 1 cup diced frozen pineapple, roughly chopped while frozen 3 cups cooked shredded pork, chicken or beef 1 tablespoon olive oil 4 large eggs 2 tablespoons chopped fresh chives, for garnish, optional
directions: Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the onions, peppers, cumin and chili powder and stir to combine. Season with salt and pepper and cook, stirring frequently, until softened and beginning to brown, 5 to 7 minutes. Add the sweet potatoes, season, and cook, stirring occasionally, until the edges begin to caramelize, about 10 minutes. Add the corn, pineapple and shredded pork, and stir well to combine. Cook until the corn and pineapple are completely thawed and warm and the mixture is hot throughout. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Crack the eggs into it, cover the pan, and cook until the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, about 3 minutes (or cook to desired doneness.) Season with salt and pepper. To serve, divide the potato hash among 4 plates; top each with a fried egg and sprinkle some chives over the top, if using.

title: Hot Pepper Jelly
ingredients: 6 c. sugar 1 1/2 c. cider vinegar 1 box Sure-Jell 1 1/2 c. crushed bell pepper 3/4 c. crushed hot pepper 1/2 tsp. green food coloring
directions: Blend pepper and vinegar. Let cook until mixed. Add sugar slowly, stirring until all is added. Let come to a rolling boil. Add Sure-Jell and food color. Pour into jelly jars and seal.

title: Cavatelli with broccoli and garlic
ingredients: 5 cup boiling water in medium sauce pan 2 cup boiling water in small saucepan 1 lb frozen cavatelli 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil 2 tbsp butter 3 clove garlic diced 1 box frozen chopped broccoli 1 1/2 cup chicken broth 1/2 cup grated parmasan Romano cheese 3 dash Black pepper
directions: Add cavatelli to medium saucepan of boiling water and cook as directed on bag While the pasta is cooking place broccoli in small sauce pan of boiling water. In a medium frying pan add olive oil and butter on medium low heat Once the butter is melted in the oil add the diced garlic and cook until light golden brown strain the broccoli and add it the the olive oil butter and garlic and slowly pour in chicken broth strain cavatelli In a medium serving bowl add grated cheese and black pepper mix it up than add cavatelli and mix together Now pour the broccoli mixture into the serving bowl with the pasta and give it a quick stir and voila!

title: Microwave Pink Popcorn Balls
ingredients: 7 c. popped popcorn (real, not microwaved) 3 c. miniature marshmallows 2 Tbsp. margarine or butter 1/4 tsp. salt
directions: In microwave, melt last three ingredients. Tint pink with a few drops of red food coloring. Pour melted marshmallow mixture over popcorn and stir gently to coat. Grease hands well with butter and shape into 10 medium sized balls. Great for girl's birthday party activity!

title: My Favorite Mai Tai
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sugar 12 cup white rum, chilled 14 cup triple sec, chilled 14 cup fresh orange juice, chilled 14 cup fresh lime juice, chilled (plus a little more for rimming glasses) crushed ice
directions: Dip chilled glass rims in a little lime juice and then in sugar to rim. Place rum, Triple Sec, and fruit juices in a chilled cocktail shaker; shake well to combine. Fill glasses with crushed ice and pour cocktail over ice. Decorate glasses with cherries, pineapple and/or orange slices. Serve with a straw.

title: Hamburger Soup
ingredients: 1 lb. lean hamburger 5 c. water 16 oz. can tomatoes, cut up 2 medium onions, chopped 2 medium carrots, sliced 2 stalks celery, chopped 1/2 c. pearl barley 1/4 c. catsup 1 Tbsp. beef bouillon 2 tsp. seasoned salt 1 tsp. dried basil, crushed 1 bay leaf salt to taste pepper to taste
directions: Brown beef; drain off fat. In 3-quart or more soup kettle, place all ingredients. Bring to boil. Simmer, covered, for at least an hour. Longer cooking blends flavors more. Hearty and delicious!

title: Tuna Salad
ingredients: 1/4 c. water 1/2 c. sugar 2 c. salad dressing
directions: Bring water and sugar to boil for 1 minute. Let cool and add salad dressing.

title: Greek Pizza With Spinach, Feta And Olives
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise 4 cloves garlic, minced 1 cup crumbled feta cheese, divided 1 (12 inch) pre-baked Italian pizza crust 1/2 cup oil-packed sun-dried tomatoes, coarsely chopped 1 tablespoon oil from the sun-dried tomatoes 1/4 cup pitted kalamata olives, coarsely chopped 1 teaspoon dried oregano 2 cups baby spinach leaves 1/2 small red onion, halved and thinly sliced
directions: Adjust oven rack to lowest position, and heat oven to 450 degrees. Mix mayonnaise, garlic and 1/2 cup feta in a small bowl. Place pizza crust on a cookie sheet; spread mayonnaise mixture over pizza, then top with tomatoes, olives and oregano. Bake until heated through and crisp, about 10 minutes. Toss spinach and onion with the 1 Tb. sun-dried tomato oil. Top hot pizza with spinach mixture and remaining 1/2 cup feta cheese. Return to oven and bake until cheese melts, about 2 minutes longer. Cut into 6 slices and serve.

title: Freezer Dill Pickles
ingredients: 1 lb cucumber, sliced 1/8-inch thick 3/4 lb yellow onion, sliced 1/8-inch thick 4 tablespoons salt 2 tablespoons water 1 cup sugar 1/2 cup cider vinegar 1 tablespoon dried dill weed
directions: Mix cucumbers, onions, salt and water in a 2 quart non-metal bowl. Let stand 2 hours. Drain after stand time but do not rinse. Return vegetables to bowl and add sugar, cider vinegar and dill weed. Stir occasionally until sugar completely dissolves and liquid covers vegetables. Pack wide mouth jars or plastic freezer containers leaving 1 inch head space. Seal tightly and freeze. Defrost in refrigerator or at room temperature. Hope this helps. Good luck!

title: Three in One Cheese Ball
ingredients: 8 ounces cream cheese, softened 16 ounces cheddar cheese, shredded, at room temperature 2 tablespoons milk 2 tablespoons onions, finely chopped 2 tablespoons Worcestershire sauce coarsely cracked black pepper 12 cup blue cheese, crumbled fresh parsley, minced 14 teaspoon garlic powder pecans, finely chopped assorted cracker
directions: In a mixing bowl, beat cream cheese, cheddar cheese, milk, onion, and worcestershire sauce until fluffy. If a smoother spread is desired, process in a food processor until creamy. Divide into thirds (about 1 cup each). Shape first portion into a ball and roll in cracked pepper. Add the bleu cheese to the 2nd portion and mix well. Shape into a ball and roll in parsley. Add garlic powder to the remaining portion and mix well. Shape into a ball and roll in nuts. Cover and refrigerate. Remove from refrigerator and let stand 15 minutes before serving. Serve with crackers.

title: Robbie'S Really Good Jam Cake
ingredients: 4 eggs 2 c. sugar 1 tsp. cloves 1 1/2 c. blackberry jam 1/2 c. buttermilk 3 c. flour 1 tsp. cinnamon 1 c. nuts, chopped 1 tsp. soda 1 box raisins
directions: Mix all ingredients into batter and bake in layers in slow oven (300°) for 40 minutes. Turn oven to 350° at end of 40 minutes and cook 5 minutes more; this browns top more.

title: Orange Dream Cake
ingredients: 23 cup butter softened 113 cups sugar 23 cup orange juice 3 tablespoons lemon juice 1 teaspoon orange zest grated 1 teaspoon lemon zest grated 2 large eggs 2 cups cake flour 2 teaspoons baking powder 1 teaspoon salt 1 cup coconut flaked 1/4 cup sugar 2 tablespoons orange juice 1 tablespoon lemon juice 4 teaspoons orange zest grated 1 cup heavy whipping cream whip
directions: In a large mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar. Add juices and peel; mix well (mixture may appear curdled). Add eggs, 1 at a time, beating well after each addition. Sift flour with baking powder and salt; add to creamed mixture and mix well. Pour into 2 greased and floured 8 inch cake pans. Bake at 375F (190C). for 25 to 30 minutes or until cake tests done. Cool in pans for 10 minutes before removing to a wire rack to cool completely. Combine frosting ingredients and frost.

title: Baked German Pancakes(Tastes Almost Like French Toast)
ingredients: 1/4 stick margarine 4 eggs, beaten until frothy 2/3 c. flour 2/3 c. milk 1 Tbsp. sugar 1 Tbsp. soft butter or margarine 1/2 tsp. cinnamon (optional)
directions: Melt 1/4 stick of margarine in each of 2 round cake pans (any size). Beat eggs until frothy. Add to beaten eggs the flour, milk, sugar, soft butter or margarine and cinnamon. Divide batter equally between the two cake pans. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes. Turn down to 350°. Bake for 10 more minutes.

title: Homemade Smoked Almonds
ingredients: 1 egg white 2 teaspoons garlic powder 2 teaspoons celery salt 1/4 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring 3 cups whole unblanched almonds, toasted and cooled
directions: In a bowl, whisk egg white until foamy. Add garlic powder, celery salt, salt and liquid smoke; stir until blended. Add almonds and stir until well coated. Evenly spread almonds in a 15-in. x 10-in. x 1-in. baking pan coated with nonstick cooking spray. Bake at 300 degrees F for 30 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes. Cool. Store in an airtight container.

title: Warm Apple Cinnamon Cobbler
ingredients: 4 apples-peeled, cored and sliced 1 c. water 2 tsp. ground cinnamon 2 tsp. cornstarch 1/4 c. fructose (fruit sugar) 1 c. whole wheat pastry flour 1 tsp. baking powder 1/4 c. canola oil 1 Tbsp. honey 1/2 c. low-fat buttermilk
directions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a large saucepan over medium heat, combine the apples, water, cinnamon, cornstarch and fructose. Cook until apples are soft and mixture is thickened, about 10 minutes. Pour apple mixture into a casserole dish. Prepare biscuit dough by combining the whole wheat pastry flour and baking powder. Add oil and stir until well mixed. Add honey and buttermilk; stir with a fork until flour mixture is moist. Add additional milk if necessary. Drop biscuit dough by tablespoons on top of apples. Bake for 20 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown. Serve warm. Yield: 6 servings.

title: Jack Daniel'S Pecan Pie
ingredients: 3 extra large eggs, slightly beaten 1 cup granulated sugar 2 tablespoons butter, melted 1 cup dark corn syrup 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract 1/4 cup jack daniel whiskey 1/2 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips 1 1/4 cups pecan halves 1 10-inch deep dish pie crust
directions: Preheat oven to 375. Combine eggs, sugar, butter, syrup, vanilla and Jack Daniel's; mix well. Sprinkle chocolate chips over the bottom of the pie shell. Add the pie mixture and pecans. Bake at 375 degrees for 35-40 minutes.

title: Sweet And Sour Carrots
ingredients: 3 c. sliced carrots 1/4 c. unsweetened pineapple juice 2 Tbsp. honey 1 tsp. cornstarch 4 green onions, cut up 2 Tbsp. butter 1 tsp. soy sauce
directions: In a medium saucepan, cook fresh or frozen carrots covered. Cook until tender. Drain. Remove from pan. Mix all together onions, juice, honey, butter, cornstarch and soy sauce. Cook until tender.

title: Dinner In A Dish
ingredients: 4 pork chops potatoes onions 1 can mushroom soup
directions: Brown pork chops slightly in a frying pan. In a casserole, place a layer of sliced potatoes and a layer of sliced onion; repeat layers. Pour undiluted cream of mushroom soup over layers. Place chops on top. Cover with foil. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Arugula, Endive, and Radicchio Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup extra-virgin olive oil 2 tablespoons white-wine vinegar 2 bunches arugula (about 1 pound) 1 small head radicchio 2 large Belgian endives
directions: In a bowl whisk together oil and vinegar and season with salt and pepper. Discard coarse stems from arugula. Thinly slice radicchio and cut endives crosswise into 1/2-inch pieces. In a large bowl toss greens with vinaigrette until coated well.

title: Garlic Pork Roast with Balsamic Vinegar
ingredients: 1 center-cut pork roast 6 md. red skined potatoes 2 tbsp. garlic, minced 1/4 cup balsalmic vinager 3/4 cup olive oil vegetable oil 1 tbsp. garlic powder 1 tbsp. onion powder 1 tbsp. meat tenderizer 1/2 tbsp. black pepper 1 dash seasoned salt (optional) 1/2 tbsp. rosemary leaves
directions: Rinse the pork roast with cold water then put it in a roasting pan. After you put it in the roasting pan you want to poke holes into the top. Then pour on the oil and balsamic vinager. Let it seep in while you cut up the potatoes into wedges (leave the skins on). Then you want to add the seasonings to the pork. You can use them to your moderation. Take the potatoes and put them into a big bowl, take all of the same spices you used for the pork including the oil but minis the vinager and mix them all around. Finally add the potatoes to the pan all around the pork and throw it into the oven at about 350F. Cook depending on how fast your oven cooks (you don't want to over cook it or it will dry right out).

title: Apple Juice Frosty
ingredients: 1 cup vanilla ice cream 2 cups apple juice 1 dash cinnamon (optional)
directions: Combine ice cream and apple juice. Beat until foamy. Pour into glasses. Top each serving with a sprinkle of cinnamon.

title: Delicious Breakfast Potatoes
ingredients: cooking spray 2 tablespoons olive oil 1 teaspoon paprika 1 pinch chili powder 1 pinch salt 1 teaspoon Mrs. Dash table blend seasoning 1 pinch black pepper 1 dash garlic 7 12 cups red potatoes, diced (depends on how many people you are making this for)
directions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit Combine the olive oil, chili powder, paprika, salt, black pepper, Mrs. Dash in a large bowl: stir well. Add diced potatoes to the mixture and using a spoon, mix the potatoes into the bowl until fully coated. Spray the cooking spray onto the cookie sheet, then placed coated potatoes along the sheet in a single layer. Bake for thirty minutes at 400 degrees Fahrenheit or until brown.

title: Chris' Delicious Gluten Free Muffins
ingredients: 2 12 cups oat bran 1 cup flour (see above) 1 cup ground flax seeds 1 tablespoon baking powder 12 teaspoon sea salt 3 medium carrots, grated 1 12 cups rice milk (or goat milk, or combo) 34 cup unsweetened applesauce 14 cup brown sugar 3 -5 drops stevia (optional) 12 cup grapeseed oil (or combination) or 12 cup macadamia nut oil (or combination) or 12 cup canola oil (or combination) 2 -3 eggs, depending on size 1 teaspoon baking soda 2 cups raisins (or 1 1/2 cups raisins and 1/2 cup of cranberries or blueberries) 1 apple, diced
directions: Preheat oven to 375F. Line two 12 cup muffin pans with liners or coat with cooking spray. In a large bowl combine bran, flour, flax seed, baking powder, and salt. Set aside. Combine remaining ingredients, except raisins, cranberries, apple etc and blend well. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and mix until well blended. Stir in raisins etc. Divide batter evenly among muffin cups. Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, or until a toothpick in centre comes out clean. Cool in pans for 5 minutes before removing to a cooling rack. Muffins can be frozen.

title: Fried Rice
ingredients: 3 c. cooked rice 1 clove garlic (minced) 1/2 onion (minced) 2 boneless chicken breasts (chopped 1 large carrot (chopped fine) 1/2 bell pepper (chopped)
directions: Make sure you have one inch of oil in your wok. Turn on high and brown garlic. Add chicken and cook until almost done. Add onion, pepper and salt, and carrots. Cook until tender and add soy sauce (to taste) and rice. Brown and serve!

title: Stewed Fresh Fava Beans with Pancetta and Onions
ingredients: 1 pound fava beans, shelled 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil 2 ounces pancetta, or salt pork, diced 1 small onion, finely chopped 1/3 teaspoon sea salt, or to taste 2 sprigs fresh mint about 1 cup water freshly ground black pepper to taste
directions: Blanch the beans in boiling salted water for 1 minute. Drain and rinse in cold water. Using your fingers, pinch the navel of each bean and pop it out of the skin. In a large saucepan, warm the olive oil over medium-low heat until fragrant. Add the pancetta and saute until lightly colored, about 3 minutes. Add the onion and saute until it is nicely softened and the pancetta is lightly browned, about 4 minutes. Add the beans, salt, and 1 mint sprig. Stir in the water. Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until the beans are tender and most of the liquid has evaporated, 20 to 25 minutes. If the beans begin to dry out and are still uncooked, add more water as necessary. Remove cooked mint, add pepper, and serve immediately, garnished with the remaining mint sprig.

title: Easy Oil Pie Crust
ingredients: 3 cups flour 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon sugar 1 cup shortening or 1 cup lard 1/4 cup cold water 1/4 cup canola oil 1/3 cup milk
directions: Process flour, salt,sugar and shortening in food processor until it just comes to a crumble. (if no processor, cut in by hand). Pour flour mixture in a large bowl and add water,oil and milk. Mix until blended. It may seem to soft, but not to worry. I typically make two crusts, use one and freeze the other by placing wax paper on top of crust.

title: Crunchy Slaw Recipe
ingredients: Approx. 4 c. shredded cabbage 4 sliced green onions 1/4 c. toasted, slivered almonds 2 tbsp. toasted sesame seeds 1 pkg. Ramen noodles, broken into pcs
directions: Add in almonds, sesame seeds and noodles to slaw just before serving, then add in dressing.

title: Apple Pie
ingredients: 1 9" double pie crust 1/2 cup Butter 3 tbsp All purpose flour 1/4 cup Water 1/2 cup Sugar 1/2 cup Brown sugar, packed 8 each Granny Smith apples, peeled, cored and sliced
directions: Preheat oven to 475F. Melt butter in saucepan. Stir in flour to form paste. Add water, sugar and brown sugar and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and let simmer. Place bottom crust in pie pan and fill with apples, mounded slightly. Cut 2nd pie crust into 1" strips. Place strips over apples in a weave pattern to form lattice work crust Gently pour mixture over lattice work crust. Pour slowly to allow mixture to penetrate apples. Bake 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350F. Continue baking 30 to 45 minutes until apples are soft.

title: Baked Stuffed Apples
ingredients: 4 medium apples 1/4 cup crumbled blue cheese, divided 1/4 cup quick-cooking oats 1 tablespoon dried cranberries 4 tablespoons raisins 2 tablespoons brown sugar
directions: Cut apples in half lengthwise; remove cores. Place in an ungreased 13x9-in. baking dish. Fill each half with 1 teaspoon blue cheese. In a small bowl, combine the oats, cranberries, raisins and brown sugar; spoon into apples. Top with remaining cheese. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 35-40 minutes or until tender.

title: Evelyn'S Rolled Sugar Cookies
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups white sugar 1 cup shortening 3/4 cup milk 2 eggs 1 teaspoon baking powder 1 teaspoon baking soda 1/2 teaspoon salt 3 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
directions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Cream together the shortening and sugar. Mix in eggs and beat well. In a separate bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt. Add flour mixture to shortening mixture in thirds. After each third, add 1/4 cup of the milk and mix well. Dough will be soft. Put dough on well-floured surface and knead in just enough additional flour so it can be rolled. Cut with your favorite cookie cutter. Transfer to parchment-lined baking sheet and bake for 10 minutes. I rotate my sheets, baking each sheet 5 minutes on middle, then 5 minutes on top rack.

title: Golden Corn Bread
ingredients: 3/4 c. yellow corn meal 1 1/4 c. flour 1/4 c. sugar 3 tsp. baking powder 1 beaten egg 3/4 c. milk 1/4 c. oil
directions: Sift dry ingredients into bowl. Add egg and milk, stirring lightly; fold in oil. Bake in 425° oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Cookies Cake
ingredients: 1 box yellow cake mix 1 egg, slightly beaten 1 can Eagle Brand milk 1 (12 oz.) bag chocolate chips 1 c. chopped pecans 1/2 bag Heath Bits 'O Brickle
directions: Combine milk and egg. Add cake mix and chopped pecans. Pour into pan and top with chocolate chips and Bits 'O Brickle. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes. Tastes better if you let set for 1 day.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 large green tomatoes 1 egg 1/4 c. water fine dry bread crumbs for coating salt and pepper to taste oil
directions: Slice tomatoes into a little thicker than 1/2-inch slices. Whisk egg with water until well blended. Dip tomato slices in egg/water mixture. Dredge well with the bread crumbs or cracker crumbs that have been seasoned to taste with salt and pepper. Fry in about 1 inch of hot oil until golden on both sides. Drain on paper towels and serve immediately.

title: Brandied Fruit
ingredients: 2 cups peaches 2 cups pineapple 2 cups apricots 2 cups cherries 2 cups sugar 2 cups fruit
directions: In a large container (loose fitting cover), add 2 cups sugar and 2 cups bite size peaches. Mix well (do not refrigerate). Stir every day until bubbles disappear, about 3 weeks. Add 2 cups sugar and 2 cups bite size pineapple. Stir every day for 2 weeks. Add 2 cups sugar and 2 cups diced apricots. Stir daily for 2 weeks. Add 2 cups sugar and 2 cups quartered cherries. Stir daily for 2 weeks. It is ready to eat now and may be refrigerated.

title: Everyday Vinaigrette Salad Dressing
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. olive oil 1 tsp. Dijon mustard 2 Tbsp. either lemon juice, rice, cider or balsamic vinegar 2 Tbsp. water pinch of salt and pepper 1 small clove garlic, minced
directions: In small bowl or jar, combine all ingredients and mix well.

title: Caraway Cabbage Soup With Lemon Dill Spaetzle
ingredients: 2 quarts smoked ham stock, clarified 2 cups cabbage, shredded & blanched 1 cup onion, shredded 1 teaspoon caraway seed 1/2 cup tomatoes, diced 1/2 cup carrot, julienned 2 teaspoons dill, chopped 1 lb flour 1/2 ounce salt 4 eggs 1 cup milk 1/2 cup water 1 1/2 tablespoons lemons, zest of
directions: Combine cabbage, onions, caraway seeds, diced tomatoes, carrots, and 1 teaspoon chopped dill. Spaetzle: Sift flour and salt into bowl. Make a well in the center. Combine lukewarm milk and water with eggs and pour into the well. Stir in flour, lemon, and remaining dill. Beat dough until bubbles start to form. Force through colander into boiling salted water. When spaetzle noodles float, remove them from the boiling water and cool. Soup: Heat ham stock in large pot. Add garnish to soup stock and simmer for one hour. Add spaetzle and serve

title: Simple Sauteed Swiss Chard
ingredients: 2 bunches swiss chard, rainbow if available 2 teaspoons olive oil 1 yellow onion, sliced in rings 2 cloves garlic, chopped coarse 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/8 cup dry sherry
directions: Clean the chard well. Make sure it's free of any sand and dirt particles. (I fill a large basin with water and wash it in three changes of water.) Don't spin the leaves dry - leave some water clinging to them. You'll need the moisture for cooking. Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a heavy pot over a medium flame. Sautee the onions for about ten minutes, until they're golden yellow. Add the garlic and sautee for another minute or two, stirring. Add the chard to the pot. Pour in the salt and wine. Cover the pot and cook, stirring every couple of minutes for about ten minutes. You want the chard nicely warmed through and softened, but still bright. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1 pkg. broccoli (1 1/2 lb.) 1 can cream of mushroom soup 1 c. salad dressing 1 stick (softened) margarine 2 eggs 1 chopped medium onion 1 1/2 c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese 1 tube Ritz crackers, crushed
directions: Cook broccoli and drain. Put in ungreased casserole dish. Combine soup, salad dressing, margarine, egg and onion. Mix well. Pour over broccoli. Sprinkle top with cheese and crackers. Press into casserole. Bake in preheated 350° oven until top is brown. Let stand 20 minutes before serving.

title: Creamy Carrots
ingredients: 5 carrots, peeled 30 g butter 2 tablespoons brown sugar 1/2 cup cream 2 tablespoons chopped chives
directions: Slice carrots into rounds. Cook til tender, drain. Melt butter. Add sugar. Cook 1 minute. Add cream. Bring to boil. Reduce heat. Return carrots, toss well. Serve with chives sprinkled on top.

title: Berry Kanten
ingredients: 1 quart apple juice 1/4 cup agar-agar flakes 1 pint berries 2 tablespoons maple syrup (optional)
directions: Soak the agar flakes and one pint of apple juice in a saucepan for 10 - 15 minutes. Wash and hull berries. In a blender puree berries with the remaining juice and maple syrup if you are using it. Set aside for now. Now, bring agar mixture to a boil then turn down heat and simmer, stirring frequently, until all agar is dissolved. When all is dissolved, allow the juice mixture to cool slightly, and then pour it into the blender with the pureed berries mix and blend briefly to combine. Pour contents of blender into your molds and allow to cool in the refrigerator until the kanten sets up. To serve:. If kanten was chilled in a baking dish, cut into portion-sized squares. Garnish with additional berries and desired whipped products such as whipped tofu cream or whipped cream depending on your diet. Note: One tablespoon of flakes should be used per cup of liquid unless using a citrus or pineapple juice then it might need to be increased because it is more acidic.

title: Ryan'S Irish Potato Casserole
ingredients: 2 lbs frozen hash browns (diced style) 3/8 cup melted margarine 1 can cream of celery soup 3/4 cup sour cream 1 cup shredded cheese (I usually use cheddar) 1/4 cup corn flake crumbs (add on top at end)
directions: Grease 9"x13" pan. Layer ingredients in above order. Bake for one hour at 350 degrees covered. Uncover and bake an additional 15-20 minutes with cornflake crumbs on top.

title: Raw Cauliflower and Tofu Dip
ingredients: 3 cups cauliflower florets 1/2 cup yogurt 3 1/2 ounces tofu 2 teaspoons olive oil 1/2 clove garlic, crushed 1 pinch dried thyme, or to taste 1 pinch dried oregano, or to taste 1 pinch cayenne pepper, or to taste 1 pinch salt and ground black pepper, or to taste
directions: Blend cauliflower florets, yogurt, tofu, olive oil, garlic, thyme, oregano, cayenne pepper, salt, and pepper in a blender until smooth.

title: Cherry Salad
ingredients: 1 medium can crushed pineapple, drained 1 can cherry pie filling 1 c. chopped nuts 1 container Cool Whip 1 can Eagle Brand milk
directions: Mix all together, adding Cool Whip last. Keep in refrigerator.

title: Kim'S Baked Beans
ingredients: 6 strips bacon (from the butcher) 1 lb. ground beef 1 onion, sliced 2 Tbsp. dark molasses 1/2 c. ketchup 1/4 c. brown sugar 1/2 tsp. dry mustard B & M baked beans
directions: Cook bacon strips; drain and crumble. Brown ground beef; drain. Add onion, molasses, ketchup, brown sugar and dry mustard. Stir ingredients together and heat through. Add small portions to B & M baked beans. Cover and bake 1 hour until piping hot at 325°. Larger portion, add entire mixture to 2 (3 pound) cans B & M baked beans. Cover and bake for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until hot. Stir occasionally.

title: Fruitcake Cookies
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. flour (unsifted) 1 tsp. soda 1/2 tsp. salt 1/2 tsp. cinnamon 1/2 c. butter or margarine 3/4 c. sugar 2 eggs 1 c. mixed candied fruit 1 c. chopped dates 3/4 c. chopped pecans 1 tsp. brandy extract (vanilla may be used)
directions: Sift together flour, soda, salt, and cinnamon. Cream butter, gradually add sugar and cream until fluffy. Add brandy extract then add eggs one at a time. Add dry ingredients then fruit and nuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls on lightly greased cookie sheets. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes at 350°.

title: Easy Chicken And Dumplings
ingredients: 4 or more chicken quarters 1 can cream of chicken soup 2 c. of Bisquick mix milk salt, to taste black pepper, to taste parsley flakes
directions: Remove any excess fat from chicken quarters. Cover chicken with water and boil approximately 20-30 minutes or until done. (Do not over cook or meat will become stringy.) Remove chicken from pot and cool; remove skin and debone; set aside. Add cream of chicken soup to chicken broth and stir.

title: Taco Soup
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef 1 small onion, chopped 1 (1 1/4 ounce) package taco seasoning 1 (1 ounce) package ranch dressing mix 1 (15 1/4 ounce) can whole kernel corn 1 (15 1/4 ounce) can hominy 1 (15 1/4 ounce) can ranch style beans 1 (15 1/4 ounce) cansliced potatoes 1 (14 1/2 ounce) can rotel
directions: Brown the ground beef and onions together. Add taco seasoning and ranch dressing mix. Stir to combine. Add all other ingredients (do not drain anything) and simmer 20-30 minutes.

title: Cheese And Chive Damper (Australian Soda Bread)
ingredients: 2 cups self-rising flour 1 tsp ground mustard 2 tbsp chilled butter, chopped 3/4 cup grated Cheddar cheese 1/4 cup chopped fresh chives 1/2 cup milk
directions: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Line a baking pan with parchment paper. Sift flour and mustard into a large bowl. Rub in butter using fingertips until it resembles breadcrumbs (this can be done in a food processor if liked). Stir in cheese and chives. Season to taste. Add combined milk and 1/2 cup water, mixing quickly to a soft dough. Turn onto a floured surface. Knead lightly and form into a 10-inch round. Place on prepared pan. Bake for 35-40 mins, until bottom sounds hollow when tapped. Serve warm in wedges with butter.

title: Honey And Yogurt Bread
ingredients: 7/8 cup warm water 1 container plain yogurt 4 tablespoons honey 2 1/2 cups wheat flour 1 2/3 cups whole wheat flour 1 packet yeast milk to taste poppy seeds to taste
directions: Mix the yeast into the warm water and place in the pan of a bread machine with the yogurt, honey and flour. Select the dough program. Let dough rise. Place in a loaf pan, brush with milk and sprinkle with poppy seeds. Bake in a preheated oven at 350°F until toothpick insert comes out clean. Serve warm.

title: Avocado and Beet Salad
ingredients: 16 each medium beets 1 cup Kraft Classic Herb Dressing, divided 2 each medium red onions, thinly sliced 1/2 cup orange juice 6 each medium avocados, peeled, pitted and cut into wedges 1/2 cup fresh parsley, chopped 2 Tbsp. grated orange zest
directions: Wash beets gently; pierce in several places with fork. Place beets in centre of large piece of heavy-duty foil placed on sheet pan. Drizzle with 1/2 of the dressing. Bring up foil sides. Double fold top and ends of packet to seal, leaving room for heat circulation inside. Bake in 400F-standard oven 45 min. or until beets are tender. Open foil carefully to release steam. Cool. Peel beets by gently rubbing off the skins with a clean cloth or paper towel. Cut beets into wedges; place in large bowl. Add onions, orange juice and remaining dressing; toss to coat. Arrange avocado wedges evenly on 20 salad plates (or 10 salad plates for trial recipe). Top with the beet mixture. Sprinkle each salad with about 1 tsp. of the parsley and about 1/4 tsp. of the orange peel.

title: Strawberry Shortcake
ingredients: 2 c. cake flour 2 Tbsp. sugar 1 Tbsp. baking powder 1/2 tsp. baking soda 1/4 tsp. salt 5 Tbsp. butter 1/2 c. milk 1 pt. heavy cream, chilled 1 c. sugar, divided 1 tsp. vanilla 3 c. strawberries, washed and sliced
directions: Preheat oven to 425°. Combine flour, 2 tablespoons sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a small bowl. Cut in chilled butter with a pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse cornmeal. Stir milk into flour mixture, mixing until a soft dough forms. Knead briefly until dough forms a ball. Divide dough in half. Pat dough halves into 2 greased 8-inch layer cake pans. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until a cake tester inserted in center comes out clean. Cool on rack.

title: Crustless Coconut Pie
ingredients: 2 eggs, beaten 7 oz. sugar 1/4 c. self-rising flour 1 c. milk 1/4 stick margarine 3 1/2 oz. grated coconut 1/2 tsp. vanilla flavoring
directions: Mix all together; pour into pie pan. No crust is needed. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Pantry-Friendly Homemade Pie Crust
ingredients: 2 cups All-purpose Flour 23 cups Shortening, Preferably Butter-flavored 1/2 cups Cold Milk
directions: In a large bowl, pour in flour and shortening; with your hands or a pastry cutter, work quickly to blend the mixture together until it resembles coarse cornmeal. Make a well in the center of the mixture and pour in the milk, mixing the contents together with a fork until the mixture follows the fork around the bowl. Flour your work surface well, and place your dough on it. Knead the dough about five times and divide the dough in half. Flatten one half into a disc, taking care to flour your dough and rolling pin very well. Roll the dough into your desired thickness, until it is about 1/4-1/8 thick. Place into a pie plate and use as desired. Makes two, 9-inch pie crusts. Note: If using for a unbaked pie filling, simply preheat your oven to 450 degrees. Poke holes generously on the crust with a fork, and bake uncovered for 10-12 minutes.

title: 7-Up Salad
ingredients: 2 small lemon jello 2 c. boiling water 2 c. 7-Up 1 c. marshmallows (small) 1 c. pineapple, crushed
directions: Drain pineapple well and save juice.

title: Nearly Instant Strawberry Trifle
ingredients: 12 oz. prepared nonfat pound cake, cut into 1-inch cubes 1/2 c. orange juice 2 pt. strawberries 10 Tbsp. sugar 1 1/4 c. nonfat milk 1 1/4 c. egg substitute 1 1/2 tsp. vanilla additional strawberries (for garnish) mint leaves (for garnish)
directions: Place cake in a 2 1/2 to 3-quart trifle bowl or other glass bowl. Pour orange juice over; set aside. In blender or food processor, puree 1 pint of the strawberries with 4 tablespoons of the sugar; pour over cake. Slice remaining strawberries; arrange over cake and set aside.

title: Garden Chicken Salad
ingredients: Sour Cream Dressing 1 1/2 c. boiling water 1 1/2 c. dry Minute rice 1 small onion, diced 1 1/2 cubed cooked chicken 1 (16 oz.) pkg. Birds Eye broccoli cuts, thawed 1/2 c. sliced celery 8 cherry tomatoes, halved
directions: Pour boiling water over rice and onion in 2-quart bowl. Cover with foil and let stand 5 minutes. Stir in dressing and remaining ingredients and mix lightly. Serve on lettuce if desired. Makes 4 servings.

title: Asparagus Cheese Tarts
ingredients: 2 pieces Thawed Puff Pastry 10 ounces, weight Fresh Sliced Mushrooms 1 teaspoon Sea Salt, Divided 1/2 teaspoons Black Pepper, Divided 1 pound Fresh Asparagus 1 teaspoon Lemon Zest 1 cup Shredded Cheese 1/2 cups Sour Cream
directions: 1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees F. 2. Roll out the pastry sheet and cut into 6 small squares. 3. Using a small knife, score a 1/2 border around the inside edge of each square and place on a greased baking sheet. 4. Saute mushrooms in a skillet and add half of the salt and pepper. 5. Transfer to a large bowl and cool. 6. Cut asparagus on the diagonal into 1 pieces and add to the mushroom mixture. 7. Add in lemon zest, remaining salt and pepper, cheese and sour cream. 8. Spoon filling on the pastry squares, leaving 1/2 border. 9. Bake 20 to 22 minutes.

title: Lauch In Rahmasse (Leeks In Sour Cream)
ingredients: 8 large leeks 3 tablespoons butter 1/4 cup hot water 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon Accent seasoning 1 cup sour cream 1 tablespoon flour 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper
directions: Trim off tough ends and roots of leeks. wash cut into 3/4 inch slices. melt butter and add leeks. cook for 2 minutes and then add water, salt and half the accent. cover and cook for ten minutes. blend together sour cream, remaining accent, and cayenne pepper and add to leeks and cook 3 minutes stirring constantly.

title: Cherry Delights
ingredients: 1/4 lb. butter 1 1/2 c. confectioners sugar 1 1/2 c. fine coconut 2 tsp. milk 1 tsp. vanilla graham crackers
directions: Combine all ingredients. Put small amount in palm of hand. Place cherry in center and roll into a ball. Roll in graham cracker crumbs. Let stand a few hours.

title: Pork And Beans
ingredients: 4 1/2 lb. navy beans 2 1/2 Tbsp. salt 2 qt. tomato juice 1 qt. water 2 1/2 Tbsp. molasses 2/3 c. brown sugar 1/2 tsp. pepper 1/2 tsp. cinnamon 1/2 c. flour
directions: Soak beans in salt water overnight, then boil until beans are nearly soft. Make a sauce of remaining ingredients. Fill cans 3/4 full of beans. Add liquid and cold pack 2 1/2 hours. Bacon can be added.

title: Yummy Soup
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb. sauteed ground beef 2 env. (1 pkg.) Lipton Beefy Onion Soup 1 15 oz. can tomato sauce 4 cans water (use tomato sauce can) 1 pkg. Italian mixed vegetables (frozen) 1/2 - 3/4 c. orzo or barley
directions: Blend all ingredients in a large pot. Simmer about one hour. Enjoy!

title: Clam Chowder
ingredients: 2 dozen littleneck clams 2 dozen cherrystone clams 1 quart water 1 head garlic, sliced in 1/2 horizontally 3 bay leaves 2 sprigs thyme, leaves picked 3 tablespoons unsalted butter 4 ounces pancetta, cut into cubes 1 celery stalk, diced 1 onion, diced 2 heaping tablespoons all-purpose flour 2 Yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cubed 2 cups heavy cream 1 cup milk Freshly ground black pepper 1 handful flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped Parmesan Oyster Crackers, recipe follows 2 cloves garlic Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper 1/2 stick unsalted butter 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil 2 cups oyster crackers 1 handful flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped 1/4 cup grated Parmigiano-Reggiano
directions: Wash and scrub the clams to get rid of the dirt. Set the littlenecks aside in the refrigerator, and combine the cherrystone clams with the water, garlic, bay leaves, and thyme leaves in a large pot. Cover, and steam over medium-high heat until the clams have all popped open, about 15 minutes. Check every 5 minutes to pull out the clams that have opened (some take longer than others), and give the pot a stir. Pull the opened clams out of their shells and chop them roughly. Cover them and set aside. Pour the broth into a big bowl through a strainer that you've lined with cheesecloth, just in case there is leftover sand; set the broth aside. Rinse out the pot and melt the butter over medium heat. Add the pancetta, celery, and onion. Saute this together for 5 minutes, until the vegetables soften. Sprinkle the flour into the pot; stir and coat everything well. Gradually pour in the strained clam broth, whisking constantly to break up any lumps of flour. When all the broth is incorporated, fold in the potatoes, and bring to a boil, stirring constantly for about 15 minutes. The soup will start to thicken from the potato starch. Reduce the heat to low and fold in the cream, milk, and chopped clams. Toss in the littleneck clams and cover the pot to let them steam open, about 5 minutes. Season the soup with many turns of freshly ground black pepper and stir everything together to heat through, but do not let it boil. Serve this in nice big bowls with some chopped parsley and Parmesan Oyster Crackers. Preheat oven to 250 degrees F. Chop garlic cloves then sprinkle with some salt and smash to make a paste. Set a large nonstick pan over medium heat. Add butter, oil and garlic and swirl pan. Add oyster crackers and chopped flat-leaf parsley and toss to coat. Spread out on a sheet tray, season with salt and pepper and sprinkle with shredded Parmigiano. Pop into the oven and bake for 25 to 30 minutes until golden and crispy. Yield: 2 cups

title: Swedish Meatballs And Tangy Sauce
ingredients: 2 slices stale bread, made into bread crumbs 2 lb. hamburger 1 small onion, minced 1/4 tsp. pepper 2 Tbsp. fat 1/2 to 1 c. milk 2 eggs 1 tsp. salt 1/2 to 1 tsp. nutmeg
directions: Soak crumbs in milk. Add next 6 ingredients and mix well. Shape into tiny balls; roll in flour. Brown in fat in skillet. When done, take up and drain. Put in sauce and simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Cocktail Sauce
ingredients: 1 large bottle catsup 1 Tbsp. lemon juice 4 Tbsp. horseradish 2 Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce salt vinegar hot sauce
directions: Pour 1/2 catsup from bottle. To the catsup left in the bottle, add lemon juice, horseradish, Worcestershire sauce and salt to taste. Finish filling bottle with vinegar. Shake well. Add hot sauce, if desired. Keep in refrigerator. Use as needed. Good on shrimp, oysters and crab. :5 Carol Taylor

title: Peanut Brittle
ingredients: 2 c. sugar 1 c. white syrup 1/2 c. water 1/2 tsp. salt 3 c. peanuts 1 tsp. margarine 1 tsp. vanilla 1 heaping tsp. baking soda
directions: Put sugar, water and syrup in pan and boil until it crackles in cold water. Add peanuts and cook slowly until the peanuts are roasted. Add vanilla, margarine and baking soda. While it is still foaming, pour on greased cookie sheet. Cool; break into pieces.

title: Make And Freeze Meatballs
ingredients: 2 lb. ground beef 1 c. quick-cooking, rolled oats 1 medium onion, chopped 1 1/2 tsp. seasoned salt 1/4 tsp. pepper 2 tsp. Worcestershire sauce 1 egg 1/4 c. water or milk
directions: Combine all ingredients. Mix with hands until well combined. Form into about 60 (1-inch) meatballs. Arrange in a single layer in a 12 x 8-inch microwave-safe baking dish. Cover with waxed paper.

title: Burger Bean Cups
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup 1 lb. ground beef 1/3 c. fine dry bread crumbs 1 egg, beaten 1/2 tsp. salt 1/2 tsp. pepper 1 (9 oz.) pkg. cut green beans 1/4 c. chopped onion
directions: Thoroughly mix 1/4 cup soup, beef, bread crumbs, onion, egg, salt and pepper. Divide into 4 equal parts and place in casserole dish. Flatten to 5-inch circles. Turn up edges to form a ring.

title: Fresh Homemade Mozzarella
ingredients: 4 pints Cold Full Fat Milk 1 teaspoon Citric Acid (dissolved in 1/2 cup cold water) 1/2 teaspoon Vegetable Rennet (dissolved in 1/4 cup water) 1/4 cup Sea Salt (dissolved in 2 pints boiling water)
directions: Mix - In a large very clean saucepan pour your citric acid mix and add the milk, stirring constantly. The citric acid will cause the milk to split slightly, don't panic this is meant to happen. Heat - Place the saucepan over a low heat and gently heat the milk to 32°C. Do this very slowly so you don't overheat or things can go very wrong. Rest - Add the rennet mixture and stir right from the bottom of the pan to make sure it is mixed thoroughly. This causes the milk solids to separate and leave you with curds (the solid stuff) and whey (the liquid). Cover and leave to rest for 5 minutes. Slice and Heat - The curds should now form a smooth layer at the top of the pan that you can is set almost like jelly. If not, cover and leave for a couple more minutes for the rennet to work its magic. Slice the curds into 1 inch cubes in the pan to break it up into, well little cubes. Put the pan back on the heat until it reaches 32°C. Drain - Time to don your most glamorous marigold gloves as things get a little hot! Take the pan off the heat and drain the curds into a fine mesh strainer (we used a sieve). Knead - Put the curds into a clean bowl and pour over enough of the boiling salt water mix. This will heat things up and make them nice and malleable as well as adding a little salty flavor. Pull the curds together and knead slightly, stretching the strands out (careful not to overwork here if you want to keep your mozzarella creamy). If the curds are not easy to work, pour away the salt water, which will have cooled slightly, and refresh with new hot salty water. Once you are happy with your lot, pull into a ball and wrap with cling film or leave to sit in a bowl of cold salted water. Your cheese will be softest when fresh, firming up a little after being chilled overnight.

title: Sock-It-To-Me Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg butter cake mix 3/4 cup Wesson oil 1/2 cup sugar 4 Tbsp brown sugar 2 tsp cinnamon 4 eggs 1 (8 oz) container sour cream 1 tsp vanilla 1/2 cup nuts, chopped
directions: Mix together brown sugar, nuts and cinnamon. Set aside. Mix everything else together. Pour half of batter in greased Bundt pan. Sprinkle with nut mixture. Pour in remaining batter. Bake at 350° for 40 - 45 minutes

title: Spiced Dogs
ingredients: 1 pkg. hot dog franks 1 jar grape jelly 1 jar currant jelly dash of Worcestershire sauce spoonful of mustard
directions: In crock-pot, place jellies, sauce and mustard, then cook on low heat until melted. Add frank slices (in 1/2-inch pieces). Let cook on low heat for a few hours.

title: Quick & Easy Lemon Chicken & Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup Kraft Zesty Italian Dressing 1 lb. boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into strips 1 cup chicken broth 1 cup small broccoli florets 1 red pepper, cut into strips 1 cup thinly sliced carrots 2 cups instant white rice, uncooked 1 tsp. lemon pepper seasoning 2 Tbsp. Kraft 100% Parmesan Grated Cheese
directions: Heat dressing in large skillet on medium-high heat. Add chicken; cook and stir 3 to 5 min. Add broth, broccoli, red pepper and carrots. Bring to boil. Stir in rice. Return to boil. Reduce heat to low; cover. Simmer 5 min. Remove from heat. Let stand 5 min. Stir in lemon pepper seasoning; sprinkle with cheese.

title: Wicky Wacky Cake
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. flour 1 c. sugar 1 tsp. soda pinch of salt 3 Tbsp. cocoa or 1 oz. sq. chocolate 1 c. warm water 1 tsp. vanilla 5 Tbsp. melted butter
directions: Sift first 5 ingredients together in the pan you plan to bake in (8 x 8 x 2-inches). Add water, vanilla and 5 tablespoons melted butter. Bake in this same pan at 350°. Do not grease pan. Bake about 30 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Caliente Chipotle Chili
ingredients: 1 whole Yellow Onion, Chopped 4 cloves Garlic, Minced 1 pound Ground Turkey Or Beef 1 Tablespoon Ground Cumin 1 Tablespoon Ancho Chili Powder 1 Tablespoon Chipotle Chili Powder 1/4 teaspoons Cayenne Pepper 1 teaspoon Smoked Paprika Salt And Pepper, to taste 4 whole Bell Peppers, Any Color, Rougly Chopped 2 whole Poblano Chiles, Roughly Chopped 1 can (4 Oz. Size) Chopped Green Chiles 1 can (15 Oz. Size) Red Kidney Beans, Drained And Rinsed 1 can (28 Oz. Size) Diced Tomatoes 2 Tablespoons Tomato Paste 3 whole Chipotle Peppers In Adobo Sauce, Chopped Small 2 bottles Smoked Porter Or Other Beer (12 Ounce Bottles) Chopped Cilantro, Shredded Cheddar Cheese, And Sour Cream For Garnish
directions: 1. In a pan over medium-high heat, saute the onion until soft, about 5 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute. Add ground turkey and cook until browned and liquid has released and mostly evaporated. Add cumin, ancho chili powder, chipotle chili powder, cayenne, paprika, and salt and pepper. Stir to incorporate, and cook for a minute or two. 2. Put turkey mixture into your slow cooker. Add the bell peppers, poblanos, green chiles, kidney beans, diced tomatoes, tomato paste, chipotles, and enough of the beer until the mixture is thinned to your desired consistency. It will thicken up a bit as it cooks, but I like it chunky. So I didn't add the whole bottle (I had one of those huge 22 ounce bottles, so it probably ended up being about a beer and a quarter), which left me the unfortunate task of finishing it right then and there. Cooking is tough, right? 3. Turn slow cooker to low and cook for 7-8 hours. 4. Garnish with chopped cilantro, cheddar cheese, and a dollop of sour cream (or sliced avocado, or whatever else you like).

title: Easy Pickled Vegetables
ingredients: 1 small head cauliflower, cut into florets (about 4 cups) 4 cups thinly sliced onions (about 4 large) 4 cups thinly sliced cucumber (about 3 medium) 2 medium sweet red pepper, cut into strips 2 medium green peppers, cut into strips 8 quarts ice water 1 cup canning salt 2-1/2 cups sugar 2-1/2 cups white vinegar 1 teaspoon celery seed 3/4 teaspoon ground turmeric 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves
directions: Place cauliflower, onions, cucumbers and peppers in a large bowl. In another large bowl, mix ice water and salt; pour over vegetables. Let stand 4 hours. Rinse vegetables and drain well. In a Dutch oven, bring sugar, vinegar, celery seed, turmeric and cloves to a boil. Add drained vegetable mixture; return to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer, uncovered, 5 minutes or until vegetables are heated through. Pack hot vegetables and liquid into six hot 1-pint jars, leaving 1/2-in. Remove air bubbles and adjust headspace, if necessary, by adding hot liquid. Wipe rims. Center lids on jars; screw on bands until fingertip tight. Place jars into canner, ensuring that they are completely covered with water. Bring to a boil; process for 15 minutes. Remove jars and cool.

title: Rice Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. Minute rice 1 pkg. frozen, chopped broccoli 2 Tbsp. margarine 1/2 c. chopped onion 1 c. chopped celery 1 can cream of mushroom soup 1 can cream of chicken soup 1 small jar Cheez Whiz
directions: Cook rice and broccoli separately as directed. Melt margarine and saute onion and celery. Combine all ingredients and pour into a 9 x 13 or 8 x 8-inch baking dish. Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.

title: Malaysian Tangy Noodle Salad
ingredients: Noodle Salad: 1 (8 ounce) package thin rice noodles (vermicelli-style), uncooked 1 (14 ounce) can baby corn, drained, cut into thirds 1 (10 ounce) can chicken breast, drained and flaked 1 (8.25 ounce) can sliced carrots, drained 1 small cucumber, seeded and diced 1 small red onion, halved and thinly sliced 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro 1/4 cup fresh mint leaves 1/2 cup dry roasted peanuts, coarsely chopped Dressing: 1/3 cup Thai sweet red chili sauce 1/3 cup fresh lime juice 2 tablespoons soy sauce 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger
directions: Prepare noodle salad: Heat large saucepan of water to boiling. Add rice noodles; remove from heat. Soak, uncovered for 5 minutes. Drain and rinse in cold water. In large bowl combine noodles, baby corn, chicken, carrots, cucumber, red onion, cilantro, mint and peanuts. Prepare dressing: In small bowl combine sweet chili sauce, lime juice, soy sauce and ginger. Toss with noodle salad to mix well.

title: Turkey Burgers With Chipotle Tartar Sauce
ingredients: 34 cup mayonnaise 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil 2 tablespoons minced red onions 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro 1 tablespoon minced canned chipotle chile 1 tablespoon drained capers 1 lb ground turkey 4 hamburger buns 4 slices red onions 8 slices plum tomatoes 2 bunches arugula (about 1 ounce)
directions: Whisk first 6 ingredients in small bowl. Season with salt and pepper. (Sauce can be made 2 days ahead. Cover and chill. ). Prepare barbecue (medium heat). Form ground turkey into four 1/2-inch-thick patties. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Grill burgers until cooked through, about 5 minutes per side. Grill buns until just toasted. Spread 1 tablespoon sauce on bottom half of each bun. Top each with 1 burger, then 1 more tablespoon sauce. Top each with 1 onion slice, 2 tomato slices, then 1/2 bunch arugula. Cover with bun tops. Serve, passing remaining chipotle tartar sauce separately.

title: Creamy Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 3 c. water 1 c. milk 1 (7.6 oz.) pkg. roasted garlic instant mashed potatoes 4 oz. cream cheese, cubed 1 c. (4 oz.) shredded Mexican cheese
directions: In a large saucepan, bring water and milk to a rolling boil. Remove from the heat. Add contents of both envelopes from the potato package. Let stand for 1 minute; whip with a fork. Place the cream cheese in a microwave-safe bowl; cover and heat at 70% power for 45 seconds or until softened. Stir into potatoes. Transfer into a greased 1-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese. Broil in oven for approximately 3 to 4 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Blushing Pink Dip
ingredients: 1 pt. sour cream 1 whole envelope onion (Lipton) soup mix 1/2 c. chili sauce 1 tsp. Worcestershire sauce 1/4 c. horseradish
directions: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate.

title: Pookie Cookies
ingredients: 2 pkg. Pillsbury chocolate chip cookie mix 2 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese 3 eggs 1 c. sugar powdered sugar
directions: Cream together the cream cheese, eggs and sugar. Cut 24 cookies from first package and lay on a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour cream cheese mixture over cookies. Cut 24 cookies from second package of cookie mix. Place on top of mixture. Bake at 375° for 45 minutes. Cool and top with powdered sugar.

title: Polenta-Crusted Shrimp with Honey Mustard
ingredients: Vegetable cooking spray 1/2 cup all-purpose flour 2 eggs, beaten 1 1/2 cups fine polenta 2 teaspoons sweet paprika 1 pound large shrimp, peeled and deveined, tail on Kosher salt, for sprinkling 1/2 cup Dijon mustard 2 tablespoons plain yogurt 5 tablespoons honey
directions: Position an oven rack in the center of the oven and preheat to 475F. Coat a baking sheet liberally with vegetable cooking spray. Put the flour in a small bowl. Pour the beaten eggs into another small bowl. Mix together the polenta and paprika in a medium bowl. Working in batches, dredge the shrimp in the flour. Dip the flour-dredged shrimp into the eggs and then coat with the polenta mixture. Place the shrimp on the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until crisp and golden. Sprinkle with the kosher salt. Combine the honey mustard ingredients in a small bowl and stir until smooth. Serve the shrimp with little dishes of sauce for dipping.

title: Root Cellar Gratin
ingredients: 4 tablespoons butter, sliced thinly 1 pound rutabagas, peeled and sliced 1/8-inch thick 1 pound Rome or Winesap apple, peeled, cored, and sliced 1/8-inch thick 1 pound turnips, peeled and sliced 1/8-inch thick 1 large yellow onion, peeled and thinly sliced 1 pound parsnips, peeled and sliced 1/8-inch thick Salt Freshly ground black pepper 1 1/2 cups grated Fontina 3 cups heavy cream 1 cup chicken stock 1 teaspoon chopped fresh thyme 1/4 cup grated Parmesan
directions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F. Butter a 13 by 9-inch casserole dish with 1 teaspoon of the butter. Starting with the rutabagas, layer 1/3 of the vegetables, apples and onions in the prepared dish, very lightly seasoning with salt and pepper and dotting with butter between each. Top with a layer of Fontina. Repeat the layering, seasoning, and cheese, ending with cheese on top. In a saucepan, bring the cream, chicken stock, and thyme to a boil. Remove from the heat and pour over the vegetables. Bake in the oven, covered, for 30 minutes. Uncover and continue baking until nearly all the cream is absorbed, about 30 to 40 minutes. Sprinkle with the Parmesan and bake until golden, all the liquid is absorbed, and the vegetables are fork tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from the oven and let cool at least 15 minutes before serving.

title: Fruit Dip
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese, softened 1/2 c. Cool Whip 1/2 c. Marshmallow Creme 2 to 3 drops red food coloring
directions: In small bowl, combine all ingredients; mix well. Serve with fresh fruit, graham crackers or vanilla wafers. Best if chilled overnight.

title: Chunky Apple-Cinnamon Cake With Creamy Cream Cheese Frosting
ingredients: 12 cup butter 2 cups sugar (can use 1 cup white and 1 cup light brown sugar) 2 large eggs 1 tablespoon vanilla 2 cups flour 1 teaspoon baking soda 1 teaspoon salt 1 12 teaspoons cinnamon 1 pinch nutmeg 5 small granny smith apples, peeled, cored and sliced 1 cup toasted walnuts, chopped 12 cup butter (no subs!) 1 (8 ounce) package cream cheese, softened 1 teaspoon vanilla 2 tablespoons whipping cream 3 12 cups icing sugar
directions: Set oven to 350 degrees. Grease a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. For the cake; in a large bowl using an electric mixer beat the butter with sugar, eggs and vanilla until well blended (about 4 minutes). In another bowl mix together the flour, baking soda, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg until blended; add to the butter mixture and mix until combined. Add in chopped apples and walnuts; mix to combine. Spread the batter into prepared baking dish. Bake for about 45 minutes or until cake tests done. Cool completely before frosting. For the frosting; in a large bowl cream the butter with the cream cheese, vanilla and whipping cream until fluffy (about 2 minutes). Add in the icing sugar and beat until combined (adding in more icing sugar if needed to acheive desired texture).

title: Roasted Potato Bunnies
ingredients: 6 whole Large Potatoes, Sweet Potatoes Or Yams 2 Tablespoons Extra Virgin Olive Oil 1/2 teaspoons Salt 1 sprig Fresh Rosemary
directions: Note you will need a small bunny-shaped cookie cutter. Use organic ingredients whenever possible. Preheat your oven to 425 F. Slice the potatoes lengthwise into 1/4" thick slices. Cut out the bunny shapes by placing the potato slice with positioned cookie cutter between two chopping boards and pressing down. Brush both sides of the bunnies with olive oil and salt them. If you are using garnet sweet potatoes/yams put them on the cookie sheet and bake for 10 minutes. Then add the rest of the potato bunnies to the cookie sheet. Bake for 15 minutes more. Remove them from the oven and turn them all over. Bake for another 15 minutes or more until they are browned. Remove them from the oven and sprinkle with rosemary. Serve immediately.

title: Pecan Pie
ingredients: 1 c. sugar 1/2 c. dark Karo syrup 3 eggs 1/2 tsp. salt 1 tsp. vanilla 1 c. pecans 1/4 c. butter
directions: Pour into unbaked 9-inch pie shell. Bake at 450° for 10 minutes. Reduce to 350°; bake for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Citrusy Gin And Blood Orange Punch
ingredients: 6 large lemons, divided 2 cups cold water 1/4 cup crystallized ginger, chopped 1/4 cup dried apricots, chopped 1/4 cup dried cranberries 3/4 cup sugar 1 cup fresh lemon juice 2 cups citrusy gin (such as Bluecoat) 3/4 cup blood orange liqueur (such as Pur Likor Spice) 1 (750-milliliter) bottle prosecco or other sparkling white wine, chilled Rosemary sprigs (optional)
directions: Carefully remove rind from lemons using a vegetable peeler, making sure to avoid white pith. Thinly slice rind from one lemon, and place in a Bundt pan. Add 2 cups water, ginger, apricots, and cran-berries, and freeze for 4 1/2 hours or until firm. Place rinds from remaining 5 lemons and sugar in a medium bowl. Muddle rinds and sugar together using a muddler or wooden spoon, working sugar into rinds to release their oils. Cover and let sugar mixture stand at room temperature 1 1/2 hours. Add juice to rind mixture; stir until sugar dissolves. Strain rind mixture through a sieve into a bowl; discard rinds. Stir in gin and blood orange liqueur; cover and chill at least 3 hours. Unmold ice ring by dipping bottom half of Bundt pan into several inches of warm water for 5 to 10 seconds to loosen; repeat as necessary to release. Invert ice ring into a large bowl or punch bowl. Pour gin mixture over ice ring. Gradually add prosecco. Garnish with rosemary, if desired.

title: Easy Baked Tofu
ingredients: 1 cake firm tofu (about 16 ounces) 1 tablespoon vegetable oil 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil 3 tablespoons soy sauce 2 teaspoons grated peeled ginger root (optional) 1 garlic clove, pressed (optional)
directions: Preheat the oven to 400. Cut the tofu into slices, cubes, triangles, or sticks. Lightly oil a baking dish large enough to hold the tofu in a single layer. Whisk together the marinade ingredients (or variation ingredients, if using) and drizzle over the tofu. Gently turn or toss to coat thoroughly. Bake uncovered, stirring once or twice, until the oil is sizzling and the tofu is firm and chewy, 30 to 40 minutes. Serve hot, at room temperature, or chilled. Cut the tofu into small cubes. Heat the vegetable oil and the sesame oil in a large skillet. Add the tofu and saute, stirring often, for 4 or 5 minutes, until lightly golden. Add the soy sauce (and other marinade ingredients if you are using a variation), lower the heat, and simmer for 3 or 4 minutes longer. Done! Add 2 to 3 teaspoons of Chinese chili paste with garlic to the basic marinade and reduce the soy sauce to 2 tablespoons. Serve with assorted steamed and raw vegetables and Spicy Peanut Sauce (page 256). Add 2 tablespoons of vinegar and 1 tablespoon of honey, maple syrup, or sugar to the basic marinade. Serve with Lemongrass Rice (page 181) and Sesame Broccoli (page 193). Use 2 tablespoons vegetable oil, 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 2 tablespoons chopped chipotles in adobo sauce, and 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro (optional) for the marinade. Try with Yellow Rice (page 179) and Quick Avocado & Corn Salsa (page 233). Mix together 1 tablespoon vegetable oil, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, and 3/4 cup of Barbecue Sauce. Serve on rice, orzo, or mashed potatoes topped with sauteed onions and peppers. On the side, serve collards (page 162) and/or Baked Acorn Squash Crescents (page 198). Coat the tofu with a mixture of 1 tablespoon vegetable oil and 1 tablespoon Old Bay Seasoning. Bring on the backyard picnic foodChipotle Potato Salad (page 216), corn on the cob with one of our festive toppings (page 188), Broccoli Slaw (page 208), and Banana Cupcakes (page 274).

title: Southern Caviar
ingredients: 3 cans black-eyed peas, drained 1/2 c. finely chopped green pepper 1/2 c. finely chopped red pepper 1 can (2 1/4 oz) diced green chiles, drained 3/4 c. finely chopped onion 2 cloves garlic, minced 1/4 c. red wine vinegar 1/4 c. olive oil 1 Tbsp. Dijon mustard Tabasco Salt Fresh cracked pepper Chopped fresh parsley Tortilla chips or melba crackers
directions: Combine peas, peppers, onion and garlic. In separate bowl, whisk together vinegar, oil and mustard; pour over bean mixture. Season with tabasco, salt and pepper. Mash bean mixture slightly; refrigerate until ready to serve. Sprinkle with parsley before serving.

title: Chocolate Chunk Cookies Recipe
ingredients: 1/2 cup (1 stick) butter, softened 1/2 cup sugar 1/2 cup firmly packed light brown sugar 1 large egg 1/2 tsp. vanilla 1 cup flour 1/4 tsp. salt 1/2 tsp. baking powder 1/2 tsp. baking soda 1/2 cup rolled oats 1 1/4 cups chocolate chumks
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Lightly grease cookie sheets. Combine butter, sugar and brown sugar in a large bowl. Beat with an electric mixer set at medium speed until creamy. Beat in egg and vanilla. Combine flour, salt, baking powder and baking soda in a small bowl and mix well. Add flour mixture to butter mixture, beating continually. Stir in oats and chocolate chunks. Drop batter by teaspoonfuls onto prepared baking sheets. Bake until lightly browned, 8 to 10 minutes. Cool on baking sheets for 1 minute. Transfer to wire racks to cool completely.

title: Braised Lentils with Goat Cheese and Walnuts
ingredients: 1 tablespoon extra-virgin olive oil 2 ounces bacon, finely diced 1 small onion, minced 1 carrot, minced 1 garlic clove, minced 1/2 pound brown lentils 3 cups water 1 bay leaf Salt and freshly ground pepper 4 ounces fresh goat cheese, crumbled 1/2 cup toasted walnuts, chopped
directions: In a large saucepan, heat the olive oil. Add the bacon, onion, carrot and garlic and cook over moderately high heat, stirring, until softened, about 5 minutes. Add the lentils, water and bay leaf, season with salt and pepper and bring to a boil. Cover partially and simmer over very low heat until the lentils are tender, about 20 minutes. Discard the bay leaf. Stir the goat cheese into the lentils and season with salt and pepper. Garnish with the walnuts and serve.

title: Creamy Chocolate Butter
ingredients: 12 lb butter, unsalted, softened 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder 3 tablespoons confectioners' sugar 1 tablespoon coffee, cold 1 teaspoon chocolate extract 14 teaspoon salt
directions: Using a stand mixer, mix all ingredients on medium-high speed until all ingredients are well combined, about 2 minutes. Remove butter from bowl and spoon onto parchment paper. Roll into a log, using edge of baking sheet to for a tight log. Chill for 2 hours before serving.

title: Florentine Cookies with OREO
ingredients: 1/3 cup unsalted butter 1 cup flour 2/3 cup sugar 1/4 cup light corn syrup 1/2 cup OREO Base Cake
directions: Melt butter in saucepan on medium-high heat. Remove from heat. Stir in all remaining ingredients except base cake until well blended. Pipe into 6x1/4-inch strips in parchment paper-lined sheet pans sprayed with cooking spray. Sprinkle each strip with 1/8 tsp. base cake. Bake in preheated 350 degrees F convection oven 7 to 9 min. or just until tops are set. Remove from oven. Carefully lift from parchment and twist or shape as desired; place on wire racks. Cool completely.

title: Chicken Stir-Fry On Rice
ingredients: 1 1/3 c. water 1/2 tsp. salt 1 1/3 c. 5 minute rice 1 Tbsp. cornstarch 2 Tbsp. soy sauce 1 Tbsp. oriental sesame oil 3/4 c. chicken broth 1 Tbsp. vegetable oil 1 tsp. minced garlic 1 bag frozen vegetables (broccoli, red peppers, bamboo shoots and straw mushrooms) 1 c. sliced green onion 12 oz. thin sliced chicken or turkey breast, cut crosswise (2 c.)
directions: Bring water and salt to boil in a covered medium size saucepan. Stir in rice. Cover; remove from heat and let stand. Stir cornstarch, soy sauce, sesame oil and broth in a bowl until blended. Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large, deep nonstick skillet over high heat until hot but not smoking. Add chicken and garlic; stir-fry 1 minute, until chicken starts to brown. Stir in vegetables and green onion; cover and cook 3 to 4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are hot and chicken is cooked through. Stir cornstarch mixture again. Pour into skillet and bring to a boil, stirring constantly, until sauce is thick and clear. Spoon over rice.

title: Taco Compuesto
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef 1/2 c. chopped onion 2 Tbsp. chopped canned green chili peppers 1 clove garlic, minced 1 tsp. chili powder 1 1/2 c. chopped tomato 3 Tbsp. low calorie Italian salad dressing 1/2 tsp. seasoned salt 8 taco shells 1 c. shredded lettuce 1/2 c. shredded low calorie process cheese product (2 oz.) 1/2 c. taco sauce
directions: Cook beef, onion, chili peppers and garlic until beef is browned; drain. Stir in chili powder and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Combine tomato, salad dressing and seasoned salt. Spoon beef mixture into taco shells; top with tomato mixture, lettuce and cheese. Pass taco sauce. Makes 4 servings.

title: Slow-Cooker Hawaiian Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup pineapple juice 12 cup packed brown sugar 13 cup soy sauce 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts
directions: Put all ingredients in slow cooker and cook on low for 6-8 hours.

title: Hello Judy’S
ingredients: 1 box (18.25 Oz. Box) Butter-Recipe Yellow Cake Mix 2 whole Eggs 1/2 cups Oil 2 Tablespoons Water 1 cup Nuts (optional) 1 package (12 Oz. Package) Semi-sweet Chocolate Chips.
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray the sides and bottom of a 13x9 pan with cooking spray. (Note: this must be mixed by hand-no mixers.) In a bowl combine cake mix, eggs, oil and water. Stir with a wooden or plastic spoon, mixture will be lumpy. Add your nuts (optional) and your chocolate chips, stirring to combine. Scrape into the pan, trying to get as even as possible. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool and cut into 24 squares.

title: Grilled Vegetable And Mozzarella Toasts
ingredients: 2 None zucchini, thinly sliced lengthwise 2 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp chopped fresh oregano 4 None large slices ciabatta or artisan bread 2 tbsp red pepper tapenade 9 oz fresh mozzarella cheese, torn 1/2 cup roasted red pepper, sliced None None Basil leaves, to serve
directions: Preheat a grill pan on high heat or preheat the grill to medium. Line a baking pan with parchment paper. Lightly brush zucchini with 1 tbsp of the oil. Sprinkle with oregano. Grill 1-2 mins each side, until lightly charred. Set aside. Brush bread with remaining oil. Grill 2-3 mins each side, until golden. Spread bread slices evenly with tapenade. Place on baking pan Top with zucchini and mozzarella. Broil toasts 4-5 mins, until cheese melts. Top with sliced pepper and basil leaves.

title: Banana Berry Brownie Pizza Recipe
ingredients: 1/3 c. Cool water 1 pkt Brownie mix, (15 ounce) 1/4 c. Oil 1 x Egg 1 pkt Philadelphia Brand Cream Cheese, softened (8 ounce) 1/4 c. Sugar 1 x Egg 1 tsp Vanilla Strawberry slices Banana slices 2 sqr Baker's SemiSweet Chocolate, melted (1 ounce)
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Bring water to boil. Mix together brownie mix, water, oil and egg in large bowl till well blended. Pour into greased and floured 12" pizza pan. Bake 25 min. Beat cream cheese, sugar, egg and vanilla in small mixing bowl at medium speed with electric mixer till well blended. Pour over crust. Bake 15 min. Cold. Top with fruit; drizzle with chocolate. Garnish with mint leaves, if you like. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Pizza Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb. hamburger 3/4 c. catsup 2 Tbsp. chopped parsley 2 Tbsp. minced onion 1 Tbsp. bell pepper 1 tsp. salt 1/2 tsp. oregano
directions: Mix beef with all ingredients. Split the buns and spread each half with beef mixture, being sure to cover to the edge of the bun. Place under the broiler about 3-inches from heat. Broil about 5 minutes. Remember to leave the oven door ajar. Remove from oven and top each piece with 2 strips of cheese. Return to broiler until cheese melts.

title: Hong Kong-Style Fish From Atlanta Fish Market
ingredients: 1/2 cup low sodium soy sauce 1/4 cup water 3 ounces dry sherry 2 tablespoons granulated sugar 2 tablespoons sesame oil 2 tablespoons olive oil 1 lb spinach, fresh, washed and stemmed black pepper, freshly ground 12 ounces white fish fillets (preferably two 6-oz. fillets) 2 tablespoons ginger, fresh, finely julienned 2 tablespoons green onions, finely julienned
directions: In a saucepan, combine soy sauce, water, sherry and sugar and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low to keep warm. In a large skillet, heat sesame and olive oils. Add spinach and toss until wilted. Season with pepper and set aside. Steam or saute fish until just done. Do not overcook. to assemble: In a large soup bowl, place a bed of spinach. Rest fish on top of spinach and garnish with ginger and green onions. Pour soy broth over fish and serve.

title: No Cook The Noodles Lasagna
ingredients: 1 large container cottage cheese 1 1/2 lb. hamburger, cooked and drained 1 large jar spaghetti sauce 1 small can tomato sauce 1 small pkg. Longhorn cheese, grated 1 pkg. Mozzarella cheese, grated lasagna noodles (uncooked)
directions: Add spaghetti sauce and tomato sauce to hamburger. Coat bottom of pan with sauce. Layer the following in a 9 x 13-inch pan: noodles (do not cook), sauce and cottage cheese and top with both cheeses. Repeat layers so there are 3 layers. Sprinkle cheese on top. Cover with foil. Bake 45 minutes at 350°. Cool and refrigerate. Reheat the next night. This is best when reheated.

title: Gourmet "Steaks"
ingredients: 2 lb. ground beef 1 can mushroom gravy 1 1/2 tsp. soy sauce 1/4 c. toasted slivered almonds
directions: Shape ground beef into 6 large oval patties. Grill or broil until desired doneness. Combine mushroom gravy, soy sauce and almonds. Heat and serve over patties. Makes 6 servings.

title: Banana Bread
ingredients: 90 g unsalted butter, softened 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 1 cup brown sugar, firmly packed 2 eggs 1 cup banana, mashed 1 cup plain flour 1 cup self-rising flour
directions: Reheat the oven to 180°C (160°C Fan-forced). Grease a 14cmx21cm loaf pan; line the base and long sides with baking paper, extending the paper 5 cm above the long sides. Beat butter, vanilla, and sugar in a small bowl with an electric mixer until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs, one at a time. Transfer mixture to a large bowl; stir in banana then sifted flours, in two batches. Spread mixture into pan; cover with a strip of pleated foil. Bake 40 minutes; uncover, bake another 30 minutes. Stand 5 minutes; lift onto a wire rack to cool. Serve toasted or warm, with butter if you like.

title: Stuffed Cordon Bleu Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb. lean ground beef 1/4 cup KRAFT Classic CATALINA Dressing 1/4 cup KRAFT Real Mayo Mayonnaise 2 Tbsp. GREY POUPON Savory Honey Mustard 1 slice OSCAR MAYER Smoked Ham, finely chopped 1/3 cup KRAFT Shredded Swiss Cheese 4 sourdough sandwich rolls, split, toasted
directions: Heat grill to medium heat. Mix meat and dressing; shape into 8 (1/4-inch-thick) patties. Combine mayo and mustard. Mix 1 Tbsp. mayo mixture with ham and cheese. Reserve remaining mayo mixture for later use. Top 4 patties with ham mixture; cover with remaining patties. Pinch edges together to seal. Grill 5 to 7 min. on each side or until done (160F). Spread rolls with remaining mayo mixture; fill with burgers.

title: Holiday Smoked Egg & Chive Dip Recipe
ingredients: 12 hard cooked Large eggs, riced or possibly sieved 2 tbsp. soft butter 1 1/2 tbsp. liquid smoke Seasoning 1 tbsp. lemon juice or possibly vinegar 2 teaspoon Worcestershire sauce 2 drops Tabasco 1 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon grnd pepper 1/2 c. frzn minced chives 3/4 c. mayonnaise or possibly salad dressing Garnish with radish slices
directions: Accompaniment: Crackers, potato chips, melba toast, etc. Combine all ingredients except garnish and accompaniment. Beat till smooth. If you like, add in more seasoning. Have consistency soft sufficient to permit potato chips to be dipped into easily. Chill till ready to serve. About 30 min before serving, remove from refrigerator and beat or possibly whip dip to fluffy and soften it. Pile into chilled bowl. Garnish with radish slices. Makes 1 qt.

title: Linguini With Soyrizo and Queso Fresco
ingredients: 1 lb linguine 2 tablespoons butter 2 tablespoons olive oil 1 lb soy chorizo or 1 lb chorizo sausage 6 garlic cloves, minced 2 yellow bell peppers, cut into bite-size pieces 1 red bell pepper, cut into bite-size pieces 1 (9 ounce) bag spinach, torn into bite-size pieces freshly ground salt and pepper, to taste 12 cup shredded parmesan cheese 14 cup crumbled queso fresco 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro
directions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain, reserving about 1 1/2 cups pasta cooking water. Return pasta to pot and add butter, stirring to coat. While pasta is cooking, place olive oil and Soyrizo or Chorizo in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook, stirring frequently, for 6 minutes or until browned and a little crispy.3. Add garlic and peppers to skillet along with 1/2 cup reserved pasta water. Cook for 6 minutes or until peppers are soft.4. Add spinach, drained pasta and an additional 1/2 cup pasta water. Cook over medium heat just until spinach is wilted and pasta is warm. (Add additional pasta water if you like to further moisten pasta.) Season to taste with salt and pepper. Toss with Parmesan and Queso Fresco, then garnish with cilantro.

title: Best Mango Smoothie
ingredients: 1 cup Fresh Or Frozen Mango Chunks 1/2 cups Plain Yogurt OR Vanilla Yogurt 1/2 cups Milk
directions: Put all of the ingredients into a blender. Blend and enjoy!

title: Sour Cream Fruit Pie
ingredients: 2 cups sour cream 1 cup white sugar 1/4 teaspoon salt 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour 3 eggs, beaten 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 1 (21 ounce) can cherry pie filling 1 (9 inch) prepared graham cracker crust
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). In a large bowl, mix together sour cream, sugar, salt, and flour. Add eggs and vanilla; stir until thoroughly combined.
