directions: In a large skillet, brown chicken in butter. Add onion; saute until tender. Stir in the tomatoes, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 15 minutes or until chicken juices run clear. Serve with rice.

title: Best Ever Oatmeal Bars
ingredients: 1/2 cups Brown Sugar 1/2 cups White Sugar 1/2 cups Butter 1/2 teaspoons Vanilla Extract 1 whole Egg 1/2 teaspoons Baking Soda 1/2 teaspoons Salt 1/2 cups Flour 1 cup Shredded Coconut 2 cups Old Fashioned Oats
directions: 1. Preheat oven to 325 F. In the bowl of a stand mixer blend sugars and butter on medium until combined. 2. Add vanilla and egg. Mix well. 3. Add baking soda, salt, and flour. Mix until well combined. 4. By hand add coconut and oats. Combine everything and pour into a buttered 8x8 pan. 5. Bake at 325 F for 18-20 minutes. 6. Remove from oven. Let them cool. Cut into bars.

title: Tocana De Cartofi (Romanian Potato Stew)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter 2 tablespoons flour 2 teaspoons salt 1/2 teaspoon pepper 1/4 teaspoon sweet paprika 1 cup stock 6 potatoes, peeled and cubed 1/4 cup heavy cream
directions: Melt butter in a deep saucepan. Add flour, salt, pepper and paprika, and stir until smooth. Gradually add stock, stirring constantly. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Add potatoes and stir. Cover and cook over medium heat for 15 minutes. Add cream and cook for 5 minutes more. Only a small amount of liquid should remain. Serve potatoes with remaining sauce.

title: Sausage Breakfast Casserole
ingredients: 2 lb. bulk ground sausage 6 slices white bread (remove crust) 1 1/2 c. shredded cheese 5 large eggs 2 c. whole milk or half and half 1 tsp. salt 1 tsp. dry mustard
directions: Cook sausage; drain and set aside. Spread each slice of bread with butter. Cut into cubes. Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Put bread cubes in bottom. Put sausage on bread. Top with cheese. Combine remaining ingredients. Beat well and pour on top. Chill at least 8 hours. Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Yummy Texas Pecan Pie
ingredients: 1/2 cup sugar 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour 1 cup light corn syrup 1 cup dark corn syrup 3 large eggs, room temperature 1 teaspoon white vinegar 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract 1 cup chopped pecans Pastry for single-crust pie (9 inches)
directions: In a large bowl, whisk the sugar, flour, corn syrups, eggs, vinegar and vanilla until smooth. Stir in pecans. Pour into crust. Cover edges with foil. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes. Remove foil; bake until puffed and golden (center will still wobble), 35-45 minutes. Cool on a wire rack. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Sweet And Sour Beans
ingredients: 8 slices bacon, fried 4 lg. onions, sliced thin 1 1/2 c. brown sugar 1 Tbsp. mustard, dry 1/2 tsp. garlic powder 1 tsp. salt 1/2 c. vinegar 2 (15 oz.) cans dried butter beans 1 (15 oz.) can green lima beans 1 (15 oz.) can dark red kidney beans 1 (16 oz.) can pork and beans
directions: Fry bacon until crisp, remove from skillet, add following to drippings: 4 large onions (sliced thin), 1 1/2 cups brown sugar, 1 tablespoon dry mustard, 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder, 1 teaspoon salt, 1/2 cup vinegar. Cook 20 minutes. Drain dried butter beans, green lima beans, and dark red kidney beans. Add pork and beans (do not drain). Mix all beans together, add bacon and onion sauce. Bake 1 hour at 350° or crockpot 6 - 7 hours on low.

title: Tami's Braciole
ingredients: 6 thin sliced beef steaks 1 salt & pepper, to taste 6 slice provolone cheese 6 whole fresh mushrooms sliced thin 1/2 each red & green peppers, sliced into thin strips 2 tbsp olive oil 1 cup good red wine 2 cups of homemade or store bought Italian style tomato based spaghetti sauce. If homemade sauce is used make it the day before.
directions: Season steak with salt & pepper. Place cheese, mushrooms & a few strips of peppers onto one end of the beef and roll up into a bundle. Heat pan add olive oil, brown bundles a few at a time on all side. Place all bundles into pan add wine & sauce, cook for 30 minutes. ENJOY ! !

title: Sea Salt Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 2 pounds sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces 1/2 teaspoon Morton(R) Coarse Sea Salt, plus more for finishing 2 tablespoons vegetable oil 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper 1/4 cup maple syrup 1/4 cup pecan pieces
directions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees F and coat 9 x 13 baking pan with cooking spray. Mix all ingredients together in a separate bowl, except for pecans. Arrange mixture in baking pan. Bake for 25-30 minutes, stirring halfway through. Remove from oven and sprinkle with pecan pieces. Finish with a pinch of sea salt and serve.

title: Ultradecadent Double-Chip Brownies
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups applesauce 2 1/2 cups sugar 2 teaspoons vanilla extract 2 large eggs, lightly beaten 2 large egg whites, lightly beaten 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour 1 cup unsweetened cocoa 3/4 teaspoon salt 1/2 cup semisweet chocolate minichips 1/2 cup vanilla-flavored baking chips (such as Ghirardelli) Cooking spray
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Spoon applesauce into a fine sieve over a bowl; let stand 15 minutes. Discard liquid. Scrape drained applesauce into a large bowl. Add the sugar, vanilla, eggs, and egg whites; stir well. Lightly spoon flour into dry measuring cups, and level with a knife. Combine flour, cocoa, and salt, stirring well with a whisk. Add to applesauce mixture; stir just until moist. Fold in chips. Spoon the batter into a 13 x 9-inch baking pan coated with cooking spray, and bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Cool on a wire rack.

title: Maple Mousse
ingredients: 2 cups heavy cream, whipped 1/2 vanilla bean, split 1/2 cup maple syrup 1/2 teaspoon powdered gelatin 1 tablespoon cold water 3/4 cup egg whites (about 5 to 6)
directions: Whip the cream with the scrapings from the vanilla bean until stiff and chill. In a small saucepan, boil the maple syrup to soft ball stage or 238 degrees on a candy thermometer. (Because there is such a small amount of maple syrup, measuring the temperature with a thermometer may be difficult. In this case, a good way to tell if the syrup is ready is to dip a spoon into the boiling maple syrup then put a drop into a cup of ice water. If the syrup dissolves it?s not ready. If it holds its shape and is slightly pliable between your thumb and finger, it's ready.) Sprinkle the gelatin over the cold water and let it sponge. Place the whites in a clean dry bowl and, using a whip attachment, whip until almost stiff. Hold them with the whip turning on low until the maple syrup is up to temperature. When the syrup is ready, take it off the stove and, with the mixer on high, drizzle it down the wall of the mixing bowl into the whites. Warm the sponged gelatin in the microwave and drizzle it into the whites as well. Continue whipping until the meringue is cooled. Fold in the whipped cream and pipe or spoon the mousse into dessert glasses and chill for 1 hour or until set.

title: Carrot and Coriander Soup
ingredients: 8 large carrots 3 cups chicken stock 1 -2 teaspoon ground coriander
directions: Slice carrots and add to chicken stock boil until carrots soften. Blend carrots and add ground coriander to suit personal taste. Viola! nice and easy tasty wholesome soup. Enjoy!

title: Chicken Enchiladas
ingredients: boiled whole chicken 1 can cream of chicken soup 1 can cream of mushroom soup 1 c. sour cream 1 c. milk 1 1/2 c. Old El Paso thick and chunky salsa 1 c. grated Cheddar cheese 1 pkg. flour tortillas 1 c. grated Mozzarella cheese 1 onion (chopped) 1 bell pepper (chopped) salt and pepper 1 tsp. garlic powder 1/2 stick butter
directions: Saute onion and bell pepper in butter. Boil chicken. Debone. Set broth aside. To sauteed onion add soups, sour cream, milk, salsa and half of both cheeses. Salt and pepper to taste. Some may prefer more garlic powder. Grease baking dish. Boil chicken broth, dipping each	flour tortilla in broth to soften. Put 1 tablespoon mixture in tortilla, roll and fold ends. When baking dish if full put remaining mixture over tortillas.	Top with remaining cheese. Bake until cheese is melted.

title: Salmon Log
ingredients: 1 can red salmon, drained 1 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese 1 Tbsp. lemon juice 2 tsp. grated onion 1 tsp. horseradish 1/4 tsp. liquid smoke 1/4 tsp. salt 2 oz. chopped pecans (for garnish) 2 oz. dried parsley (for garnish)
directions: Mix together and chill 3 to 4 hours before rolling. Roll into a log on Saran Wrap in pecan, parsley flake mixture. Refrigerate overnight and serve with crackers.

title: Vegetarian Chili
ingredients: 1 chopped onion 2 garlic cloves minced 1 1/4 cups white wine or 1 1/4 cup vegetable stock 1 cup red lentils 1 chile spicy, seeded chopped 1 teaspoon thyme 1 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice 2 teaspoons cumin 3 tablespoons soy sauce 1 can red kidney beans jalapenos sour cream black olives onions steamed white rice cheddar
directions: Saute garlic and onion until soft and fragrant. Add white wine or stock and tomatoes. Add lentils and spices and cook for at least 40 minutes, add more water/stock as needed, cook longer if lentils are still crunchy. Add kidney beans cook for 10 minutes more. Serve on top of white rice with corn or fritos. Top with cheese and stuff. Enjoy! :)

title: Mike'S Sausage Casserole
ingredients: 26 oz. Ranch style beans 16 oz. Pace thick and chunky salsa 1 lb. Chappell Hill garlic smoked sausage 1/2 c. chopped onions 2 pkg. Boil-in-Bag rice 1/2 pkg. feather shredded Colby and Monterey Jack cheese
directions: Peel skin from sausage. Start preparing rice. Slice sausage into 1/4-inch slices. Place in 9 x 13 Pyrex dish and microwave for 5 minutes. Turn after 2 1/2 minutes. Heat beans while fixing rice. When rice is ready, mix all ingredients except cheese and pour in dish. Place dish in oven and broil for 5 minutes. Remove and top with cheese. Return to oven, browning cheese to taste. Remove and serve.

title: Microwave Sliced Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 4 medium even potatoes 1 tsp. salt 2 to 3 Tbsp. melted butter 2 to 3 Tbsp. chopped fresh herbs (parsley, chives, thyme or sage) 2 to 3 tsp. dried herbs of your choice 4 Tbsp. grated Cheddar cheese 1/2 Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
directions: Rinse and pat potatoes dry. Cut potatoes into thin slices, but not all the way through. Use a handle of a wooden spoon to prevent knife from cutting all the way through.

title: Cheesy Potatoes
ingredients: 1 stick of oleo 1 cup sour cream 1 can chicken soup 1 - 8 oz. Velveeta cheese 1 small onion 2 lbs. frozen shredded potatoes 2 cups crushed corn flakes 1 stick of oleo, melted
directions: Melt first five ingredients on top of stove or microwave. Put potatoes in 9x12 pan. Cover with cheese mixture, then crushed cornflakes and final stick of oleo. Bake 350° for 50 minutes.

title: Coconut Pistachio Pie
ingredients: 2-1/2 cups sweetened shredded coconut, lightly toasted 1/3 cup butter, melted 2 cups cold 2% milk 2 packages (3.4 ounces each) instant pistachio pudding mix 1 cup whipped topping 2 tablespoons chopped pistachios, optional
directions: In a small bowl, combine coconut and butter. Press onto the bottom and up the sides of a greased 9-in. pie plate. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or until firm. In a small bowl, whisk milk and pudding mixes for 2 minutes. Let stand for 2 minutes or until soft-set. Spread 1-1/2 cups over crust. Fold whipped topping into remaining pudding; spread over pie. Sprinkle with pistachios if desired. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.

title: Key Lime Squares
ingredients: 1 c. butter or margarine 1/2 c. confectioners sugar 2 c. plus 6 Tbsp. all-purpose flour 1/8 tsp. salt 4 eggs 2 c. granulated sugar 6 Tbsp. lime juice 1 Tbsp. grated lime or lemon rind confectioners sugar (for dusting)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Combine butter/margarine, confectioners sugar, 2 cups flour and salt. Mix with a pastry blender or two knives until mixture is well blended. Pat evenly into a 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pan and bake 20 minutes. Beat eggs lightly. Stir in granulated sugar, 6 tablespoons flour, lime juice and rind. Mix well and spread over baked crust. Bake 25 minutes longer. Remove from oven and sift confectioners sugar over the top. Let cool and cut into squares.

title: Smoked Salmon And Pepper Tapas
ingredients: 1 baguette or loaf of french bread, sliced in 2-3 inch pieces 2-3 T olive oil 1/2 lb. smoked salmon 6 oz. creme fraiche 10 oz. pickled peppers, cut into 2 inch pieces Raspberry balsalmic vinegar
directions: Brush the bread with olive oil and lightly grill or toast until just crisp. Let cool. On each piece of bread, place a small piece of salmon and a piece of pepper. Top with small amount of creme fraiche and drizzle with vinegar.

title: Yuba-Style Simmer with Frozen Firm Tofu
ingredients: 1 block firm tofu (silken is also fine, but the finished product may not be the same) to taste your choice of vegetables
directions: Freeze the tofu. Let it thaw naturally, lightly drain, and then cut. Simmer the tofu in your choice of mentsuyu. It's also delicious if you add shiitake mushrooms, leek, eggplant, konnyaku, or your choice of vegetables. If you buy tofu when it's cheap and freeze it, it really comes in handy when you're in a pinch. It's also money-saving.

title: Chocolate Pie
ingredients: 2 sq. chocolate or 4 Tbsp. cocoa 2 1/2 c. scalded milk 1 c. sugar 4 egg yolks, beaten 4 Tbsp. flour 1/2 tsp. salt 2 Tbsp. butter 2 tsp. vanilla 2 baked pie shells
directions: Scald milk and mix chocolate. Beat. Combine flour, sugar and salt. Add egg yolks. Pour chocolate over egg mixture. Return to double boiler and cook until thick, about 15 to 20 minutes. Add butter and vanilla. Cool and add to cooked pie shell. Makes 2 pies. Delicious.

title: Date Nut Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 c. sugar 8 oz. pitted dates, chopped 1 stick margarine 1 c. Rice Krispies 1 c. pecans vanilla (if desired) Angel Flake coconut
directions: Cream together sugar, dates and margarine and boil 3 minutes, stirring constantly. Add	Rice Krispies, pecans and vanilla, if desired. Stir	well and dip out by teaspoonfuls. Roll in Angel Flake coconut. Makes about 3 dozen rolls.

title: Cranberry Pie
ingredients: 2 c. whole cranberries 1/2 c. sugar 1/2 c. walnuts, chopped 1 c. Bisquick 1 c. sugar 1 tsp. almond extract 3/4 c. margarine, melted 2 eggs, beaten
directions: Grease a 10-inch pie plate. Put whole cranberries, sugar and walnuts in pie plate. Beat eggs; add Bisquick, sugar, melted oleo and almond extract. Spread over cranberries. Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Smoked Sausage White Bean Chili
ingredients: 1 (14 ounce) package Hillshire Farm(R) Smoked Sausage, cut into 1/2-inch cubes 1 cup chicken broth 2 (15.8 ounce) cans great Northern beans, drained, rinsed 1 (4.5 ounce) can chopped green chilies, drained 2 teaspoons chili powder 1 teaspoon ground cumin
directions: Brown sausage in 4-quart saucepan over medium-high heat for 5 minutes. Add broth; stir to incorporate any browned bits on the bottom of pan. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to boil; reduce heat, simmer uncovered for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Ranch-Marinated Pork Chops
ingredients: 2 thick cut pork chops 1 cup ranch dressing 3 tablespoons Worcestershire sauce 1 teaspoon dry mustard 2 garlic cloves, minced 1 teaspoon onion powder
directions: Wash and pat dry pork chops with paper towel; poke several holes in them with a fork. In a shallow baking pan, mix together rest of ingredients. Place pork in marinade, turning to coat completely. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour, turning at least once. Preheat oven to 275 degrees. Remove cover from pan, bake chops for about 30 minutes (or until done), turning at least once during cooking. Serve with baked potatoes, using cooked marinade and pan drippings to top.

title: Winter Vegetable Stew
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter 2 tablespoons olive oil 4 teaspoons thyme 1 tablespoon tarragon 1 teaspoon garlic powder 14 cup chickpea flour (besan) 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar 1 12 quarts vegetable stock 1 medium onion, diced 14 head cabbage, julienne 2 small potatoes, such as Yukon Gold, diced (with or without skin) 1 large parsnip, peeled and diced 1 12 cups peeled and diced winter squash, such as butternut
directions: Saute onion and cabbage in butter and olive oil until the onion becomes translucent. Add remaining ingredients and simmer 30 minutes or until parsnip is soft. Do not overcook--vegetables should retain their shape.

title: "Harvest Zucchini"
ingredients: 1 1/4 lb. zucchini (about 5 small) 1/3 c. finely chopped onion 1/4 c. butter or margarine 1/2 c. dairy sour cream 2 Tbsp. milk 1 tsp. salt 2 tsp. paprika 2 tsp. poppy seed
directions: Prepare 4 cups sliced zucchini as directed. In large skillet, cook and stir zucchini and onion in butter until butter is melted. Cover; cook, stirring occasionally, until zucchini is tender. Mix remaining ingredients; gently stir into zucchini and heat through.

title: Eggplant Parmesan
ingredients: 1 eggplant salt salad oil 1 egg 1/2 lb. mozzarella cheese 2 cups tomato sauce 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese
directions: Wash and peel eggplant. Cut into thin slices, salt and let drain for an hour. Dip into beaten egg and saute in hot salad oil. Fry until golden brown. Arrange in baking dish alternating lays of eggplant, mozzarella, tomato sauce and half of parmesan. Sprinkle remainder of parmesan (1/4 cup) over the top and any egg that is left. Bake in 350 degree oven for 30 minutes.

title: Apple Walnut Mint Salad
ingredients: 1/2 apple thinly sliced 1/2 cup walnuts roasted and chopped 2 tablespoons coriander finely chopped 1/4 cup mint leaves chopped 1/2 teaspoon pepper salt to taste 1 tablespoon white vinegar 1 tablespoon olive oil 1/8 cup green onions both whites and greens
directions: Combine salt, pepper, vinegar and olive oil. Whisk this mixture till creamy. Add the remaining ingredients and mix well Season it with salt and pepper Serve chilled Any other salad vegetable can be added- eg. cucumber, tomato, cabbage, carrots etc.)

title: Beef Summer Sausage
ingredients: 2 lbs ground beef 2 tsp. liquid smoke 1 c. water 1 tsp. whole mustard seed 1/8 tsp. pepper 1/4 tsp. garlic salt 3 Tbsp. Morton's Tender Quick 1/2 tsp. onion salt
directions: Combine the above ingredients and mix well. Form mixture into a large roll. Wrap in foil. Place in the refrigerator for 24 hours. Poke holes in the foil with a fork along the bottom and place in a baking dish with a little water. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350.

title: Company Potatoes
ingredients: 1 pkg. hash brown potatoes 1 can cream of chicken soup 1/2 c. sour cream 1 c. Cheddar cheese, shredded 1/4 c. chopped onion 1/2 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. pepper
directions: Mix all ingredients. Put into greased pan.

title: Kahlua Bars
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs 1/2 cup melted butter 2 cups milk chocolate chips 2 (8 ounce) packages cream cheese 2 eggs 1 tablespoon vanilla 1/2 cup Kahlua 1/4 cup sugar 1/4 cup packed brown sugar
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Grease a 8x8 inch baking pan. Combine graham cracker crumbs and butter. Press into bottom of pan and bake for 8-10 minutes until slightly crispy. Cream eggs, cream cheese, vanilla, sugar, brown sugar, and kahlua until well-combined and smooth. Pour evenly over crust. Sprinkle chocolate chips evenly over filling. Bake 20 minutes. Place in fridge for about an hour to allow to cool completely before serving.

title: Nine Layer Salad
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, cut into small pieces 1 bell pepper, chopped 2 sticks celery, chopped 1 bunch green onions, chopped 1 small can English peas 1/3 c. mayonnaise 1 tsp. sugar 16 oz. Cheddar cheese, shredded 1 lb. bacon, cooked and crumbled
directions: Layer the first 4 ingredients in a casserole dish. Drain peas and add. Spread the mayonnaise over the peas and sprinkle sugar over mayonnaise. Add cheese and top with bacon. Chill in refrigerator for several hours before serving.

title: Saltine Cracker Candy
ingredients: 2/3 c. canned milk 1 1/3 c. sugar 24 saltines, crushed 1/2 c. crunchy peanut butter 1/2 tsp. vanilla flavoring 1 c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
directions: Combine sugar and milk and slowly bring to boil. Stir constantly. Boil for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add other ingredients. Mix well and pour into an 8-inch square dish. Let cool. Then cut into squares.

title: Shrimp Rice-Paper Rolls with Vietnamese Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh lime juice 1/4 cup sugar 3 tablespoons fermented fish sauce (nam pla)* 1 tablespoon unseasoned rice vinegar 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro 2 garlic cloves 1 teaspoon minced jalapeno chili with seeds 1 1/2 tablespoons olive oil 6 ounces fresh shiitake mushrooms, stemmed, caps thinly sliced 4 ounces dried thin Chinese rice sticks (maifun)* 12 8- to- 9-inch round rice-paper sheets* 1 cup fresh mint leaves 1 cup fresh cilantro leaves 1 cup small fresh basil leaves 1 cup finely shredded iceberg lettuce or green cabbage 1 cup mung bean sprouts or daikon (Japanese white radish) sprouts 1 cup matchstick-size strips seeded English hothouse cucumber 1 cup matchstick-size strips peeled carrot or jicama 8 ounces cooked peeled deveined medium shrimp, cut lengthwise in half
directions: Whisk all ingredients in medium bowl until sugar dissolves. Let stand at least 30 minutes. (Can be made 1 day ahead. Cover; chill.) Heat oil in medium skillet over medium-high heat. Add mushrooms and saute until soft, about 5 minutes. Cool. Place rice sticks in large bowl; add enough hot water to cover. Let stand until softened, about 30 minutes. Drain. Cut into 6-inch lengths; set aside. Fill same bowl with warm water. Add 1 rice-paper sheet and turn until beginning to soften, about 30 seconds (sheet will still be stiff in a few spots). Remove from water; drain on kitchen towel. Repeat with 5 more rice-paper sheets, arranging in single layer. Divide half of mint, cilantro, and basil among softened rice-paper sheets, arranging in line across lower third of each sheet and leaving 1-inch border on each end. Top with half of rice sticks, shaping into compact log. Top with half of lettuce, sprouts, cucumber, carrot, shrimp, and mushrooms. Fold bottom of each rice sheet over filling, then fold in ends and roll into tight cylinder. Place rolls, seam side down, on platter. Repeat soaking with remaining rice-paper sheets, then top with remaining filling to form 6 more rolls. (Can be made 6 hours ahead. Cover with damp paper towel and plastic wrap; chill.) Cut each roll diagonally into thirds. Arrange on platter and serve with sauce. *Available at Asian markets.

title: Heavenly Honeydew Juice
ingredients: 1 (5 pound) honeydew melon, quartered and seeded 2 cups ice cubes 1 cup water 3 tablespoons white sugar
directions: Scrape flesh from honeydew melon quarters into a blender; add ice cubes, water, and sugar. Blend until smooth and sugar has dissolved. Serve immediately.

title: Gail'S Crab Dip
ingredients: 8 oz. cream cheese 1 tsp. Lea and Perrins 2 Tbsp. lemon juice garlic powder onion powder 1 bottle Heinz seafood cocktail sauce 1 can white crab meat, drained
directions: Soften cream cheese with electric mixer. Blend in Lea and Perrins, lemon juice (can use ReaLemon), garlic powder and onion powder to taste. Spread on pie plate or platter. Cover with bottle of cocktail sauce and top with crab meat. Serve with tortilla chips or crackers.

title: No Bake Cookies
ingredients: 1 stick margarine 2 c. sugar 4 Tbsp. cocoa 1/2 c. milk 2 1/2 c. oatmeal 1/4 c. peanut butter 1 tsp. vanilla
directions: Combine the first 4 ingredients in a large saucepan. Bring to a rolling boil. Boil for 2 or 3 minutes. Reduce heat and stir in the oatmeal, peanut butter and vanilla. Drop by teaspoons onto waxed paper.

title: Thai Cashew Salad
ingredients: 1 English cucumber, sliced thinly 1 carrot, cut into matchsticks 12 red bell pepper, cut into thin strips 12 yellow bell pepper, cut into thin strips 3 scallions, sliced thinly 1 cup cashews, roasted and salted 2 cups salad greens 1 bunch cilantro stems, removed 1 bunch basil, stems removed 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice 2 tablespoons soy sauce 1 teaspoon vinegar 2 garlic cloves, minced 14 teaspoon red pepper flakes 1 teaspoon sugar 14 teaspoon pepper
directions: Prepare the dressing: combine the lime juice, soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, red pepper flakes, sugar, and pepper. Wash the salad greens, the cilantro, and the basil and place in bowl. Toss greens with half of the dressing and arrange on serving platter. Combine remaining ingredients in bowl and toss with remaining dressing and arrange on top of greens. Serve immediately.

title: Bright Yellow Chicken!
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ground cumin 1 tablespoon paprika 1 tablespoon ground tumeric 2 teaspoons red chile powder or 1 tsp cayenne pepper to taste 1 1/2 teaspoons ground pepper fresh 3 teaspoons salt to taste 1 tablespoon garlic powder 1 lemon large, maybe two if you need to adjust the thickness of the paste 5 pounds chicken
directions: For more details on this great chicken recipe click http://bit.ly/1zK5fIO

title: Special Tea Cakes
ingredients: 2 c. self-rising flour 1 c. sugar 2/3 c. shortening 1 tsp. vanilla flavoring 1/2 c. milk 3 eggs
directions: Beat eggs, sugar, milk, vanilla and shortening. Work in flour like you would for biscuit dough. Knead and roll out on floured surface. Cut out and bake on cookie sheet for 15 to 20 minutes at 375°. Yields 2 dozen cakes.

title: Beer Basted London Broil Recipe
ingredients: 1 x round steak, cut 1 1/2 inches thick (about 2 1/2 pounds) 1 bot or possibly can of beer 1/2 c. vegetable oil 2 tsp salt 1 tsp leaf oregano, crumbled 2 clv garlic, crushed
directions: Trim excess fat from steak; score remaining fat at 1-inch intervals. Score surface of meat in diamond pattern, 1/8-inch deep with sharp knife. Place meat in large plastic bag or possibly shallow glass baking dish. Combine beer, oil, salt, oregano and garlic in a small saucepan; bring to boiling. Lower heat and simmer 10 min; cold marinade. Pour marinade over steak; seal in plastic bag or possibly cover dish with plastic wrap. Chill over night. Let steak stand at room temperature 1 hour before grilling. Remove steak from marinade; reserve marinade to baste steak. Build a medium fire or possibly set gas or possibly electric grill to medium-high. Grill steak, 3 inches from heat, 8 min for rare, 12 min for medium and 15 min for well done; brush with reserved marinade; turn steak with tongs; grill 7 min for rare, 12 min for medium and 15 min for well done or possibly till steak is done to your liking. Place on wooden carving board and allow to rest 10 min; cut into thick slices. Serves 4

title: Rhubarb Dessert
ingredients: 2 c. diced rhubarb 1 c. sugar 1 egg 1/2 c. nuts 1 c. flour 1 tsp. salt 1 tsp. soda 1/2 c. brown sugar
directions: Mix together rhubarb and sugar; let stand for 1/2 hour. Add egg, flour, salt and soda. Mix thoroughly. Pour into ungreased 9-inch square pan. Sprinkle brown sugar and nuts on top. Bake at 300° or 325° for 1 hour. Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Creamy Chicken with Pasta
ingredients: 400g small pasta (e.g. shells, elbows, macaroni), uncooked 1 red capsicum, sliced into thin strips Target 1 pkg For $2.99 thru 02/06 4 slices ham, chopped 1 small BBQ chicken, flesh removed and chopped Safeway 1 lb For $1.99 thru 02/09 1 cup KRAFT* Cheddar Cheese, grated 2 spring onions, finely chopped 1/3 cup KRAFT* Thousand Island Dressing 1/3 cup sour cream
directions: Cook pasta according to packet directions. Drain. Combine hot pasta, capsicum, ham, chicken, cheese and spring onions and mix until well combined. Stir in combined dressing and sour cream and serve.

title: Mom'S Chocolate Pie
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. sugar 5 Tbsp. flour 2 Tbsp. baking cocoa 1 Tbsp. soft oleo 1 egg yolk 2 c. milk 1 tsp. vanilla dash of salt
directions: Mix all together in cooking pan; cook over medium heat until thick. Pour into baked pie shell. Top with meringue or Cool Whip. If meringue, brown in oven.

title: Soft-Poached Egg Yakitori Bowl
ingredients: 1 thigh Chicken thigh meat 1 tbsp Sugar (or artificial sugar) 2 tbsp Garlic soy sauce 1 tsp Vinegar (optional) 1 tbsp Sake 1/2 Tomato 5 Green beans 2 Soft poached eggs) 1 bit Shredded nori seaweed 1 Mayonnaise
directions: Make a soft-poached egg.. Parboil the green beans in salted water and cut into small pieces. (I use frozen beans). Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces, heat the vegetable oil in a frying pan, and stir-fry. Once the chicken is crispy, add the seasonings. When the sauce reduces, it's done. Fill the rice bowls with rice, then top with the chicken, green beans, chopped tomatoes, and top with the remaining sauce from the frying pan. Top with the egg from Step 1, scatter on the shredded nori, and drizzle with mayonnaise to finish. The poached egg is really creamy. I recommend eating your rice bowl with it thoroughly mixed in.

title: Spinach & Ground Beef Lasagna
ingredients: 6 lasagna noodles, cooked (or oven-ready) 1 lb ground beef 1 (19 ounce) pasta sauce 1 teaspoon oregano 1 (10 ounce) package frozen chopped spinach, thawed, drained 1 (15 ounce) carton part-skim ricotta cheese 1/4 cup fresh parmesan cheese, grated 2 cups part-skim mozzarella cheese, grated
directions: Brown ground beef in pan over medium-high heat. Add tomato sauce (reserving a tablespoon) and oregano. Simmer until heated through. Remove from heat. In a bowl, mix spinach, ricotta cheese and 1/8 cup Parmesan cheese together. Set aside. Fresh lasagna noodles are preferred, but you can use oven-ready noodles too. In a 9x13 pan, spray lightly with vegetable oil. Add the remaining tomato sauce (mixed with a little water) to the 9x13 pan. Start the first layer of lasagna noodles, topped by a sprinkling of mozzarella cheese. Follow with the meat mixture, then lasagna noodles. Another sprinkling of mozzarella cheese, topped by the spinach mixture and lasagna noodles. Finish the top layer with the remaining cheeses. Bake covered at 375 F for 45 minutes, then uncover and broil until golden on top (about 10 to 15 minutes). Let stand for 5 minutes before cutting and serving. Enjoy!

title: Crab Meltaways
ingredients: 1 can crabmeat 1 jar Old English cheese spread 1 c. mayonnaise 1 tsp. garlic 1 tsp. Worcestershire sauce 3/4 to 1 stick margarine, softened 5 English muffins, split
directions: Mix together first 6 ingredients and spread on muffin halves. Bake at 350° to 400° until golden brown. Better if baked on wire cookie rack placed in a lipped pan to catch excess margarine. May be frozen up to 3 months before baking.

title: Curry Turkey Veggie Medley
ingredients: 1 pound Extra-Lean Ground Turkey 1 whole Small Onion, Diced 1 whole Small Yellow Squash, Diced 1 whole Small Zucchini, Diced 1 cup Garbanzo Beans, Drained And Rinsed, Coarsely Chopped 1- 1/2 teaspoon Garlic Powder 1 teaspoon Coarsely Ground Garlic Salt 2 teaspoons Curry Powder 1 can (10 Oz. Size) Ro'tel Original, Drained (any Brand Of Diced Tomatoes And Green Chilies Is Fine)
directions: Begin browning ground turkey in a greased, medium pan over medium to medium low heat. While turkey is still slightly pink, add all remaining ingredients except canned tomatoes. Cover and allow vegetables to soften, stirring occasionally. Add drained can of Rotel and simmer until ready to eat. If there is too much liquid, simmer uncovered for 5 minutes or until liquid reduces. Serve with tortilla chips or in taco shells.

title: Caesar's Palace Cheesecake
ingredients: 5 (8 ounce) packages cream cheese, softened 1 cup sugar 5 eggs 1 cup whipping cream 2 teaspoons vanilla 1 teaspoon grated lemon peel 2 tablespoons grated orange peel 2 tablespoons lemon juice 3 tablespoons orange juice
directions: Cream together cream cheese and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition. Blend in whipping cream, vanilla, peels and juices until smooth. Turn into greased 9" springform pan and set in a larger pan filled with water 1" water and bake at 350 for 40 minutes. Reduce heat to 325 and bake 20 minutes longer or until cake is set. Cool in springform pan then remove sides of pan. Chill, or serve at room temperature.

title: Rice and Fassoula
ingredients: 2 lbs dried great northern beans 2 lbs stew meat 1 onion 3 (6 ounce) cans tomato paste water
directions: Soak beans over night. their size will double so soak beans in large enough bowel. in large pot fill it to hafy way with water, bring to boil. add stew meat and skim surface of water to get rid of melted fat from meat. when water is mostly clear add whole onion and beans, not including water they soaked inches. open 3 small cans of tomato paste and remove contents to small bowl. mix paste with water until smooth. stir pot lower heat to medium-low. cook for 2-3 hours until mixture thickens.

title: Potato Soup
ingredients: 3 Tbsp. butter 3 c. sliced onions 3 Tbsp. flour 2 qt. hot water 1 Tbsp. salt and pepper 4 c. diced potatoes 1/2 sour cream or 3 Tbsp. butter 2 to 3 Tbsp. minced parsley
directions: Saute onions, blend in flour.	Remove from heat. Beat in 1 cup of flour and add rest.	Add remaining ingredients and simmer covered for 40 minutes.

title: Fast, Easy, Elegant Chestnut Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs chestnut meats (canned or frozen) 1 onion, chopped 2 leeks, sliced 6 -8 cloves garlic 2 cups cream or 2 cups creme fraiche 8 cups vegetable stock salt, to taste pepper, to taste
directions: This is really easy. Put everything except the cream, salt and pepper in a soup pot. Bring to boil, turn dow, and cook gently for 30 minutes. Mush up the chestnuts a bit with a fork. Decide if you want the soup a bit chunky, or really smooth. I prefer the smooth version. For both, use immersion blender to the point where you like the look of the soup for a chunky version. For the really smooth version, blend in blender after using the immersion blender until it reaches the consistency you like. Taste, check for seasoning, add salt and pepper, stir in cream. If it is too thick, add a bit of stock or water. I liked it best a bit thick.

title: Mary Lou'S Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 4 c. diced chicken 4 c. chicken broth 1 1/2 c. diced Velveeta cheese 1 1/2 c. diced celery 1 large onion, diced 2 eggs 1 can cream of mushroom soup 4 c. cracker crumbs (Ritz or soda) 1 1/2 tsp. pepper 2 tsp. salt
directions: Mix all together and put into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Lime Salsa Chicken Skewers With Cilantro Creme Sauce
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into chunks 2 large limes, juice of (apx. 1/2 cup) 4 tablespoons very dry sherry 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil 1 teaspoon oregano 12 teaspoon garlic powder 12 teaspoon salt 1 (14 1/2 ounce) can diced tomatoes, drained 2 scallions, sliced (green onion) 12 cup sliced ripe olives 6 tablespoons marinade, reserved above 2 tablespoons jalapenos (seeded, deveined, and chopped) 2 tablespoons cilantro, fresh, chopped 2 tablespoons mint, fresh, chopped 2 tablespoons almonds, slivered, toasted 12 teaspoon black pepper 8 ounces cream cheese, softened 1 tablespoon sour cream 12-23 cup green tomatillo salsa (Pace & Victoria are good) 1 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper 1 teaspoon celery salt 12 teaspoon ground cumin 2 teaspoons garlic powder 1 bunch cilantro leaf, fresh chopped 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice 2 red bell peppers, seeded lg. chunk 2 onions, peeled, quartered
directions: Chicken & Marinade: In a large Zip-Lock bag, make the marinade by mixing together the lime juice, sherry, oil, oregano, and garlic salt. Remove three Tablespoons of marinade; set aside. Add chicken to the remaining marinade, turning to coat. Marinate chicken in refrigerator for at least 1 hour. Soak wooden skewers in hot water at least 30 minutes. Salsa: In a bowl, mix all ingredients well, and chill for an hour or more before serving. Cilantro Creme Sauce:. Combine all ingredients in a blender or food processor. Blend until smooth and creamy. Place in a serving bowl, chill a few hours or overnight. Skewers: Toss bell peppers and onion quarters in with marinating chicken for last 30 minutes. Starting and ending with red bell pepper, make 7-8 skewers. Place the skewers chicken on grill with rack about 8 inches from heat source. Brush the heated marinade over chicken. Grill, turning and basting frequently with marinade, about 16 - 20 minutes, or until chicken is fork-tender. Arrange skewers on the platter, with cilantro cream sauce underneath, and salsa on top.

title: Tart Chicken Salad With Sour-Cream Dressing
ingredients: 2 whole chicken breasts, about 3/4 lb. each 1 large onion, peeled and quartered 2 tsp. salt 1/2 c. coarsely chopped, drained, sour dill pickles 4 boiled new potatoes, cooled, peeled and thinly sliced 3 hard-cooked eggs, peeled and thinly sliced 1/8 tsp. white pepper 3/4 c. mayonnaise, freshly made or a good unsweetened commercial variety 3/4 c. sour cream 2 Tbsp. capers, drained, washed and patted dry with paper towels 1 Tbsp. finely cut fresh dill leaves 6 green olives 1 medium tomato, peeled and cut up lengthwise into eighths 1 small head Boston lettuce, the leaves separated, washed and dried with paper towels
directions: In a heavy 2 to 3-quart pot, combine the chicken, onion and 1 teaspoon of the salt. Cover with about 1 1/2 quarts of cold water and bring to a boil uncovered over high heat, skimming off the fat and scum as it rises to the surface. Partially cover the pan, reduce the heat to low and simmer about 10 minutes, or until the chicken is tender. Remove the chicken from the pot and with a small, sharp knife, remove and discard the skin and cut the meat away from the bones. Cut the chicken meat into strips about 1/2-inch wide and combine them in a large mixing bowl with the pickles, potatoes and eggs. Sprinkle with the remaining teaspoon of salt and 1/8 teaspoon of white pepper. In a small bowl, beat together the mayonnaise and sour cream and stir half of it into the salad. Taste for seasoning.

title: New Orleans Pralines
ingredients: 1 c. brown sugar 1 c. white sugar 1/2 c. Carnation milk 3 Tbsp. butter 1 c. pecans 1 tsp. vanilla
directions: Cook first 4 ingredients in a heavy saucepan until soft ball stage, stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Stir in pecans and vanilla, continuing to stir until mixture begins to thicken. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper. Let set until hardens.

title: Roasted Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 1 (1-pound) pork tenderloin 1 tablespoon olive oil
directions: Sprinkle salt and freshly ground black pepper over pork tenderloin. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add olive oil to pan; swirl to coat. Add pork to pan; cook 3 minutes, browning on all sides. Bake pork at 400° for 22 minutes or until a thermometer registers 155° (slightly pink). Let stand 10 minutes before cutting across grain into thin slices. Serve with desired salsa or chutney.

title: Turkey with Apricots and Chiles
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups rice uncooked long-grain 2 teaspoons margarine nondiet tub-style canola margarine 1 cup onions chopped 2 each garlic cloves minced 1 1/4 cups chicken broth defatted, divided 1 teaspoon cumin ground 1/4 teaspoon coriander ground 1/4 teaspoon allspice ground 10 each apricots dried, quartered 1 tablespoon green chili peppers, canned 1 cup tomatoes fresh 1 pound turkey breast cut into bite-sized pieces 1 x apricots into strips for garnish, if desired
directions: Cook rice according to package directions. Combine margarine, onion, garlic, and 2 tablespoons broth in Dutch oven or similar large pot. Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until onion is soft, 5 or 6 minutes. If liquid begins to evaporate, add a bit more broth. Stir in cumin, coriander and allspice. Add remaining broth, apricots, chiles and tomato. Stir to mix well. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 10 minutes, or until flavors are well-blended. Stir in turkey and cook an additional 5 minutes. Serve over rice, garnished with apricot strips, if desired.

title: Raw Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, grated 1 c. green peppers, chopped 1 c. grated carrots 1 c. chopped celery 1 Tbsp. celery seed 1/4 c. salad oil 1/4 c. sugar 1/4 c. vinegar salt and pepper to taste
directions: Toss well and serve.

title: Turkey Hash With Brussels Sprouts and Parsnips
ingredients: 12 ounces parsnips, chopped, about 2 cups Butter, oil or lard 4 ounces thick-sliced bacon, cut into 1/4-inch lardons 1 large onion, diced, about 2 cups Salt and pepper 1 pound cooked turkey, preferable dark meat, diced 2 tablespoons chopped sage 1 cup turkey or chicken broth 1 1/2 cups slivered brussels sprouts 6 scallions, chopped 1 jalapeno, finely chopped 4 to 6 eggs, for frying Cilantro sprigs for garnish (optional)
directions: Simmer parsnips in salted water for about 2 minutes, until cooked through but firm. Drain and set aside. Heat oven to 400 degrees. Put 4 tablespoons butter in a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat. Add bacon and fry lightly for 1 minute, then add onions and reduce heat to medium. Cook, stirring occasionally, until onions are soft and beginning to color, about 10 minutes. Season well with salt and pepper. Add parsnips, turkey and sage. Stir to coat well. Let sizzle, adding more butter as needed, until mixture is well browned, about 10 minutes. Check seasoning. Add broth and transfer skillet to oven. Bake, uncovered, until broth is absorbed and hash is crisp, 10 to 15 minutes. Meanwhile, cook brussels sprouts: Heat a small amount of butter or oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add slivered sprouts, salt and pepper; stir-fry briefly, until sprouts are just cooked, about 2 minutes. Stir in scallions and jalapeno. Spoon sprouts over hash mixture and set aside to keep warm. For each portion, cook 1 large egg sunny-side up. Top hash with fried eggs and garnish with cilantro sprigs.

title: Sugarless Cookies(Diabetic)
ingredients: 3/4 c. water 1/4 c. margarine 1 c. chopped dates 1/4 tsp. cinnamon 1/2 tsp. baking soda 1 egg 1 c. flour 1/2 tsp. baking powder 1/4 tsp. salt 1 tsp. vanilla 1 Tbsp. liquid sweetener
directions: Boil together for 3 minutes the water, margarine, dates and cinnamon. Let cool and add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Drop onto greased cookie sheets. Bake 10 minutes at 350°. Nuts may be added. One cookie equals 1 bread and 1/2 fat exchange on diabetic diet.

title: Connie'S Caramel Frosting
ingredients: 1/2 c. butter 1 c. brown sugar 1/4 c. milk powdered sugar (as needed to reach desired consistency)
directions: Melt butter. Add brown sugar. Boil over low heat for 2 minutes. Stir constantly. Add milk. Stir until it reaches boiling point again. Remove from heat. Cool to lukewarm. Beat in powdered sugar. Spread over cooled Connie's Crazy Chocolate Cake.

title: Sweet Potatoes With Marshmallows
ingredients: 2 large cans sweet potatoes 1 c. milk 1 tsp. vanilla 3 Tbsp. sugar 1/2 stick butter 1/4 tsp. cinnamon few dashes nutmeg 1 Tbsp. orange juice marshmallows
directions: Drain sweet potatoes; put through ricer until mashed. Scald milk. Add vanilla, sugar and butter. To potatoes add cinnamon, nutmeg and orange juice; stir. Add milk mixture to potatoes; stir. Use half of the sweet potato mixture to make a layer on the bottom of your dish, then a layer of marshmallows. Top with remaining sweet potatoes. Bake at 350° until very hot. Add a top layer of marshmallows and brown. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Triple-Ginger Pound Cake
ingredients: 3 12 cups all-purpose flour 1 tablespoon ground ginger 2 12 teaspoons baking powder 1 teaspoon salt 2 cups sugar 1 cup unsalted butter, at room temp 2 large eggs 2 large egg yolks 1 tablespoon vanilla extract 1 14 cups milk (don't use low-fat or nonfat) 12 cup minced crystallized ginger 3 12 tablespoons grated peeled fresh ginger
directions: Preheat oven to 350. Grease two 9x5x3-inch loaf pans. Stir flour, ground ginger, baking powder and salt into medium bowl. Beat sugar and butter in large bowl until fluffy. Add eggs and yolks 1 at a time, beating well after each addition. Beat in vanilla. Mix dry ingredients and milk alternately into batter. Fold in crystallized ginger and grated ginger. Divide batter between prepared loaf pans. Bake cakes for about 1 hour.

title: 7-Up Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. pineapple supreme cake mix 1 small pkg. vanilla instant pie mix 3/4 c. Wesson oil 4 eggs 1 (10 oz.) bottle 7-Up
directions: Put dry cake and pie mix in a large mixing bowl. Add oil. Add eggs one at a time. Add 7-Up; mix well. Pour into a greased cake pan and bake according to cake mix directions. Makes 3 layers.

title: Passover Chocolate Sponge Cake
ingredients: 12 large eggs separated 1 1/2 cups sugar 2 tablespoons water cold 1 each oranges rind grated, juiced 1/2 pound chocolate (sweet) grated 3/4 cup matzo meal
directions: Preheat oven to 350F (180C). Beat egg yolks and sugar until light and fluffy (about 7 minutes). Add cold water, orange juice, orange rind, chocolate and cake flour. Gently fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour into a 10 inch tube pan with removable insert. Bake for 55 to 65 minutes or until cake springs back when gently pressed. Cool completely, inverted on cake rack, before removing from pan.

title: Indonesian Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1/2 each pork tenderloin 1 each lemon green, juiced 2 tablespoons soy sauce, tamari 2 tablespoons brown sugar 2 each garlic cloves crushed 1 tablespoon cumin 1 tablespoon curry powder 1 teaspoon sambal ulek (ground chili peppers and salt) 1 tablespoon sesame oil 2 tablespoons peanut oil
directions: Marinate pork tenderloin in other ingredients for 2 hours in covered container in the fridge. Brown on all sides in hot pan for no more than 10 minutes. Serve with fried bananas and Serundeg.

title: Ice Cream Salad
ingredients: 1 large pkg. lemon-lime gelatin 1 pt. vanilla ice cream 1 medium can crushed pineapple with juice 1 c. boiling water 1 medium can fruit salad, drained
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Cool. Add ice cream and pineapple with juice. Chill until partly thickened (ice cream may cool it enough). Add drained fruit cocktail. Chill.

title: Bran-Apple Muffins(Low-Fat)
ingredients: 1/2 c. buttermilk 1/2 c. prune or apple juice 1/2 c. bran cereal shreds 1/2 c. rolled oats 1 tsp. baking soda 2/3 c. pitted prunes 3 Tbsp. water 1/2 c. packed brown sugar 2 large egg whites 1 Tbsp. molasses 1 c. flour 1 c. peeled and grated apple, spooned, not packed, into cup 1/4 tsp. salt rolled oats
directions: Preheat oven to 375°. Coat twelve 2 3/4-inch muffin tin cups with vegetable cooking spray; set aside. In a small bowl, combine buttermilk, prune juice, bran, rolled oats and baking soda; set aside. In the container of food processor, combine the prunes and water. Pulse on and off until prunes are finely chopped. Combine prune puree and sugar in a mixer bowl; beat in egg whites and molasses. Stir in buttermilk mixture, flour, apple and salt; blend thoroughly. Spoon batter into prepared muffin tin cups, dividing equally. Sprinkle tops lightly with additional rolled oats. Bake for 20 minutes. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Smoky Sauce For Ribs
ingredients: 1 cup no-salt-added ketchup 1 cup red wine vinegar 1/2 cup brown sugar 1/4 cup molasses 1 1/2 teaspoons liquid smoke 1/2 teaspoon salt substitute 1/2 teaspoon black pepper 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder 1/2 teaspoon onion powder
directions: Whisk all of the ingredients together until smooth. Boil the sauce very briefly and then simmer for half to three quarters of an hour until it has thickened. Use on pork spareribs or in any of your barbecued meat recipes. Store refrigerated - will last for a few weeks.

title: Pork and Lotus Root Shigure Stew
ingredients: 250 grams Chopped pork or thinly sliced pork (belly meat, roast etc.) 1 Lotus root 1 Konnyaku 2 to 3 tablespoons Soy sauce 2 tbsp Mirin 3 tbsp Sake 1 tbsp Sugar
directions: Cut the pork into 3~5cm pieces. Thinly slice the konnyaku, and then thinly slice it again from the edges. Peel the skin from the lotus root, thinly slice, and briefly soak in water. Cut the lotus root into 1/2 or 1/4 if it's too thick. Add water and the lotus root to a small pot, and turn on the heat. After bringing it to a boil, add the konnyaku, and boil together. Heat vegetable oil in a frying pan or pot, and saute the pork. Add the lotus root and konnyaku after the meat has cooked through, and saute. Add soy sauce, mirin, sake, and sugar, and simmer. It's convenient to use noodle konnyaku instead cutting normal konnyaku. I learnt this tip from user "Miwaboshi". Check out the sister recipe "Pork Meat and Burdock Root Shigure Stew".

title: Broccoli-Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen, chopped broccoli 1/2 c. chopped onion 1/2 c. butter or margarine 1 1/3 c. cooked rice 1 (6 oz.) jar pasteurized process cheese 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup (undiluted)
directions: Combine broccoli with onion and cook as directed on broccoli package; drain. Combine vegetables with remaining ingredients. Pour into greased, shallow 2-quart casserole. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Lemon Pie
ingredients: 4 Tbsp. cornstarch 1 1/2 c. sugar 2 c. boiling water 2 Tbsp. butter 4 beaten egg yolks 1/4 tsp. salt 1/2 c. lemon juice grated rind of 1 lemon
directions: Mix together cornstarch, sugar and boiling water and stir well. Place over medium heat and boil until it thickens. Add butter, egg yolks, salt, lemon juice and grated rind of lemon. Cook three minutes, then pour into a baked shell. Cover with meringue and brown.

title: Sausage Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. sausage 2 medium onions, sliced 2 c. tomato juice 4 medium potatoes, sliced 1 can corn salt and pepper to taste
directions: Fry out fat from sausage; do not add back in. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.

title: Gingersnap Strips(No Rolling Out Or Cutting)
ingredients: 3/4 c. shortening 1 c. white sugar 1 egg 1/4 c. molasses 2 c. flour 2 tsp. soda 1/2 tsp. salt 1/2 tsp. cinnamon 1/4 tsp. ginger 1/4 tsp. cloves
directions: Bake at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes. Yields 6 dozen.

title: Marinated Lima Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 (14 ounce) package frozen lima beans 1/4 cup green bell peppers or 1/4 cup red bell pepper, diced 3 tablespoons red onions or 3 tablespoons yellow sweet onions, diced Dressing 3 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar or 3 tablespoons apple cider vinegar 2 tablespoons sugar 2 tablespoons vegetable oil 2 teaspoons fresh horseradish, grated or 2 teaspoons prepared horseradish salt and black pepper, to taste
directions: Place the frozen lima beans in a pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil. Boil 3 minutes then reduce heat, cover and simmer 20 minutes. Drain. In a medium-sized non-reactive bowl combine the lima beans with the red peppers and onions. In a separate small measuring cup, whisk together the dressing ingredients. Pour dressing over lima beans and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours to allow the salad to marinate.

title: Deviled Eggs
ingredients: 4 hard-boiled eggs, peeled and halved lengthwise 1 tablespoon finely chopped chutney 2 teaspoons reduced-calorie mayonnaise 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard 14 teaspoon cayenne pepper 18 teaspoon salt
directions: Remove the yolks from the egg halves; set the whites aside. In a medium bowl, mash the egg yolks with a fork; mix in the chutney, mayonnaise, mustard, cayenne. and salt. Spoon (or use pastry bag) the yolk mixture into the egg white halves. Sprinkle with paprika, if desired.

title: Coleslaw
ingredients: 1/3 cup mayonnaise 2 tablespoons minced green onions 1 tablespoon sugar 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice 1/4 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground pepper 1 (10-oz.) package shredded coleslaw mix
directions: Whisk together mayonnaise, green onions, sugar, lemon juice, salt, and pepper in a large bowl. Add coleslaw mix, and toss to coat.

title: Rhubarb Sticky Buns
ingredients: 1/4 cup cold butter (no subs) 1/2 cup packed brown sugar 1 cup chopped rhubarb (fresh or frozen, and thawed) BATTER 1/3 cup softened butter or 1/3 cup margarine 1/2 cup sugar 1 large egg 1 1/2 cups flour 2 teaspoons baking powder 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground nutmeg 1/2 cup cream
directions: In a bowl, cut butter into brown sugar till crumbly. Stir in rhubarb. Spoon mixture evenly into 12 WELL GREASED muffin cups (I have tried using cupcake papers, and it doesn't work!). Set aside. In a mixer bowl, cream butter or margarine, and sugar. Beat in egg. Combine dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture alternately with cream. Spoon batter over rhubarb filling cups about 3/4 full. Bake 350° for 15-20 minutes. Cool 5 minutes and invert onto serving tray. Serve warm.

title: Favorite Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli, separated into florets 1 head cauliflower, separated into florets 8 bacon strips, fried and crumbled 1/3 c. chopped onion 1 c. chopped tomatoes 2 hard-cooked eggs, sliced 1 c. mayonnaise or salad dressing 1/3 c. sugar 2 Tbsp. vinegar
directions: In a large salad bowl, combine broccoli, cauliflower, bacon, onion, tomatoes and eggs. Set aside.

title: Carrots And Pineapple
ingredients: 1/2 c. pineapple juice 1/2 c. carrot stock 1 Tbsp. cornstarch 1/2 tsp. salt 1/8 tsp. pepper 1 Tbsp. butter 2 c. sliced cooked carrots 1/2 c. drained pineapple chunks
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients in saucepan; bring to a boil. Cook until thickened, stirring constantly. Add remaining ingredients; heat through.

title: Divinity Fudge
ingredients: 2 lb. granulated sugar 1 c. light Karo syrup 1 Tbsp. vinegar 1 c. water pinch of salt 4 egg whites 1/2 lb. nuts 1 Tbsp. vanilla
directions: Cook syrup, sugar, water, vinegar and salt (approximately 275°). Cook until the mixture threads. Slowly beat in well beaten egg whites. Add nuts and vanilla. Cook until thick enough to spoon. Drop on wax paper. Mixture hardens fast!

title: Custard
ingredients: 1 cup milk powder 1/2 cup custard powder 1/4 cup sugar 1/4 cup cocoa 1 vanilla essence
directions: mix all ingredients in microwave safe jug add enough cold water to mix into a paste once mixed, add 1litre of boiling water microwave on high for 1minute. mixture should be thick. if not microwave for a further 30 sec to 1 minute

title: Mildred'S Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 1 c. tomato juice 1/4 c. tomato paste 1/4 c. lemon juice 1 Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce 3 drops hot pepper sauce 1 tsp. horseradish 2 garlic cloves 1 tsp. sugar 1/2 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. black pepper 2 scallions 1 fresh plum tomato 2 1/2 lb. chicken parts
directions: Preheat broiler, line it with foil. In a medium sauce pan, combine tomato juice, tomato paste, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, pepper sauce, horseradish, garlic, sugar, salt and pepper. Bring to boil over medium heat. Reduce heat, uncover and simmer for 10 minutes. Coarsely chop scallions and tomato. Place chicken on broiler, spoon half of sauce over chicken and grill 4 inches from heat until chicken turns brown. Stir in scallions and tomato in the remaining sauce. Turn chicken over and spoon remaining sauce on chicken. Cook 4 inches from heat until brown, about 12 minutes.

title: Pork with Strawberry-Herb Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon extra-virgin olive oil Two 3/4-pound pork tenderloins, each cut crosswise into 4 pieces and pounded 1 inch thick Salt and freshly ground pepper 2 tablespoons unsalted butter 1 shallot, minced 3/4 cup chicken stock or low-sodium broth 2 tablespoons strawberry jam or preserves Scant 1 teaspoon chopped thyme 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard
directions: In a large skillet, heat the oil. Season the pork with salt and pepper; cook over high heat, turning once, until browned and just cooked through; transfer to a plate and cover loosely with foil. Melt 1 tablespoon of the butter in the skillet. Add the shallot and cook over moderate heat, stirring, until softened. Add the stock, jam and thyme; cook over high heat, stirring until thickened. Whisk in the mustard. Reduce the heat to low and whisk in the remaining butter. Season with salt and pepper. Return the pork and any juices to the skillet; turn to coat then serve.

title: Chocolate-Lemon Creams
ingredients: 2 (8-ounce) packages cream cheese, softened 2 tablespoons grated lemon rind 3 tablespoons fresh lemon juice 1 teaspoon lemon extract 1 cup sifted powdered sugar 12 (2-ounce) chocolate candy coating squares 2 (2-ounce) vanilla candy coating squares (optional)
directions: Beat first 5 ingredients at medium speed with an electric mixer until smooth; cover. Freeze 2 hours. Shape cream cheese mixture into 1-inch balls, and place on a wax paper-lined baking sheet; cover and freeze 1 hour. Let stand at room temperature 10 minutes. Microwave chocolate candy coating in a 1-quart microwave-safe bowl at HIGH 1 1/2 minutes or until melted, stirring twice. Dip balls into coating; place on wax paper. Let stand until firm. Place vanilla coating in a zip-top plastic bag. Seal and submerge coating in warm water until melted. Snip a hole in 1 corner of bag, and drizzle coating over chocolates, if desired. Note: A food processor may be used for the first step.

title: 8 Minute (French Style) Rissoto
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil 1 tablespoon butter 1/2 white onion, you can use any onions you like (chopped small) 1 garlic clove (chopped) 1 cup arborio rice 1 teaspoon fresh thyme (chopped) 2 tablespoons white wine 2 cups chicken stock
directions: Saute onions in butter and olive oil until soft, add garlic and rice. Stir to coat rice and cook until milky in color, about 2 minutes. Add thyme and stir inches Add white wine and stir. Add chicken stock and stir. Bring to a boil. Turn down and simmer, covered, for 8 minutes. Take off heat and set aside, without removing the lid, for 5 minutes. Serve hot. You can add sauteed mushrooms on top of this rice for another twist and it's delicious.

title: Snickerdoodles
ingredients: 1/2 c. shortening 3/4 c. sugar 1 egg, slightly beaten 1 1/3 c. sifted flour 1/2 tsp. cream of tartar 1/2 tsp. soda 1/2 tsp. salt
directions: Cream together shortening and sugar. Add eggs and continue to beat until light and fluffy. Add dry ingredients; mix well. Roll into balls the size of walnuts. Roll balls in a mixture of 1 tablespoon sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon. Place 2 inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes or until slightly browned.

title: Sourdough English Muffins
ingredients: 2-3/4 to 3 cups all-purpose flour 1 cup water 1/2 cup 1/3 cup instant nonfat dry milk powder 1 tablespoon sugar 3/4 teaspoon salt 1/4 cup cornmeal, divided Butter, jam or honey
directions: In a large bowl, combine 2 cups flour, water and Sourdough Starter. Cover and let stand overnight. Combine the milk powder, sugar, salt and 1/2 cup flour. Add to sour dough mixture; mix well. Turn onto a floured surface; knead until smooth and no longer sticky, about 2-3 minutes, adding more flour if needed. Roll to 1/2-in. thickness. Cut with a 3-in. round cookie cutter. Greased and sprinkle with 2 tablespoons cornmeal. Place muffins 2 in. apart on prepared . Sprinkle remaining cornmeal over muffin tops. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 45 minutes. In a lightly greased griddle or electric skillet, cook muffins at 275° for 10 minutes. Turn and cook 10-15 minutes longer or until golden brown. Split with a sharp knife or a fork and toast if desired. Serve with butter, jam or honey.

title: Fresh Vegetable Saute
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. olive oil 1-1/2 cups each: broccoli and cauliflower florets 1 cup diagonally sliced carrots Target 2 lb For $3.00 thru 02/06 3/4 cup each: snow peas and sliced yellow squash 1/2 cup each: sliced mushrooms, red pepper strips and onion wedges 1/4 cup red wine vinegar 1 env. GOOD SEASONS Italian Dressing Mix
directions: Heat oil in large skillet on medium-high heat. Add vegetables; cook and stir until crisp-tender. Stir in vinegar and dressing mix; cook until heated through, stirring occasionally.

title: Fancy Free Recipe
ingredients: 2 ounces bourbon 1/2 ounce maraschino liqueur, such as Luxardo 2 dashes orange bitters 1 dash Angostura bitters Garnish: large orange twist
directions: Place a large ice cube in an old fashioned glass. Add bourbon, maraschino, orange bitters, and Angostura and stir until chilled, about 15 seconds. Garnish with orange twist and serve.

title: Chicken Curry
ingredients: 2 cans cream of celery soup 2/3 can milk 1 tsp. chopped parsley 1/2 tsp. cumin 1/4 tsp. coriander curry powder to taste (2 Tbsp. or so)
directions: Season chicken breast with garlic salt and salt and pepper. Bake with onion and little water. Cut up and put in sauce and leave overnight. Heat slow. Serve over rice.

title: Strawberry Banana Freeze
ingredients: 1 c. orange juice 2 tsp. honey 1/2 medium size, ripe banana, sliced 1/2 c. strawberries crushed ice
directions: Combine orange juice, honey, banana and strawberries in electric blender. Cover and swirl at high speed until smooth. Gradually add ice cubes, crushed, until	desired thickness. Serve immediately.

title: Tangy Chicken
ingredients: 1 fryer, cut up 2 Tbsp. oleo 1/2 c. Heinz 57 1/2 c. water
directions: Brown chicken in oleo. Combine Heinz 57 and water. Pour over chicken. Cover and cook 30 to 40 minutes. Remove cover the last 10 minutes. Spoon sauce over chicken.

title: Honey And Yogurt Mousse With Honeyed Grapes
ingredients: 2 cups Greek yogurt 1/2 cup honey 3/4 cup heavy cream 1 None vanilla bean, halved lengthwise 1 tsp unflavored gelatin 2 None egg whites 2 tbsp sugar None None FOR THE HONEYED GRAPES 1/4 cup honey 4 oz red grapes, attached to stems
directions: Place yogurt in a sieve lined with a muslin or absorbent piece of cloth. Place sieve over a bowl. Cover and refrigerate overnight to drain. Place honey, cream and vanilla bean in a medium saucepan on low heat. Stir until honey has dissolved. Remove from heat. Meanwhile, sprinkle gelatin over 4 tsp water in a small heatproof bowl. Place bowl in a small saucepan of simmering water stir until gelatin has dissolved. Stir gelatin into honey mixture. Cool until lukewarm; remove vanilla bean. Stir yogurt into honey mixture. Beat egg whites in medium bowl with electric mixer until firm peaks form. Add sugar; beat until dissolved. Fold egg whites into honey and yogurt mixture. Pour into six 3/4-cup dessert glasses. Cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for 3 hours, or until set. Meanwhile for the honeyed grapes, place honey, grapes and 1/2 cup water in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low; simmer, uncovered, for 5 mins, or until syrup has thickened. Cool. Serve mousses topped with honeyed grapes and drizzled with syrup.

title: Upside Down Cobbler
ingredients: 1 c. flour 1 c. sugar 1 cube margarine 1 egg 1 c. milk 2 tsp. baking powder pinch of salt 4 c. sweetened fruit
directions: Combine and mix well the flour, sugar, margarine and egg. Add and mix well milk, baking powder and pinch of salt.

title: Party Ham Ball
ingredients: 2 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese 2 pkg. ham 1 Tbsp. Accent 1 Tbsp. Worcestershire 1 tsp. onion salt 1/4 tsp. garlic powder (optional)
directions: Reserve 4 slices ham. Mix all ingredients together by hand. Shape into ball and chill overnight. Before serving wrap 4 pieces of ham around ball and secure with toothpicks. Serve with crackers. (Chop ham before combining with other ingredients.)

title: Three Corn Casserole
ingredients: 1 can creamed corn 1 can whole kernel corn 1 box jiffy corn muffin mix 1 - 8 oz. pkg. of cheddar cheese, optional 2 eggs 1 stick of margarine, melted 1 c. dairy sour cream
directions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into a 9-inch x 13-inch baking dish. Bake 45 to 60 minutes at 350°.

title: Oriental Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 1 pkg cole slaw mix 1 pkg oriental flavored ramen noodles 1/2 c sugar 1/4 c vinegar 1/4 c cooking oil sunflower seeds (shelled)
directions: Mix sugar, vinegar, and oil with seasoning packet from ramen noodles. Break up ramen noodles into small pieces. Mix all ingredients together.

title: Really Good Snack Mix
ingredients: 3 tablespoons butter, melted 4 teaspoons Worcestershire sauce 1 tablespoon canola oil 1 teaspoon seasoned salt 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder 2 cups Corn Chex 2 cups Crispix 2 cups bite-sized Shredded Wheat 1-1/2 cups salted cashews
directions: Preheat oven to 250°. Mix first five ingredients; toss with cereals and cashews, coating evenly. Spread into a 15x10x1-in. pan coated with cooking spray. Bake 45 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes. Cool completely before storing in airtight containers.

title: Crab Salad with Grilled Portobello Mushrooms and Walnut Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chopped roasted walnuts 1 teaspoon minced garlic Salt and pepper to taste 1 tablespoon champagne vinegar 3 tablespoons walnut oil 4 large Portobello mushrooms, stem removed 2 ounces frisee lettuce 2 ounces watercress 1/2 cup fresh jumbo lump crabmeat
directions: Add the walnuts, garlic and salt and pepper to the champagne vinegar and slowly whisk in the walnut oil. Baste the four portobello mushrooms with the vinaigrette and grill over a table top grill. Toss the frisee and the watercress with the remaining vinaigrette and place the mushroom in the center of the plate and mound the frissee on top. Garnish with jumbo lump crabmeat

title: Margie'S Cheesy Baked Broccoli
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter -- melted 2 tablespoons flour 3 ounces cream cheese -- softened 1/4 cup blue cheese, crumbled 1 cup milk 20 ounces frozen broccoli -- blanched 1/3 cup Ritz Crackers -- crushed
directions: Blend flour, butter, cheeses, and milk in small saucepan. Cook until mixture boils. Arrange broccoli in shallow casserole that has been sprayed with PAM. Pour sauce over broccoli. Sprinkle with Ritz Crackers. Bake at 350*F for 30 minutes.

title: Super Easy Spanish Rice (4 Ww Points)
ingredients: 14 1/2 ounces tomatoes with jalapenos 1 cup rice 1 1/2 cups water 1/2 teaspoon salt
directions: Pour entire can of tomatoes (including liquid) into pan. Add water, rice, and salt. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 20 minutes.

title: Custard Fresh Apple Pie Recipe
ingredients: 1 unbaked pie shell 3 whole Large eggs 1/2 c. sugar 1 tbsp. flour 1 3/4 c. lowfat milk 1 teaspoon vanilla 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg Healthy pinch salt 3 c. sliced apples 1 tbsp. sugar plus 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon
directions: Now you put 3 c. sliced apples, 1 Tbsp. sugar and 1/4 tsp. cinnamon. Mix well, then arrange apple slices on top of pie and bake at 350 degrees for 30 to 35 min.

title: Almond Brittle Cookies
ingredients: Cookie Crust 1 cup unsalted butter, room temperature 1 cup sugar 1 pinch salt 2 oranges, zest of, grated 1/4 cup lightly beaten egg 2 tablespoons milk 2 teaspoons vanilla extract 2 cups cake flour 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour 1/2 cup raspberry jam 1 tablespoon amaretto liqueur Almond Topping 9 tablespoons unsalted butter 1/2 cup sugar, plus 1 tablespoon sugar 2 tablespoons honey (heaping) 1 pinch salt 1/4 cup heavy cream 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 3 drops fresh lemon juice 2 cups sliced blanched almonds
directions: Make cookie crust: Using electric mixer, beat butter at medium speed until light. Add sugar, salt, and orange zest; beat until fluffy, 3-5 minutes. Add egg, milk, and vanilla and beat until blended. Add flours and mix at low speed just until smooth. Refrigerate, wrapped in plastic wrap, until firm, at least 2 hours. Let dough warm at room temperature briefly before rolling out. Lightly butter 15-1/2x10-1/2" baking sheet. Roll out dough on lightly floured surface to rectangle slightly larger than baking sheet. Line baking sheet with dough, letting edges hang. (Dough can also be pressed into pan with fingertips.) Refrigerate at least 20 minutes. Heat oven to 400 degrees. Trim dough flush with pan. Prick all over with fork. Bake until light golden, 16-18 minutes. Prick any air bubbles with fork. Mix jam and liqueur together and brush over hot pastry. Make topping: Melt butter in heavy saucepan over medium heat. Stir in sugar, honey, and salt. Cook, stirring constantly, until sugar dissolves. Stir in cream and boil, stirring constantly, until lightly thickened, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla, lemon juice, and almonds. Very gently spread almond mixture in smooth layer over pastry without disturbing raspberry glaze. Bake until bubbly and golden brown, 17-20 minutes. Cool completely in pan on wire rack. Cut into 1" squares. Store in airtight containers.

title: Chicken Paprikash
ingredients: 3 Tablespoons Olive Oil 1/2 cups All-purpose Flour 1 Tablespoon Paprika Salt And Pepper, to taste 4 whole Boneless Chicken Breast Halves, Cut In Half 2 whole Yellow Onions, Thinly Sliced 3 whole Large Carrots, Roughly Chopped 1/2 cups Flat Leaf Parsley, Plus More For Garnish 1/2 teaspoons Dried Thyme 3 cloves Garlic, Minced 2 whole Fresh Tomatoes, Roughly Chopped 1 cup White Wine 1 cup Chicken Broth Cooked Egg Noodles, To Serve 1/2 cups Sour Cream
directions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet. In a large dish or bowl (I use a Pyrex 8x8 dish), whisk together the flour, paprika, salt and pepper. Place the chicken pieces in the flour mixture and toss until evenly coated; shake off any excess and add to hot oil. Cook over medium heat until browned, about 4 to 5 minutes on each side. Remove chicken and set aside. Add the sliced onions and carrots to the skillet. Stir in parsley leaves and thyme, and cook for 5 minutes, or until onions are soft. Add garlic and continue to cook for 1 minute, or until fragrant. Mix in the tomatoes. Pour in wine and chicken broth, and bring to a boil. Return the chicken pieces to the pan. Turn down the heat to low, cover, and cook for 1 hour. Divide the cooked egg noodles among 4 to 6 dinner plates. Remove the chicken from the pan and set on top of egg noodles. Whisk the sour cream into the pan and continue to whisk until thoroughly combined; remove from heat. Spoon the sauce over the chicken and noodles. Garnish with parsley. Serve.

title: Crusty Catfish
ingredients: fresh catfish fillets crushed pecans Dijon mustard milk salt pepper
directions: Preheat oven to 450°. Cut fish into thin strips; double check for bones. In a bowl, mix 2 parts Dijon mustard and one part milk. Salt and pepper fish; dip in mustard-milk mixture. Roll in crushed pecans. Place fish on a well-greased cookie sheet and bake until outside coating is crisp and the fish flakes easily with a fork.

title: Scalloped "Hashbrown Potatoes" Recipe
ingredients: 2 pound bag frzn hashbrown potatoes 1 can mushroom soup 1 c. lowfat sour cream 10 ounce. grated Cheddar cheese 1/4 c. chopped onion 1/2 stick melted butter
directions: In large bowl mix the above ingredients all together. Put frzn potatoes in colander and run warm water over them to separate. Then mix potatoes into the above ingredients and mix thoroughly. Put mix into a 9 by 13 inch baking dish. Heat 1/2 stick butter, mix with 4 c. corn flakes (crushed). Put corn flake mix on top potato mix, cover with foil, and bake for 1 hour in 350 degree oven.

title: Reconstruction Pumpkin Soup
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. chopped onions 2 Tbsp. chopped green peppers 2 Tbsp. butter 2 c. milk 3/4 tsp. salt pepper to taste chopped parsley 1/8 tsp. Worcestershire sauce 1 c. cooked pumpkin puree
directions: Saute onions and green peppers in butter for 5 minutes. Add milk, pumpkin, salt, pepper and Worcestershire sauce. Cook in top of double boiler until very hot. Garnish with parsley.

title: Sour Cream Biscuit
ingredients: 2 sticks margarine 2 c. self-rising flour 1 c. sour cream
directions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour into miniature muffin tins. Bake at 350° about 10 to 12 minutes or until done. Yields about 3 dozen.

title: Cranberry Grog
ingredients: 1 quart apple cider 1 quart cranberry juice 1/2 cup brown sugar 8 whole cloves 1 cinnamon stick dark rum (optional)
directions: Heat all together. One ounce of dark rum can be added to each serving cup.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
ingredients: 3 bowls cucumbers 2 bowls onions 1 bowl vinegar 1 1/2 bowls sugar 2 tsp. celery seed 2 tsp. turmeric 3 sticks (1-inch long) cinnamon 4 green peppers
directions: Slice cucumbers and onions and chop or slice green peppers. Mix all ingredients in large kettle. Salt and let stand one hour. Cook on medium heat 20 minutes. Put into canning jars and seal.

title: Five-Cheese Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 10 ounces cheddar cheese soup 1 cup half-and-half 8 ounces cream cheese 8 ounces cheddar cheese, shredded salt, to taste pepper, to taste 2 tablespoons butter 16 ounces wide egg noodles, cooked 16 ounces cottage cheese 1/2 cup parmesan cheese, shredded 1/2 cup seasoned croutons cooking spray
directions: In a large mixing bowl, blend together the cottage cheese and cooked noodles. Pour this blend into a 9" x 13" casserole dish that has been sprayed with cooking spray. Using a large saucepan, pour in the soup, half and half, cream cheese, cheddar cheese, salt, pepper, and butter. Heat over medium-low heat until melted and blended. Pour this over the noddles in the casserole dish. Sprinkle the top of the casserole with the croutons and the parmesan cheese. Bake at 375-degrees F. for 15 minutes.

title: Ham Croquettes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter or margarine 1/4 cup all-purpose flour 1 cup milk 1 egg, beaten 1/2 teaspoon paprika 1 1/2 cups ground, cooked ham 1 1/2 cups cooked regular rice 1 egg, beaten 1 tablespoon milk 1 cup fine dry breadcrumbs 3 tablespoons vegetable oil
directions: Melt butter in a heavy saucepan over low heat; add flour, stirring until smooth. Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. Gradually add 1 cup milk; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened and bubbly. Gradually stir 2 tablespoons hot mixture into 1 beaten egg; add to remaining hot mixture, stirring constantly. Stir in paprika. Add ham and rice; mix well. Set aside to cool. Shape mixture into 12 (2 1/2- inch) croquettes. Combine 1 beaten egg and 1 tablespoon milk; mix well. Dip each croquette into egg mixture, and coat with breadcrumbs. Fry croquettes in hot oil until brown on both sides, turning once.

title: Beet Salad with Plums and Goat Cheese
ingredients: 12 2-inch-diameter beets, tops trimmed 1/2 cup white wine vinegar 1 teaspoon sugar 1/2 cup vegetable oil 1/4 cup walnut oil or olive oil 1 1/2 pounds firm but ripe plums, pitted, cut into 1/2-inch pieces 1 medium-size red onion, sliced into rings 1 1/2 6-ounce bags fresh baby spinach leaves 8 ounces soft fresh goat cheese (such as Montrachet), crumbled
directions: Preheat oven to 375F. Wrap beets tightly in foil packages (3 beets in each). Place on baking sheet. Roast beets until tender, turning packages occasionally, about 1 hour 45 minutes. Unwrap beets; cool completely. Peel beets and cut into 1/4-inch-thick rounds. Place in large bowl. Combine vinegar and sugar in blender. Gradually blend in vegetable oil, then walnut oil. Season vinaigrette to taste with salt and pepper. (Beets and vinaigrette can be prepared 2 days ahead. Cover separately; refrigerate. Let beets stand 2 hours at room temperature before continuing. Rewhisk vinaigrette before using.) Toss beets with 1/4 cup vinaigrette. Toss plums and onion with cup vinaigrette in another large bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Overlap beets around edge of platter. Mound spinach in center of platter; drizzle with some vinaigrette. Spoon plums and onion over salad. Sprinkle with goat cheese and serve.

title: Bonnie'S Rolls
ingredients: 3/4 c. butter 1/2 c. sugar 1 c. scalded milk 1 cake Fleischmann's yeast, dissolved in 1/2 c. lukewarm water 1 c. mashed potatoes 1/2 tsp. salt 3 eggs, well beaten
directions: Cream butter, sugar and salt. Add milk, yeast, potatoes, then eggs. Add enough flour to make a stiff dough.

title: Rhubarb Pie
ingredients: two eggs 1 tablespoon minit tapioca (or flour or cornstarch). about 3/4 cup sugar 4-5 cups thinly sliced rhubarb cinnamon
directions: Beat eggs in a bowl. Add minit tapioca Add sugar Add rhubarb Sprinkle with cinnamon if desired Pour into an 8 inch pie shell and bake at 400 for 45 minutes

title: Macaroni and Cheese in Parmesan Cups
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups fresh grated Parmesan 1/3 cup diced onion 1 sprig fresh thyme leaves 3 sprig fresh dill 1 sprig fresh oregano leaves 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley leaves 1 allspice berry 1 bay leaf 2 cloves garlic 1 1/2 cups heavy cream 1/2 cup shredded Vermont sharp Cheddar 1/4 cup shredded Cotswold 1/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan 1 cup cooked macaroni Salt and fresh ground pepper
directions: To make the Parmesan Cups: Put a small nonstick pan on stove over medium heat. Lay tart molds upside down on flat surface. Place 1 tablespoon of cheese in a small pile about the size of a quarter in the pan. Cook until cheese melts and starts to bubble. Flip the cheese and continue cooking until golden brown. Drape cheese over tart mold and press down with another tart mold to form cup shape. Let cool. Remove from molds and trim off excess cheese after cheese has cooled. To make Macaroni and Cheese: Put the onion, herbs, garlic and cream in a heavy saucepan and bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer until cream is reduced by half. Strain and put cream back in pan on low heat. Whisk in the cheese. Add cooked macaroni to cheese mixture. Season, to taste, with salt and pepper. To assemble: Spoon mixture into each Parmesan cup and garnish with chopped parsley.

title: Banana Muffins
ingredients: 1/2 cup Flour - Teff or white flour 1/2 cup whole wheat flour or coconut flour 1/3 cup brown sugar 1 tablespoon Baking powder 1 cup buttermilk 2 tablespoon chia seeds 1/2 cup peanut butter 1 banana 1 egg 2 tablespoon vegetable oil 1 teaspoon vanilla
directions: Combine dry ingredients soak chia seeds in buttermilk add wet ingredients to dry add to muffin tray bake 20 mins at 350 degrees

title: Impossible Chicken Pie
ingredients: 1 pkg. frozen broccoli 3 c. Cheddar cheese 1 1/2 c. cooked chicken 2/3 c. chopped onion 1 1/3 c. milk 3 eggs 3/4 c. Bisquick salt and pepper (optional)]
directions: Rinse broccoli to thaw; drain. Mix broccoli, 2 cups of cheese, the chicken and onion in pie plate. Beat milk, eggs and baking mix until smooth (salt and pepper). Pour into plate. Bake until knife comes out clean, 25 to 35 minutes. Top with remaining cheese.

title: Potato Soup
ingredients: 10 lb. potatoes 1 lb. cheese 4 c. shredded Cheddar cheese 2 large sour cream 1 lb. bacon
directions: Dice and boil potatoes. Thicken with flour mixture. Add cheeses and sour cream. Add bacon bits or have on sides. You can halve this recipe.

title: "Best Ever" Lasagna Recipe
ingredients: 1 (16 ounce.) pkg. lasagna noodles 1 pound Mozzarella cheese, sliced 2 pound grnd beef 2 cloves garlic, chopped 1 sm. onion, chopped 2 c. tomato sauce 1 (12 ounce.) can tomato paste 1 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon pepper 1/2 teaspoon oregano 1 tbsp. parsley flakes 1 can mushrooms, liquid removed 2 Large eggs 3 c. cottage cheese 1/4 c. Romano cheese 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon pepper
directions: Cook lasagna noodles following package directions. Brown meat, onion, and garlic. Drain grease. Add in tomato sauce and paste, 1 tsp. salt, 1/2 tsp. pepper, oregano, parsley flakes, and mushrooms. Simmer 20-30 min. Beat Large eggs. Add in cottage cheese, Romano cheese, 1/2 tsp. salt, and 1/4 tsp. pepper. Place layer of noodles in bottom of 9 x 13 inch pan. Add in 1/2 of cheese mix, 1/2 meat mix, 1/2 Mozzarella slices. Repeat noodles, cottage cheese, meat, Mozzarella layers. Top with layer of noodles. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Cover with foil. Bake at 350 degrees for 45-60 min. Can be prepared ahead and refrigerated 1-2 days or possibly frzn for weeks, then baked as needed.

title: S’Mores Pizza
