In another bowl, whisk molasses, milk and egg yolk until blended; stir into crumb mixture just until moistened. Turn onto a lightly floured surface; knead gently 6-8 times. Pat into an 8-in. circle. Cut into 12 wedges. Place wedges 1 in. apart on a greased . In a small bowl, beat egg white until frothy; brush over scones. Sprinkle with sugar. Bake golden brown, 12-15 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Tomato Cucumber Mix
ingredients: 2 tomatoes, diced 1 small onion, chopped bacon bits 1 cucumber, sliced Mozzarella cheese sugar mayonnaise
directions: Dice tomatoes. Slice cucumber. Chop onion and mix together. Mix together 1/4 cup sugar and 1 cup mayonnaise. Pour this over tomato mixture. Sprinkle with cheese. Add bacon bits.

title: Shrimp Crescent Appetizers
ingredients: 1 (8 ounce) package refrigerated crescent dinner rolls 16 small cooked shrimp seafood cocktail sauce, to top each crescent
directions: Preheat oven to 350*. Seperate crescent roll dough into 8 triangles. Cut each triangle in half. Place 1 cooked shrimp in center of each small triangle; top with cocktail sauce. Fold into crescent shape; moisten sides with water; crimp sides in a decorative pattern. Bake for 12 minutes or until golden brown and slightly puffed.

title: Baked Salmon
ingredients: 1 fillet of salmon 30 grams butter 1 tsp fresh finely chopped chives 1 tsp fresh chopped parsley 1/4 fresh chilli pepper, sliced 10 grams chopped broccoli 10 grams green beans 5 grams spinach 1 garlic clove, crushed inside skins 1 a drop of olive oil 1 a slice of lime
directions: Pre-heat an oven to 220C / 200C fan. On a sheet of baking parchment or tin foil, pour the drop of oil into the centre. Lay the green beans, broccoli, and spinach on the sheet. Then place the salmon on top. Place the butter, chives, parsley, garlic clove and chilli. Lay the slice of lime on top, now wrap the salmon inside the sheet, making sure to create a bag, leaving room for the fish and veg to steam inside. Place in the oven and cook for 15-20mins or until cooked to your liking.

title: Strawberry Delight
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. plain flour 1 stick margarine, melted 1/2 c. pecans, chopped finely 1 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese 1 c. powdered sugar 1 c. Cool Whip
directions: Mix together the first 3 ingredients and press in bottom of a 9 1/2 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 325° for 30 to 40 minutes or until lightly browned. Mix the cream cheese, powdered sugar and Cool Whip. Pour this over cooled crust. Pour 1 package of thawed strawberries (you may use fresh, if possible) over the cream cheese mixture. Cover the strawberries with a jar of strawberry glaze. Chill and serve.

title: Oven Dried Beef Jerky
ingredients: 2 lb. round steak 1/2 c. soy sauce 1 Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce 1/4 tsp. pepper 1/4 tsp. garlic powder 1/2 tsp. onion powder 1 tsp. hickory smoked salt
directions: Cut steak into thin strips. Lay strips in season serve. Mix rest of ingredients in order given and pour over meat. Seal. Turn meat over every hour, for a minimum of 4 hours. Can stand overnight.

title: Carrot Cake #2
ingredients: 2 c. flour 1 1/4 c. sugar 2 tsp. baking soda 1 1/2 tsp. cinnamon 1/2 c. vegetable oil 3 eggs 2 (6 oz. each) jars junior carrot baby food 1 (8 oz.) can crushed pineapple in its own juice 1/2 c. coconut 1/2 c. chopped walnuts
directions: Heat oven to 350°. Grease tube pan. In large bowl, stir together flour, sugar, baking soda and cinnamon. Whisk in oil, baby food and eggs until smooth. Fold in pineapple with juice and coconut and pour into pan. Bake for 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter No Bake Cake
ingredients: 1 cup cold milk 14 cup peanut butter 1 (3 1/2 ounce) package chocolate flavor instant pudding and pie filling mix 1 12 cups thawed Cool Whip 55 vanilla wafers, divided 2 semi-sweet chocolate baking squares (optional) 2 cups strawberries, whole (optional)
directions: Add milk to peanut butter in medium bowl, beating with wire wisk until well blended. Add dry pudding mix. Beat 2 min or until well blended. Stir in the whipped topping. Reserve 5 of the wafers for later use. Spread about 1 tsp of the pudding mixture onto each of the remaining 50 wafers. Stack wafers together, standing them on edge around the outer edge of a round serving platter to form a ring. Cover the ring with the remaining pudding mixture. Refrigerate 6 hours or overnight. Crush the remaining 5 wafers; sprinkle over the dessert. Make chocolate curls with the chocolate squares and sprinkle on top. Fill the center of the ring with whole strawberries. Store leftover dessert in refrigerator.

title: Croatian Torte Recipe
ingredients: 6 Large eggs, separated 6 tbsp. sugar 6 tbsp. flour 1 teaspoon baking pwdr
directions: Place egg whites in electric mixer, beat stiffly, then set aside. In another bowl, mix egg yolks and sugar, beat well with mixer till light and thick. Remove from mixer and add in flour and baking pwdr, mixing by hand and then add in egg whites and mix lightly. Pour contents into two prepared 9 inch layer pans, 1 1/2 inches deep. Bake 35 to 40 min in a 325 degree oven. Remove cake from pan while it is warm. Let it cold and then slice into layers.

title: Chickpea and Pasta Soup
ingredients: 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil, plus more to taste 2 garlic cloves, peeled and crushed 1 carrot, chopped 1 celery stalk, chopped 1 onion, chopped 1 teaspoon dried rosemary 2 cups cooked (page 431) or canned chickpeas, drained 1/4 cup small pasta, like elbow macaroni or broken spaghetti Salt and black pepper to taste Fresh parsley sprigs, optional
directions: Put the 3 tablespoons oil in a large saucepan or stockpot over medium-high heat. Add the garlic, carrot, celery, and onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are fragrant and softened, about 5 minutes. Add the rosemary and chickpeas and stir well. Pour in enough water to cover the chickpeas, cover, lower the heat, and simmer for 10 minutes. Cool the mixture slightly if time allows (its never a good idea to puree boiling hot mixtures if you can avoid it). Use a food mill, an immersion blender, or an upright blender to puree the mixture. If you are going to refrigerate the soup, do so now. If not, return it to the saucepan and reheat over low heat. Meanwhile, cook the pasta in boiling salted water until nearly tender; drain. Just before serving, stir the pasta into the soup and reheat. Season with salt and pepper, garnish with parsley, and serve, drizzled with a little more olive oil. Add 1/2 cup canned plum tomatoes, chopped, with their juices, after the vegetables have softened. Cook for 5 minutes and then substitute 1 cup dried lentils (no need to soak) for the chickpeas. Stir well, add enough water to cover, cover the pot, and simmer for 30 minutes. Cook the pasta as in step 2 and proceed directly to step 3. Do not puree the soup mixture. Instead, just add the cooked pasta before serving. Add 1/2 cup canned plum tomatoes, chopped, with their juices after the vegetables have softened. Cook for 5 minutes and add the cooked chickpeas. Do not add water to cover. Instead, continue stirring and cook over low heat for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, cook 1 cup short Italian pasta, like penne, rigatoni, or fusilli. Toss the cooked pasta with the chickpea mixture, season with salt and pepper, garnish with parsley, and serve.

title: Smoked Salmon Tagliatelle
ingredients: 11 ounces tagliatelle pasta noodles 1 garlic clove, crushed 1 ounce butter 23 cup white wine 1 cup heavy cream 8 ounces smoked salmon, finely sliced 4 ounces Baby Spinach 2 tablespoons fresh dill, chopped
directions: Cook the tagliatelle according to packet instructions. Meanwhile, fry the garlic in butter for 2 minutes Add the wine and boil for 3 minutes Add the cream and simmer for 2 minutes Drain the pasta and return to the pan. Fold in the sauce with half the sliced salmon, the spinach leaves and dill. Transfer to a large platter and top with the remaining salmon.

title: Candied Fruitcake
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. pitted dates (cut up) 1 lb. candied pineapple, cut up 1 lb. candied cherries, equal portions of red and green 2 lb. pecan halves 2 c. flour 1 c. sugar 2 tsp. baking powder 1/2 tsp. salt 4 lg eggs light corn syrup to rub on cakes after baking
directions: Mix all ingredients together. Butter loaf pans and line with brown paper. Bake at 375 degrees for 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours. Brush corn syrup on cakes.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
ingredients: 4 whole chicken breasts (skinless/boneless) 1 lb. linguini 1/2 lb. butter or margarine 1/2 c. sliced mushrooms 2 cans cream of chicken soup 1/2 c. water 16 oz. sour cream 1/4 c. dry sherry 1/2 c. Romano cheese parsley salt and pepper garlic salt
directions: Cook chicken, cut into bite-size pieces and set aside. Cook pasta and drain. Saute mushrooms, butter, garlic salt and parsley. Add chicken to mushroom mixture and let set to blend flavors.

title: Sourdough Starter (For Classic Sourdough Bread)
ingredients: 3 (1/4 ounce) packets dry yeast 1 1/2 cups warm water 1 tablespoon granulated sugar 2 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
directions: Dissolve yeast in water in a large plastic container (gallon size works well). Add sugar. When yeast bubbles (about 10 minutes), stir in flour until you have a smooth paste. Cover loosely to allow gases to escape and place in a warm spot in your kitchen 2 to 3 days. The mixture should bubble and give off a sour odor. Stir starter once a day, making sure to stir in any crust that's formed. After this point, you can store starter in the refrigerator or leave it out in a cool, dark area of your kitchen. Feed starter by stirring in 1 cup all-purpose flour and 1/2 cup water every day if you leave it out, or every few days if it's refrigerated; otherwise, it will become too acidic and eventually die. Once starter has grown a few weeks and has reached full strength, you can decrease feedings to once a week. If you don't use your starter regularly, it's going to get unruly and burst the bounds of it's container. Give some away to friends along with feeding and baking instructions.

title: Roasted Garlic Pasta
ingredients: 3 cups chicken broth 7 heads garlic, peeled 34 lb your favorite pasta (I like farfale or bowtie) 1 tablespoon olive oil 34 cup minced garlic 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes 34 cup fresh oregano, minced salt freshly ground black pepper
directions: NOTE: If you'd like this to be more a cajun flare, add your favorite cajun seasoning salt and change the oregano to parsley Preheat the oven to 250 F degrees. In a 9 x 12 inch baking dish, combine 1 1/2 cups chicken broth and the peeled whole garlic cloves. Roast, uncovered, tossing every 10 to 15 minutes, until golden brown, Set aside. In a large saucepan, cook the pasta in boiling water over high heat for 8 to 12 minutes, until al dente. Drain, reserving 3/4 cup of the cooking water. Return to the saucepan, cover and keep warm over low heat. In a large skillet, heat the remaining 1 1/2 cups broth and the oil over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and pepper flakes. Stir and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until garlic turns golden brown but not brown. Add the pasta, roasted garlic and reserved pasta water. Toss and cook for 1 to 2 minutes to allow the pasta to absorb the sauce. Add oregano and toss again. Season with salt and pepper. Serve with a salad and garlic toast.

title: Slow Cooker Cheesy Chicken And Tortillas
ingredients: 1 1/4 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast halves 1 tablespoon chili powder 1 teaspoon ground cumin 1 3/4 cups Swanson(R) Natural Goodness Chicken Broth 2 (10.5 ounce) cans Campbell's(R) Condensed Cream of Chicken Soup or Campbell's(R) Condensed 98% Fat Free Cream of Chicken Soup 8 (6 inch) flour tortillas, cut into 1-inch pieces 2 cups shredded Mexican cheese blend 6 cups hot cooked long-grain white rice
directions: Place the chicken into a 4-quart slow cooker. Sprinkle with the chili powder and cumin. Pour in the broth. Cover and cook on LOW for 8 to 9 hours* or until the chicken is cooked through. Remove the chicken to a cutting board. Using 2 forks, shred the chicken. Reserve 1 cup liquid in cooker, adding additional broth, if needed, to make 1 cup. Stir the soup into the cooker. Stir in chicken. Heat the oven to 350 degrees F. Layer half the chicken mixture, tortillas and cheese in a 13x9x2-inch baking dish. Repeat the layers. Bake for 30 minutes or until the mixture is hot and bubbling. Serve over the rice.

title: S'mores Nachos
ingredients: 8 rectangular graham crackers 1 12 cups miniature marshmallows 34 cup milk chocolate chips
directions: Break each graham cracker into 4 pieces. (Once you break them you should have 32 pieces of graham crackers. ). Pile pieces in ungreased metal pie pan. DO NOT USE GLASS. Top with chocolate chips and marshmallows. Broil 6 inches from heat for 30 to 60 seconds or until marshmallows are puffed and golden, watching to prevent burning.

title: Bacon and Parsley ' Sloppy Joes'
ingredients: 12 lb pork belly, cut in matchstick cubes 1/5 inch thick (streaky bacon ) 1 cup of finely chopped parsley 1 cup tomato ketchup (Heinz) 1 medium sized tomatoes (diced) salt and pepper 4 soft buns (not too big)
directions: This is something that you can make very quickly , there is no time to be away from the cooker. Heat up a dry pan and throw in the bacon , it will start to sweat and loose fat quite rapidly , so you really don't need any extra fat here. Keep stirring until your bacon bits are golden brown (nor charred) . Add the parsley and fry it for about 30 seconds so it starts loosing moisture and has given some taste to the fat. Add the tomato ketchup, some pepper and salt and let the whole thing reduce until your ketchup is darker than usual (keep turning in it with a wooden spatula making sure nothing sticks). Add the cubed tomato, quickly stir it in the now heavily concentrated mixture in your pan, and let the whole heat up for a few seconds. The tomato doesn't have to 'cook', it just has to be warmed up. The whole thing should now have the consistency of thick tomato sauce. Serve inside a toasted soft bun (cut in half and toasted in a toaster or lightly fried if you don't have a toaster wide enough). Enjoy your snack and don't forget to give some feedback.

title: One-Dish Chicken Dinner
ingredients: 4 c. potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced salt and pepper 2 c. cooked chicken, cubed 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen peas, partially thawed 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup 1/2 soup can milk 2 Tbsp. instant minced onion 1/4 tsp. dry mustard dash of hot pepper sauce paprika
directions: Layer half the potatoes in 11 1/2 x 7 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with pepper and lightly salt. Top with chicken, then peas and then remaining potatoes. In a saucepan, combine remaining ingredients, except paprika. Heat through. Pour over casserole. Sprinkle with paprika and cover.

title: Fresh Peach Ice Cream
ingredients: 8 egg yolks 1 cup sugar 1/4 teaspoon salt 2 cups milk 2 cups heavy cream 3 medium peaches, peeled, pitted, and mashed 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
directions: In a medium saucepan whisk together egg yolks, sugar, and salt. Gradually wisk in milk. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until custurd thickens slightly and coats the back of the spoon, 10 to 12 minutes. Pour custurd into a medium bowl set over ice. Stir in cream, mashed peaches, lemon juice, and vanilla. Let stand, stirring occasionally until chilled. Churn in an ice cream maker according to manufacturers instructions. Transfer churned ice cream to a plastic container and freeze until firm.

title: Pineapple Chicken(Microwave)
ingredients: 1 1/2 to 2 lb. boneless chicken, cut in pieces 1 (8 oz.) can crushed pineapple, drained 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can condensed cream of chicken soup 3/4 c. raisins
directions: Place chicken pieces in glass 2-quart casserole dish. Cover with wax paper. Microwave on High for 12 minutes. Turn chicken over. Combine pineapple, soup and raisins. Pour over chicken. Cook in microwave oven, uncovered, on High for 12 to 15 minutes more.

title: R.U. Peking? Chicken
ingredients: 4 lb. chicken wings or drumsticks 1/2 c. soy sauce (preferably Chinese) 1/4 c. sherry or Madeira 1/3 c. hoisin sauce 1/4 c. cider vinegar 1/2 c. honey 1/4 c. orange marmalade 6 scallions, minced 2 cloves garlic, minced 2 Tbsp. green pepper, minced 1 tsp. grated lemon rind 1 tsp. grated orange rind 4 drops Tabasco
directions: Combine all ingredients (except chicken) in a saucepan; bring to a boil and simmer 5 minutes. If using wings, cut off and discard tips and separate wings at joints. If using drumsticks, cut or snip at bottom and push meat up to form a "drumette" with handle (if desired). Place chicken in a glass or ceramic bowl; pour seasoning mixture over chicken and mix well to coat. Marinate overnight in the refrigerator. Drain and save marinade.

title: Baked Apple Rings(Yield: 4 Servings)
ingredients: 4 baking apples (ex: Rome) 1/2 c. brown sugar 1/2 tsp. powdered cloves 1/2 tsp. cinnamon 1/2 c. honey 1/2 c. water
directions: Preheat oven to 400°. Core and slice apples into 1/2-inch rings. Place in shallow baking dish. In a saucepan, combine and heat remaining ingredients. Pour over apples and bake 15 minutes or until tender, turning to baste once or twice.

title: Spinach Dip
ingredients: 1 can chopped spinach 1 egg 1 bag shredded Mozzarella cheese 1 (8 oz.) jar sour cream 1 bag tortilla chips or Ritz crackers
directions: Drain spinach; cook until boiling, then add egg. Cook until egg is done, then add cheese. Stir until cheese is melted, then put in bowl. Add sour cream and serve.

title: Beef And Cheddar Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 teaspoons canola oil 1 cup chopped onion 1 tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon chopped chipotle chile in adobo sauce 1 cup chopped tomato 1/3 cup chopped cilantro stems 4 light flour tortillas (such as La Tortilla Factory) Cooking spray 1.5 ounces shredded reduced-fat cheddar (about 1/3 cup) 1/2 cup chopped tomato 1/4 cup cilantro leaves
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Heat canola oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add onion; saute 2 minutes. Add minced garlic and chopped chipotle chile; cook 2 minutes. Add 1 cup chopped tomato and chopped cilantro stems; cook 2 minutes. Add shredded pot roast and 1 cup sauce from Traditional Beef Pot Roast with Carrots; cover and simmer 5 minutes. Divide beef mixture among tortillas; place, seam side down, in an 11 x 7-inch baking dish coated with cooking spray. Pour 1/2 cup sauce over tortillas; sprinkle with cheddar. Cover; bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Turn broiler to high. Broil, uncovered, 2 minutes. Top with 1/2 cup chopped tomato and cilantro leaves.

title: Red Velvet Cookies
ingredients: 1 box red velvet cake mix Duncan Hines 2 eggs 1/3 cup vegetable oil powdered sugar optional
directions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Combine one (1) box of Duncan Hines Red Velvet cake mix, two (2) eggs and one-third (1/3) cup vegetable oil using a hand blender or wire whisk. Form teaspoon sized balls and place on a lightly greased cookie sheet or baking pan about one inch (1") apart. Slightly pat down the top of each cookie ball. Cook for 8-10 minutes (the top of the cookie will crack). While hot, lightly sprinkle the top of the cookie with powdered sugar (optional) and VOILA! Enjoy your red velvet cookies and share the recipe with your friends and family.

title: Pan Roast Beef Tenderloin With A Mushroom Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 dash olive oil 1 teaspoon butter 2 (6 ounce) beef tenderloin salt and pepper 1 clove garlic 1 sprig thyme 6 tablespoons cognac (or white wine) 1/4 cup chicken broth 3/4 cup 35% cream 1 cup of assorted mushroom chopped parsley
directions: In a fry pan over medium high heat, add a splash of olive oil and half a teaspoon of butter. Season the beef tenderloin with salt and pepper and add to pan. Add the clove of garlic and sprig of fresh thyme. Slowly roast the beef tenderloin on all sides, turning routinely every 2 to 3 minutes. To cook the beef tenderloin medium, this should take approximately 10 to 12 minutes. Once roasted nicely, golden brown, remove the beef tenderloin and keep warm off to one side. Pick out the garlic and thyme, return the pan to the heat, and add a splash of cognac and flame so as to allow the alcohol to burn off. Add the chicken stock and reduce by two- thirds, then add the cream and simmer gently to reduce and thicken by half. Season with salt and pepper and keep sauce warm on one side. Using a clean fry pan, over high heat, quickly saute your choice of assorted mushrooms that have been picked over and cut into hazel nut size pieces. Saute in a splash of olive oil and butter. Season with salt and pepper; this should take 3 to 4 minutes for the mushrooms to soften and release some juices. Arrange beef tenderloin& mushrooms on your plates, then drizzle sauce around the mushrooms and a little over the tenderloin. Sprinkle with chopped parsley and serve.

title: Baked Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 1 c. sugar 2 eggs 1 tsp. vanilla 1/2 c. milk 1/2 tsp. salt 1/2 lemon juice 6 large sweet potatoes pinch of cinnamon 1/3 c. margarine
directions: Boil sweet potatoes. Let cool and peel. Beat potatoes with 1/3 cup margarine. Add rest of ingredients. Mix well. Put in casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Vincent'S Shrimp Enchiladas
ingredients: 1/3 cup onion (chopped) 2 tablespoons oil 4 ounces chevre cheese (goat cheese) 1/2 cup half-and-half salt and pepper 1 teaspoon olive oil 12 shrimp (peeled-deveined-cut in 1/3s) 4 flour tortillas (8-inch size) 1 cup half-and-half 1 1/2 tablespoons chipotle chiles in adobo 1 avocado (peeled and sliced-optional) 1/4 cup cilantro (chopped-optional)
directions: Saute onion in oil until translucent. Combine onion,cheese,half and half and salt and pepper in a small saucepan, cook over low heat 2 minutes. Saute shrimp in olive oil for 1 minute, spoon about 1/3 cup of shrimp and 1/4 of the previously prepared cream sauce in the middle of each tortilla. Fold tortillas to enclose the filling, secure with a wooden pick. Combine half and half and chopped chipotle in a small saucepan over med. heat, cook until slightly thickened, stirring frequently. Simmer the tortllas in chipotle cream for 5 minutes, remove picks place on individual serving plates garnished with remaining shrimp,chipotle cream, cilantro and avocado slices.

title: Potato Pancakes
ingredients: 1 c. riced potatoes 1/2 tsp. salt 1 egg, beaten 1 Tbsp. flour 1/4 c. milk
directions: Mix ingredients in order given. Beat thoroughly and bake on an aluminum griddle to save fat.

title: Apple Brownies
ingredients: 1 cup Flour 1 teaspoon Cinnamon 1 teaspoon Baking Powder 1/2 teaspoons Salt 7 Tablespoons Coconut Oil 2 Tablespoons Water 7 Tablespoons Brown Sugar 1 Egg 1 Large Sweet Apple 1/2 cups Walnuts
directions: Preheat oven to 180°C and butter a 20x20 cm (8x8 inch) baking pan. In a medium sized bowl whisk together flour, cinnamon, baking powder and salt. In a separate large bowl beat together oil, water, sugar and egg until pale. Peel, core and chop the apple. Chop the walnuts. Then fold both into the sugar mixture. Fold in the flour mixture. Spread batter into the pan and bake for 40 minutes. Note: If you do not have coconut oil or if you prefer to use butter, use 115 g (1 stick) instead of oil and water.

title: Peanut Butter Ale Apple(All Children Of God Will Enjoy This One!)
ingredients: 1 apple, sliced peanut butter wheat germ
directions: Spread each slice of apple with peanut butter. Experiment with amounts of peanut butter. Peanut butter also tastes good on bananas. May add wheat germ to taste.

title: Cheese Ball
ingredients: 2 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese 1/4 c. chopped bell peppers 1 small onion, chopped 2 c. chopped pecans, divided 1 c. for inside, 1 c. for outside 1 small can crushed pineapple, well drained Lawry's seasoned salt to taste
directions: Mix all ingredients. Shape and roll in chopped pecans. Chill until ready to serve. Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Orange Buttercream Frosting
ingredients: 1 (16-ounce) package powdered sugar 1/2 cup butter, softened 1 1/2 teaspoons grated orange rind 6 to 8 tablespoons heavy whipping cream
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients and 6 tablespoons whipping cream in a large bowl. Beat at medium-low speed with an electric mixer until creamy. Beat at medium-high speed until frosting is smooth and fluffy, adding cream, if necessary, for proper consistency.

title: Spaghetti with Zesty Bolognese
ingredients: 1 small onion, chopped King Sooper's 1 lb For $0.99 thru 02/09 1/4 cup Kraft Zesty Italian Dressing 1 lb. (450 g) extra-lean ground beef 1 jar (650 mL) Classico di Napoli Tomato & Basil Pasta Sauce 1 can (19 fl oz/540 mL) stewed tomatoes, undrained 330 g spaghetti, uncooked 2 Tbsp. Philadelphia Cream Cheese Product 1/4 cup Kraft 100% Parmesan Grated Cheese
directions: Cook onions in dressing in large skillet on medium heat 5 min. or until crisp-tender. Add meat; cook on medium-high heat until browned, stirring frequently. Stir in pasta sauce and tomatoes. Bring to boil; simmer on medium-low heat 15 min., stirring occasionally. Meanwhile, cook spaghetti as directed on package, omitting salt. Drain spaghetti. Remove meat sauce from heat. Add cream cheese product; stir until cream cheese is melted and mixture is well blended. Serve spaghetti topped with sauce and Parmesan.

title: Super Easy Madeleines
ingredients: 200 grams 1 Cake flour 200 grams 1 Powdered sugar 1/2 tsp 1 Baking powder 1 pinch 1 Salt 4 2 Egg 6 drops 2 Vanilla oil 200 grams 3 Butter (unsalted)
directions: Whisk the dry ingredients in a bowl (or sift for similar results). Add beaten eggs and the vanilla oil and whisk all the ingredients together. (Stop mixing when the dry ingredients are incorporated). Add melted butter in three batches, stirring well with a rubber spatula after each addition. Optional: If you let the batter rest in the fridge for 30 minutes, it'll make the cakes more delicious (I put the batter in a piping bag and let it chill). Coat the molds with butter, dust with flour and shake off the excess. Fill the molds with the batter (about 3/4 since the cake will rise in the oven). Preheat the oven to 390F/200C. Place the madeline mold into the oven. Reduce the temperature to 350F/180C and bake for about 17 minutes (depending on your oven and the mold, baking time may be between 15-20 minutes). Scallop and heart shaped. These are bear and tart shaped. Mini Gugelhupf. Winnie-the-Pooh and Hello Kitty shapes. The madeleine moulds (shell, heart, bear, scallop, rose and tart) can easily be bought online. If you want to make cake-like madeleines, use a tart mould. If you want tiny ones with an elevated centre, choose a deep mould.

title: Turkey Paprikash
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups uncooked medium egg noodles (about 8 ounces) 2 teaspoons vegetable oil 1 cup reduced-fat sour cream 2 tablespoons paprika, divided 1/2 teaspoon salt, divided 1/4 teaspoon black pepper 1 cup vertically sliced onion 1 lb turkey breast cutlets, cut into 1/4-inch-wide strips 1/2 cup reduced-sodium fat-free chicken broth
directions: Cook noodles according to package directions, omitting salt and fat. While noodles cook, heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Combine sour cream, 1 tablespoon paprika, 1/4 teaspoon salt, and pepper in a bowl; set aside. Combine 1 tablespoon paprika, 1/4 teaspoon salt, onion, and turkey, tossing to coat. Add turkey mixture to pan; saute 4 minutes or until turkey is done. Add broth; cook 2 minutes or until liquid almost evaporates. Reduce heat to medium-low. Add sour cream mixture; cook 1 minute or until thoroughly heated, stirring constantly (do not boil). Serve over noodles.

title: Banana Nut Bread
ingredients: 1/2 c. shortening 1 1/2 c. sugar 2 eggs, well beaten 1 1/2 c. bananas, mashed 3 c. flour 1/4 tsp. salt 1 1/2 tsp. soda 1/4 c. sour milk 1 c. black walnuts
directions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs and bananas and mix well. Mix flour, salt and soda. Add flour and sour milk alternately to first mixture. Stir in nuts and beat well. Bake in greased loaf pan at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Hot Swiss and Almond Spread
ingredients: 1 pkg. (8 oz.) PHILADELPHIA Cream Cheese, softened 1-1/2 cups shredded KRAFT Swiss Cheese 1/3 cup MIRACLE WHIP Dressing Family Dollar $3.50 thru 02/07 2 Tbsp. chopped green onion 1/8 tsp. ground nutmeg 1/8 tsp. pepper 1/3 cup sliced almonds, toasted Assorted crackers or toasted bread cut-outs
directions: Mix all ingredients except crackers until well blended. Spread mixture into 9-inch pie plate or quiche dish. Bake at 350F for 15 minutes, stirring after 8 minutes. Garnish with additional toasted almonds, if desired. Serve with assorted crackers or toasted bread cut-outs. Microwave: Prepare as directed except for baking. Microwave on MEDIUM (50%) 6 minutes or until Swiss cheese is melted and mixture is warm, stirring after 4 minutes. (Do not overcook.) Stir before serving. Garnish with additional toasted sliced almonds, if desired. Serve with assorted crackers or party rye bread slices.

title: Toasted Shrimp Salad "Boats"
ingredients: 1/2 lb small cooked shrimp 1/2 cup diced celery 1 tbsp chopped chives or minced onion 1 tsp chopped parsley 1 tsp fresh lemon juice 1/4 cup mayonnaise or to taste 6 hotdog buns 1 hot sauce to taste such as franks hot sauce or your favorite 1 shredded lettece 1 butter and garlic powder for toasting buns 1 salt and black pepper to taste
directions: FOR BUNS butter sides of buns and sprinkle with garlic powder toast lightly in skillet combine shrimp with celery,chives,lemon,parsley,salt, pepper,hot sauce and mayonnaise line toasted rolls with shredded lettece add shrimp salad and serve!

title: Double Chocolate Crème Brulée
ingredients: 16 ounces, fluid Heavy Whipping Cream 2 ounces, weight Chocolate -- Whatever You Have! 8 whole Egg Yolks 1/4 cups Cocoa Powder (regular Or Dark) 1/2 cups Granulated Sugar, Plus More For Tops
directions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees. Chop up chocolate. Separate eggs; put 8 yolks into a large bowl (a bowl with a spout to pour from if possible). Whisk in cocoa powder and sugar till most is dissolved. Heat whipping cream on the stove until warm-almost simmering. Remove from the heat and whisk in the chopped chocolate. Whisk till dissolved. Add about half of a cup of the cream/chocolate to the yolk mixture and whisk well (you are tempering the egg yolks so they don't cook too quickly). Add a half cup more and whisk well. Now add all and whisk well. At this point, you can pour it all through a strainer. I didn't want to get anything else dirty, so I skipped this step, and they turned out fine. Put 6 ramekins in a 9 x 13 dish. You may not fit them all in one 9 x 13-that is fine. Pour mixture into ramekins evenly. Pour warm water into the 9 x 13 dish, carefully around the ramekins. Come as close as you can to the top of the ramekins without it making a mess-about halfway up. Bake at 250 degrees for an hour and a half. When creme brulee is done, it will shimmy a little bit but it shouldn't be too liquid-y. Remove creme brulees from the water bath immediately and put in the fridge. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight. This is a great make-ahead dessert. At serving time, sprinkle a spoonful of sugar on top of each; shake off excess into the sink. You just need the layer that sticks to the top. Torch the top, moving quickly over the sugar. You'll see it melt then bubble a bit. Bubbling means it's done. Don't burn and keep the torch moving! If you don't have a torch, put them on the top rack of your oven under the hot broiler. Watch with the door cracked for the sugar to go clear then start to bubble. Take them out as soon as you see some bubbles. Serve!

title: Potato Puff Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef 1/2 c. chopped onion 1/3 c. chopped green pepper 1 Tbsp. chili sauce or catsup 1 can cream of mushroom soup 1/4 c. water 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen Tater Tots
directions: In skillet, combine ground beef, onion and green pepper. Cook over medium heat, breaking up with fork until meat is browned and onion and green peppers are tender. Add chili sauce, undiluted soup and water. Turn into 1 1/2 quart casserole.	Cover; top with frozen Tater Tots. Bake uncovered at 375° for 35 minutes, until Tater Tots are golden brown.

title: Souper Deluxe Hot Dish Mix
ingredients: 1 lb. browned ground beef 1 medium chopped onion 1 1/2 c. chopped celery 1/2 c. Minute rice 1 can cream of mushroom soup 1 can chicken and rice soup 1 c. water 1/2 tsp. salt 1/8 tsp. pepper 1 can mushrooms
directions: Combine ingredients and bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours. Last 1/2 hour, cover with crushed potato chips.

title: Creamy Fruit Pie
ingredients: pastry for 2 (9-inch) pie crusts or make your own 2 (3 oz.) pkg. cream cheese 1 c. sugar 2 Tbsp. milk 1 Tbsp. orange rind 1 c. heavy cream 1/4 c. water 1/2 c. orange juice 1/4 c. lemon juice 2 Tbsp. cornstarch 1 pt. strawberries, hulled and halved 2 medium bananas, sliced 1 (10 oz.) can mandarin oranges, drained 1 small can pineapple chunks, drained 1 kiwi fruit, sliced
directions: Roll out pastry into a 12-inch circle. Place on 12-inch pizza pan or baking sheet. Form 1/2-inch rim; flute edges. Prick crust with fork. Bake at 425° for 12 minutes. Cool on rack.

title: Liver with Onions and Vinegar (Fegato Alla Veneziana)
ingredients: 1 pound fresh calf's liver 2 to 4 tablespoons butter, as desired 2 large Spanish onions, sliced lengthwise into thin strips Salt and pepper, as desired 1 tablespoon vinegar, or as desired Flour for dredging, seasoned with salt and pepper 2 to 4 tablespoons clarified butter for frying 2 tablespoons chopped parsley
directions: Trim liver of veins and membranes. Cut on the diagonal into wide, 1/4-inch slices. Melt the butter in a large skillet. Fry the onions in the butter over medium heat, stirring often, until nicely browned, 10 to 15 minutes. Season to taste with salt, pepper and vinegar. Set aside. Dredge liver pieces with seasoned flour, and shake off excess. In a second large skillet, melt the clarified butter over high heat, and when very hot, drop in the liver pieces, a few at a time. Fry 30 seconds or so on each side. Remove to a serving dish. Liver should still be raw in the center. When all liver pieces have been fried, place the onions in the skillet containing the liver juices and reheat the onions thoroughly, stirring often. Add the liver to the onions, toss briefly to heat through, and turn out onto the serving dish. Sprinkle with chopped parsley.

title: Baked Beans
ingredients: 2 1/4 lb. dry small pea beans 1 c. sugar (heaping) 2 1/4 tsp. dry mustard 4 1/2 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. pepper 1/4 tsp. ginger 4 1/2 Tbsp. dark Karo syrup 4 1/2 Tbsp. molasses 1/2 lb. salt pork 1 onion hot water
directions: Inspect beans; wash and cover with water. Soak overnight. In the morning, drain the beans. Cover with fresh water; simmer for 15 minutes. Drain and rinse with water. Scrape and score salt pork. You may chop onion, or bury it whole in center of beans. Add remainder of ingredients to beans with enough water to cover. Top with salt pork. Bake in a 250° oven for 8 hours. Add water when necessary.

title: Easy Brunswick Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs beef (cubed for stewing) 2 -3 boneless skinless chicken breasts 1 large sweet onion (chopped) 5 lbs potatoes (diced) 3 (14 3/4 ounce) cans cream-style corn 1 (11 ounce) can white shoepeg corn (may use frozen) 2 (28 ounce) cans crushed tomatoes 1/4 cup butter 1/4 cup sugar salt & pepper 4 tablespoons texas pete hot sauce
directions: The night before I make this brunswick stew I placed the beef and the chicken in my crock pot with alot of water (about 3/4 of the crock pot is filled with meat and water). Cook on low all night. Next morning, strain meat (set aside) and put liquid in stock pot on stove over med high heat. Add chopped onions and potatoes to the broth. Cook until tender. When tender, chop with a potato masher. Cook until it starts to become thick. While onions & potatoes are cooking, chop meat up until no chunks are found. Add to onion & potato mixture. Add remaining ingredients. Rinse tomato cans with 1/4 can water and add to stew. Cook on low or simmer for 4-5 hours.

title: Fruit Dip
ingredients: 1 can unsweetened fruit cocktail, drained well 1 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese
directions: Mix together in blender. Chill and serve with fresh fruit.

title: Jam Cake
ingredients: 1 c. shortening 2 c. sugar 1 c. sour milk 3 c. flour 1 c. raisins 1 c. nuts 1 c. jam (strawberry) 4 eggs, beaten in one at a time 1 tsp. soda 1 tsp. salt 1 tsp. cinnamon 1 tsp. cloves 1 tsp. allspice
directions: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs and spices. Mix soda with milk and add with flour. Add jam, raisins and nuts. Bake for 25 minutes at 375°.

title: Sweet and Spicy BBQ Shrimp
ingredients: 2 lbs large shrimp, peeled and deveined 12 cup mae ploy chili sauce 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes 2 large garlic cloves, minced 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice 2 tablespoons tequila 1 tablespoon creole seasoning
directions: mix chili sauce, garlic, lime, red pepper flakes, tequila and creole seasoning together in a mixing bowl. Add Shrimp and marinate for 30 minutes. Skewer shrimp on soaked bamboo sticks and BBQ for about 4-5 minutes on each side on your BBQ grill. Serve with grilled veggies and rice or just lay out on lettuce on a platter at a BBQ.

title: Cooking Light'S Flaky Buttermilk Biscuits
ingredients: 9 ounces all-purpose flour (about 2 cups) 2 1/2 teaspoons baking powder 1/2 teaspoon salt 5 tablespoons butter, chilled and cut into small pieces 3/4 cup fat-free buttermilk 3 tablespoons honey
directions: Preheat oven to 400°. Combine flour, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl; cut in butter with a pastry blender or 2 knives until mixture resembles coarse meal. Chill 10 minutes. Combine buttermilk and honey, stirring with a whisk until well blended. Add buttermilk mixture to flour mixture; stir just until moist. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface; knead lightly 4 times. Roll dough into a (1/2-inch-thick) 9 x 5-inch rectangle; dust top of dough with flour. Fold dough crosswise into thirds (as if folding a piece of paper to fit into an envelope). Reroll dough into a (1/2-inch-thick) 9 x 5-inch rectangle; dust top of dough with flour. Fold dough crosswise into thirds; gently roll or pat to a 3/4-inch thickness. Cut dough with a 1 3/4-inch biscuit cutter to form 14 dough rounds. Place dough rounds, 1 inch apart, on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake at 400° for 12 minutes or until golden. Remove from pan; cool 2 minutes on wire racks. Serve warm.

title: Creamy Burger Mushroom Sauce
ingredients: 1 tbsp butter 2 tsp granulated beef bouillon 1/2 cup dairy sour cream 1 (4 ounce) can mushroom pieces and stems, drained (I use Green Giant)
directions: In a small saucepan, combine butter, bouillon, and mushrooms. Cook until heated through; remove from heat. Stir in sour cream. Spoon onto cooked hamburgers.

title: Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. butter 1/2 Tbsp. flour salt and pepper to taste pinch of cayenne pepper 1 c. milk 1 egg yolk 1 Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
directions: Melt butter in small saucepan and stir in flour; salt and pepper to taste. Add milk, stirring continuously until sauce thickens. Remove pan from heat and stir in the egg yolk. Stir in the cheese. Makes about 1 1/4 cups.

title: White Lightning Texas Chili
ingredients: 1 lb. dried navy beans 4 (14 1/2 oz.) cans chicken broth 1 large onion, chopped 2 cloves garlic, minced 1 Tbsp. ground white pepper 1 Tbsp. dried oregano 1 Tbsp. ground cumin 1 tsp. salt 1/2 tsp. cloves 5 c. cooked chicken 2 (4 oz.) cans chopped green chilies 1 seeded and chopped jalapeno pepper 8 (8-inch) flour tortillas salsa sour cream shredded Monterey Jack cheese
directions: Sort and wash beans. Cover with water and soak overnight (or at least 8 hours). Drain the beans and place in a large pot. Add 3 cans of broth and the next 7 ingredients. Bring this mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer and cover. Simmer for 2 hours or until beans are tender. Add the fourth can of broth, the chicken and the next 3 ingredients. Cover and simmer for 1 hour. Layer the bottom of a large casserole dish with the tortillas. Cover with the chili. Add the salsa, sour cream and cheese as desired.

title: Coconut Cake
ingredients: 1 white cake mix 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand milk 1 (7 oz.) can cream of coconut Cool Whip 1 c. chopped pecans 1 c. shredded coconut
directions: Prepare cake mix according to package directions. While it is still hot, punch holes in the top and pour the Eagle Brand and cream of coconut over the top. Allow to cool completely. Top with Cool Whip, nuts and coconut.

title: Mim'S Mess
ingredients: 1 layer sliced potatoes 1 layer sliced onions grated cheese rice 1 can tomato soup 1 lb. ground beef 1 bell pepper salt and pepper 1 can water
directions: Place in a 2-quart casserole dish in order: 1 layer of potatoes, 1 layer of onions. Cover with green pepper. Brown ground beef and drain. Layer over other layers. Layer grated cheese. Sprinkle with uncooked rice. Cover with tomato soup and can of water. Bake at 325° for 2 hours.

title: Plum Cake
ingredients: 2 c. self-rising flour 2 c. sugar 3 eggs 2 small jars plums (baby food) 1 tsp. cinnamon 1 tsp. ground cloves 1 c. Wesson oil 1 c. pecans, chopped fine
directions: Mix all ingredients. Bake in tube pan for 1 hour at 325°.

title: Fresh Fruit In Balsamic Pepper Syrup
ingredients: 5 tablespoons honey 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar 1/4 teaspoon coarsely ground black pepper 1 pint fresh strawberries, hulled and halved 1 pint fresh blueberries
directions: Stir honey and balsamic vinegar together in a bowl until well blended. Stir in pepper. Add strawberries and blueberries; stir gently to coat with honey and balsamic vinegar. Let stand at room temperature until flavors combine, 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Dump Cake
ingredients: 1 large can crushed pineapple 1 c. cherry pie filling 1 pkg. dry yellow cake mix 1 can coconut 1 c. nuts 2 sticks butter
directions: Layer first 5 ingredients in a 13 x 9-inch cake pan. Melt butter and pour evenly over ingredients. Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

title: Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 2 to 3 peeled, sliced cucumbers 1/2 head chopped cabbage 1 sliced onion 1/2 c. sugar 1/2 c. oil 1/2 c. vinegar 1/4 tsp. celery seed
directions: Place cucumbers, cabbage and onion in large bowl. Mix well in saucepan. Heat oil, vinegar and sugar. Heat just to boiling point. Pour over vegetable mixture. Sprinkle with celery seed. Mix well. Chill 2 or 3 hours. (Can add shredded red cabbage and shredded carrots.) Serves 6 to 8.

title: Upside-Down Apple Pie(Opp-Ned Eple Pie)
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. flour 1/2 c. Crisco 1/4 c. water salt 1 tsp. lemon juice 1/3 c. brown sugar 1 Tbsp. flour 1/2 tsp. cinnamon 1/2 tsp. nutmeg 1/4 tsp. salt
directions: Mix together in a bowl. Sprinkle mixture over apples. Roll out the other pastry and place on top of the apple mixture. Punch holes for steam to escape. Bake at 450° for 10 minutes and at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Apple Crisp No-Bake Cheesecake
ingredients: Crust 1 qt. graham cracker crumbs 3/4 cup sugar 3/4 cup unsalted butter, melted Filling 3 qt. milk 2-1/2 qt. JELL-O Brand Cheesecake Filling Mix 1 Tbsp. ground cinnamon 2 qt. Canned or frozen sliced apples, well drained Streusel Topping 1 qt. vanilla wafers, chopped 3/4 cup unsalted butter, melted 1 tsp. ground cinnamon 1 cup caramel ice cream topping
directions: Crust: Mix graham crumbs, sugar and butter until well blended. Press onto bottoms of 4 (9-inch) springform pans (or onto bottom of 1 springform pan for trial recipe), using about 1 cup of the crumb mixture for each crust. Filling: Pour milk into large bowl of mixer fitted with wire whip attachment. Add cheesecake mix and cinnamon. Beat 30 sec. or just until cheesecake mix is moistened. Scrape bowl. Beat on medium speed 2 min. (Do not overbeat.) Gently stir in apples. Spoon evenly over crusts. Refrigerate 2 hours. Streusel Topping: Combine chopped wafers, butter and cinnamon. Sprinkle evenly over cheesecakes, using about 1 cup of the crumb mixture for each cheesecake. Drizzle with caramel topping.

title: Easy To Do Oven Bbq Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup ketchup 1/2 cup honey 1/4 cup red wine vinegar 4 cloves garlic, minced 4 tablespoons olive oil 6 cut up chicken pieces
directions: In a medium, nonreactive bowl, combine the ketchup, honey, vinegar and garlic. Mix well, cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add the chicken parts and saute for 2 to 3 minutes per side, just to sear the meat. Transfer chicken to a 9x13 baking dish and cover each piece well with the reserved sauce. Bake at 350 degrees F (175 degrees C) for 35 to 45 minutes, basting with the sauce every 15 minutes.

title: Pickled Turnips Or Radishes
ingredients: 2 cups baby turnips, cut in thin wedges (about 1/4 to 1/3 inch at the widest point), or sliced in half-moons 1/2 cup (135 grams) seasoned rice wine vinegar 1 tablespoon (15 grams) sherry vinegar 1/4 cup (50 grams) sugar 1 cup (230 grams) water 2 1/4 teaspoons (10 grams) kosher salt
directions: 1. Place the turnips in a bowl or jar. 2. In a large bowl, combine the rice wine vinegar, sherry vinegar and sugar. Bring the water to a boil, remove from the heat and add to the vinegar and sugar mixture. Stir until the sugar is dissolved. Add the salt and stir well. Pour over the turnips, cover and refrigerate for at least 2 days before eating and for up to 2 weeks. Shake the jar from time to time or, if you use a bowl, place a saucer on top of the turnips to keep them submerged. Remove from the brine with a slotted spoon to serve. Advance preparation: These benefit from a week or longer in brine and will last for a couple of weeks. Variation: Pickled Radishes This isn't really a variation, though radishes can look a lot like baby red turnips. They're not as pungent and require less time in the brine. Slice the radishes or, if they're large, cut in half-moons. Cover with the brine and eat within a few days. They don't benefit from a long brining period as turnips do.

title: Chocolate Crackle-Top Cookies
ingredients: 1-3/4 cups flour 2 tsp. CALUMET Baking Powder 1/2 tsp. salt 1/2 cup butter, softened 1-2/3 cups packed brown sugar 2 eggs 1 tsp. vanilla 2 oz. BAKER'S Unsweetened Chocolate, melted 1/4 cup powdered sugar
directions: Combine flour, baking powder and salt. Beat butter and brown sugar in large bowl with mixer until light and fluffy. Add eggs and vanilla; mix well. Blend in chocolate. Gradually add flour mixture, mixing well after each addition. Refrigerate 3 hours. Heat oven to 350 degrees F. Shape dough into 36 (1-inch) balls. Roll, 1 at a time, in powdered sugar until evenly coated. Place, 4 inches apart, on parchment-covered baking sheets. Bake 15 min. or until tops are cracked and centers are almost set. Cool 2 min. on baking sheet. Remove to wire racks; cool completely.

title: Egg Wash
ingredients: 1 large egg 1 teaspoon heavy cream (preferably) or 1 teaspoon whole milk
directions: Beat egg and cream or milk in small bowl until combined. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to use. Preparation time is the cooking time I did not include the time for the pies to bake as it is an unknown.

title: Pineapple Walnut Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can chunk pineapple in syrup boiling water 1/2 c. walnuts vegetable oil 1 whole chicken breast, split, boned and sliced 1 large clove garlic, pressed 1 medium onion, sliced 2 Tbsp. chopped ginger root 1/2 lb. broccoli, cut in florets 3 Tbsp. soy sauce 1 Tbsp. cornstarch
directions: Drain pineapple, reserving syrup. Pour boiling water over walnuts. Let stand 2 minutes. Drain. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in wok or skillet. Stir-fry walnuts until brown. Remove and drain. Add oil as needed. Stir-fry chicken, garlic, onion and ginger until chicken turns white. Remove. Add broccoli. Stir-fry until tender-crisp. Return nuts and chicken mixture to wok. Add pineapple. Combine syrup, soy sauce and cornstarch. Stir into pineapple mixture. Cook until sauce boils and thickens. Serve with rice. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Chicken With Buttermilk Dumplings
ingredients: 1 (2 1/2 to 3 lb.) chicken 1 small onion 2 c. flour 1/2 tsp. soda 1/2 tsp. salt 1/4 c. shortening 1 egg, beaten 3/4 to 1 c. buttermilk 1 can cream of chicken soup 1 to 1 1/2 c. milk
directions: Combine chicken, onion and enough water to cover in a large pan; cook until tender. Remove chicken from broth, reserving broth. Debone chicken. Sift flour, soda and salt together into mixing bowl. Cut in shortening. Blend egg and buttermilk. Stir enough buttermilk mixture to form dough. Roll thin on lightly floured board. Cut into short strips. Combine chicken, soup and broth; bring to a rolling boil, stirring. Drop in dumplings and cook until tender. Add milk and bring to a boil. Serve immediately. Makes 8 servings.

title: Fried Corn
ingredients: 6 (8 oz.) ears garden fresh corn 3 Tbsp. bacon drippings 3 Tbsp. oleo 1 tsp. salt or to taste 1 tsp. sugar (optional) dash of black pepper
directions: Cut corn kernels and scrape milk from cobs. Melt fats in heavy iron skillet. Add corn and seasonings. Stir constantly as it cooks. Use low heat and cook until it is thick and tender, about 15 to 20 minutes. Serves 4 to 6 people.

title: Sauerkraut Salad(A Minute On The Lips, A Lifetime On The Hips.)
ingredients: 1 (27 oz.) can sauerkraut, rinsed and drained 1 green pepper, chopped (3/4 c.) 1 medium onion, chopped (1/2 c.) 1/3 c. chopped celery 1 tsp. celery seed 1 1/2 c. sugar 2/3 c. vinegar 1/2 c. vegetable oil 1/3 c. water
directions: Combine the first 5 ingredients. Mix the remaining ingredients. You may heat second mixture to dissolve sugar, if you want. Pour over kraut mixture. Chill 24 hours. Serves 4.

title: Split Pea Soup
ingredients: 2 c. dry split peas 2 c. fine cubed ham or pork 2 qt. water 1 c. chopped onion 1 c. chopped celery and leaves 1 c. chopped carrots 1 clove garlic, chopped 1 bay leaf 1 tsp. sugar 1/2 tsp. thyme dash of cayenne (optional) 2 Tbsp. butter 2 Tbsp. flour
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients in large kettle and bring to a boil. Then set back to simmer and cover, cooking for 1 hour. At this time, add all the vegetables and spices up to the optional cayenne. Cook until tender. Put soup through a blender using puree to coarse setting then return to kettle. You may have to add some broth or water. Finally, to bind and thicken soup, mix butter which is melted with flour and a little soup. Return all this to the rest of the soup and stir until thickened. Serve with cornbread or just crackers. Keeps well after cooling in the refrigerator. Take out what you want; add a little water; heat and eat.

title: Beef And Cheese Tortilla Casserole
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. salad oil 1 lb. ground beef 1 medium onion, chopped 2 tsp. instant coffee 1 tsp. salt 1 tsp. pepper 1/2 c. water 2 c. shredded Longhorn cheese 3 tsp. chili powder 2 (8 oz.) cans tomato sauce 12 corn tortillas 1 (3 oz.) pkg. cream cheese
directions: Brown beef, add onion and saute 3 minutes. Pour off grease. Stir in coffee, salt, pepper, chili powder and 1 can tomato sauce. Heat to simmering. Spread each tortilla with cream cheese. Place about 1/2 cup of meat mixture over cheese on half of each tortilla. Arrange with folded edge up in 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Pour remaining meat in spaces around tortillas. Pour remaining can of sauce and water over top. Sprinkle with cheese, cover and bake at 375° for 25 minutes.

title: Fruity Apple Rings
ingredients: 2 apple rings, slices 2 tablespoons cream cheese 2 tablespoons post Fruity Pebbles cereal
directions: Spread cream cheese over apple rings. Sprinkle with Post Fruity Pebles Cereal. Enjoy. You want to slice your apple rings about 1/4 to 1/2 inch thick.

title: Flag Cake
ingredients: 2 c. Flour, sifted 1 tbsp. Baking Powder 1/4 tsp. Salt 4 jumbo Eggs 2 c. Sugar 1 tsp. Lemon Extract 1 pt. Fresh Strawberries 1 tsp. Vanilla Extract 1 c. Milk, scalded 1 pt. Whipping Cream 1/2 c. Confectioners Sugar 1/2-1 tsp. Vanilla 50 Fresh Whole Blueberries, dry
directions: Grease 13 x 9 pan, line with wax paper. Grease again. Sift Flour, baking powder and salt and set aside. In another bowl, beat eggs and add sugar and extracts. Scald milk and add to dry ingredients. Add egg mixture. Pour into prepared pan and bake at 350° for 35-40 minutes. When done, let cool in pan at least 30 minutes. Whip the cream and add confectioners sugar and vanilla. Slice the strawberries. Slice cake lengthwise. Take 1 1/2 cups of frosting mixture and add strawberries (reserve enough for garnish) and spread for filling. Add top layer and frost with remaining cream. With remaining strawberries, make 4 rows to form stripes and the 50 blueberries to form starts.

title: Roast Beef Tenderloin With Cognac Butter
ingredients: Cognac butter: 1 1/2 teaspoons butter 3 tablespoons minced shallots 3 tablespoons cognac 6 1/2 tablespoons butter, softened 1 tablespoon fresh thyme leaves 1/8 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper Tenderloin: 1 tablespoon Dijon mustard 2 teaspoons honey 1 teaspoon lower-sodium soy sauce 3/4 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 1 (2-pound) beef tenderloin, trimmed 2 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme Cooking spray
directions: To prepare cognac butter, melt 1 1/2 teaspoons butter in a small nonstick skillet over medium-low heat. Add shallots; cook 2 minutes or until tender, stirring shallots occasionally. Carefully stir in cognac; cook 1 minute or until liquid is reduced by about one-third. Remove from heat; cool. Place 6 1/2 tablespoons butter in a small bowl; stir in cooled cognac mixture, 1 tablespoon thyme leaves, and 1/8 teaspoon black pepper. Cover and chill 10 minutes. Divide butter mixture in half. Scrape each half of butter mixture onto a piece of plastic wrap; shape each portion into a 4-inch-long log. Wrap each butter log in plastic wrap; refrigerate or freeze 1 log for another use. Preheat oven to 425°. To prepare tenderloin, combine mustard and next 4 ingredients (through 1/2 teaspoon pepper); stir with a whisk. Spread mustard mixture over all sides of tenderloin; sprinkle with 2 tablespoons thyme. Place tenderloin in a shallow roasting pan coated with cooking spray. Bake at 425° for 38 minutes or until a thermometer inserted in center of tenderloin registers 135° or until desired degree of doneness. Let stand 10 minutes. Cut tenderloin crosswise into 16 slices. Arrange 2 slices on each of 8 plates. Cut 1 butter log into 8 slices; top each serving with 1 butter slice.

title: Crab-Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 cup crabmeat 12 cup cream cheese 12 cup chopped fresh parsley leaves 12 cup chopped green onion 4 tablespoons parmesan cheese 2 portobello mushroom caps or 10 white mushroom caps 12 cup breadcrumbs salt, to taste pepper, to taste nonstick cooking spray
directions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F. Combine crabmeat, cream cheese, parsley, green onions and Parmesan. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Stuff the mushrooms with the mixture and top with bread crumbs. Spray the tops with the nonstick spray to help them brown. Transfer to oven and bake for about 20 minutes, or until the filling is hot and melted.

title: Italian Vegetable Casserole
ingredients: 1 eggplant, sliced 1 red bell pepper, sliced in rings 1 onion, sliced 16 ounces mushrooms, sliced 2 zucchini, sliced 2 tablespoons olive oil 3 cups spaghetti sauce 1 cup fresh mozzarella cheese, shredded
directions: Brush vegetables with olive oil. Grill or pan fry until soft. Spray a 9 X 13 baking dish with non-stick vegetable oil spray. Spoon enough sauce in bottom to cover. Layer vegetables. Add sauce every couple of layers. Finish with sauce and then cheese. Bake at 400 until hot and cheese is browned. Servings and Cook Time estimated.

title: Spicy Corned Beef
ingredients: 5 lbs piece corned beef 1/4 teaspoon dried rosemary 1 bay leaf 1 teaspoon dill seed 6 whole cloves 1 cinnamon stick 1 garlic clove 1 medium onion, cut in chunks 2 celery ribs, cut in chunks 1/2 orange, unpeeled, cut in chunks GLAZE 1/2 cup chili sauce 1 cup water 1/2 cup brown sugar, packed
directions: in a large stockpot, combine all of the ingredients except the glaze and cover with warm water. Bring to a boil and simmer, covered, over medium-low heat for 40 minutes per pound, approximately 2 1/2 hours. the meat should be tender, but not falling apart. remove the beef from the broth, cover and cool, then refrigerate overnight. when the meat is cold, slice it very thinly and place in a 9x13" serving dish. cover and refrigerate. to serve, preheat the oven to 350*. make the glaze by combining the chili sauce and water. pour just enough glaze over beef to moisten it well.it should not cover the meat entirely. sprinkle the brown sugar over the top and bake the beef, uncovered for 30 minutes -- or untl the meat is heated through and the sugar is a bit crackly.you may want to turn up the heat to broil for a minute or two to achieve this effect.

title: Chicken And Dumplings
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb. chicken, cut up 1 tsp. salt 1 tsp. pepper 2 c. all-purpose flour 1/2 c. milk 1/2 c. water 1 1/2 c. milk
directions: Cover chicken with water. Salt and pepper. Boil over medium heat for 30 minutes. Remove from broth.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
ingredients: 6 medium sliced potatoes 1 can condensed mushroom soup 1 oz. butter 1 c. grated Cheddar cheese 1 small onion, chopped 1 can condensed Cheddar soup 1 c. sliced mushrooms salt and pepper to taste
directions: Combine ingredients in baking dish. Bake at 375° about 1 hour or until potatoes are tender. Top with grated cheese. Put back in oven until cheese is golden brown.

title: Beef Stroganoff Casserole
ingredients: nonstick cooking spray 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 cup onion chopped 2 cloves garlic minced 1 1/2 pounds ground beef 85% lean 1/4 teaspoon salt for beef 1/8 teaspoon pepper for beef 1 cup tomato sauce 1 cup cottage cheese small curd 4 ounces cream cheese chopped into small pieces 1/4 teaspoon salt for filling 1/8 teaspoon black pepper for filling 3 1/2 cups egg noodles cooked and drained, about 8 oz. uncooked 1 cup cheddar cheese shredded 1 tablespoon parsley chopped
directions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Spray 9x13-inch baking pan with cooking spray and set aside. Heat olive oil in a large saute pan over medium-high heat then add onion and cook 2-3 minutes, until translucent. Add garlic and cook another 30 seconds, until fragrant. Add ground beef and cook 5-6 minutes, occasionally stirring and breaking up with a wooden spoon. Once cooked, carefully drain any excess fat from pan. Season with salt and pepper. Add tomato sauce, cottage cheese, cream cheese, salt and pepper and cook 2-3 minutes, stirring to melt cream cheese. Add cooked noodles and toss to coat. Transfer mixture to prepared baking pan and spread into an even layer. Top with cheese. Transfer pan to oven and cook 20-25 minutes, until bubbling. Check to see that casserole is done. Remove from oven or add time as needed. Allow to cool in pan for 10 minutes. Serve garnished with parsley.

title: Ghirardelli® Chocolate Saltine Toffee
ingredients: 2 Cup(s) Unsalted butter, cut into pieces 5 Ounce(s) Sliced almonds, toasted 60 Ounce(s) Saltine crackers 5 Ounce(s) Ghirardelli 60% Cacao Bittersweet Chocolate Chips 2 Cup(s) granulated sugar. 2 Tbsp(s) corn syrup
directions: In a half sheet pan lined with parchment paper, lay out saltine crackers, salt side down, in a single layer. Set aside. In a medium-size sauce pot, combine sugar, butter and corn syrup. Place over medium heat until butter melts, stirring continuously. Increase to high heat and cook until mixture registers 350°F on a candy thermometer, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat and carefully pour mixture over saltines, spreading evenly. Let sit a few minutes and then sprinkle chocolate over toffee. Once chocolate melts, spread in an even layer over toffee. Sprinkle sliced almonds on top. Freeze until chocolate sets. Once the chocolate is set, break into pieces.

title: French Roast Beef
ingredients: 3 Tablespoons Table Salt 2 Tablespoons Garlic Salt 1 Tablespoon Black Pepper 1 Tablespoon Vegetable Shortening 1 whole Sirloin Tip Roast
directions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees. In a small bowl, combine the salt, garlic salt, and pepper. Wipe off the roast with a wet paper towel. Rub seasoning into the roast and brown in a pan (make sure the pan you use is okay to place in an oven and has a lid!) over medium heat. Put the pan with the lid on top in the oven for 20 minutes. Do NOT open the oven door. Once the twenty minutes are over, turn the oven off and leave it in without opening for 12 hours. Once the 12 hours are up, you may refrigerate it till ready to serve and reheat in the oven on a low temperature covered in foil. (The size of the roast is up to youthe smaller the roast, the less seasoning you use!)

title: Deviled Crabmeat
ingredients: 5 (6 1/2 oz.) cans crabmeat 1 stick butter, melted 1/2 c. seasoned breadcrumbs 3 Tbsp. chopped parsley 3 tsp. prepared mustard 1 generous half c. milk 1 1/2 Tbsp. lemon juice 1 1/3 Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce 4 or 5 Tbsp. Parmesan cheese, grated
directions: Mix half the butter with all the other ingredients except the cheese. Put in 6 shallow ovenproof ramekins. Pour remaining butter over them and sprinkle the Parmesan cheese on top. Bake at 425° for 10 minutes.

title: Salmon Loaf
ingredients: 1/2 pkg. Stove Top stuffing (small box) 1/2 pkg. Stove Top seasoning 1 Tbsp grated onion (optional) 1 16 oz. can salmon, including juice 1 Tbsp grated green pepper (optional) 2 c. cubed chicken 1/2 c. onion, chopped 1/2 c. celery, chopped 1/4 c. green pepper, chopped 1/2 c. mayonnaise
directions: Mix and pour over first half of bread cubes. Add remaining cubes. Beat 2 eggs slightly and add 1 1/2 c. milk and pour over top of mixture and let stand 1 hour or over night. When ready to use, spoon 1 can of cream of mushroom soup over. Sprinkle buttered cubes over top.

title: Asian Stir Fry Recipe
ingredients: 6 Tbsp. Cornstarch 3/4 tsp Galric pwdr 2 1/4 tsp Intant beef boullion granules 3/4 tsp Onion pwdr 6 Tbsp. Wine vinegar 6 Tbsp. Water 1 1/2 tsp Grated fresh ginger 3/4 c. Soy sauce 3/4 c. Dark corn syrup 2 2/3 c. Water
directions: Makes about 5 c. Combine cornstarch,garlic pwdr,bouillon granules,and onion pwdr. Use a whisk to stir in vinegar, 6 Tbsp. water and ginger till cornstarch is dissolved. stir in soy sauce, corn syrup and 2 2/3 c. water. Pour into a 5 c. container. Store in refrigerator and use withiin 4 weeks. Stir well before using.

title: Barbecue Sauce Made In Heaven Recipe
ingredients: 1/2 lb light brown sugar (half of a 1-lb. box, 1 c. plus 2 Tbsp.) 1 c. ketchup 1/2 c. Worcestershire sauce 1/4 c. plus 2 Tbsp. honey 1/2 c. cider vinegar 3 x green onions (white and green parts), chopped 2 x cloves garlic, chopped 8 whl cloves 1/2 x bay leaf 2 Tbsp. dry mustard 1/2 tsp crumbled dry rosemary 1/2 tsp grnd or possibly crumbled dry oregano 1/4 tsp grnd black pepper 1/2 tsp grnd cayenne pepper Few drops liquid smoke 2 Tbsp. butter 1 Tbsp. lemon juice
directions: In a medium saucepan, mix together brown sugar, ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, honey, vinegar, green onions, garlic, cloves, bay leaf, dry mustard, rosemary, oregano, pepper and cayenne. Over medium heat, heat through, then simmer for about 30 to 45 min; add in liquid smoke, butter and lemon juice, simmer gently 5 more min. Strain and throw out solids. Serve hot. Book/Legendary American Recipes" by Patricia Colarco

title: Classic Grilled Chicken Caesar
ingredients: 2 cups KRAFT Light Classic Caesar Reduced Fat Dressing 1 cup KRAFT 100% Shredded Parmesan Cheese - Full Moisture 2-1/4 gal. romaine lettuce, torn 2 qt. boneless skinless chicken breasts, grilled, sliced 2 qt. grape tomatoes 1 qt. cucumbers, thinly sliced
directions: Mix dressing and cheese until well blended. Toss lettuce with chicken, tomatoes and cucumbers in large bowl. Add dressing mixture just before serving; mix lightly.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
ingredients: 2 c. yellow corn meal 2 Tbsp. sugar 1/2 c. oil 4 eggs 1 can creamed corn 1 c. onions, chopped 1 c. flour 3 tsp. baking powder 1 tsp. salt 1 c. milk 1 1/2 c. shredded cheese 3 to 6 jalapeno peppers
directions: Combine all ingredients and bake in a greased pan 25 to 30 minutes at 375°.

title: Pickled Blueberries
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons whole mixed pickling spices 1 3/4 cups sugar 1 1/2 cups cider vinegar 3/4 cup water 1 cinnamon stick 2 pints blueberries, washed and picked over
directions: Tie pickling spice ia a double-thickness cheesecloth bag. Stir together spice bag, sugar, vinegar, water and cinnamon stick in a large nonaluminum saucepan. Simmer, uncovered, 20 minutes. Add blueberries; simmer 3 minutes or just until berries become softened. Pour mixture into a large bowl. Cover and refrigerate overnight. To serve, remove spice bag and cinnamon stick and use slotted spoon to serve. If not using immediately, spoon into sterilized canning jars. Refrigerate.

title: Ritz Pie
ingredients: 3 egg whites (room temperature) 1 c. sugar 1/2 tsp. baking powder 14 Ritz crackers, crushed (not too fine) 2/3 c. chopped walnuts 1/2 pt. whipping cream vanilla
directions: Beat egg whites until dry, stiff peaks form. Gradually add sugar and baking powder, beating well after each addition. Add crushed Ritz crackers and chopped nuts. Bake in an 8 or 9-inch well-greased pie plate. Preheat oven to 350°, then bake pie at 325° for 30 minutes. Cool pie. Cover with whipped cream flavored with vanilla.

title: Berry Simple Smoothie
ingredients: 2 cups frozen unsweetened strawberries 1 cup plain fat-free yogurt 12 cup light cranberry juice 14 cup Splenda granular (sugar substitute)
directions: Combine in a blender until smooth.

title: Banana Bread
ingredients: 1/3 c. vegetable oil 1 1/2 c. mashed bananas 1/2 tsp. vanilla 1/2 c. chopped nuts 3 eggs 2 1/2 c. Bisquick 1 c. sugar
directions: Beat all ingredients vigorously with spoon. Pour batter in pan. Bake at 350° until toothpick comes out clean. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Quick And Easy Party Meat Balls
ingredients: 3 to 5 lb. ground beef 1 to 2 packets Lipton onion soup mix 2 to 3 jars Heinz chili sauce 10 to 12 oz. jar Welch's grape jelly 1 to 2 eggs
directions: Mix ground beef, eggs and soup mix real good. Roll into 1-inch balls. Cook at 350° until brown. While meat balls are cooking, in a large saucepan, mix chili sauce and jelly, heating to boiling. When meat balls are cooked, add them to the sauce. Cover and simmer on warm heat until ready to serve. The meat balls can be made ahead of time and placed in the freezer until you want to have a party.

title: Melt In Your Mouth Sugar Cookies
ingredients: BEAT TOGETHER 1 cup margarine 1 cup white sugar 1 cup powdered sugar THEN ADD 2 beaten eggs 1 teaspoon salt 1 cup Wesson Oil 2 teaspoons vanilla SIFT AND ADD 4 cups flour, plus 4 tablespoons flour 1 teaspoon baking soda 1 teaspoon cream of tartar
directions: Refrigerate the dough until chilled. Then roll into balls and place on greased cookie sheet. Press with glass dipped in sugar. Bake in 350 degree oven about 8 to 10 minutes. Bet you can't stop yourself from eating these!

title: Four Layer Chocolate Dessert
ingredients: 1 c. self-rising flour 1 stick oleo, melted 2 Tbsp. sugar 1 c. chopped pecans 1 c. powdered sugar 12 oz. carton Cool Whip 2 (3 oz.) pkg. chocolate pudding mix 3 3/4 c. cold milk
directions: First Layer: Mix melted oleo, flour and sugar. Add pecans; mix well. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 375° for about 15 minutes or until lightly brown and cool.

title: Strawberry Pie
ingredients: 1/2 pt. strawberries 6 tsp. cornstarch 4 Tbsp. strawberry gelatin 1 c. sugar 1 pie shell Cool Whip
directions: Mix cornstarch and sugar; stir in 1 cup of water and cook until thickened. Add gelatin to mixture. Place fresh strawberries in cooked pie shell (better if the berries are cut in half). Pour mixture over them. Refrigerate. Serve with Cool Whip on top.

title: Firehouse Chili
ingredients: 2 lb. ground beef 1 tbsp. butter 1 large onion, chopped 1 green pepper, chopped 1 tsp. salt 1 tsp. black pepper 1 tsp. cayenne pepper(use cautiously) 2 1 lb. cans whole tomatoes 3 small cans dark red kidney beans
directions: In a large saucepan saute beef, onion, green pepper, salt, black pepper and cayenne in 1 tbsp. butter until browned. Add tomatoes and kidney beans and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes. Great served with warm breadsticks or garlic bread.

title: Dakota Dish
ingredients: 2 lb. hamburger 1 onion, chopped 5 potatoes, cubed 1 large can pork and beans 1 large can tomatoes
directions: Brown hamburger with onion. In a large casserole, mix together with beans, tomatoes and potatoes. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. (Potatoes can be precooked to speed up baking.)

title: "Cholesterol-Free" Shrimp Cocktail
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower 1 c. catsup 4 Tbsp. lemon juice 4 Tbsp. minced onion 4 Tbsp. minced parsley 1 to 1 1/2 Tbsp. horseradish 6 drops Worcestershire
directions: Steam or microwave cauliflower (pulled apart somewhat) until shrimp consistency (steaming about 5 minutes). Rinse immediately in cold water. Break cauliflower into bite size when cool. Arrange on serving platter. Combine remaining ingredients as low calorie cocktail sauce, taste it and you will think you are eating shrimp.

title: Banana Rum Cake W/ Caramel Sauce
ingredients: 1 box yellow cake mix 1/2 teaspoon baking soda 1/2 cup rum Rave Review Culinary 2 eggs 1/4 cup sour cream 4 bananas ripe 2 tablespoons vegetable oil 1/2 cup powdered sugar 3 tablespoons butter 2 tablespoons vanilla Nielsen Massey 2 tablespoons spiced rum Rave Review
directions: Preheat Oven 350 degrees In a mix-master combine the eggs, sour cream, Rave Review Culinary Rum, baking powder, vegetable oil and bananas; mix on low speed until smooth; add the cake mix and continue mixing until smooth. Butter a bundt pan and pour the batter evenly into the pan. Bake 25 - 30 minutes or until the toothpick test comes out clean. Let cool and gently remove from pan. For the Drizzle In a small sauce pot combine all of the ingredients for the drizzle and stir on low heat until smooth. Let the drizzle stand for a minute to cool a bit and then drizzle over the cake.

title: Parmesan Cheese Bread
ingredients: 1 cup milk (scalded) 3 tablespoons sugar 1 tablespoon salt 1 tablespoon butter 1 cup warm water 2 (1/4 ounce) packages dry yeast 1 cup grated parmesan cheese 4 1/2 cups flour
directions: Mix the milk, sugar, salt, and margarine together. In a small bowl mix the warm water (115 degrees) and the yeast; mix well; proof for a few minutes. Add the yeast mixture to the above milk mixture. Add the cheese. Add the flour to the right consistency. Knead 100 times. Put in a greased bowl and rise in a warm place till double in bulk--about 1 hour. Knead again for about 1/2 minute. Put into 2 small greased bread pans. Bake at 375 degrees for 1 hour being careful not to burn it; if it starts to look too brown, cover it with foil and continue baking. NOTE: If you four-times this recipe, it will make 5 good size loaves and will use 2 large Parmesan cheese.

title: Pioneer Woman Cinnamon Rolls 101
ingredients: 4 cups whole milk 1 cup vegetable oil 1 cup sugar 4 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast 8 cups all-purpose flour 1 cup flour 1 teaspoon baking powder 1 teaspoon baking soda 1 tablespoon salt 1 1/2 - 2 cups melted butter 1 cup sugar generous sprinkling cinnamon 7 tablespoons melted butter GLAZE 2 lbs powdered sugar 2 teaspoons maple flavoring 1/2 cup milk 1/4 cup melted butter 1/4 cup brewed coffee 1/8 teaspoon salt
directions: Mix milk, vegetable oil, and sugar in a pan (large soup-pot type). "Scald" the mixture (heat until just before the boiling point.) Turn off heat and leave to cool 45 minutes to 1 hour. When the mixture is lukewarm to warm, but NOT hot, sprinkle in yeast. Let this sit for a minute so the yeast gets all warm and moist and happy. Then add 8 cups of all-purpose flour. Stir mixture together. Cover and let sit for at least an hour. Now add 1 more cup of flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Stir mixture together. At this point, you could cover the dough and put it in the fridge until you need it-overnight or even a day or two, if necessary. Just keep your eye on it and if it starts to splurge out of the pan, just punch it down. Or, of course, you can just go ahead and make the rolls. Let's do that, shall we?. Sprinkle surface generously with flour. Take half the dough and form a rough rectangle. Then roll the dough thin, maintaining a general rectangular shape. Rectangle should increase in both width and length as you roll it out. Now drizzle melted butter over the dough. Don't be shy; lay it on thick, baby. You know you want it. Oh, by the way? This is not non-caloric. In case anyone asks. Sprinkle sugar over the butter, followed by a generous sprinkling of cinnamon. Starting at the opposite end, begin rolling the dough in a neat line toward you. Keep the roll relatively tight as you go. Some of the butter / sugar / cinnamon mixture may ooze out toward the end, but that's no big deal. Next, pinch the seam to the roll to seal it. Spread 1 tablespoon of melted butter in seven round, foil cake or pie pans. Then begin cutting rolls approximately 3/4 to 1 inch thick and laying them in the buttered pans. Repeat this process with the other half of the dough. This recipe makes approximately seven pans of rolls (56 rolls). Let the rolls sit for 20 to 30 minutes to rise, then bake at 400 degrees until light golden brown, about 15 to 18 minutes. GLAZE: While the rolls are in the oven, make the deliciously sinful maple frosting. To a mixing bowl, add powdered sugar, maple flavoring, 1/2 cup milk, 1/4 cup melted butter, brewed coffee, and salt. Stir until mixture is thick but pourable. Taste and adjust as needed. Generously drizzle frosting over warm rolls after you pull them out of the oven. And take a walk on the wild side. Don't be afraid to drown them puppies. Be sure to get frosting around the perimeter of the pan, too, so the icing will coat the outside of the rolls.

title: Hot Sausage Dip
ingredients: 1 lb. hot sausage 1 lb. ground beef 1 onion, minced 2 lb. Velveeta cheese 1 c. Ro-Tel tomatoes, chopped 1 c. mushroom soup
directions: Brown sausage, onion and ground beef. Drain off fat. Melt cheese. Combine with meat and remaining ingredients. Serve with chips.

title: Raspberry Pie Supreme
ingredients: 5 cups raspberries 1 each pie shell (9 inch) 9 inch, unbaked 1 cup sour cream 1 1/2 cups sugar 1 cup flour, all-purpose 1/4 teaspoon salt
directions: Spread raspberries in unbaked pie shell. Stir sour cream and combined sugar, flour and salt together, mixing well. Spoon over berries, spreading to edge of shell. Sprinkle top with 2 teaspoons of sugar. Bake at 450~ for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350~; bake 30 minutes more or until topping is lightly browned. Cool at room temperature; serve fresh.

title: Sausage Ball Appetizers
ingredients: 1 lb. ground sausage 1 c. grated Cheddar cheese 1 c. Bisquick mix or pancake mix
directions: Mix the ingredients. Roll into balls, size of walnuts. Place on cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes, or until brown. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Hamburger Pie
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs hamburger 1 can cream of potato soup 1/2 cup chopped green pepper 1 medium onion, chopped salt and pepper 8 ounces cheddar cheese, grated 1 egg 2 pie crusts (uncooked)
directions: Cook hamburger, green pepper, onion, salt and pepper, until meat is browned. Remove from heat and drain off excess grease. Pour in potato soup and mix well. DO NOT ADD WATER. Line bottom of a deep dish pie pan with 1 pie crust. Spoon in 1/2 of meat mixture, top with 1/2 of cheese; repeat with the rest of meat mixture and cheese. Put top crust on and seal edges with fork. Mix egg well and brush on top crust. Bake at 350 degrees until crust is golden brown.

title: Potato Salad Niçoise
ingredients: 3/4 pound green beans, cut into 2-in. lengths 3 pounds small red potatoes, scrubbed 1/4 cup white wine vinegar 1/4 cup extra-virgin olive oil 1/2 medium red onion, slivered, rinsed, and drained 3 lemons 2 cups mayonnaise 2 tablespoons Dijon mustard 2 medium garlic cloves About 1/2 tsp. kosher salt Freshly ground black pepper 2 tablespoons drained capers 1 cup pitted Nicoise olives
directions: Cook green beans in a large pot of boiling water just until tender-crisp, 7 to 8 minutes. Drain, cool in a bowl of ice water, drain again, and chill until ready to use. Put potatoes in a large pot, cover with cold water, and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat and simmer just until tender when pierced, about 15 minutes. Drain. When they're cool enough to handle, quarter potatoes and put them in a large bowl. Pour vinegar and olive oil over warm potatoes; add the onion, mix gently, and let stand until cool. Meanwhile, make aioli: Finely shred peel of 1 lemon and squeeze enough lemons to get 7 tbsp. juice. In a food processor, whirl mayonnaise, lemon juice, mustard, garlic, 1/2 tsp. salt, and lots of pepper until smooth. Add lemon zest and pulse just to blend. Mix cool potatoes with 1 cup aioli and the capers. Cover; chill until cold, along with remaining aioli. Just before serving, gently stir in green beans, olives, more aioli if salad is too dry, and more salt and pepper to taste. Note: Nutritional analysis is per serving.

title: Rich Corn Bread
ingredients: 1 c. corn meal 1 c. white flour 4 tsp. baking powder 1/4 c. sugar 1/2 tsp. salt 1 c. milk 2 eggs 1/4 c. melted butter
directions: Mix and sift dry ingredients. Add milk gradually, eggs well beaten and butter. Bake in a buttered, shallow pan, in a hot oven, 400°.

title: Microwave Multi sausages Pizza
ingredients: 1 cup chicken sausage 1 cup chicken pepperoni sausage 1 cup chicken nuggets (cubed) 1 stick leek (chopped) 1/2 capsicum( chopped) 1 green chilli (chopped) 1/2 tsp white pepper powder 1 onion, chopped 2 clove garlic chopped 3 tbsp olive oil, extra virgin 1 tbsp butter 1/4 tsp dry oregano 3 pre backed personal pan size pizza base
directions: Heat oil in pan, put onions & cook till soft. Then put garlic & cook until slightly golden. Add other ingredients of Group#1 except butter. Cook for 2-3 min. Then add butter & saute for 2-3 min more. Keep aside when done. Take one pre backed pizza base ( I always find in superstores) on microwave safe plate,make layers one by one -1#spread tomato sauce,2#cheese, 3#sausage mix, 4#tomato sauce,5#cheese. Finish with sprinkle of dry oregano. Cover with a lid and microwave on 70% power for 2min 30sec. Serve hot. Enjoy. You can refrigerate the mix and can use in making pasta. Also mini pizzas can be made by using bread slices.

title: Easy Grape Jelly
ingredients: 7 heaping c. grapes 7 c. sugar 7 Tbsp. water
directions: Wash grapes. Strain with Foley mill. Boil ingredients 20 minutes; strain and immediately pour into jars.

title: Sausage Dip
ingredients: 2 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese 1 (1 lb.) pkg. Jimmy Dean sausage 1 can Ro-Tel diced tomatoes and green chilies
directions: In skillet, brown sausage and drain fat. Return sausage to skillet; add cream cheese and Ro-Tel and heat until melted. Turn into bowl and serve with corn tortilla chips.

title: Black Russian Brownies
