ingredients: 1 Tbsp. butter or margarine 7 1/4 oz. can (1 1/4 c.) salted peanuts 2 1/2 c. Domino sugar
directions: Heat sugar in skillet until sugar caramelizes. Add peanuts. Pour onto buttered surface. Stretch and pull candy into thin sheets. Break up into individual pieces.

title: Leslie'S Rafferty'S  Sunshine Chicken Salad
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups cubed cooked chicken 1 cup thinly sliced celery 1 cup halved red grapes 2 tablespoons parsley 1/2 cup mayonnaise 1 tablespoon lemon juice 1 tablespoon cider vinegar 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon sugar 1 dash pepper 1/4 cup slivered almonds
directions: Combine chicken, celery, parsley and grapes. Combine rest of ingredients in separate bowl and mix well then pour over chicken. Sprinkle with almond slivers. Chill 1 hour before serving. Time does not include cooking the chicken or chilling.

title: My Mother'S Chili Beans
ingredients: 2 lb. pinto beans 1 lb. bacon, chopped and fried 1 large onion, chopped chili powder to taste 1 clove garlic (optional) salt and pepper
directions: Cream together one full quart of love; add one heaping cup laughter. Sift together 1 pound of patience and 1 tablespoon of tolerance. Add dash of courage, a handful of appreciation and a sprinkle of praise. Combine with the first mixture alternately with a gallon of understanding. Stir well and simmer for several prayer hours, or until done to taste.

title: Asian Sauteed Cucumber Recipe kchurchill5
ingredients: 3 medium to large cucumbers (seedless cucumbers) 1 carrot peeled and shredded 2 scallions chopped diagonally 1/2' pieces 3 tablespoons soy sauce 1 tablespoon fresh grated ginger 1 squeeze or 1/2 teaspoon fresh lemon juice and 1 teaspoon lemon zest Salt and pepper to taste 1 tablespoon sesame seeds Vegetable oil to saute Dash of red pepper flakes (optional)
directions: First shred the carrots and prepare the cucumber. Dont peel. Cut lengthwise in thin strips and then in 2" pieces In a large pan (non stick) for stir fry, toast the sesame seeds just for a minute or two until lightly brown. Remove and set aside. Then heat the oil in the same pan. Add the scallion, ginger, cucumber, soy and cook a couple of minutes. Then add the carrot and lemon juice, salt and pepper. Toss in the sesame seeds and remove from the heat. Serve warm hot or room temp. A great simple side

title: Lentils With Rice And Onions (Mujadra)
ingredients: 1 cup dry lentils 3 -5 cups low sodium chicken broth or 3 -5 cups water 1/2 cup dry long-grain rice 2 tablespoons olive oil 2 large onions 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon syrian pepper or 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper and 1/2 tsp ground allspice
directions: Pick through the lentils, checking for stones, rinse the lentils, and put them in a pot with 3 cups of chicken broth or water. Bring to a boil and simmer for about 20 minutes or until lentils are starting to become tender. Add the rice and cook for an additional 15-20 minutes, until the rice is cooked. Check the mixture occasionally and add more liquid if necessary. While the rice and lentils cook, cut the onions in half and cut each half into thin slices. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add the onions, reduce the heat to medium, and cook, stirring frequently, until the onions are thoroughly browned. Add the onions, salt, and Syrian pepper to the rice and lentils. Add a little more liquid if necessary to keep the mixture moist and simmer for 5 more minutes.

title: Spicy Curry Grilled Shrimp with Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 1 pound large shrimp, shelled and deveined 1 1/2 teaspoons mild curry powder 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger 1/4 teaspoon ground coriander 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil Kosher salt Freshly ground pepper 1/2 cup plain whole-milk yogurt 2 teaspoons finely chopped mint 2 teaspoons finely chopped cilantro 1/4 teaspoon cumin seeds 1 large English cucumber (1 pound)halved lengthwise, seeded and thinly sliced on the bias 1 medium jalapenohalved lengthwise, seeded and thinly sliced Lemon wedges, for serving
directions: Light a grill. In a large bowl, toss the shrimp with the curry powder, cayenne, ginger and coriander and 1 tablespoon of the olive oil. Season with salt and pepper. Grill the shrimp over moderately high heat until slightly charred and white throughout, about 2 minutes per side. In a medium bowl mix the yogurt with the mint, cilantro, cumin seeds and the remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil. Stir in the cucumber and jalapeno, and season with salt and pepper. Serve the grilled shrimp with the cucumber salad and lemon wedges.

title: Navy Bean, Tomato & Fennel Cassoulet with Cheese Toasts
ingredients: 1 lb. (450 g) dried navy beans, soaked overnight, drained 1 fennel bulb, chopped 3 carrots, chopped Target 2 lb For $3.00 thru 02/06 2 onions, chopped King Sooper's 1 lb For $0.99 thru 02/09 2 stalks celery, chopped 4 cloves garlic, minced 2 tsp. each dried thyme leaves and dried rosemary 1/2 cup Kraft Extra Virgin Olive Oil Italian Sun-Dried Tomato Dressing 1 can (28 fl oz/796 mL) no-salt-added diced tomatoes, undrained 2-1/2 cups vegetable broth 8 slices whole wheat baguette (1/4-inch thick) 1/2 cup Cracker Barrel Shredded Light 4 Cheese Italiano Cheese 3 Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley
directions: Place beans in large saucepan; add enough fresh water to cover beans by 3 inches. Bring to boil on medium-high heat; cover. Simmer on medium-low heat 35 to 40 min. or just until beans are tender; drain. Immediately rinse beans with cold water until cooled. Heat oven to 350 degrees F. Transfer beans to 4-L casserole dish or roasting pan sprayed with cooking spray. Add all remaining ingredients except bread slices, cheese and parsley; stir. Cover. Bake 1 hour 15 min. to 1 hour 30 min. or until vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally and uncovering after 30 min. About 15 min. before cassoulet is done, place bread slices on parchment-covered baking sheet; sprinkle with cheese. Bake 10 to 12 min. or until bread is toasted and cheese is melted. Serve cassoulet topped with cheese toasts and parsley.

title: Apple Oatmeal Muffins
ingredients: Coconut Cooking Spray, As Needed For The Pan 2 cups Rolled Oats 2 cups Apple Cider 1 cup Apple Sauce 1 Tablespoon Dark Brown Sugar 2 teaspoons Baking Powder 2 teaspoons Cinnamon 1 teaspoon Baking Soda 1/2 teaspoons Salt 1/2 teaspoons Nutmeg 2 cups All-purpose Flour Vegan Caramel Chips, For Sprinkling On Top
directions: Preheat oven to 400°F and spray a 12-well muffin tin generously with the cooking spray. Soak oats in the apple cider a large mixing bowl for 10 minutes to soften them and let them absorb the flavor. Then add in the apple sauce, brown sugar, baking powder, cinnamon, baking soda, salt and nutmeg. Stir it all together well. Finally, stir in the flour just until it disappears. Don't overwork it. Fill each muffin well pretty much to the top, then sprinkle a handful of the caramel chips on top and press them into the batter so they stick. Bake the muffins until golden brown and baked through, about 20 minutes. Use a toothpick and insert it into the center to make sure it comes out cleanly just to be sure. Let them cool for a bit in the tin, then carefully remove them to a cooling rack to finish cooling. Serve and enjoy! They keep well for a couple of days in an airtight container too.

title: Creamed Spinach
ingredients: 1 whole Onion, Finely Diced 2 cloves Garlic 2 Tablespoons Butter 1 bag (large Bag) Fresh Spinach 1 cup Heavy Cream Salt And Pepper, to taste
directions: Finely dice one onion and 2 cloves of garlic. Melt 2 tablespoons of butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add onions and garlic and saute until translucent. Now add in the spinach. Lightly press it down with a spoon and toss it very gently as it wilts. When it comes to creamed spinach, wilting is good. When the spinach is mostly wilted(but not falling apart) add in about 1 cup of heavy cream Stir it around just a bit and give it a sprinkle of salt and pepper. That's all there is too it. And word on the street is, it's delicious cold the next day, eaten with a fork straight out of the fridge. Of course, I wouldn't know anything about that.

title: Butter Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. butter (not oleo) 1 c. sugar 2 c. flour
directions: Cream butter and sugar. Add flour. Roll in 2 rolls and refrigerate at least 3 hours or overnight. Slice and bake at 325° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Oven-Roasted Corn On The Cob With Garlic Butter
ingredients: 1/4 cups Unsalted Butter, Softened 1 clove Garlic, Minced 1/4 teaspoons Salt 1/8 teaspoons Black Ground Pepper 4 ears Corn, Shucked
directions: Preheat oven to 350°F. In a small bowl, cream together butter, garlic, salt and pepper. Spread the butter mixture over each corn. Wrap each corn in aluminum foil and place on a baking sheet. Roast for 40 minutes, turning halfway. Take out the corn and open the foil on top to expose the corn. Turn the oven to broil and place corn back in. Broil on high for 2-3 minutes. Serve with a piece of butter on top. Sprinkle more salt and pepper as desired.

title: Caramel Nut Pound Cake
ingredients: 2 sticks butter or oleo 1/2 c. Crisco 1 lb. light brown sugar 1 c. chry. sugar 5 or 6 large eggs 3 c. all-purpose flour 1 tsp. salt 1/2 tsp. baking powder 1 c. milk 1 tsp. vanilla 1 c. chopped pecans
directions: Cream the butter or oleo, Crisco, brown sugar and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time. Add the flour, salt and baking powder alternately with the milk and vanilla. Fold in the chopped pecans. Bake in a large tube pan at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Saucy Franks
ingredients: 12 ounces chili sauce bottled 15 ounces cranberry sauce whole berry 2 pounds frankfurters (hot dogs)
directions: Combine chili sauce and whole-berry cranberry sauce in a deep 2 quart heat-resistant, non-metallic casserole. Add frankfurters. Heat, covered, in Microwave Oven 4 minutes. Stir. Heat, covered, an additional 10 minutes or until franks are heated through. Stir occasionally.

title: Marinated Collard Greens
ingredients: 1 bunch chopped greens 1 Tbsp. capers olive oil vinegar or lemon crushed garlic (3 large cloves) salt and pepper
directions: Steam greens until tender in salted water. Drain thoroughly. Sprinkle ingredients on top of them. Toss. Marinate a few hours in refrigerator. Serve cold.

title: Cheese Dip
ingredients: 2 lb. Velveeta cheese 1 1/2 lb. medium Cheddar cheese 1 small can evaporated milk 1 small onion, chopped 4 small cans green chilies, chopped 1 (12 oz.) can tomatoes with juice, chopped 1 Tbsp. butter or oleo
directions: In a 3-quart saucepan, saute onion in butter until colorless. Add evaporated milk, chilies and tomatoes. Chop all cheese into chunks, about 1-inch. Add to saucepan and heat slowly (stir continuously so it doesn't burn). When smooth and creamy, pour into Cool Whip bowls and freeze. Microwave as you need them. Makes about 3 1/2 Cool Whip bowls.

title: Abigail's Cobbler
ingredients: 1 cup flour 1 cup sugar 1 cup milk 12 cup butter 12 teaspoon baking powder 29 ounces sliced peaches (or any fruit of choice)
directions: Pre-heat oven to 350f or 325f if using glass pan. Melt Butter. Mix Dry ingredients. Add milk and melted butter to dry ingredients. Pour batter into pan. Put fruit on top. Bake for 30 minutes. Serve warm with vanilla custard/pudding or thickened cream.

title: St. Louis Noodles
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. ground beef 1/2 c. chopped onions 1/2 c. chopped green peppers 1 small can mushrooms (if desired) 1 can tomato soup 1 can water 8 oz. pkg. noodles 8 oz. pkg. grated cheese
directions: Saute the ground beef, onions and peppers. Add the mushrooms, if desired. Add the soup and water. Cook the noodles; drain. Add to rest of the ingredients. Add the cheese. Cover with foil and bake 35 to 45 minutes at 350°.

title: Cherry Gelatin Salad
ingredients: 1 (21 ounce) can cherry pie filling 1 (8 ounce) can crushed pineapple, undrained 2 (3 ounce) packages cherry-flavored gelatin mix 2 cups boiling water
directions: Stir cherry pie filling, pineapple, and gelatin mix into boiling water until gelatin is dissolved. Pour mixture into a glass baking dish. Refrigerate until set, at least 2 hours.

title: Cream of Broccoli Soup
ingredients: 4 cups fresh broccoli, chopped 1 large potato, chopped 1 small onion, chopped 2 cups water 1 12 cups almond milk
directions: Boil water. Add potato and onion. Simmer 10 minutes, til tender. Add chopped broccoli. Simmer til broc is bright green and take off heat. Cool til OK for blender. Put in blender and add almond milk. Blend to desired consistency. Possibly season in blender with dash of any or all of the following: thyme, curry, nutmeg, pepper.

title: Poke Cake
ingredients: 18 1/2 oz. pkg. white cake mix 1 (3 oz.) pkg. Jell-O 1 c. boiling water 1/2 c. cold water whipped topping fruit
directions: Prepare cake mix as directed on package. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool in pan 15 minutes. Pierce with fork at 1/2-inch intervals. Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water; pour over cake. Chill 3 to 4 hours. Garnish with whipped topping and fruit. Makes 12 servings.

title: Banana Milkshake
ingredients: 2 banana halves 1 egg 1 1/2 c. milk 1 Tbsp. sugar 1 c. ice
directions: Put both banana halves, 1 egg, 1 1/2 cups of milk and the sugar in the blender; blend until smooth. Add ice and blend again. Enjoy.

title: Weight Watchers Veggie Sandwich
ingredients: 1 sandwhich thins roll, Arnold Select 100% Whole Wheat 14 cup alfalfa sprout 1 tomatoes, sliced 14 cup cucumber 14 tablespoon carrot, shredded 1 slice provolone cheese 1 teaspoon honey mustard
directions: Slice tomato and cucumber, and shred the carrot. Spread half of the honey mustard on each half of a Sandwich Thins roll. Top bottom half with provolone cheese, alfalfa sporuts and the other half of the Sandwich Thins roll.

title: French Onion Soup
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. butter, melted 2 or 3 onions, sliced 1 bay leaf 1 c. dry red wine 2 cans consomme 1 can water
directions: Saute onions in butter until tender. Add remaining ingredients and simmer 20 minutes. Put soup in bowls. Add toasted garlic bread. Top with Mozzarella cheese and add grated Parmesan or Romano cheese. Brown in oven.

title: Bacon Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1 lb. bacon, cooked and crumbled 1 bunch broccoli flowerets 1 c. shredded Cheddar cheese 1/2 c. chopped onion 1 c. mayonnaise 2 Tbsp. vinegar 1/2 c. sugar
directions: I use 2 bunches broccoli with 1 cup mayonnaise mix.

title: Cheeseburger Casserole
ingredients: 1 large onion 1 lb. ground beef 1 can tomato paste 1 can tomato sauce 1/2 can water salt and pepper to taste garlic to taste shredded Cheddar cheese 2 or 3 cans Hungry Jack biscuits
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Brown ground beef, onion, salt, pepper and garlic. Add tomato paste and tomato sauce. Simmer for 15 minutes. In casserole dish, layer ground beef mixture, cheese and biscuits until all ingredients are gone. Bake for 30 minutes.

title: Easy Chicken With Mushroom Sauce
ingredients: olive oil 3 -4 chicken thigh fillets 1 (10 1/2 ounce) can cream of mushroom soup teriyaki sauce soy sauce 2 tablespoons chopped garlic cloves 1 tablespoon chopped white onion 12 teaspoon salt (per chicken thigh) 12 teaspoon pepper (per chicken thigh) 14 teaspoon cinnamon (per chicken thigh) 1 teaspoon garlic powder, teaspoons garlic powder set aside for later use (per chicken thigh) 2 teaspoons garlic powder, set aside for later use 14 cup white milk 1 (14 ounce) box white rice
directions: Thaw chicken thighs over night if necessary, start cooking once throughly thawed. Add thin coat of olive oil into a pan and start by cooking the chicken breasts until fully cooked through. While chicken is cooking, add teriyaki sauce, soy sauce, salt, pepper, cinnamon, and garlic powder onto both sides of all chicken breasts. (Use as much sauce as desired - Recommended amount: About 3-4 teaspoons per side). Add chopped garlic into pan and simmer for 1-2 minutes. After garlic cooks for a few minutes, add one can of cream of mushroom soup. Let simmer on medium-low heat for 8-10 minutes, or until start of boiling. Once soup starts to boil, immediately remove pan from hot stove and let sit. After stove cools, replace pan and keep warm on simmer/low heat. Follow instructions on the box for the rice. Once rice is fully cooked, dish out desired amount per person, and top with desired amount of chicken breasts. Top chicken and rice with remaining mushroom soup mixture and enjoy.

title: Melts in Your Mouth
ingredients: 1 cup butter 13 cup powdered sugar 1 teaspoon vanilla 1 cup flour 34 cup cornstarch 1 cup powdered sugar 2 tablespoons melted butter 1 teaspoon vanilla 2 tablespoons milk
directions: Cream butter, powdered sugar and vanilla. Sift flour and cornstarch. Add to creamed ingredients. Roll into small balls and flatten with a wetted glass to prevent the dough from sticking. Bake at 350 for 12-14 minutes. Meanwhile, cream sugar, butter and vanilla for frosting. Add milk until thin enough to spread. Divide frosting into 2 bowls and color 1 bowl with red frosting and 1 bowl with green frosting.

title: Cappuccino Cheesecake
ingredients: 1-1/2 cup nuts, finely chopped 2 tbsp. sugar 3 tbsp. butter, melted -OR- 2 chocolate wafers 3 tbsp. butter, melted 1 lb. cream cheese, softened 1 cup sugar 3 tbsp. flour 4 eggs 1 cup sour cream 1 tbsp. instant espresso coffee 1/4 tsp. cinnamon 1/4 cup boiling water
directions: Heat oven to 325F. Dissolve instant coffee with cinnamon in water. Set aside to cool. Mix nuts, sugar, and butter and press onto bottom of a 9-inch springform pan. Bake for 10 minutes, remove, and set aside. Increase oven to 450F. Beat cream cheese, sugar and flour at medium speed until well blended. Add eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition. Blend in sour cream. Gradually add cooled coffee mixture to cream cheese mixture, mixing well until blended. Pour over crust. Bake for 10 minutes and then reduce over temperature to 250F. Continue baking for 1 hour. Turn off oven and let cake cool inside for 1 hour. Remove and cool completely. Refrigerate at least 3 hours.

title: Red Devil'S Food Cake
ingredients: 1/2 c. shortening 1 1/2 c. sugar 2 eggs 4 Tbsp. cocoa 2 Tbsp. hot coffee 1 tsp. vanilla 1 7/8 c. flour * 1 tsp. salt 1 tsp. soda 1 c. buttermilk 1 tsp. red food coloring
directions: Cream shortening and sugar until fluffy. Blend in eggs. Mix cocoa, food coloring and hot coffee together in small bowl. Add to mix. Sift flour, salt and soda together. Add to mixture alternately with milk and vanilla.

title: Polenta With Spicy Meatballs And Sautéed Mushrooms
ingredients: Meatballs, Tomato Sauce and Mushrooms 1 pound ground beef 1 pound ground pork 2 shallots very finely chopped 1 garlic clove crushed, green inner part removed 4 tablespoons fresh parsley finely chopped 6 tablespoons fresh breadcrumbs 1 pinch chilli powder or flakes (optional) 1 egg yolk salt 2 tablespoons all purpose flour 2 1/2 cups tomato sauce 4 cups wild mushrooms cleaned 8 tablespoons Extra Virgin Olive Oil 3 sprigs thyme, just the leaves Creamy Polenta 2 cups polenta 8 cups water 3 teaspoons salt 1/3 cup butter 1/4 cup milk
directions: For the meat balls. Fry the shallots and crushed garlic in 2 tablespoons of olive oil until translucent. Remove from the heat and let cool completely. In a big bowl add the ground beef and pork, the breadcrumbs, the cold fried shallots and garlic, 2 tablespoons of parsley and the egg yolk. Mix very well with your hand, season with salt and the chilli powder. Mix again very well to blend in all the flavours. Cover and chill for 1 hour. Dust your hands with flour and make you meatballs the size you like, I like mine pretty small. Put them on a tray and chill until ready to fry. In a large sautee pan add 2 to 3 tablespoons of olive oil and fry the meatballs, swirling them so they brown evenly. Remove and keep warm. In a pan warm up the tomato sauce and when hot add the meatballs. Cover and simmer for 8 minutes. Check seasoning and keep warm. For the mushrooms: Clean and trim the mushrooms and cut in pieces. In a large sautee pan add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and fry half the mushrooms until golden brown. Fry the second half of the mushrooms. Put the mushrooms together in the pan, add the thyme and the other 2 tablespoons of parsley, season with salt and pepper and mix well. Keep warm. For the polenta: Bring water and salt to a boil. Pour the cornmeal in a steady stream and whisk. Lower heat to low and cook the polenta so that it barely boils, whisking constantly. When it starts to thicken, use a wooden spoon and continue cooking for 45 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes until the polenta creates a crust in the pan and pulls away from the sides. Add the butter and milk, stir well to melt butter and incorporate all the ingredients. Serve the hot polenta with the meatballs and tomato sauce on top and the mushrooms around. Sprinkle with some chopped parsley.

title: Cauliflower Olive Salad
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, broken into small pieces 1 cup stuffed manzanilla olives, chopped 1 cup French onion dip 1 tablespoon olive oil (may need more or less)
directions: Thin dip with olive oil. (could also use some of the juice from the olives). Toss dip with cauliflower and olives. Chill and serve. Note: French Onion Dip - 2 cups (16 ounces) sour cream stirred together with 1 package of your favorite French onion dip mix. Use 1 cup in this recipe.

title: 7 Layer Salad
ingredients: lettuce bell pepper celery green onions 1 can LeSueur extra small English peas 8 oz. mayonnaise 1/3 c. sugar grated cheese boiled eggs bacon
directions: Layer first 5 ingredients in large bowl in that order. Mix mayonnaise and sugar together. Spread on top of salad. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Top with boiled eggs and bacon.

title: Flowerpot Pudding
ingredients: 1 small to medium flowerpot, without drainage holes, washed 1 pkg. Oreo cookies 2 pkg. instant vanilla pudding 3 c. milk 3 oz. cream cheese, softened 1 12 oz. pkg. cool whip 1 c. powdered sugar 1 pkg. gummy worms, optional
directions: Crumble cookies and put in bottom of flowerpot. Mix pudding mix and milk. In separate bowl, mix cream cheese, cool whip and powdered sugar, and then stir both together. Mix well and spread over cookie layer. Top with remaining crushed cookies. Place gummy worms into mixture, leaving 1/2 to 1 inch sticking out. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Dirt Cups
ingredients: 2 c. cold milk gummy worms or frogs 1 (4 serving size) pkg. Jell-O chocolate flavor instant pudding 1 (16 oz.) chocolate sandwich cookies, crushed 1 (8 oz.) Cool Whip, thawed
directions: You will need 8 to 10 (7 ounce) clear plastic cups.

title: Pumpkin Crisp
ingredients: 1 (18.25 ounce) package yellow cake mix 1 egg 1/2 cup butter, melted 1 (29 ounce) can pumpkin puree 2 eggs 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1/2 cup white sugar 2/3 cup evaporated milk 3/4 cup white sugar 1/2 cup butter, softened
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Set aside 1 cup cake mix for the topping. Combine remaining cake mix, 1 egg, and melted butter or margarine. Pat into a 9x13 inch baking pan. In a large bowl, mix pumpkin, 2 eggs, spices, 1/2 cup sugar, and milk. Pour pumpkin mixture over the cake mix crust. In a small bowl, combine 1 cup cake mix and 3/4 cup sugar. Cut in 1/2 cup softened butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Sprinkle mixture on top of pumpkin mixture. Bake at 350 degrees F (175 degrees C) for 55 minutes.

title: Duck and Potato Crepinettes with Wilted Greens and Balsamic Syrup
ingredients: 1 pound magret, with duck fat 1/2 pound pancetta 2 large Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/4-inch dice 1 teaspoon cinnamon 1 teaspoon cumin seeds 1 tablespoon salt 1/4 pound caul fat (available at specialty butcher shops) 4 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil 2 cloves garlic, thinly sliced 2 cups kale chiffonade (1/2-inch ribbons) Salt and pepper 2 (16-ounce) bottles balsamic vinegar, reduced by 3/4
directions: Preheat the grill or broiler. Cut the duck meat and pancetta into 1/4-inch cubes. Run the meat through a meat grinder. Place the potatoes in a pan, cover with cool water and place over medium-high heat. Cook until just tender, then refresh in cool water and set aside. In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground meat and the potatoes with the cinnamon, cumin, and salt. Mix very well, then divide the mixture into 8 equal oval patties, about 1/2-inch thick. Wrap each patty in caul fat. Place the patties under the broiler or on the grill and cook through, about 4 to 5 minutes per side. Set aside. In a large 12 to 14-inch saute pan, heat the olive oil until just smoking. Add the garlic and saute until very light brown, about 2 minutes. Toss in the kale and saute, stirring quickly, about 2 to 3 minutes, until just wilted but not too soft. Remove from the heat and season with salt and pepper. Divide the mixture evenly among 4 plates, place 2 crepinettes over each portion and serve with balsamic syrup drizzled over.

title: Hermits
ingredients: 3/4 c. shortening 1 c. sugar 1 egg 1/4 c. molasses 2 tsp. baking soda 1/4 tsp. salt 2 1/4 c. sifted flour 3/4 tsp. ginger 1 tsp. cinnamon 1/2 tsp. ground cloves 1/2 c. raisins
directions: Sift together soda, salt, flour, ginger, cinnamon and ground cloves. Mix shortening, sugar, egg and molasses well. Stir in remaining sifted ingredients. Add raisins last. Press evenly over ungreased jelly roll pan (11 x 17-inch) or shape in rolls about one inch in diameter and squash lightly with wet glass bottom to 1/3-inch thickness. Sprinkle sugar over dough. Bake for 9 to 11 minutes at 375°. Cracks in the cookies will remain yellow and appear uncooked, but remove from oven. Cool. Cut into bars.

title: Ham And Egg Pie
ingredients: 3 boiled eggs 1 can mushroom soup 1 can chicken soup 1 can chicken broth 1 c. sifted flour (self-rising) 1 c. milk 1/4 c. butter or margarine chopped ham 1 hamburger patty 1 medium onion, sliced 1/2 medium potato 1 carrot, sliced
directions: Place hamburgers in bottom of baking dish. Slice potatoes, carrots and onions. Place over meat and cover closely with foil. Cook at 300° for an hour.

title: Oven-Fried Fish
ingredients: 2 pounds fish fillets bite-sized 1 teaspoon salt 1 cup milk 1 cup dried bread crumbs 1 teaspoon basil 1 teaspoon oregano 2 tablespoons margarine Melted
directions: Heat the oven to 500F degrees. In a shallow dish, mix the salt and milk. In a separate bowl, combine the bread crumbs, basil, and oregano. Dip the fish pieces in the milk and then roll them in the bread crumb mixture. Place the fish in a nonstick baking dish. Pour the melted butter over the fish and bake 10-12 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Serve immediately.

title: Pecan Pie
ingredients: 3 eggs 1/4 c. melted butter 1/4 c. milk 1 tsp. vanilla 2 c. light brown sugar 1/2 c. chopped nuts
directions: Mix together all ingredients, except pecans. Pour into 9-inch unbaked pie shell. Sprinkle with nuts. Bake at 325° for 45 to 55 minutes. Cool before cutting.

title: Prince Of Wales Cake
ingredients: 1 c. sugar 2 eggs 1/2 c. sour milk 1 Tbsp. molasses 1 tsp. baking powder 1/2 c. chopped raisins 1/2 c. butter (scant) 2 c. flour 1 tsp. cinnamon 1 tsp. cloves 1 tsp. soda
directions: Put 1 cup of flour with raisins. My mother's old recipe.

title: Dalarolimpa(Swedish Limpa Bread)
ingredients: 2 c. water 3/4 c. Lyle's golden syrup 2 pkg. yeast 2 eggs, slightly beaten 6 1/2 c. unbleached flour 2 3/4 c. rye flour
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add syrup and eggs to yeast mixture. Add unbleached flour and rye flour and knead until smooth and elastic. Cover and let rise until double in size. Punch down and knead slightly. Divide into two loaves. (Can be placed on greased baking sheet or into two greased loaf pans.) Let rise again for 30 to 40 minutes. Bake at 375° for about 35 minutes.

title: Three Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can Green Beans (16 oz) 1 can wax beans (same size) 1 can kidney beans (same size) 1 Green pepper, sliced 2/3 cup vinegar 1/3 cup oil 1 tsp salt 1 tsp Black pepper 1 onion cut into rings 1/3 cup sugar
directions: Drain beans well. Mix beans and other ingredients. Mix lightly and marinate for two hours before serving.

title: Sarah's Italian Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef 1 egg 14 cup quick-cooking rolled oats 14 cup parmesan cheese 1 tablespoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon prepared garlic in oil 1 dash black pepper 1 tablespoon parsley 1 teaspoon italian seasoning 18 teaspoon ground cumin
directions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees F. In a large mixing bowl, combine all of the ingredients, one at a time. I usually mix it all together with my bare hands, with frequent washing, but you can used a mixing spoon, or put plastic sandwich bags on your hands. Form meat into small to medium size balls about an inch and a half in diameter- or your preference. Place meatballs on cookie sheets lined with tinfoil. Bake for 30-40 minutes, or until slightly browned. I usually check it after 35 minutes.

title: Peach Chipotle Jam Recipe
ingredients: 2.5 pounds fresh peaches, washed, pitted (not skinned) 4 cups sugar 1 large chipotle en adobo 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice
directions: Process peach flesh until finely chopped and juicy. Chop chipotle very finely. Place all ingredients in a heavy saucepan such as Le Creuset. Cook over high heat until boiling. Skim foam from top of mixture and discard foam. Boil mixture until it reaches 226deg and continue boiling 8 to 10 minutes. At this point the jam can be canne

title: Dried Beef Casserole
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. noodles, cooked and drained 1 can cream of mushroom soup 1 c. milk 1/4 lb. dried beef buttered bread crumbs
directions: Fry beef in butter until lightly browned. Add mushroom soup and milk.	Combine noodles, beef mixture and put in a casserole.	Cover with buttered bread crumbs. Can also use beef chunks instead of dried beef.

title: Traditional Frittata (Vegan)
ingredients: 12 cup tofu, crumbled 2 teaspoons arrowroot 1 teaspoon sesame oil 2 tablespoons soymilk 18 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon canola oil 14 cup artichoke heart, canned 2 tablespoons vegan mozzarella cheese or 2 tablespoons vegan mozzarella cheese, finely diced 2 tablespoons red bell peppers, diced 2 tablespoons kalamata olives, chopped 1 tablespoon scallion, finely sliced
directions: In a bowl blend together the tofu, arrowroot & sesame oil, then add the soy milk & salt, mixing to blend. Put oil in a 7" or 8" omelet pan & heat over medium-low heat, before adding tofu mixture, being.sure to spread it quickly onto the surface of the pan. In another bowl, mix together artichoke hearts, mozzarella, bell pepper, olives & scallion, then sprinkle this mixture evenly over the tofu mixture. Cover & cook about 5 minutes or until frittata is completely done. Be sure to keep heat on medium-low to prevent bottom of the tofu mixture from burning (OR you can cook the frittata in a preheated 350 degree F oven for 5 to 8 minutes, using an ovenproof pan). The frittata can be enjoyed either hot or at room temperature.

title: Shrimp in a Chipotle, Lime & Cilantro Remoulade
ingredients: 1 pound Large Shrimp, Shell And Tail On 3 Tablespoons Mayonnaise 5 cloves Fresh Garlic 4 Tablespoons Fresh Cilantro 1 stalk Celery, Diced 1 Tablespoon Dried Chipotle Chiles 1 teaspoon Fresh Lime Juice A Drizzle Of Olive Oil Salt And Pepper, to taste
directions: Whiz all of the ingredients except the salt and pepper (and of course the shrimp!) in a food processor until combined. Add salt and pepper and adjust the seasonings to taste. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of water to a vigorous boil for 15-20 minutes. Turn the water off, and as soon as it stops boiling, put the shrimp in. Let them sit in the hot water for 3-4 minutes until theyre an opaque pinkish-white. Thats all it takes! (Of course you should check one to make sure theyre done before you take them out of the water.) Immediately plunge them into an ice water bath until cool, then take them out, peel, pat dry, and toss with the sauce.

title: Schnitz And Kneppe(Schnitz Means Dried Apples And Kneppe Refers To Fluffy Dumplings.)
ingredients: 1 qt. dried apples 2 Tbsp. brown sugar 1 tsp. salt 1 egg, beaten 1/2 c. milk 3 lb. smoked ham 2 c. flour 4 tsp. baking powder 3 Tbsp. melted butter
directions: Cover apples and ham with water and simmer 2 hours. Add brown sugar and simmer 1 more hour. Mix flour, baking powder and salt; mix egg, butter and milk in separate bowl. Add to flour mixture; drop by tablespoon into simmering ham and apples. Cover tightly and cook 15 minutes without lifting lid. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Beef Tips In Gravy
ingredients: 1 lb. beef stew meat 1 tsp. onion powder 1 tsp. Worcestershire sauce black pepper 1 Tbsp. margarine 1 Tbsp. oil 1 tsp. instant beef bouillon 1/2 c. strong cold coffee 1 c. water 1/4 c. flour
directions: Place meat in a bowl with the next 3 ingredients. Marinate 1 hour. Heat margarine and oil in skillet. Stir in meat and sear. Add bouillon, coffee and water. Simmer, covered, for 30 minutes. Blend flour in 1/2 cup water. Stir in skillet and thicken. Serve over noodles or rice.

title: Easy No-Bake Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese 1/3 c. lemon juice 1 tsp. vanilla extract 1 (9-inch) graham cracker crust 1 (14 oz.) can sweetened condensed milk 1 can cherry pie filling
directions: Combine cream cheese and condensed milk. Beat at medium speed with electric mixer until well blended, approximately 5 minutes. Add lemon juice and vanilla extract. Mix until thick and creamy.

title: Kielbasa Appetizer(Great For Parties!)
ingredients: 1 lb. kielbasa 1/2 c. vinegar 1 c. brown sugar 1 tsp. dry mustard
directions: Boil kielbasa for 1/2 an hour, then slice thin. Mix together vinegar, brown sugar and dry mustard and heat thoroughly. Add kielbasa to sauce mixture. Serve on toothpicks.

title: Minestrone
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. cannellini beans 1/2 lb. fresh spinach 1/2 small head savoy cabbage 2 carrots 1 potato 1 medium red onion 2 stalks celery 1/4 lb. string beans 2 Tbsp. chopped fresh Italian parsley 2 cloves garlic, minced 3 slices bacon or 3 slices pancetta 1 Tbsp. tomato paste 1/4 c. olive oil chicken broth
directions: Rinse beans and drain well. Remove stems of spinach. Wash cabbage and spinach. Cut spinach and cabbage leaves into thin strips and steam, with only the water left on the leaves after washing, until tender but not soggy. Drain and set aside. Cut carrots, potato, onion, celery and string beans into small pieces. Chop together parsley, garlic and bacon or pancetta.

title: Marinade For Deer Recipe
ingredients: 1 c. soy sauce 1/4 c. brown sugar 1/2 teaspoon garlic pwdr 1 pkg. Italian dressing (dry) 1 onion, minced fine 1 1/2 c. oil
directions: Mix above ingredients and pour over meat. Meat may be cut into 1/2" strips or possibly steaks. Marinade for at least 2 hrs. Drain the sauce off the meat and roll in flour and fry till done.

title: Sweet-Sour Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 c. catsup 2 Tbsp. brown sugar 2 Tbsp. vinegar 2 tsp. prepared mustard 2 Tbsp. molasses 2 Tbsp. dry onions
directions: In a 1-quart measuring cup, mix together all ingredients. Cook on High in microwave for 2 minutes. Spread over chicken or pork and bake, grill or microwave until meat is done.

title: Polly'S Bourbon Balls
ingredients: 1/2 c. candied cherries 2 pkg. pitted dates 1 pkg. dried figs (stems removed) 2 c. pecans 1/2 c. bourbon whiskey 1 (4 oz.) can flaked coconut
directions: Put dates, figs and pecans through the coarsest blade of food grinder. Mix with diced candied cherries and whiskey. Shape into marble sized bites, using 2 teaspoons of the mixture. Roll each marble in coconut. Makes 6 dozen.

title: Miracle Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. Jell-O 1 c. boiling water 1 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese 1 c. sugar 3 Tbsp. lemon juice 1 tsp. vanilla 1 large can Milnot, stiffly beaten 3 c. graham cracker crumbs 3/4 c. melted butter
directions: Pour water over Jell-O. Chill until slightly thickened. Cream the sugar, cheese and vanilla. Add Jell-O and lemon juice. Mix well. Fold in stiffly beaten milk. Mix graham crackers and butter. Press firmly in bottom and sides of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Chill overnight.

title: Guava - Mango Licuado (Smoothie)
ingredients: 3/4 cup guava, scooped from peel and chopped 3/4 cup mango, peeled and chopped (frozen if you like it slushier) 2 cups cold milk 3 tablespoons honey (to taste) or 3 tablespoons sugar (to taste) 1/2 lemons, juice of or 1/2 lime, juice of mint sprig (to garnish)
directions: Put all ingredients except mint sprig into blender. Blend until smooth. Strain to remove seeds and fibrous bits. Garnish with mint spring. Drink (with a straw if you like!).

title: Pollo Rellenos with Salsa Fresca
ingredients: 4 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves, trimmed of any fat or sinew (see Notes) 2 tablespoons low-fat Cheddar cheese 2 tablespoons chopped green chile (canned or frozen) 1/4 cup skim milk or buttermilk 1/2 cup cornflake crumbs (see Notes) Salsa Fresca (see Notes), optional
directions: Rinse the chicken and pat dry. Pound with a tenderizer mallet or the flat side of a heavy knife. Lay the chicken breasts out flat and divide the cheese and chiles among them. Roll the chicken and fasten with toothpicks or skewers, tucking in the sides to hold the cheese mixture. Dip in the milk to coat uniformly, then dip into the cornflake crumbs. Place in a microwave-safe baking dish, cover with wax paper, and cook on high for 10 to 12 minutes. Meanwhile, combine the Salsa Fresca, if using. Spoon a ribbon of salsa over each serving.

title: Sour Cream Date Pie
ingredients: 8 -9 inches pie shells, unbaked 1 cup sour cream 3/4 cup brown sugar 1 pinch salt 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg 2 large eggs 1 tablespoon brandy or 1 tablespoon vanilla 1 cup pitted dates, chopped 1/2 - 3/4 cup chopped nuts
directions: Combine sour cream, sugar, salt, nutmeg, eggs, and brandy. Beat until smooth. Add the dates and nuts and blend well. Pour into pie shell. Bake in a 425 degree F. oven for 10 minutes, then reduce heat to 325 degrees F. and continue baking for 25 minutes, or until firm.

title: Roasted Duck with Orange Ginger Glaze
ingredients: 1 (2-pound) duckling Salt and pepper 1 tablespoon sugar 1 tablespoon water 2 tablespoons dry white wine 1 tablespoon cider vinegar 2 ounces orange juice 2 tablespoons freshly chopped ginger 16 ounces duck, beef, or chicken stock 2 oranges, supremed
directions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F. Begin by placing the duck breast side up on a baking rack. Season with the salt and pepper, and roast until the juices run barely pink, about 45 minutes. Remove the duckling from the pan and set it aside. Degrease the pan drippings by skimming off the top layer. To prepare the sauce, combine the sugar and water and caramelize carefully. Add the wine, vinegar, orange juice and ginger. Mix them well and reduce by half. Add the stock and bring to a boil. Add the pan drippings, reduce the heat and simmer until sauce reduces by half. Once sauce is done, strain it through a cheesecloth or fine strainer and set aside. To serve, place the duckling on a large serving tray. Add the orange segments on top and around the duck, and pour the sauce over the duck.

title: Broccoli With Oil And Lemon Vinegar
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb. broccoli, cut 1/2 to 2/3 c. olive oil 2 Tbsp. lemon vinegar 1 Tbsp. lemon juice salt and pepper
directions: Cook broccoli until tender-crisp. Drain and put in serving dish. Combine all remaining ingredients and pour over broccoli. Serve hot or cold.

title: Stuffed Peppers with Lamb and Eggplant
ingredients: 1 pound firm, tight skinned eggplant, diced 1/2-inch pieces Salt 8 small green bell peppers Freshly ground black pepper 1/4 cup extra-virgin olive oil, plus a little for dish and drizzling 4 anchovy fillets in oil, optional 2 cloves smashed garlic 2 sprigs rosemary, leaves finely chopped 2 medium starchy potatoes, peeled and diced 1/2-inch 2 vine-ripe tomatoes, seeded and chopped 1 small yellow onion, chopped A couple handfuls pitted good quality green olives, chopped 1 pound cooked lamb, 1/2-inch diced 1/3 pound fontina or Gruyere, 1/2-inch dice Chicken stock or water
directions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F. Put the eggplant in a colander and sprinkle with salt. Let it drain for 30 minutes, then rinse, drain and pat dry and chop. Cut the top third of peppers off horizontally, seed and reserve tops. Season the peppers with salt and pepper, to taste, and put them in a large bowl. Drizzle them with a little extra-virgin olive oil, and arrange them upright in an oiled roasting dish. Heat the 1/4 cup of extra-virgin olive oil, in small pan over medium heat. Add the anchovies, if using, and let them melt into the olive oil. Stir in the garlic and rosemary and swirl for 1 to 2 minutes. Transfer the oil mixture to a mixing bowl and add the eggplant, potatoes, tomatoes, onions, olives, lamb and cheese. Toss to combine and fill the peppers, slightly overstuffing them. Set the tops in place and roast for1 hour. Cool and store for a make-ahead meal. Reheat in a hot oven by adding a little chicken stock or water to the baking dish for moisture. Cover the baking dish with foil and bake for 20 minutes. Remove the foil and bake until hot and cooked through, about 10 more minutes. Serve 2 peppers per adult portion.

title: Westphalia Slaw Dressing
ingredients: 2/3 cup sugar 1/2 cup vinegar 3/4 cup vegetable oil 1/2 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon celery seed 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard 1 teaspoon pepper
directions: Mix well in pint jar. Can also be used for wilted lettuce (just heat).

title: Cheesy Shrimp Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 (4 ounce) can chopped green chilies 2 cups cooked shrimp 1 cup chopped fresh spinach 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 cup shredded monterey jack pepper cheese 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese 1 tablespoon chopped cilantro 12 flour tortillas (6-inch size) nonstick cooking spray
directions: Chop the shrimp. Saute the spinach in the olive oil and set aside. Drain the chilis. Combine the chilis, shrimp, spinach, pepperjack cheese, cheddar cheese, and cilantro. Heat a small skillet over medium heat. Spray one of the tortillas with cooking spray and place, spray side down, in the skillet. Top with 1/6 of the shrimp mixture. Spray another tortilla with cooking spray and place, spray side up, on the shrimp mixture. Cook for about 2 minutes until golden. Gently flip the quesadilla and cook another 2 minutes. Repeat for remaining tortillas. To serve, cut each quesadilla in quarters and serve with sour cream and salsa for dipping.

title: Barbecue Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb. hamburger 1 c. bread crumbs 1/2 c. milk salt and pepper 1/2 c. water 1/4 c. vinegar 1/2 c. catsup 1 Tbsp. sugar 1/2 c. chopped green pepper 1/2 c. onion 1 1/2 Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce 1 Tbsp. sugar
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients. Roll into balls. Put into 9 x 13-inch pan or baking dish. Mix other ingredients and pour over meatballs. Bake at 325° for 45 minutes or until juice is cooked up.

title: Shredded Kale Salad With Date Puree & Pine Nuts
ingredients: 2 cups Medjool dates, pitted 2 cups Water 1/2 teaspoon Sea salt Pinch Nutmeg Pinch Cayenne pepper 1/2 Lemon, juiced 1 bunch Kale, center ribs removed, leaves finely shredded 1/4 cup Pine nuts, toasted 1 1/2 tablespoons red wine vinegar 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil 1 tablespoon date puree Salt and freshly ground black pepper
directions: Make date puree: In a food processor, combine dates, water, salt, nutmeg, cayenne and lemon juice. Whiz until it resembles a smooth paste. Taste and adjust the seasoning. Keep date puree refrigerated up to two weeks or freeze for three months. Use the rest in smoothies or yogurts. Make the dressing: Whisk together vinegar, olive oil and date puree until well combined. Season to taste. In a large bowl, mix the dressing and shredded kale until well coated, taste and adjust the seasoning. To assemble the salad, spread a thin layer (1 teaspoon) of date puree in each plate and top it with kale salad, sprinkle with toasted pine nuts and generous amount of bread crumb. Serve.

title: Pork Stock
ingredients: 4 lb pork bones, I used ribs cut up 1 onion, peeled and quartered 1 stalk celery, chopped 1 carrot, chopped 1/2 tsp black pepper 4 peeled garlic cloves 2 quart low or no sodium chicken broth 2 quart low or no sodium beef broth 1/2 tsp thyme 2 tbsp canola oil
directions: Preheat oven to 450 In a large roasting pan add oil to cover bottom, add pork bones season with salt and pepper. Roast 15 minutes, turning once until brown.. Remove from oven, add pork bones to large stockpot, pour some broth in roasting pan to scrape up all browned bits, add to pot with pork bones. Add all remaining ingredients to stockpot and bring to a boil, skim off and discard any foam. Lower heat to low and simmer 6 hours, uncovered,you want the liquid to reduce almost in half. Strain stock to remove all solids. Chill overnight and remove hard fat layer from top, your broth is now ready to use! I do not add any extra salt, so it can be added to any recipe without worry of to much salt.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
ingredients: 1 c. yellow cornmeal 1 c. all-purpose flour 1 Tbsp. baking powder 1 tsp. salt 2 Tbsp. sugar 1 c. buttermilk 1 egg, beaten 1 (8 3/4 oz.) can cream-style corn dash of hot pepper sauce 1/4 c. bacon drippings, melted 1/4 c. minced green onions with tops 1/2 c. shredded Cheddar cheese
directions: Combine first five ingredients in a large bowl; set aside. In another bowl, combine buttermilk and egg. Add corn and remaining ingredients. Pour over dry ingredients and stir just until blended. Do not overmix.

title: Trade Winds Salad
ingredients: 1 (7 oz.) pkg. Creamettes elbow macaroni 1 (12 oz.) can luncheon meat, cubed 1 (15 oz.) can pineapple chunks, drained (reserve 2 Tbsp. liquid) 1 c. cubed process American cheese 1 (8 oz.) container sour cream 1/2 c. chopped green pepper 1/2 c. mayonnaise lettuce leaves 2 Tbsp. brown sugar 1/2 tsp. salt 1 Tbsp. margarine
directions: Cook elbow macaroni as directed on package. Rinse and drain. In a large skillet, melt margarine with brown sugar. Add luncheon meat. Cook and stir until golden brown. In a large bowl, combine cooked macaroni, luncheon meat, pineapple, cheese and green pepper. Stir together mayonnaise, sour cream, reserved pineapple liquid and salt. Add to macaroni mixture; mix well. Chill thoroughly. Serve on lettuce. Garnish as desired.

title: Irish Potato Soup
ingredients: 6 potatoes 3 carrots 1 1/2 onions 1 tablespoon parsley 2 cups milk 2 pinches salt and pepper
directions: steam veggies until very tender process through Mouli food mill with some of the cooking water add milk, parsley salt and pepper and heat through

title: Nine Day Slaw
ingredients: 3 lb. chopped cabbage 2 medium onions, chopped 1 small can pimentos 2 green peppers, chopped 2 c. sugar (I use 1 1/2 c.) 1 c. vinegar 1 c. oil 1 tsp. celery seed 1 Tbsp. salt
directions: Bring to a boil the sugar, vinegar, oil, celery seed and salt. Pour over the chopped ingredients and refrigerate.

title: Elsie Style Chili
ingredients: 3 lb. ground beef 1 medium onion, diced 1 large clove garlic 1 1/2 tsp. salt 1 tsp. red pepper 1 large can tomato juice 1 tsp. cumin seed (3 tsp. ground) 1/2 tsp. oregano 2 heaping Tbsp. masa harina 2 oz. chili blend
directions: Saute beef and onion until done. Toast chili blend in skillet. Do not scorch. Add to meat; rinse remaining chili blend from skillet. Pour over meat; add remaining ingredients and simmer in covered pot for 2 to 3 hours.

title: Key Lime-Mangocream Cheese Pound Cake
ingredients: 1 stick salted butter 2 sticks imperial margarine 8 oz cream cheese 2c. sugar 6 eggs 2 c.cake flour 1/4 c. key lime juice 1 mango pureed 1/2 tsp pure vanilla 1/2 tsp lemon extract
directions: cream first 4 ingredients well add 5 of the eggs, 1 @ a time and beat well aftereach (seperate 1 of the eggs and whip the egg white til stiff add the yolk to the mixture) add juice, flavorings and beat well. add the pureed mango and fold well-add the egg whites and continue to fold gently until incorporated. gently pour in large tube pan. Place in center of 300 degree oven bake til cake tester comes out clean.(about 1hr.) Glaze if desired plain powder sugar glaze (or add tbl spoon lime juice for flavor to sugar glaze)

title: Polish Sausage With Peppers And Onions
ingredients: 1 large sweet red pepper 1 large sweet yellow pepper 1 medium sweet Spanish onion 1 clove garlic, minced 3/4 tsp. dried thyme leaves 1 Tbsp. olive oil 6 Polish sausage links 1/2 c. water 1/2 c. dry white wine
directions: Cut peppers into 12 wedges. Cut onion into 1/2-inch thick slices, then separate into rings. Cook peppers, onion, garlic and thyme in oil in large pan 8 to 10 minutes, stirring often. Remove to warm platter and keep warm. Place sausage in water in pan. Cover and cook over medium heat 8 to 10 minutes, turning once. Remove cover and continue cooking 2 to 4 minutes or until cooked and browned. Remove to platter and pour off drippings. Increase heat to medium-high and add wine to pan. Stir to loosen brown bits, then return vegetables and sausage to pan, stirring to coat with sauce. Continue cooking 2 to 3 minutes or until sauce is slightly reduced and thickened. Makes 6 servings.

title: Pecan Delight Pie
ingredients: 3 egg whites 1/2 tsp. baking powder 1/4 tsp. salt 1 c. sugar 1 c. saltines (18 crackers) 1 c. chopped pecans
directions: Beat egg whites, baking powder and salt until thick. Beat in sugar until meringue holds a peak. Fold in cracker crumbs and pecans. Pour into greased pie pan. Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes. Cool. Cover with Cool Whip.

title: Fruit Glow Punch(All Ingredients Should Be Cold When Mixed)
ingredients: 1 - 6 oz. can concentrated orange juice - thawed 1 - 6 oz. can concentrated lemonade - thawed 1 quart of chilled apple juice 2 quarts of chilled ginger ale 1 pint lemon or orange sherbet (lemon works best)
directions: Combine all liquids and mix well. Add sherbet either in balls or chunks, serve immediately. DO NOT ADD ICE TO THIS PUNCH. The chilled liquids and sherbet keep it cold. Some people think this is alcoholic because of the apple juice.

title: Carrot Cornbread
ingredients: 4 oz shredded carrot 1 (8.5 oz) package Jiffy corn muffin mix 1/3 cup diced red and green pepper 1/3 cup buttermilk or skim milk 1/4 cup whole egg substitute, such as Egg Beaters None None fresh flat-leaf parsley, for garnish
directions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Lightly grease a 9x5 inch loaf pan. In a food processor, pulse carrot until chopped. Transfer to a large bowl and mix in corn muffin mix and peppers. Add buttermilk and egg substitute and mix until barely moistened. Batter should still be lumpy. Transfer to loaf pan and bake for 20-22 mins, or until a skewer inserted in the center comes out clean. Let cool for 10 mins. Serve warm, sliced and garnished with parsley.

title: Chocolate-Chip Oatmeal Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. unbleached white flour 1/2 c. whole wheat flour 1/4 tsp. baking soda 1/2 tsp. baking powder 1/4 tsp. salt 3/4 c. butter, softened 3/4 c. sugar 3/4 c. packed light brown sugar 2 eggs 1 tsp. vanilla 2 c. rolled oats 1 c. chopped walnuts 1 c. (6 oz.) semi-sweet chocolate chips
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Butter cookie sheet. Combine flours, baking soda, baking powder and salt in a medium size bowl.

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu Recipe
ingredients: 1 cup panko 2 tablespoons plus 1 teaspoon olive oil Kosher salt Freshly ground black pepper 1/4 cup Dijon mustard 2 (10-ounce) boneless, skinless chicken breasts 8 thin slices prosciutto (about 3 ounces) 4 ounces Gruyere cheese, thinly sliced into 3-by-1-inch planks 8 toothpicks
directions: Heat the oven to 375 degrees F and arrange a rack in the middle. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and set it aside. Place the panko and 1 tablespoon of the oil in a shallow dish, season with salt and pepper, and use your hands to combine evenly. Place the Dijon and the remaining 4 teaspoons of oil in another shallow dish and whisk to combine. Set both dishes aside. Cut each chicken breast in half horizontally. Place 1 chicken piece on a work surface, cover with plastic wrap, and pound to an even 1/4-inch thickness with a meat mallet, a rolling pin, or the bottom of a pan; transfer to a large plate. Repeat with the remaining pieces of chicken. Lay the chicken on a cutting board and season both sides with salt and pepper. Arrange the pieces so the narrowest ends face you. Place 1 piece of prosciutto on top of a piece of chicken vertically, and a second piece perpendicular, making a cross pattern. Center a quarter of the cheese over the prosciutto horizontally. Fold both pieces of prosciutto over the cheese to completely cover and enclose it. Fold the bottom of the chicken up over the cheese-and-prosciutto bundle to enclose it, then roll tightly into a cylinder. Use 2 toothpicks to secure the roll; set aside. Repeat with the remaining chicken, prosciutto, and cheese. Dip 1 chicken piece in the Dijon mixture and roll to coat it in a thin, even layer. Then place it in the panko, roll to coat, and press the breadcrumbs onto the chicken to adhere. Place the breaded chicken on the prepared baking sheet and repeat with the remaining chicken cylinders, spacing them evenly on the sheet. Bake until the cheese is melted and the chicken is cooked all the way through, about 45 minutes. Remove the toothpicks and serve immediately.

title: Sneaky Mac 'N Cheese
ingredients: 14 1/2 ounces ronzoni smart taste rontini pasta 1/2 cup nonfat dry milk powder 3 cups 1% low-fat milk 3 tablespoons butter 1/4 cup all-purpose flour 12 ounces frozen butternut squash puree 8 ounces shredded sharp cheddar cheese (2 cups) 1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce 1 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon pepper 3/4 cup crushed whole wheat Ritz cracker (18-20 crackers) 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme fresh thyme sprig (optional)
directions: Preheat oven to 350. Coat shallow 2-quart baking dish with cooking spray. Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain well; reserve. Meanwhile, whisk dry milk powder into low-fat milk until smooth. In large pot, melt 2 tablespoons butter over medium-low heat. Whisk in flour; cook, whisking constantly, until starting to brown, 2 minutes. Whisk in milk mixture until blended; cook, stirring, until thickened, 2 minutes. Stir in squash until smooth and blended. Stir in cheese, worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper until melted and smooth. Remove from heat. Stir pasta into cheese sauce; transfer to baking dish. Melt remaining 1 tablespoon butter; stir in crackers and dried thyme. Sprinkle over pasta mixture. Bake until bubbly and golden brown, about 15 minutes. If desired, garnish with thyme sprigs.

title: Cajun Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 small red onion 1/2 cup plain fat-free yogurt 1/2 teaspoon sugar-free Cajun seasoning 1 (1-lb) head of romaine lettuce, cut into 1-inch slices (8 cups) 1 medium cucumber, peeled, seeded, and thinly sliced 4 (6-oz) boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cooked and thinly sliced Salt and freshly ground black pepper
directions: Mince enough onion to equal 1 tbsp and thinly slice the rest into rings. Whisk together yogurt, Cajun seasoning, and minced onion in a large mixing bowl. Add lettuce, cucumber, and onion slices and toss to combine; season to taste with salt and pepper. Arrange salad on plates and top with sliced chicken.

title: Crayon Soap
ingredients: 1 c. Ivory Snow soap a scant 1/4 c. warm water food coloring muffin tin
directions: Have your child measure the Ivory into a bowl. Add water and stir out all the lumps. The consistency may seem a little dry, but it will eventually mix together. Add a heavy dose of food coloring until the color looks right and spoon the mixture into the muffin tin to dry. Make additional batches for different colors. The crayons take from 1 to 2 days to dry. Pop them from the muffin tin when they are firm to the touch. Crayon soap washes off all surfaces, including the skin, with a wet washcloth.

title: Buckeyes
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. powdered sugar 2 sticks margarine or butter, room temperature 1 c. peanut butter 2 c. semi-sweet chocolate chips 1/4 c. shaved paraffin
directions: Cream margarine, peanut butter and powdered sugar. Make into small round balls and set aside.

title: Super Easy Mild Chili
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean ground beef (90%-95%) 1 (16 ounce) can red kidney beans 3 (16 ounce) cans Del Monte crushed tomatoes with mild green chilies 1 (15 1/2 ounce) jar mild salsa hot sauce (Fire In The Hole is good!) 1 (3 7/8 ounce) can sliced olives salt and pepper
directions: Brown ground beef in (preheated) large skillet with a little water. Drain and rinse beef in a colander. MUST RINSE IF YOU WANT IT LOW FAT! Leave the colander in the sink. Put beef in a stock pot. Rinse kidney beans in the colander. Mix them with the beef. Add all other ingredients. Cook over med-low heat for about an hour. Stir once in a while. DON'T LET IT BURN! Serve hot. Great with Tortilla chips and shredded cheddar cheese. Note: For the best Nachos EVER, Spread finished chili over tortilla chips, top with shredded Monterey Jack cheese. Place in preheated 400°F oven for 10 minutes. Sour cream on the side. You can make this into 2 layers also. Just add more chips, then chili, then cheese again. Same cooking time if layered.

title: Cheesy Sweet and White Potato Soup
ingredients: 2 large or 3 medium sweet potatoes 4 medium-large white potatoes, preferably russet 2 to 3 cups low-fat milk, rice milk, or soy milk 1 1/2 cups grated Cheddar cheese or Cheddar-style nondairy cheese 1/2 teaspoon seasoned salt 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard Pinch of ground nutmeg 1 cup frozen green peas, thawed
directions: Microwave the sweet potatoes and white potatoes separately on high until easily pierced with a knife. Allow 4 minutes per sweet potato and test; add another minute each until done. Allow 2 minutes per white potato; add another minute each until done. When the potatoes are cool enough to handle, slip the peels off and cut into large chunks. Puree the potatoes in the food processor in two batches, adding 1 cup of water to each batch, until smooth and transfer to a soup pot. Or place the potatos in a soup pot with 2 cups water. Insert an immersion blender into the pot and process until smooth. Bring the mixture to a simmer. Add enough milk to make a fluid but fairly thick consistency. Add the cheese, salt, mustard, and nutmeg. Cover and simmer gently for 10 minutes. Let stand for 1 to 2 hours before serving, or serve at once. Top each serving with a sprinkling of green peas.

title: Chicken Salad
ingredients: 2 cups diced cooked chicken 1 cup diced celery 1 cup mayonnaise Salt to taste 1/4 teaspoon white pepper 2 tablespoons sliced almonds, toasted
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients; stir gently. Cover; chill 2 hours. Spoon salad in center of Avocado Mousse, and sprinkle with almonds.

title: Hurricane Punch
ingredients: 1/2 (64-ounce) bottle red fruit punch 1/2 (12-ounce) can frozen limeade concentrate, thawed 1 (6-ounce) can frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed 1 2/3 cups light rum 1 2/3 cups dark rum
directions: Stir together all ingredients. Serve over ice.

title: Party Chicken
ingredients: 8 chicken breasts chipped beef bacon pepper paprika 3 to 4 cans cream of mushroom soup large carton sour cream
directions: Put bacon strips around breasts. Mix 3 or 4 cans cream of mushroom soup and large carton of sour cream. Pour over chicken and add chipped beef. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°.

title: Jerusalem Artichoke Soup
ingredients: 8 cups (or more) canned low-salt chicken broth 1 pound Jerusalem artichokes 1 1/2 pounds russet potatoes, peeled, cut into 1/2-inch pieces 3 leeks, sliced (white and pale green parts only) 2 garlic cloves, minced 1/4 teaspoon dried savory 1/8 teaspoon ground ginger 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream 1 green onion (dark green part only), chopped
directions: Bring 8 cups broth to boil in large saucepan. Peel Jerusalem artichokes and cut into 1/3-inch thick pieces. Add to broth. Add potatoes, leeks, garlic, savory and ginger. Cover pan and simmer until vegetables are very soft, about 25 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in marjoram; cool about 20 minutes. Working in batches, puree soup in blender until smooth. Return to same saucepan. Bring soup to simmer. Add cream. Season with salt and pepper. Simmer 5 minutes to blend flavors, thinning with more chicken broth if soup is too thick. (Can be made 1 day ahead. Cover and keep refrigerated. Rewarm soup over medium-low heat before continuing.) Ladle soup into bowls; sprinkle with green onion and serve.

title: Charred Corn Panzanella
ingredients: 4 ounces whole-grain country-style boule without crusts, cut into 1-inch dice (3 cups) 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar Kosher salt 4 ripe tomatoes, chopped and juices reserved 1 clove garlic, minced 2 tablespoons olive oil 3 cups fresh corn kernels 1 serrano chile, stemmed, seeded and thinly sliced 1 medium onion, diced 1/4 cup fresh cilantro, chopped
directions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees F. Spread the bread out on a rimmed baking sheet and toast until golden brown, about 10 minutes. Let cool. Put the vinegar, 1/4 teaspoon salt, the tomatoes and their juices and the garlic in a large bowl and toss together. Set aside. Heat the oil in a large skillet over high heat. Add the corn and spread in a single layer. Cook until blackened in spots, about 3 minutes. Add the chiles and onions and cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned and crisp-tender, about 2 minutes. Transfer the mixture to the bowl with the tomatoes. Add the bread to the bowl and gently stir together; season with salt. Stir in the cilantro and serve.

title: Pizza Dough
ingredients: 1 pkg. active dry yeast 1 Tbsp. sugar 1 c. warm water 3 c. flour 1 tsp. garlic salt 1/4 c. olive oil 2 Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
directions: In a small bowl, dissolve yeast and sugar in water. Let rest until foamy. In a large bowl, mix the flour and garlic salt. Add olive oil to yeast mixture. Make well in flour and add yeast mixture; stir to combine. If too sticky, add more flour. Knead on a floured board until smooth and elastic, adding flour as needed. Pat dough into ball. Put in large bowl and set in a warm place covered with a clean towel for about 1 hour or until doubled in size. Punch down dough and divide into 2 equal portions. Roll out on a floured surface into a 12-inch circle. Place on pan and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Makes 2 (12-inch) pizzas. Top with your sauce and toppings. Bake at 400° for 15 to 18 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. shortening 1 c. brown sugar 2 eggs 2 1/2 c. sifted flour 1 tsp. soda 1 c. granulated sugar 1 c. peanut butter 1 tsp. vanilla 1/4 tsp. salt
directions: Cream together shortening, granulated sugar and brown sugar. Mix in peanut butter. Add 2 well beaten eggs and vanilla. Sift together flour, salt and soda and add to shortening mix. Mix and stir well. Roll dough into small balls. Place on greased cookie sheet. Crisscross with a fork. Bake in oven at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes or until brown. Makes 48 cookies.

title: Lime Almond Cheesecake
ingredients: CRUST 1/4 lb salted butter, melted 2 cups ground cinnamon graham crackers 1/4 cup sugar FILLING 4 (8 ounce) packages cream cheese 1 1/2 cups sugar 1 1/2 tablespoons lime juice 1 pinch salt 4 large eggs TOPPING 2 cups sour cream 1/4 cup sugar 1 teaspoon almond extract
directions: Press ground Graham Cracker crumbs into bottom of a 10" spring form pan and a 1/3 of the way up the sides. In blender, cream the cream cheese and sugar on low. Add pinch of salt and lime juice, blend. Add eggs, one at a time, on low, to prevent to much air from getting into batter. Pour into crust. Place into pre-heated, 350 degree oven for 45 minutes. Remove from oven and let stand for 10 minutes. Mix sour cream, sugar and almond extract, and add to top of cake after 10 minutes has passed. Place in oven for 10 more minutes. Remove from oven and immediately place in the refrigerator to prevent cracking.

title: Oven-Grilled Loaded Turkey Melts
ingredients: 2 ripe avocados, peeled and mashed 2 tablespoons mayonnaise 1 teaspoon garlic powder 8 bread slices 1 pound thinly sliced deli turkey 4 tomato slices 4 sliced red onion rings 8 bacon slices, cooked 1/4 pound smoked mozzarella cheese slices 3 tablespoons butter, softened
directions: Stir together avocado, mayonnaise, and garlic powder. Spread avocado mixture on one side of 4 bread slices. Top evenly with turkey, tomato, onion, bacon, cheese, and remaining bread slices. Spread half of butter on one side of each sandwich. Place buttered sandwiches on a baking sheet. Place a second baking sheet on top of sandwiches. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes or until golden.

title: Chocolate Custard Ice Cream Recipe
ingredients: 2 c. granulated sugar 1/4 c. flour (all-purpose) 1/8 teaspoon salt 2 c. rich lowfat milk 4 sq. Hershey's baking chocolate 2 Large eggs 4 c. light cream 2 tbsp. vanilla
directions: Combine the sugar, flour and salt in top of a double boiler. Add in the lowfat milk gradually and then add in the baking chocolate. Cook over the boiling water, stirring constantly, till thick, then cook 10 min longer, stirring occasionally. Stir a small amount of cooked mix into slightly beaten Large eggs. Return to the double boiler and cook 3 min longer. Cold. Add in the cream and the vanilla. Refrigeratemix, then freeze. To freeze, fill the chilled container 2/3 full with ice cream mix. Cover tightly and set into freezer tub. (For an electric freezer, follow manufacturer's directions.) Fill tub with alternate 3-inch layers of crushed ice and 1 part rock salt. Turn the handle slowly for 5 min. Turn rapidly till the handle becomes difficult to turn (about 15 min). Remove the dasher and pack down ice cream and cover with waxed paper. Again put the lid on top and fill opening for dasher with cork. Repack freezer in ice using 4 parts crushed ice and 1 part rock salt. Cover with paper or possibly cloth. Let ripe 2 to 3 hrs. Yield: 4 qts ice cream.

title: Meat Loaf
ingredients: 3 lb. lean ground beef 1 c. cracker crumbs 2 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. pepper 1/2 tsp. sugar 3 beaten eggs 1/4 c. milk celery and carrots, about 2 to 3-inches long 1/4 c. water
directions: Mix first 7 ingredients together and mold into a loaf in baking dish or pan. Place celery and carrots along sides and at ends of meat loaf.	Salt vegetables and add water; cover with foil. Bake at 350° for about 2 hours or until done.

title: Armenian Rice
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/3 c. butter 1 1/2 c. rice 4 1/2 c. bouillon (beef or chicken) 2 1/4 tsp. salt 2 1/4 tsp. pepper 1/2 chopped almonds
directions: Brown butter and rice, add bouillon, salt and pepper and almonds. Bake at 350° for 75 minutes. Watch that rice doesn't become too dry.

title: Crock-Pot Apple Butter
ingredients: 1/8 c. vinegar 8 c. applesauce 4 c. sugar 1/2 c. cinnamon candies 1 tsp. ground cloves
directions: Pour vinegar into bottom of crock-pot. In large bowl, mix applesauce, sugar, candies and cloves. Pour into pot. Cover with a wet cloth. Do not use lid. Cook on high for 4 hours. Stir occasionally. Pour into hot jars and seal. Makes 4 pints.

title: Baked Beans
ingredients: 2 cans (53 oz.) Van Camp's pork and beans 1 c. brown sugar 1 c. catsup 1/2 c. mustard 1 onion, chopped
directions: Mix in casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Steak With Salt Crusted Potatoes And Pineapple Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 cup table salt 2 pounds new potatoes scrubbed 4 tablespoons olive oil 2 sprigs rosemary halved 4 sirloin steaks 6-7 oz 1/3 cup barbecue sauce 8 ounces pineapple rings drained and chopped 2 tablespoons chopped cilantro 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar 1 pinch sugar 4 cups salad greens 4 ounces cherry tomatoes halved
directions: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Bring 4 cups water and the salt to a boil in a medium saucepan. Add the potatoes and simmer for 15 mins. Drain. Place potatoes on a parchment paper-lined baking pan. Roast for 12-15 mins. Heat 2 tbsp of the oil in a large skillet on medium-high heat. Add the rosemary and steaks. Cook the steaks in 2 batches for 3-4 mins each side or until desired doneness. Remove from the pan and set aside to rest. Meanwhile, mix the barbecue sauce with the pineapple and cilantro. For the vinaigrette, mix the vinegar with the sugar and remaining 2 tbsp oil. Season with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Place the lettuce and cherry tomatoes in a bowl. Drizzle with the dressing and toss well. Serve with the steak, potatoes and pineapple barbecue sauce.

title: Grilled Pork Burritos With Salsa Verde
ingredients: 1 pound pork loin chops boneless, about 3/4-inch thick 2 teaspoons vegetable oil 2 teaspoons chili powder 1/4 teaspoon salt 2 pounds tomatillos fresh, husks discarded, rinsed and patted dry 1 jalapeno chilies 1 avocado ripe, pitted, peeled and chopped 2/3 cup white onion or yellow onion, chopped 1/3 cup cilantro leaves packed 3 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil 3 cloves garlic 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt 1 pinch sugar 6 flour tortillas "burrito sized" 10-inch, or whole grain tortillas 16 ounces fat-free refried beans heated* 1 cup cooked white rice heated 1 cup Mexican cheese blend reduced-fat, four cheese, shredded 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro chopped lime wedges for serving
directions: For Salsa Verde: Prepare grill for direct cooking over medium-high heat, about 450 degrees F. Place tomatillos and jalapeno on grill grate and cook, with the lid closed, turning them occasionally, until jalapeno skin is blackened and blistered (about 5 minutes) and tomatillos are browned but not bursting (7 to 9 minutes). Transfer them to a bowl as they are done, and let cool. Scrape and discard skin from jalapeno. Seed jalapeno, reserving seeds. Pulse avocado, tomatillos and any juices, jalapeno (without seeds), onion, cilantro, oil, garlic, salt and sugar in a blender or food processor until smooth.For a spicier salsa, add seeds.Transfer to a medium saucepan and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Reduce heat to very low to keep salsa warm. Extra salsa can be stored in the refrigerator and kept up to 3 days. To make pork: Lightly oil grill grate. Brush pork with oil and season with chili powder and salt. Grill pork over medium-high heat, with lid closed, about 4 minutes per side, or until the internal temperature reaches between 145 degrees F. (medium rare) to 160 degrees F. (medium) on a digital meat thermometer. Remove from grill and let rest for 3 minutes. Place tortillas on grill grate and cook until heated, about 30 seconds per side. Remove from grill and wrap in a napkin to keep warm. To assemble burrito: Chop pork into bite-sized pieces.For each burrito, spread 2 tablespoons of beans in a wide strip on center of tortilla.Top with rice and cheese, evenly distributed between the burritos, and 1/6 of chopped pork. Sprinkle with cilantro. Fold in right and left sides, and roll up tortilla from the bottom. Transfer each to a dinner plate.Smother each with one sixth of warm salsa, add lime wedges and serve immediately.

title: Dog's Nose
ingredients: 1 ounce gin 12 ounces beer
directions: Pour the gin into a beer mug and then add the beer.

title: Italian Pasta Salad
ingredients: 3 c. cooked pasta (choose favorite style, nuggets, miniature lasagna, penne; all work well) 1 can whole kernel corn, drained 1 c. chopped onion 1 c. chopped celery 1 c. chopped carrots 1 c. chopped raw broccoli 1 c. chopped raw cauliflower 1 small bottle nonfat Italian dressing
directions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate 2 or more hours so flavors blend.

title: Fall Off The Bone Baby Back Ribs
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs baby back ribs, cut in half 2 tablespoons onion powder 2 tablespoons garlic powder 4 tablespoons brown sugar 1 teaspoon cumin 1 teaspoon salt 2 teaspoons chili powder 2 teaspoons smoked paprika 1/4 teaspoon black pepper 2 tablespoons oil 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce
directions: Remove silverskin from back of ribs. Cut ribs into manageable sections. Mix all dry ingredients in a bowl. Add oil to dry ingredients, mixing with hands to combine. Cover ribs, top and bottom, with dry rub and place in an airtight bag. Marinate ribs in refrigerator overnight. Remove ribs from refrigerator 1 hour before cooking, so they get to room temperature. Heat oven to 250 degrees F. Wrap rib sections in foil, creating pouches. Place foil wrapped ribs on baking sheet. Bake in center of oven for 4 hours. Remove ribs and carefully drain liquid from pouches. Turn oven to Broil. Open pouches to expose tops of ribs. Place ribs under broiler for 3 to 5 minutes. Watch carefully so they don't burn. Remove from broiler and brush a light layer of barbeque sauce on top of ribs.

title: Caesar-Crusted Crispy Chicken Strips
ingredients: 3/4 cup creamy Caesar dressing, divided 1/4 cup buttermilk 1/2 teaspoon sea salt 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground pepper 1 1/2 pounds chicken breast strips 1 cup Japanese breadcrumbs* 1/2 cup all-purpose flour 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley 1 cup canola or safflower oil Romaine lettuce leaves
directions: Combine 1/2 cup Caesar dressing and next 3 ingredients in a medium bowl. Add chicken; toss to coat. Combine breadcrumbs, flour, and parsley in a shallow dish or pie plate. Dredge chicken in breadcrumb mixture, pressing gently to adhere crumbs to both sides. Place on a baking sheet. Chill 30 minutes. Heat oil in a large deep-sided skillet 2 to 3 minutes or until hot. Cook chicken, in batches, 3 to 4 minutes on each side or until golden brown. Drain on paper towels. Serve warm or chilled with remaining 1/4 cup Caesar dressing and Romaine leaves. *For testing purposes, we used Panko Japanese breadcrumbs.

title: Sauerkraut Balls Recipe
ingredients: 8 ounce. pork sausage 1/4 c. finely minced onion 1 can (14 ounce.) sauerkraut liquid removed and fine cut 2 tbsp. dry bread crumbs 1 pkg. (3 ounce.) cream cheese, softened 2 tbsp. minced parsley 1 teaspoon mustard 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt 1/8 teaspoon pepper 1/4 c. flour 2 Large eggs, well beaten 1/4 c. lowfat milk 3/4 c. dry bread crumbs Oil for deep frying
directions: Cook sausage and onion in skillet till meat browns. Drain. Add in kraut and 2 tbsp. of crumbs. Combine cheese, parsley, mustard, garlic salt and pepper. Stir into kraut mix. Chill. Form into 3/4 inch balls, coat with flour. Combine Large eggs with lowfat milk. Roll floured balls in egg mix, then in remaining crumbs, allow meatballs to come to room temperature. Fry in warm oil till brown.

title: Porcini Mac & Cheese
ingredients: 1 package (1 ounce) dried porcini mushrooms 1 cup boiling water 1 package (16 ounces) small pasta shells 6 tablespoons butter, cubed 1 cup chopped baby portobello mushrooms 1 shallot, finely chopped 1 garlic clove, minced 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour 2-1/2 cups 2% milk 1/2 cup pumpkin or amber ale 2 cups shredded sharp white cheddar cheese 1 cup shredded fontina cheese 1 teaspoon salt 1 cup soft bread crumbs
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. In a small bowl, combine dried mushrooms and boiling water; let stand 15-20 minutes or until mushrooms are softened. Remove with a slotted spoon; rinse and finely chop. Discard liquid. Cook pasta according to package directions for al dente. Meanwhile, in a Dutch oven, heat butter over medium-high heat. Add portobello mushrooms and shallot; cook and stir 2-3 minutes or until tender. Add garlic; cook 1 minute longer. Stir in flour until blended; gradually stir in milk and beer. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly; cook and stir 3-4 minutes or until slightly thickened. Stir in cheeses, salt and reserved mushrooms. Drain pasta; add to mushroom mixture and toss to combine. Transfer to a greased 13x9-in. baking dish. Top with bread crumbs. Bake, uncovered, 35-40 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Meringue Kisses
ingredients: 6 egg whites 1/4 tsp. cream of tartar 1 tsp. vanilla 1/4 tsp. salt 1 1/2 c. sugar (okay to use powdered)
directions: Beat egg whites until frothy; add salt and cream of tartar. Continue beating until stiff; gradually beat in sugar. Add vanilla last, then add what you like (chocolate chips, coconut, Rice Krispies, nuts). Drop by spoonful on brown paper. Bake for about 40 minutes at 275°. Remove from paper while still warm. If difficult to remove, set paper on damp towel.

title: Butter-Pecan Bread
ingredients: 1 egg 1 c. buttermilk 1 c. light brown sugar 2 Tbsp. melted butter 2 1/4 c. flour 2 tsp. baking powder 1/2 tsp. soda 1/2 tsp. salt 1/2 tsp. cinnamon 1/4 tsp. nutmeg 1 c. pecans
directions: Beat egg and add sugar, butter and buttermilk. Add to this mixture the sifted dry ingredients and the pecans. Bake 1 big or 3 small (baked in medium size fruit cocktail cans). Grease containers and dust with flour. Fill 2/3 full. Bake at 325° for 20 to 30 minutes for small loaves, longer for large.

title: Corn Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. hamburger (uncooked) 1 can creamed corn 1 can chicken and rice soup 1 3/4 c. uncooked macaroni
directions: Combine all ingredients in a casserole dish. Season to taste. Bake at 350° for 1 hour with lid. Remove lid and let bake for another 15 minutes for crispness.

title: Cabbage Goulash
ingredients: 1 bell pepper, chopped 1 head cabbage, chopped 1 can Ro-Tel tomatoes 1 to 1 1/2 c. instant rice onion salt 1 lb. hamburger
directions: Brown beef with bell pepper; drain and add cabbage, Ro-Tel and rice and cover with water. Steam until cabbage is cooked to desired tenderness.

title: Portuguese Sausage-Kale Soup
ingredients: 6 ounces turkey kielbasa, sliced 1 large onion, chopped 1 large clove garlic, chopped 1 teaspoon olive oil 1 pound fresh kale, washed, or 1 package (10 ounces) frozen chopped kale, thawed and drained 2 cans (13 3/4 ounces each) reduced-sodium chicken broth 4 cups water 2 carrots, sliced 1 teaspoon dried leaf marjoram, crumbled 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/8 teaspoon pepper 1/2 cup uncooked long-grain white rice
directions: Saute kielbasa, onion and garlic in oil in large pot over medium-low heat until tender, about 10 minutes. If using fresh kale, cut off stems and slice into 1/2-inch pieces. Keep stem pieces separate. Coarsely chop fresh leaves. Add to the pot the chicken broth, 4 cups water, carrot, marjoram, salt, pepper and sliced fresh kale stems or frozen kale, if using. Bring to boiling. Lower heat; cover and cook for 15 minutes longer. If using fresh kale, add the leaves at this point along with the rice to the pot. Bring to boiling. Lower the heat; cover and simmer for 15 minutes or until the rice is tender.

title: Pork Chops With Grapes
ingredients: 4 pork loin chops salt and pepper Dijon-style mustard butter 15 to 20 seedless grapes 1/2 c. sour cream
directions: Season pork chops and spread one side with mustard. Heat butter in a skillet and brown the chops mustard side up. Turn and brown the mustard side and spread browned side with mustard. Add grapes to the pan and shake it. Cover and simmer over low heat until chops are tender and cooked through. Remove the chops to a warm platter. Skim most of the fat from the dripping. Add sour cream to pan and heat but do not boil. Pour sauce over meat. Serves 4.

title: Beef & String Bean Stirfry
ingredients: 5 ounces lean steak sliced flank, skirt, or other thin 1/2 cup onion sliced 2 cloves garlic sliced 2 cups string beans 2 tablespoons sauce yoshida, or soy sauce 1 teaspoon sesame oil red chili flakes to taste 1/3 cup steamed brown rice
