ingredients: 1 c. flour 1 Tbsp. sugar 1/2 c. margarine 1/3 c. chopped nuts
directions: Mix all ingredients for first layer and spread in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake 350 for 20 minutes. Cool.

title: Deep Fried Turkey Injection - Butter Creole
ingredients: 2 tablespoons kosher salt (DO NOT USE REGULAR SALT! WILL CLOG YOUR INJECTOR) 2 teaspoons garlic powder 2 teaspoons white pepper (DO NOT USE BLACK PEPPER, WILL CLOG YOUR INJECTOR) 2 teaspoons cayenne pepper 1/2 teaspoon onion powder 1 cup melted butter
directions: Melt butter slowly as not to burn. Add rest of ingredients and mix well. (I place in a covered bowl and shake vigorously). Inject into your turkey and allow to sit for one hour or more before deep frying. HINT: We were cooking the turkey while camping, and decided to leave it in the bag to inject it, so it would not be so messy! It worked great!

title: Yummy Soft And Simple (Evil) Brownies
ingredients: 3 ounces semisweet chocolate, melted 1 egg 1 cup brown sugar 1 cup chopped walnuts 3/4 cup all-purpose flour 4 tablespoons soft butter 1/4 teaspoon salt
directions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix to combine thoroughly. Spread evenly in a buttered 8-inch square baking pan and bake in a preheated 350F oven for 25 minutes. Cool before cutting into 2-inch squares. (Really, let them cool....they are pretty likely to fall apart if you don't.)

title: Aunt Betty's Chocolate Spice Cake Recipe
ingredients: 1 c. minced walnuts 2 Tbsp. non-dairy margarine melted 1/2 c. finely-grnd walnuts 3/4 c. non-dairy margarine room temperature 1 1/2 c. sugar 4 x Large eggs separated 1 3/4 c. sifted cake flour 2 tsp baking pwdr 1/2 tsp grnd cloves 1/2 tsp grnd cinnamon 1/2 tsp grnd allspice 1/4 tsp salt 1 c. orange juice 4 ounce unsweetened chocolate melted 1 tsp vanilla extract 8 ounce semisweet chocolate coarsely minced 1/2 c. strong brewed coffee 1/2 c. apricot or possibly strawberry preserves strained 1 Tbsp. fruit liqueur (optional)
directions: For the chocolate glaze, in top of double boiler set over, but not touching, simmering water (or possibly in microwave), heat chocolate, coffee, preserves and liqueur, if using. With wooden spoon, stir constantly till mix is melted and well blended. Let cold before glazing cake or possibly transfer to glass bowl, cover with plastic wrap and chill. Serve warm or possibly cool. Toast walnuts on baking sheet in 350-degree oven till golden brown and fragrant, about 15 min. Brush 10-inch fluted tube pan with melted margarine. Sprinkle with grnd walnuts. In bowl of heavy-duty electric mixer, beat room-temperature margarine and sugar on medium speed till light and fluffy. Beat in egg yolks, 1 at a time, till well blended. Sift flour, baking pwdr, cloves, cinnamon, allspice and salt in medium bowl. Spoon flour mix into margarine mix alternately with orange juice till completely blended. Stir in melted chocolate, toasted walnuts and vanilla. Beat egg whites on high speed till stiff, 2 to 3 min; fold into batter. Pour batter into prepared pan. Bake at 325 degrees till toothpick inserted into center of cake comes out clean and cake begins to shrink away from sides of pan, about 50 min. Cold cake in pan on wire rack. Carefully loosen sides and center of cake from pan and invert onto cake plate. Garnish with Chocolate Glaze. This recipe yields 16 servings.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
ingredients: 2 cans boned chicken 2 cans cream of chicken soup 2 cans mixed vegetables 1 1/2 c. Bisquick 1 egg 3/4 c. milk
directions: Mix chicken, soup and vegetables in ungreased casserole dish. Mix Bisquick, egg and milk and pour over top of mixture. Bake at 350° for 25 to 35 minutes.

title: Corn Souffle
ingredients: 2 cans creamed corn 1 cup frozen corn 1 cup sour cream 1 box Jiffy corn mix 2 eggs, beaten 1 stick butter, melted (I use about half of that)
directions: Combine all ingredients. Grease a souffle dish. Bake at 350 for one hour. Be sure center is cooked.

title: Apple Pie
ingredients: 1 Pillsbury ready made crust or ingredients to make 1 crust 8 to 10 green apples cinnamon 1 c. sugar 1 cube butter 1/2 c. plus 2 Tbsp. flour
directions: Prepare your crust; do not bake. Peel and slice the apples thin. Mix 1/2 cup sugar with as much cinnamon as you prefer in apple pie, also adding 2 tablespoons flour and sprinkle over the apples. Take 1 cube frozen butter and cut or grate into 1 cup flour plus 1/2 cup sugar. Use a pastry cutter or fork to blend the three together. Sprinkle this over the apples and place the pie in a large brown bag from the grocery store. Staple the bag shut to avoid any steam escaping. Place this on a cookie sheet and bake. Do not open the oven door for any reason as the bag will catch on fire. Bake 1/2 hour at 400°, then 1 hour at 350°. Warm the pie to serve. Do not try to make more than 1 pie at a time in one oven.

title: Whole Wheat Honey Bread
ingredients: 4 c. whole wheat flour, divided 1/2 c. nonfat dry milk 1 Tbsp. salt 2 pkg. active dry yeast 3 c. water 1/2 c. honey 2 Tbsp. vegetable oil 4 to 4 1/2 c. all-purpose flour
directions: Combine 3 cups whole wheat flour, nonfat dry milk, salt and yeast in large bowl. Heat water, honey and oil in saucepan over low heat until warm; pour warm liquid over flour mixture. Blend with electric mixer at low speed for 1 minute and at medium speed for 2 minutes. Add remaining whole wheat flour; blend with mixer. Stir in about 4 cups all-purpose flour by hand. Turn onto floured board and knead, adding flour as necessary to keep dough from being too sticky, until dough is smooth and elastic (about 5 minutes). Place dough in greased bowl, turning greased side up. Cover; let rise 45 to 60 minutes, until dough is light and doubled in bulk.

title: Sherried Mushroom Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 4 large baking potatoes (about 3-1/4 pounds) 1/4 cup butter, cubed 1 cup sliced fresh mushrooms 1 small onion, chopped 1 garlic clove, minced 1/2 cup sherry 1/3 cup 2% milk 1/2 cup sour cream 2 tablespoons minced fresh chives
directions: Preheat oven to 375°. Scrub potatoes; pierce several times with a fork. Place in a foil-lined 15x10x1-in. baking pan; bake 1 hour or until tender. Meanwhile, in a large skillet, heat butter over medium-high heat. Add mushrooms, onion and garlic; cook and stir until tender. Stir in sherry. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer, uncovered, 14-16 minutes or until liquid is almost evaporated. When potatoes are cool enough to handle, cut each potato lengthwise in half. Scoop out pulp, leaving 1/4-in.-thick shells. In a large bowl, mash pulp with milk, sour cream and chives. Stir in mushroom mixture. Spoon into potato shells. Return to baking pan. Bake 25-30 minutes or until heated through.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb. mushrooms (about 24), cleaned 4 slices bacon, chopped 1 small onion, chopped 1 c. soft bread crumbs 1/4 c. Parmesan cheese 1/4 tsp. pepper
directions: Remove mushroom stems and finely chop 1 cup; reserve. Combine bacon and onion in a medium glass bowl. Cook at High 3 to 4 minutes or until crisp; stir once. Drain. Stir in reserved mushroom stems, bread crumbs, cheese and pepper. Stuff mushroom caps with bread crumb mixture. On a glass platter arrange 12 in circular pattern. Cook covered at High 6 to 7 minutes. Let stand uncovered 2 minutes. Serve. Repeat for remaining mushrooms.

title: Jasmine Tea Scented Fruit Salad
ingredients: For the Jasmine tea syrup 250 milliliters water 8 grams Jasmine tea 250 grams sugar For the fruit salad half a small watermelon, rind removed and cut into bite-sized pieces 1/2 packet each of raspberries, blueberries and blackberries 1/2 pomegranate, seeds removed 1/4 pound cherries
directions: Start with the syrup. Bring the water to a boil and add the jasmine tea. Let steep for 4-5 minutes. Strain, reserving the tea. Add the sugar to the tea, return to a boil just long enough for the sugar to dissolve. Set aside to cool down. To serve, arrange the fruit in a large bowl or on a large platter. Serve the syrup separately so everyone can serve themselves.

title: Tom Kha Soup!
ingredients: 4 cups vegetable broth 1 ginger thumb-sized piece of, thinly sliced 3 inches lemongrass piece of, bruised with heel of a knife 14 ounces coconut milk 2 limes 4 tablespoons fish sauce 3 chicken thighs bone-in & skinless, about 1-1.5 lbs 1/2 onion thinly sliced 1 cup bean sprouts rinsed 1 package firm tofu drained and cubed 1/2 cup snow peas 1/2 cup snap peas 1/2 cup green beans 1 zucchini sliced 1 can baby corn spears, cut into bite sized pieces 1 can water chestnuts sliced, drained 4 ounces cremini mushrooms shittake, whatever you have on hand or a blend of the three, quartered 1 head broccoli cut into florets 2 carrots ends cut off and peeled 2 cups white rice cooked, short-grain Sriracha cilantro coarsely chopped hoisin sauce
directions: Click link for other directives http://bit.ly/1CJ9JP5

title: Jerk Marinated Roasted Onions
ingredients: 1 bottle (12 Oz. Size) Lager Beer 1/2 cups Water 2 cups Jerk Marinade (store Bought) 2 Yellow Onions, Ends Trimmed And Sliced Into 3/4 Inch Slices Horizontally 2 teaspoons Chopped Fresh Thyme, Divided 1/2 teaspoons Kosher Salt 1/4 teaspoons Black Pepper
directions: Mix beer, water, and jerk marinade in small bowl and pour into a baking dish that will hold all the onions. Place onions down in marinade. Marinate overnight covered in refrigerator. Preheat oven to 400°F. Flip onions over in the marinade, and lay on the flat bottom of each side. Using half the fresh thyme, top each onion slice with some. Season with salt and pepper. Roast in oven for 1 hour or until golden brown, basting once or twice during roasting. Remove from heat, spoon reduced sauce over and sprinkle with remaining fresh thyme. Remove from skins and serve.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 pkg. frozen, chopped broccoli 2 c. cooked rice (1 c. raw rice) 1 small jar Cheez Whiz or 4 oz. Velveeta 1 can cream of mushroom soup 1 can cream of chicken soup 1/2 c. chopped onion 1/2 c. celery 1/4 c. bell pepper 1 stick oleo
directions: Saute onion, celery and bell pepper in 1 stick oleo. After rice is almost done, add broccoli and mix well. Add cheese and soups to onion, celery and pepper. Mix well. Combine all ingredients. Cook at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Vanilla Wafers
ingredients: 2 qt. flour 1 pt. lard 1 Tbsp. soda 1 Tbsp. vanilla 1 1/2 c. molasses (Karo or King syrup) 1 c. brown sugar 1/2 pt. boiling water
directions: Rub the lard into flour as for pie dough. In another dish mix molasses, sugar and vanilla. Dissolve soda in boiling water and mix with flour and lard. If not stiff enough, add more flour. Cut in strips 3 x 2-inches wide and 1/4-inch thick. Prick with fork and bake at 375° in a greased and floured cookie sheet. (Grease and flour the cookie sheet and roll the dough on it. Cut, stick and bake, then recut when taken out of oven.)

title: Strawberry Pancakes - 1 Point Per Pancake Ww
ingredients: 1 cup complete pancake and waffle mix 2 tablespoons sugar 14 teaspoon ground ginger 2 tablespoons fat free egg substitute 12 cup apple butter 12 cup 1% low-fat milk 12 cup fresh strawberries, chopped
directions: Whisk sugar, mix, and ginger in a bowl. In another bowl whisk milk, apple butter, and egg substitute. Stir together wet and dry until well blended. Gently fold in strawberries. Cook and serve.

title: Moist and Rich Chocolate Gateau
ingredients: 100 grams Milk chocolate bar 40 grams Butter 2 Egg (medium size) 50 grams Sugar 20 grams Cocoa powder 10 grams Cake flour 1 tbsp Rum Liquor 1 Cocoa powder (for garnish)
directions: Sift the flour and cocoa powder. Separate the egg yolks and whites. Preheat the oven to 160C. Finely chop the chocolate. Melt together with the butter in a double boiler. Make a meringue with the egg whites by adding 10 g of sugar in 3 batches, whipping until stiff peaks form. In a separate bowl, cream the egg yolks and 20 g of sugar until white. Whisk cocoa powder into the chocolate mixture. Combine well. Add the creamed egg yolks from Step 4, as well as the rum. Mix again. Whisk 1/3 of the meringue into the batter. Then change to a rubber spatula and fold in the remaining meringue in 2 batches. Use a fold-and-cut motion to combine the flour. Pour into a mould, smoothing the surface with a rubber spatula. Bake for 30 - 35 minutes. After the cake has cooled down, remove from the mould and sprinkle on cocoa powder with a tea strainer. Double the amount of ingredients if you're planning to use a 18 cm mould. The baking time is the same. Powdered sugar was used as a topping here. When giving this as a gift, presenting it on a lace paper dolly wrapped in a cellophane bag prevents the cake from losing its shape.

title: Swedish Pecans
ingredients: 4 c. pecans pinch of salt 1 stick butter 2 egg whites 1 c. sugar
directions: Heat pecans thoroughly. Whip egg whites and salt. Add sugar gradually. Mix nuts and egg whites. Drop into pan which butter has been melted. Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Peppermint Palmiers
ingredients: 12 cup butter, softened 12 cup granulated sugar 12 cup packed brown sugar (the lightest in color) 12 teaspoon baking powder 14 teaspoon salt 1 egg 2 tablespoons white creme de menthe 1 tablespoon milk 12 teaspoon vanilla 2 34 cups all-purpose flour 1 (8 ounce) package cream cheese, softened 12 cup powdered sugar 14 cup all-purpose flour 1 tablespoon white creme de menthe 3 drops liquid red food coloring 12 cup finely crushed peppermint candy (about 20)
directions: For dough, in a large mixing bowl, beat the butter with an electric mixer on medium to high speed for 30 seconds. Add granulated sugar, brown sugar, baking powder, and salt. Beat until combined, scraping sides of bowl occasionally. Beat in egg, the 2 tablespoons creme de menthe, the milk, and vanilla. Beat in as much of the 2-3/4 cups flour as you can with the mixer. Stir in any of the remaining 2-3/4 cup flour. Divide dough in half. Cover; chill about 3 hours or until dough is easy to handle. Meanwhile, for filling, in a medium mixing bowl, combine cream cheese, powdered sugar, the 1/4 cup flour, and the 1 tablespoon creme de menthe. Beat with an electric mixer on low to medium speed until smooth. Stir in a few drops red food coloring until filling is pale pink. Gently fold in crushed candies. Cover and chill up to 2 hours. (Do not chill longer than 2 hours or the candies will bleed into the filling and the filling will become too soft and sticky.) On a lightly floured surface, roll a portion of the dough into a 12x8-inch rectangle. Spread half of the filling over the dough rectangle to within 1/2 inch of each long edge. Roll both long edges, scroll fashion, to meet in center. Brush seam where dough spirals meet with water; lightly press together. Repeat with remaining dough and filling. Wrap rolls in plastic wrap. Place rolls on a tray or cookie sheet. Freeze for 4 hours to 24 hours or until rolls are firm. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. Line cookie sheet with parchment paper; set aside. Using a serrated knife, cut rolls into 1/4-inch slices. Place slices 2 inches apart on prepared cookie sheet. Bake in preheated oven about 10 minutes or until edges are firm and bottoms are lightly browned. Transfer cookies to a wire rack and let cool.

title: Cucumber-Dill Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup diced seeded peeled cucumber 1/4 teaspoon dried dill 1 garlic clove, minced 1 (8-ounce) carton plain nonfat yogurt
directions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl; stir well. Cover and chill.

title: Fesenjam (Pomegranate-Walnut Chicken)
ingredients: 4 each chicken breasts boneless 1 medium onions finely diced 1 dash vegetable oil 2 tablespoons lemon juice 1 x black pepper to taste 1 x salt to taste 1 cup chicken broth 1/4 cup molasses pomegranate 13 cup walnuts finely ground
directions: Saute the onion in the oil until transparent, then brown the chicken breasts. Add lemon juice, pepper, (salt) and chicken stock. Simmer 15 minutes. Add pomegranate molasses and walnuts. Simmer another 45 minutes. Serve with or over rice. *Pomegranate molasses is available at any Middle Eastern food store. If you have difficulty finding it, you can substitute pomegranate juice or grenadine syrup.

title: Cheese Cream Brownies
ingredients: 4 oz. German chocolate 3 Tbsp. margarine 8 oz. cream cheese 2 Tbsp. margarine 1/4 c. sugar 1 egg 1 Tbsp. flour 1/2 tsp. vanilla 2 eggs 1 c. sugar 1/2 tsp. baking powder 1/2 tsp. salt 1/2 c. flour 1 tsp. vanilla
directions: Melt chocolate with 3 tablespoons of margarine. Stir and cool. Cream 2 tablespoons of margarine with cream cheese and 1/4 cup sugar. Beat until fluffy. Add 1 egg, 1 tablespoon of flour and 1/2 teaspoon of vanilla. Set aside. Beat 2 eggs until light. Slowly beat in 1 cup of sugar. Add baking powder, salt and 1/2 cup flour. Blend in chocolate mixture. Add 1 teaspoon of vanilla. Spread 1/2 batter in a greased 8 or 9-inch square pan. Top with cream cheese mixture. Spoon rest of chocolate mixture over top. Zigzag with knife through batter. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350° until done, but moist.

title: Michigan Sauce
ingredients: 2 lb. lean hamburger (85% or 90%) 2 (8 oz.) cans tomato sauce 3/4 tsp. garlic powder 6 tsp. chile powder 2 tsp. dried onions 2 tsp. black pepper 1 tsp. cumin powder 1 Tbsp. mustard 1/4 small bottle Louisiana hot sauce
directions: Mix all together and simmer on low heat for 2 to 3 hours. Serve with hot dogs and onions on a bun.

title: Bran Muffins
ingredients: 2 c. oatmeal 2 c. All-Bran cereal 2 c. Shredded Wheat 1/2 c. wheat germ 1 (1 lb.) box brown sugar (2 1/4 c.) 1/2 c. oil 4 eggs 3 tsp. soda 1 qt. buttermilk 5 c. flour (1/2 whole wheat)
directions: In a blender, crumble Shredded Wheat until fine. Mix all ingredients together. Keep covered in refrigerator. Will keep for a month. Bake muffins as needed for 10 to 15 minutes at 350°.

title: 30 MINUTE SHEPHERD'S
ingredients: 2 lb GROUND BEFF 1 ONION CHOPPED 1 tbsp OLIVE OIL 1 CARROT 2 lb POTATOES MASHED 2 tbsp butter 2 tbsp FLOUR 1 cup BEEF STOCK 2 tsp WORCETERSHIRE 1/2 cup FROZEN PEAS
directions: BOIL POTATOES AND MASH THEM ADD OIL TO HOT PAN WITH BEEF. SEASON MEAT WITH SALT AND PEPPER. BROWN AND CRUMBLE MEAT FOR 3 TO 4 MINUTES. ADD CHOPPED CARROT AND ONION TO MEAT. COOK VEGGIES WITH MEAT 5 MINUTES, STIRRING FREQUENTLY. IN SMALL SKILLET OVER MED HEAT COOK BUTTER AND FLOUR TOGETHER 2 MINUTES. WHISK IN BROTH AND WORC SAUCE. THICKEN GRAVY 1 MINUTE. ADD GRAVY TO MEAT AND VEGGIES. STIR IN PEAS PREHEAT BROILER TO HIGH. FILL A SMALL RECTANGULAR CASSEROLE WITH MEAT AND VEGGIES MIXTURE. SPOON POTATOES OVER MEAT EVENLY.

title: Blackberry Cobbler
ingredients: 2 c. flour 4 tsp. baking powder 1/2 tsp. salt 1 c. milk 1 c. sugar 2 eggs 1/2 tsp. butter or shortening 1 tsp. vanilla 6 c. berries 1/2 c. sugar 1 c. sugar 1 c. water
directions: Mix together flour, baking powder and salt. Cream together 1 cup sugar, eggs, butter and vanilla. Add flour mixture and milk to egg mixture. Pour into pan. Sprinkle berries over batter with 1/2 cup sugar.

title: Yummy Brownies!
ingredients: 1 cup butter or 1 cup margarine 1 cup white sugar 1 cup brown sugar 34 cup cocoa 3 eggs 1 cup flour 1 12 teaspoons baking powder 1 teaspoon vanilla 1 cup chopped pecans (optional) or 1 cup walnuts (optional)
directions: melt margarine/butter in a pot, add white and brown sugar, cocoa. mix well over medium low heat until sugars and cocoa are dissolved. remove from heat. add 3 eggs one at a time, beating well after each. add flour and baking powder, vanilla and nuts (optional). pour into 9 x 12 pan. bake for 25-30 min at 350.

title: Ranch Cheddar Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts 1 tablespoon flour 1/2 cup ranch dressing 1/4 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese
directions: Preheat oven to 375°F Mix together ranch dressing and flour. Coat chicken breasts with ranch/flour mixture and refrigerate in a container for 15-20 minutes. Arrange coated chicken on a baking sheet. Combine both cheeses and sprinkle over chicken breasts. Bake 25 minutes and serve.

title: Chocolate Torte
ingredients: 1 box Devil's Food Cake Mix Without Pudding 1 package (8 Oz.) Cream Cheese, Softened 2/3 cups Brown Sugar 1 teaspoon Vanilla 1/8 teaspoons Salt 2 cups Whipping Cream, Whipped 2 Tablespoons Grated Semisweet Chocolate
directions: Mix and bake cake according to package directions, using two 9-inch pans. Cool in pans for 15 minutes; remove and cool completely on wire racks. In a bowl, beat cream cheese, brown sugar, vanilla and salt until fluffy. Fold in whipped cream. Split each cake layer into 2 layers. Place one on a serving plate and spread with 1/4 of the cream mixture. Sprinkle with 1/4 of the grated chocolate. Repeat layers. Cover and refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 (40 oz.) can sweet potatoes, drained 1 c. sugar 1/2 tsp. salt 1/2 stick butter, melted 1/2 c. milk 1/2 tsp. vanilla 2 eggs, beaten
directions: Beat above ingredients well and pour into a greased casserole dish. Mix topping ingredients and spread over potatoes. Bake at 350° for 35 - 40 minutes.

title: Lamington Cake
ingredients: Sponge cake 110 grams plain flour 145 grams sugar 1/2 teaspoon baking powder 100 milliliters milk 130 milliliters olive oil 150 grams strawberry jam Cocoa icing 120 grams cocoa powder 220 grams powdered sugar 50 milliliters warm water 200 grams desiccated coconut, to coat
directions: Pre heat the oven to 180C. Grease a baking tin on the sides (I used 22cm round cake tin) or line it with baking paper. Separate the eggs and whisk egg whites. Whisk for about 3-4 minutes or until they reach soft peak. In a separate bowl sift flour, add baking powder and stir. Whisk egg yolks with hand whisker add milk and good quality olive oil as this will affect the taste of the cake. Add flour to it and mix until you get smooth and thick batter. Add egg whites while gently string with spatula. Try not to brake the fluffiness. Pour the batter into the baking tin and bake for 25 minutes. Check the cake with a cake tester before taking out of the oven. Leave on the cooling rack to cool completely. Slice the cake horizontally in half and spread one half with the jam. Top with the other half and leave it to set (I left in in the fridge overnight). Spread desiccated coconut onto a baking sheet. Cut the cake into 12 slices. Dip each into the cocoa icing and leave for minute or two on the cooling rack for the extra cocoa liquid to drain. It is less messy that way. Roll each slice of the cake in the desiccated coconut and leave on the cooling rack to dry before placing into cake box.

title: Corned Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. lemon jello 3 c. boiling water 2 c. mayonnaise 6 hard-cooked eggs, sliced 2 c. chopped celery 1/2 c. chopped green pepper 2 Tbsp. chopped green onions 2 (12 oz. each) cans corned beef
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add mayonnaise to jello while still hot. Scrape fat from corned beef and crumble into small pieces. Add remaining ingredients to warm jello mixture, except sliced hard-cooked eggs. Use two foil pans (11 5/8 x 1/4 x 2 3/8-inches). Divide half of the mixture between the two pans. Top with sliced hard-cooked eggs. Pour remaining jello mixture between pans. It will set up quickly. Make a day ahead.

title: Apple Zucchini Bread
ingredients: 4 cups all-purpose flour 1 tablespoon baking soda 1-1/2 teaspoons ground cinnamon 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg 1/4 teaspoon salt 5 large eggs 1-1/2 cups vegetable oil 2 cups sugar 1 cup packed brown sugar 1 tablespoon vanilla extract 2 cups shredded unpeeled zucchini 1 cup shredded peeled apples 1-1/2 cups chopped pecans
directions: In a large bowl, combine flour, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt. In another bowl, beat eggs. Add oil, sugars and vanilla. Pour over dry ingredients; mix well. Stir in zucchini, apples and pecans (batter will be stiff). Spoon into three greased 8x4-in. loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 50-55 minutes or until done. Cool in pans for 10 minutes before removing to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: "Nanie'S" Hot Milk Cake
ingredients: 4 eggs 2 c. sugar 2 1/2 c. flour 2 tsp. baking powder 1 c. milk 1 c. butter 1 tsp. vanilla 1 tsp. lemon extract
directions: Beat eggs and blend in sugar, 1 cup at a time; mix well. Melt butter in 1 cup of hot milk. Cool a bit, then add to egg-sugar mixture. Mix flour and baking powder together. Add to egg, sugar and butter mixture slowly.

title: Sweet And Spicy Chicken Meatballs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground chicken 1/2 cup breadcrumbs 1/2 cup pre-shredded mozzarella cheese 2 eggs 1 tablespoon parsley 1 teaspoon cumin 1 teaspoon onion salt 1 teaspoon paprika 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon pepper 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes 1 teaspoon rosemary 1 red bell pepper 1/4 cup olive 1/4 cup olive oil 2 chili peppers 2 pepperoncini peppers 2 tablespoons sugar 1 (8 ounce) can condensed tomato soup 1 (8 ounce) can tomato paste 2 cups crushed tomatoes 1 tablespoon oregano 1 tablespoon basil 2 garlic cloves 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar
directions: preheat oven to 450 mix all meatball ingredients in a large bowl. roll into 1 inch balls and place on non stick baking sheet. place baking sheet in oven for 15 minutes. place peppers, olives, oregano, basil, balsamic and garlic in food processor and puree. Mix this mixture with tomato products in a medium saucepan. Heat on medium high for 5 minutes or until simmering. Place chicken meatballs into sauce and let simmer uncovered for 30 minutes. Serve as side, appetizer or on a bun as a sandwich.

title: Apple Bread
ingredients: 2 c. sugar 1 c. salad oil 3 eggs, well beaten 3 c. sifted flour 2 tsp. soda 1 c. chopped nuts 1 tsp. salt 2 Tbsp. vanilla 2 c. chopped apples
directions: Mix salad oil, sugar and eggs. Add flour, soda, nuts, salt and vanilla. Stir in apples. Bake in Bundt pan 60 to 90 minutes at 350°.

title: Sour Cream Coffee Cake
ingredients: 1/3 c. brown sugar 1/4 c. white sugar 1 tsp. cinnamon 1 c. chopped walnuts 1 c. butter 1 c. sugar 2 eggs 1 tsp. vanilla 2 c. flour 1 tsp. baking powder 1 tsp. baking soda 1/2 tsp. salt 1 (8 oz.) carton sour cream
directions: Blend together and set aside first 4 ingredients. Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time. Add vanilla. Sift in dry ingredients alternately with sour cream.

title: Breakfast Casserole
ingredients: 12 slices white bread, remove crusts and cut into 1-inch cubes 1 c. American cheese, grated 2 to 3 c. cooked ham, diced 6 to 8 eggs 1 3/4 to 2 c. milk 2 tsp. salt 1 stick oleo
directions: Place half of bread cubes in buttered 9 x 14-inch pan. Cover with ham and cheese. Then with remaining bread cubes. Combine eggs, milk and salt. Beat and pour over bread. Drizzle melted oleo on top. Refrigerate at least 12 to 24 hours. Bake, covered, at 350° for 45 minutes, uncover and bake 15 minutes longer until done.

title: Creamy Polenta
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups 2% reduced-fat milk 2 cups unsalted chicken stock (such as Swanson) 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 1 cup stone-ground polenta
directions: Bring milk, chicken stock, salt, and pepper to a simmer in a medium saucepan over medium-high heat. Gradually add polenta, stirring constantly with a whisk. Reduce heat, and simmer 10 minutes or until liquid is absorbed, stirring occasionally.

title: Steamed Fish
ingredients: 1 (2 lb) whole perch or 1 (2 lb) rock cod fish 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon sherry wine 4 tablespoons preserved black beans 2 tablespoons sesame oil 2 tablespoons soy sauce 2 green onions, cut into 1 1/2-inch lengths 4 slices ginger, 1-inch x 2-inch shredded 4 large dried Chinese mushrooms, prepared and cut into strips
directions: Clean fish and wipe dry. Rub fish with salt and sherry (inside and outside); place on a large platter. Mash salted black beans with sesame oil and soy sauce. Spread mixture over fish. Arrange green onions, shredded ginger and mushroom strips on top of fish. Place platter on top of rack in steamer. Steam fish for 18-20 minutes. Serve hot as part of a chinese meal. Note: dried mushrooms are soaked in boiling water for 20 minutes, squeezed dry, stems removed and sliced.

title: Calzone-On-A-Stick
ingredients: 8 turkey sausage links about 1-1/2 lbs., or chicken sausage links, cooked 8 wooden craft sticks 16 5/16 ounces refrigerated biscuits 1 package, grand-size 1 jar ragu pasta sauce 1 lb. 8 oz., Old World Style(R) 4 chees mozzarella stick
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Insert craft stick halfway into each sausage; set aside. Separate biscuits. On lightly floured surface, roll each biscuit into 7 x 4-inch oval. Place 2 tablespoons Pasta Sauce on long side of each oval. Top with sausage and 1/2 mozzarella stick. Fold dough over and pinch edges to seal. On greased baking sheet, arrange calzones seam-side down. Bake 15 minutes or until golden. Serve with remaining Pasta Sauce, heated, for dipping.

title: Cheese Ravioli With Brown Butter And Waln
ingredients: 3 1/4 cups all purpose flour 4 eggs lightly beaten 1 tablespoon olive oil 3 1/2 ounces frozen peas thawed 5 1/4 ounces ricotta cheese 3 ounces goat cheese 2 tablespoons fresh mint chopped 2 teaspoons lemon zest 1 egg yolk 1/2 cup butter 2/3 cup walnuts chopped salad beet, to serve
directions: Sift together flour and 1/2 tsp salt. Add eggs, olive oil and 1 tbsp ice water. Mix to form a dough. Turn out onto a floured surface and knead for 3-5 mins, until smooth. Cover and let rest for 10-15 mins. Meanwhile, to make the filling, combine peas, ricotta, goat cheese, mint, lemon zest and egg yolk. Season. Cut dough in 1/2. Roll out each portion as thin as possible (around 1mm thick) using a pasta machine or rolling pin. Cut each sheet in 1/2. Spoon 1 tsp filling at 1 inch intervals across 2 sheets of pasta. Brush around filling with water and top each sheet with a second pasta sheet. Press down firmly between and around each mound of filling. Cut into squares. Cook ravioli in boiling salted water for 3-4 mins, until they rise to the surface. Remove with a slotted spoon. To finish, heat butter in a frying pan over high heat for 3-4 mins, until golden brown. Add walnuts and ravioli. Toss together. Serve with beet salad.

title: Tangy Poppy Seed Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 can (20 ounces) unsweetened pineapple chunks, drained 1 pound fresh strawberries, quartered 2 cups fresh blueberries 2 cups fresh raspberries 2 medium navel oranges, peeled and sectioned 2 medium kiwifruit, peeled, halved and sliced 2 to 4 tablespoons honey 1/2 teaspoon grated lime zest 2 tablespoons lime juice 2 teaspoons poppy seeds
directions: Place all fruit in a large bowl. In a small bowl, whisk dressing ingredients. Drizzle over fruit; toss gently to combine.

title: Best Chocolate Chip Banana Bread
ingredients: 2 cup all-purpose flour 1 cup sugar 1 tsp baking powder 1/2 tsp baking soda 1 tsp salt 1 cup mashed bananas (about 3 small) 1/2 cup shortening 2 eggs 1 1/2 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips 1 cup water (optional)
directions: Heat oven to 350F. Grease two 8 x 4 x 2-inch loaf pans. In large mixer bowl, combine all ingredients except chocolate chips. (Optional) Add water to add moisture. Blend well on medium speed. Stir in chocolate chips. Pour into prepared pans. (Optional) Lay some chocolate chips along the top of the mixture. Bake 45 to 50 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Let cool for 10 minutes. Remove from pans. Let cool completely on wire rack.

title: Asparagus Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. skimmed milk 2 cans asparagus tips 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup 2 pkg. saltine crackers 1 c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
directions: Crush saltines into a casserole dish. Top crackers with asparagus. Mix mushroom soup with skimmed milk. Pour over asparagus. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350° until cheese is melted.

title: Hamburger Or Sausage Quiche
ingredients: 1 unbaked pie crust 1/2 lb. ground beef or ground sausage 1/4 c. mayonnaise 1/2 c. milk 2 eggs 1 Tbsp. cornstarch 1 1/2 c. grated cheese (Cheddar) 1/2 c. chopped onion
directions: Brown meat; add salt and pepper to taste. Blend together mayonnaise, milk, eggs and cornstarch until smooth. Stir in meat, cheese and onion. Pour into pie crust. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Blueberry Cobbler
ingredients: 12 cup sugar 1 tablespoon cornstarch 4 cups fresh blueberries 1 teaspoon lemon juice 1 cup flour 1 tablespoon sugar 1 12 teaspoons baking powder 12 teaspoon salt 3 tablespoons shortening 12 cup milk
directions: Heat oven to 400 Blend 1/2 cup sugar& the cornstarch in med. saucepan Stir in blueberries& lemon juice Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens& boils Boil and stir 1 minute Pour into ungreased 2 qt casserole Place in oven while preparing biscuit topping Measure flour, 1 tbsp sugar, the baking powder& salt into bowl Add shortening& milk Cut through shortening 6 times Mix until dough forms a ball Drop dough by 6 spoonfuls onto hot fruit Bake uncovered 25-30 min or until biscuit topping is golden brown. Serve warm.

title: Penne Pasta With Gorgonzola Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb. penne pasta olive oil 1 large chopped onion 3/4 small jar minced garlic or fresh garlic 1 tsp. chopped basil 1/2 lb. Gorgonzola cheese 14 oz. can diced tomatoes, drained
directions: In skillet, saute onion, garlic, basil and tomatoes in olive oil. Stir cheese into tomato mixture. Pour over cooked, drained pasta.

title: Coconut Cake
ingredients: 3 eggs 1/2 tsp. salt 1 c. sugar granulated 2/3 c. butter 1/3 c. milk 1 tsp. vanilla 2 c. flour 3 tsp. baking powder 1 can baking coconut (6 or 8 oz. can)
directions: Separate white of eggs in small bowl. Mix egg yolk, butter and sugar together. Add dry ingredients; beat. Then add milk and coconut. Beat white of eggs until stiff; fold into cake mix. Pour in two 8-inch cake pans. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Easy  Stromboli
ingredients: 1 pkg pizza crust mix 2 c finely chopped ham 1 pkg 4 oz pepperoni 1 c mozzarella cheese shredded 1 c american cheese shredded 2 tbsp salsa or pizza sauce a pinch of each: margarine, oregano, thyme
directions: Mix pizza crust by direction on pkg. roll out into a 9x14 rectangle. Spread salsa down center, add ham then spices, add cheese, then pepperoni.

title: Irish Stout Granita With Raw Oysters Recipe
ingredients: 3/4 cup porter or Irish stout 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 1 teaspoon lemon zest, plus more for garnish 1 medium shallot, finely diced (about 2 tablespoons) 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh parsley leaves One dozen fresh oysters, scrubbed clean Malt vinegar, to taste
directions: Pour the beer into an 8x8 baking dish, then stir in the black pepper and lemon zest. Place the dish into the freezer. Start checking the dish after 20 minutes. Once the mixture begins freezing around the edges, use a fork to stir the mixture and break up any large pieces of ice. Rake the frozen crystals toward the center of the dish. Return the dish to the freezer and check the mixture every 10 minutes, continuing to scrape and break apart any large chunks of ice and rake them to the center of the dish. Repeat every 10 minutes until you have very fine, almost snow-like, crystals. Because there is so little liquid in this granita, it won't take long to freeze completely. When ready to serve, shuck oysters. Shake a few dashes of malt vinegar onto each of the shucked oysters, between 1/8 to 1/4 of a teaspoon depending on taste. Spoon some of the granita onto each of the shucked oysters, then garnish each with the additional lemon zest, shallots, and parsley. Serve immediately.

title: Pineapple Casserole
ingredients: 1 small can crushed pineapple and juice 2 Tbsp. flour 5 pieces bread, cubed 2 eggs 1/2 c. sugar 1/4 c. melted butter
directions: Mix all together and put in greased casserole. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Green Bell Pepper Rings
ingredients: 2 lbs green peppers, cut into 1/4-inch rings (about 6 medium) 3 tablespoons olive oil 3 -4 garlic cloves, minced 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper 1/2 teaspoon sea salt
directions: Remove ribs from pepper rings. Heat oil in large skillet. Add garlic, black pepper and pepper rings; cook, over high heat and stirring frequently, until tender-crisp-----about 5 minutes. Sprinkle with sea salt. Serve at once.

title: Lemonade
ingredients: 1 c. sugar 5 c. cold water 10 to 12 fresh lemons or 1 c. lemon juice
directions: Dissolve sugar in 1 cup water and lemon juice. Add remaining cold water. Serve over ice. Makes about 6 1/2 cups.

title: Spicy Hush Puppies
ingredients: 2 -3 cups vegetable oil 2 cups self-rising cornmeal 1 cup all-purpose flour 12 teaspoon ground red pepper 1 (14 3/4 ounce) can creamed corn 1 medium onion, chopped 13 cup pickled jalapeno pepper, chopped 1 egg 2 tablespoons milk
directions: In a deep fryer or small-medium saucepan, heat 2 inches of oil to 375F If you are using your stovetop, you will reach 375F on medium low heat. In a medium bowl, combine all dry ingredients. Stir in wet ingredients, including onion and jalenpenos. Drop tablespoons of batter into hot oil, 3 at a time. Fry about 3 minutes, turning once. Drain on paper towels.

title: Miso Soup
ingredients: 5 -6 cups water 1 teaspoon instant dashi stock 1/2 cup miso 3 green onions, chopped
directions: Bring water to a boil; add dashinomoto and miso, stir until miso is dissolved. Add any extras if desired. Garnish with chopped green onions.

title: Kirk Link'S Ozark Puddin' Pie
ingredients: 1 egg 3/4 c. sugar 2 Tbsp. flour 1 1/4 tsp. baking powder 1/8 tsp. salt 1 c. chopped nuts 1/2 c. chopped apples 1 tsp. vanilla
directions: Beat egg and sugar until smooth. Combine flour, baking powder and salt. Stir into egg mixture. Add nuts, apples and vanilla. Bake in greased pie pan, 30 minutes at 325°. Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Oriental Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 4 c. diced, cooked chicken or turkey 2 c. diced celery 1 tsp. grated onion 1 can water chestnuts, sliced 4 c. cooked rice (2 c. uncooked) 2 cans cream of chicken soup 1 tsp. salt 1/2 tsp. pepper 2 Tbsp. lemon juice 1 1/2 c. mayonnaise * 1/2 c. chicken stock * 4 c. potato chips or crushed crackers
directions: *Or use 1 cup mayonnaise and 1 cup chicken stock.

title: Yum-Yum Salad
ingredients: 1 can crushed pineapple, well drained 1 can cherry pie filling 1 can Eagle Brand milk 1 (8 oz.) carton Cool Whip 3/4 c. pecans, chopped
directions: Combine pineapple, pie filling and milk. Then add Cool Whip and pecans. Pour in 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish. Refrigerate overnight. Serve on lettuce leaf.

title: Grandma's Oatmeal Crackers
ingredients: 1 cup shortening 1 cup sugar 2 cups flour 1 pinch baking soda 1 teaspoon baking powder 12 teaspoon salt 4 cups oatmeal 12 cup water
directions: Mix all ingredients. Roll on cookie sheet and cut into squares. Lightly sprinkle with salt. Bake at 375* for 10-15 minutes until lightly browned. Very good! (To roll out, I put waxed paper on the top and roll with rolling pin. Prevents the pin from sticking to the dough.) I guessed at number of servings.

title: Baked Fillets With Lemon-Celery Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs frozen perch or 2 lbs flounder fillets, thawed 10 3/4 ounces cream of celery soup, undiluted 1/4 cup butter, melted 3 tablespoons finely chopped green peppers 2 tablespoons lemon juice paprika
directions: Arrange fillets in a lightly greased 12 x 8 x 2 inch baking dish. Combine soup, butter, green pepper, and lemon juice; pour over fish. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake, uncovered, at 350 degrees for about 20 minutes or till fish flakes easily with a fork. Place fish under broiler 2-3 minutes or till lightly browned.

title: George Washington Pie
ingredients: 2 eggs 1/2 c. sugar 1 tsp. vanilla 1 c. chopped walnuts 1/4 tsp. salt 1 c. Karo dark syrup
directions: Beat eggs. Stir in other ingredients. Pour into pie shell. Bake in a slow 325° oven until a rich brown, about 45 minutes.

title: Sausage-Cheese Balls(Makes 75 Appetizers.)
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. biscuit mix 1 lb. grated Cheddar cheese 1 lb. lean ground pork sausage
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Combine ingredients until dough sticks together. Roll in 1 1/2-inch balls. Bake about 25 minutes. Drain on paper towels. Serve warm on toothpicks.

title: Hazelnut And Herb Toasts
ingredients: 1/2 None loaf brioche bread, sliced, crusts removed 1/3 cup extra virgin olive oil, plus extra for brushing and drizzling 6 oz hazelnuts, roasted, skins removed 1/2 oz mint leaves, plus extra to garnish 1/2 oz parsley leaves 1/2 tsp zaatar, plus extra to serve 1 None lemon, juiced
directions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Line a baking sheet with foil. Brush both sides of bread with oil. Cut into fingers and arrange on baking sheet. Bake 5-10 mins, turning once, until golden. Meanwhile, for the topping, place hazelnuts, herbs, oil, zaatar and lemon juice in a food processor or blender. Process into a chunky paste and season to taste. Spread on toasts, drizzle with olive oil and top with extra mint leaves to serve.

title: Strawberry Cheese Pie
ingredients: 1 (9-inch) baked pastry shell or graham cracker crust 1 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk 1/2 c. lemon juice 1 tsp. vanilla 1 qt. fresh strawberries 1 (16 oz.) jar strawberry glaze
directions: In large bowl, beat cream cheese until creamy. Gradually beat in Eagle Brand until smooth. Stir in lemon juice and vanilla. Pour into prepared crust. Chill 3 hours or until set. Top with strawberries and glaze.

title: Mexican Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 2 c. grated cheese 1 chicken, boiled 1 can cream of chicken soup 1 can cream of mushroom soup 1 can chicken broth 1 can Ro-Tel tomatoes 1 sack tortilla chips (medium size) 1 onion, chopped
directions: Heat soups and add chicken. Butter pan; layer chicken, then onion, then chips, then cheese. Repeat layers and end with cheese on top. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Pasta A' Figiol(Italian Soup)
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef, browned 6 c. water 2 Tbsp. beef base 2 cans red beans, drained 1 can white beans, drained 1 medium onion 2 stalks celery 1 carrot, grated 1 qt. pureed tomatoes 16 oz. can tomato juice 16 oz. can tomatoes 2 Tbsp. parsley 1 Tbsp. oregano 1 tsp. pepper 1 1/2 tsp. salt 1/2 to 1 c. pasta
directions: Simmer until pasta is done.

title: Upscale Peas With Mint
ingredients: 2 teaspoons olive oil 1 small shallot, minced (about 1 1/2 T) 1 med.garlic clove, minced 1 lb baby peas, frozen 14 cup chicken broth, low sodium 14 teaspoon sugar 14 cup fresh mint leaves 1 tablespoon butter, unsalted 2 teaspoons lemon juice, fresh if possible salt and pepper
directions: Heat oil in 12" skiller over medium high heat until simmering. Add shallots and ccok, stirring frequently until softened, about 2 minutes. Add garlic and cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Stir in peas, broth and sugar. Cover and cook until peas are bright green and just heated through, stirring halfway, until heated through, 3-6 minutes. Add mint leaves and butter until incorporated. Remove from heat, stir in lemon juice. Add salt and pepper to taste and serve immediately.

title: Marinated Fruit Salad
ingredients: 2 apples 3 pears 3 peaches 1 pineapple confectioners sugar 1/4 c. rum
directions: Pare, core and slice apples and pears. Halve, peel, pit and slice peaches. Cut pineapple into chunks.

title: Grilled Skirt Steak and Orzo with the Works
ingredients: 1 1/2 to 2 pounds skirt steak 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar (eyeball it) 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil (EVOO), plus some for drizzling Coarse black pepper Coarse salt 1/2 pound orzo 1 large red onion, chopped 4 garlic cloves, chopped 1 fennel bulb, quartered, cored, and thinly sliced 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes (a couple of pinches) 1 cup chicken stock or broth 1 pint grape tomatoes 10 fresh basil leaves, chopped or torn 1/2 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley leaves (a couple of generous handfuls), chopped 1/2 cup grated Parmigiano-Reggiano (a couple of overflowing handfuls)
directions: Coat the skirt steak in balsamic vinegar, a good drizzle of EVOO, and a lot of freshly ground black pepper and marinate in a nonreactive dish for 5 to 10 minutes. Preheat an outdoor grill or ridged grill pan to high. Bring a large sauce pot of water to a boil to cook the orzo. Once boiling, salt the water and add the orzo. Cook until al dente, with a bite to it, about 12 minutes. While the water is coming up to a boil, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat with the 2 tablespoons of EVOO (twice around the pan); add the onions, garlic, fennel, red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper and cook, stirring frequently, for 4 to 5 minutes, or until the veggies are slightly tender. Season the steak with salt and grill for 3 to 4 minutes on each side. Remove the meat to a plate, tent loosely with foil, and let it rest for 5 minutes to allow the juices to redistribute. To the veggies, add the chicken stock and grape tomatoes, bring up to a bubble, and cook for 2 minutes, or until the grape tomatoes begin to burst. Add the cooked orzo, basil, parsley, and grated Parmigiano cheese and stir to combine. Slice the meat very thin on a sharp angle. Serve alongside the orzo with the works.

title: Pecan Pralines
ingredients: 1 1/4 c. white sugar 1/4 stick oleo 1 tsp. vanilla 3/4 c. brown sugar 1/2 c. canned milk 2 or 3 c. pecans
directions: Bring sugar, butter and milk to a boil, stirring constantly, until a soft ball when dropped in water. Remove from the fire. Add vanilla and pecans. Beat until it begins to thicken. Drop on wax paper.

title: Deep-South Ovenly Chicken
ingredients: 4 Tbsp. butter or margarine (1/2 stick) 1 c. buttermilk baking mix 1/2 c. pecans, finely chopped 1 (5 oz.) can evaporated milk (2/3 c.) parsley sprigs (for garnish) 1 tsp. paprika 1 tsp. salt 1/2 tsp. poultry seasoning 1 (3 lb.) fryer-broiler, cut up
directions: About 1 1/4 hours before serving: In large open roasting pan in 400° oven, melt butter or margarine. Meanwhile, on waxed paper, combine baking mix, chopped pecans, paprika, salt and poultry seasoning. Into pie plate, pour evaporated milk. Dip chicken pieces in milk, then coat well with baking mix mixture. Place chicken pieces, skin side down, in roasting pan. Bake chicken 30 minutes. With pancake turner, carefully turn chicken pieces. Bake 20 minutes longer or until juices run clear when chicken is pierced with a fork, covering with foil after 10 minutes if chicken begins to brown too quickly. Arrange chicken on platter. Garnish with parsley sprigs. Makes 4 servings.

title: Mom'S Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 c. granulated sugar 1/3 c. packed brown sugar 1/2 c. margarine or butter, softened (1 stick) 1/2 c. peanut butter 1/2 tsp. vanilla 1 egg 1 c. flour 1/2 c. quick cook oats 1 tsp. baking soda 1 (6 oz.) pkg. chocolate chips 1/4 tsp. salt
directions: Heat oven to 350°. Beat sugars, margarine, peanut butter, vanilla and egg in medium bowl until creamy. Mix in flour, oats, baking soda and salt. Stir in chocolate chips. Drop by teaspoon about 2 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. Makes about 2 dozen cookies.

title: Sandwich-on-a-Stick
ingredients: 1 pouch CAPRI SUN 100% Juice, Apple Splash 1 slice whole wheat bread, quartered 2 pieces (1/2 oz. each) KRAFT 2% Milk Cheddar Cheese 2 grape tomatoes 2 cucumber slices 1 Tbsp. KRAFT Lite Ranch Dressing
directions: Remove and discard plastic from beverage straw. Thread bread, cheese, tomatoes and cucumbers alternately onto straw. Serve with dressing for dipping. Use straw for beverage after threaded ingredients are removed.

title: Cocoa Brownies
ingredients: 1 c. sugar 1/2 c. margarine or butter, softened 1 tsp. vanilla 2 eggs 2/3 c. all-purpose flour * 1/2 c. cocoa 1/2 c. chopped walnuts 1/2 tsp. baking powder 1/2 tsp. salt
directions: Heat oven to 350°. Mix sugar, margarine, vanilla and eggs. Stir in remaining ingredients. Spread in greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch square pan. Bake until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean, 25 to 30 minutes. Cool. Frost with Fudge Frosting, if desired. Cut into about 2-inch squares. Makes 16 brownies, 160 calories per brownie.

title: Crock Pot Cheesy Mushroom Chicken
ingredients: 1 (10 ounce) can cream of mushroom soup 1 (10 ounce) can cream of chicken soup 1 (8 ounce) can mushroom pieces 1/2 cup cooking sherry 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese 1 teaspoon dried celery flakes 1 teaspoon minced garlic 1/2 teaspoon paprika 6 skinless chicken breast halves egg noodles or rice
directions: Combine first eight ingredients and mix in a mixing bowl. Place chicken in crock pot and cover with mixture. Cook on low for eight hours. Serve over noodles or rice (prepared to package directions).

title: Black Cherry Gelatin Dessert
ingredients: 1 pkg. black cherry gelatin 1 c. boiling water 1/2 c. orange juice 1 can black cherries 1/2 c. black cherry juice
directions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water. Add orange and cherry juice. Add cherries; stir at intervals to keep them evenly distributed until mixture begins to gel. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Serve plain or with whipped cream.

title: Chimichurri Cheesesteaks
ingredients: 2 cups packed fresh flat-leaf parsley leaves (about 2 bunches) 4 garlic cloves, chopped 1/4 cup lemon juice 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil 1 3/4 teaspoons MORTON Salt, divided 1 1/4 teaspoons pepper, divided 4 cups thinly sliced sweet onion (about 2) 2 tablespoons CRISCO Vegetable Oil 1 1/2 pounds U.S. BEEF Boneless Chuck-Eye Steaks (3/4- to 1-inch thick) 6 SARA LEE Center-Split Deli Rolls 1/4 pound thinly sliced provolone cheese REYNOLDS WRAP Heavy Duty Foil
directions: Pulse parsley and garlic in a blender or food processor just until finely chopped. (Do not puree.) Remove to a medium bowl, and stir in lemon juice, olive oil, 3/4 teaspoon salt, and 3/4 teaspoon pepper; set aside. Cook onion and 1/2 teaspoon salt in hot vegetable oil over medium-high heat, stirring often, 15 minutes or until onions are golden brown and tender. Sprinkle steaks evenly with remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt and remaining 1/2 teaspoon pepper. Grill, covered with grill lid, over medium-high heat (350° to 400°) 7 to 10 minutes on each side or to desired degree of doneness. Cut rolls in half lengthwise, and grill cut sides of rolls during the last few minutes of cooking steaks. Remove steaks and rolls. Cut steaks into thin slices. Spread parsley mixture evenly on cut sides of bread; place steak slices and onion evenly on bottom bread halves, and top each evenly with cheese and remaining bread halves. Wrap each sandwich in foil. Grill, covered with grill lid, 3 to 4 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Grilled Pineapple With Mint Sugar
ingredients: 3 tablespoons sugar 2 tablespoons chopped fresh mint leaves 3/4 teaspoon finely grated lime rind 1 medium pineapple, peeled, cored, and cut into 12 wedges Cooking spray 1 tablespoon butter, melted
directions: Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high. Combine sugar, mint, and rind in a mini food processor; process until mint is finely ground (mixture should resemble damp green sand). Arrange pineapple on grill grates coated with cooking spray; cook 3 to 4 minutes on each side or until well marked. Arrange pineapple on a platter; drizzle evenly with butter. Sprinkle with sugar mixture; let stand 2 minutes before serving.

title: Cheesy Chicken Wings
ingredients: 2 lb. chicken drummettes 1 c. Parmesan cheese 2 tsp. paprika 1 Tbsp. leaf oregano 2 tsp. salt 1/2 c. melted butter
directions: Mix cheese and spices. Dip chicken in butter, then roll in cheese mixture. Place on foil-lined cookie sheet that has been sprayed with Pam. Make a lip with the foil so the grease won't spill over.

title: Williamsburg Orange Cake
ingredients: 8 tablespoons butter, softened 1 cup sugar 2 eggs 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 1 23 cups all-purpose flour 1 teaspoon baking soda 12 teaspoon salt 1 cup sour milk or 1 cup buttermilk 1 cup raisins, chopped 2 ounces walnuts, coarsely chopped (about 1/2 cup) 1 tablespoon orange zest 2 cups sifted confectioners' sugar 2 tablespoons warm water
directions: FOR THE CAKE: Cream together the butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in the eggs and the vanilla extract. In a small bowl, blend the flour, baking soda and salt. Add the flour mixture to the butter mixture alternately with the sour milk or buttermilk, beginning and ending with the flour mixture. Blend well after each addition. Stir in the raisins, walnuts and orange peel. Pour the mixture into a buttered and floured 8 inch square pan, and bake in a preheated 350F oven for 45 to 50 minutes, or until a cake tester comes out clean when inserted into the center of the cake. Leave the cake in the pan on a wire rack for 10 minutes before removing it from the pan and cooling it thoroughly on the rack. Cover the cooled cake with the glace icing. FOR THE GLACE ICING: For this recipe use 2 tablespoons sweet sherry instead of water, and flavored with 1 tablespoons grated orange peel. Stir the warm water and the confectioners sugar together until the sugar dissolves completely and the icing is smooth. The icing should be thick enough to coat the back of a spoon. If it is too thick, add more liquid; if too thin, add a little sugar. The icing should be used at once. Makes about 1 cup. To make coffee flavored icing replace the water with strong black coffee. Once it is made, plain glace icing may be flavored to taste with vanilla, almond or peppermint extract, or with a liqueur. Liqueur must be added in large amounts than more concentrated extracts; if you use liqueur, reduce the amount of water used in the icing by about 1 Tablespoon. For chocolate flavored icing, melt 2 ounces of semisweet chocolate in the top of a double boiler over hot water. Let the chocolate cool slightly, then stir it into the prepared icing. The Early American Cookbook.

title: Buttermilk Pancakes
ingredients: 1 c. buttermilk 1/2 tsp. soda 1/2 tsp. salt 1 1/2 tsp. sugar 2 Tbsp. oil or shortening 1 egg 1 c. or more flour to make a good batter 1 tsp. baking powder
directions: Mix batter, test pancake. Add more flour if necessary.

title: Spicy Rosemary Walnuts
ingredients: 4 tablespoons unsalted butter 1 tablespoon dried rosemary 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes 1/2 teaspoon salt 6 cups walnut halves
directions: Preheat oven to 350°F with a rack in center. In a pan, melt butter with rosemary, red pepper flakes and salt. Spread walnut halves on a large baking sheet. Pour butter mixture over and toss to coat. Bake, stirring occasionally, until golden, 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Sausage Balls #1
ingredients: 1 lb. sausage 2 c. cheese (1 lb.), grated or chunked 2 1/2 c. Bisquick
directions: Knead all ingredients together. Form into balls and bake at 350° for 12 minutes.

title: Moosewood'S Italian Fish Stew
ingredients: 3 garlic cloves, minced 2 cups onions, chopped 2 tablespoons olive oil 2 teaspoons fennel seeds, ground 1/2 cup dry white wine (only use what you would drink!) 4 cups potatoes, cubed 4 cups fennel (often referred to as Anise) 28 ounces plum tomatoes, un-drained 1 tablespoon dried rosemary (use a tea strainer) or 2 fresh rosemary sprigs 1 teaspoon dried orange peel 1 pinch saffron (generous!) 1 1 lb black-tip shark fillets (a firm fish fillet) or 1 lb cod fish fillet (a firm fish fillet) 16 ounces bottled clam juice salt and pepper
directions: Saute garlic and onion in the oil over medium heat. Stir frequently (about 7-8 minutes). Add the ground fennel and white wine and cook for two minutes. Add the chopped fennel, potatoes, tomatoes, and clam juice. Place the rosemary and orange peel in a tea ball or make a boquet garni and add it to the stew. Bring to a boil, lower the heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Add saffron and fish to the stew and simmer for about 20 minutes (until fish flakes with fork). Add salt and pepper to taste. Top with basil or parsley and serve with fresh bread. ENJOY!

title: Slow Cooked Beef
ingredients: 1 pkg. stew meat, cut into small pieces or for healthier meat, use eye of round roast and cut into bite size pieces 1 can cream of mushroom soup 1 can cream of celery soup 1 can cream of chicken soup 1/2 can water
directions: Mix soups and the one half can of water together and pour over meat mixture in roasting pan. Cook in a slow oven, 250°, for 3 hours. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Black Bean Salsa
ingredients: 1 (15-ounce) can black beans, rinsed and drained 1/2 cup frozen corn, thawed 2 plum tomatoes, seeded and chopped 1 green onion, chopped 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro 1 garlic clove, pressed 1/2 teaspoon Creole seasoning
directions: Stir together all ingredients. Cover and chill until ready to serve.

title: Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 can mandarin oranges, undrained 1 can pineapple chunks, drained 1 can fruit cocktail, drained 1 (3 oz.) pkg. instant lemon pudding
directions: Mix the three cans of fruit. Add pudding mix and mix thoroughly. Refrigerate 24 hours. Before serving, add bananas if desired.

title: Creme De Brie Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 24 large mushrooms 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil 1 stalk celery, diced 12 red pepper, diced 2 tablespoons drained non pareil capers 18 teaspoon dried thyme or 14 teaspoon fresh thyme 18 teaspoon dried oregano leaves or 14 teaspoon fresh oregano salt and pepper 2 (5 ounce) packagesalouette creme de brie cheese, Original
directions: Preheat oven to 350F Wash mushrooms thoroughly. Remove stems and set aside. Place cap (hollow) side down into a shallow baking dish. Brush the bottom and sides of the mushroom caps lightly with oil and bake for 15 minutes in the preheated oven. Chop the mushroom stems finely and saute in olive oil with diced celery and peppers for 5 minutes. Stir in the capers and season to taste with the thyme, oregano, salt and pepper. Remove mushrooms from oven, and fill with mixture and top with 1 tablespoons of Alouette Creme de Brie. Broil on the top rack of the oven for 3-4 minutes until cheese is browned and bubbly.

title: Broccoli cheese casserole
ingredients: 35 Ritz crackers 14 lb Velveeta cheese 14 lb margarine 2 (10 ounce) packages frozen broccoli
directions: Cook Broccoli as directed. Crush crackers into fine crumbs. Melt cheese and butter together. Layer into a casserole dish. top with crackers. Bake at 350 degrees F.

title: Pea And Cheese Salad
ingredients: 1 (12 ounce) package frozen peas, thawed 1 cup chopped celery 2 hardboiled egg, chopped 1 cup cubed cheddar cheese 1/2 cup thinly sliced radish 1/4 cup chopped green onion 1 cup Miracle Whip 1 teaspoon seasoning salt 1 teaspoon ground mustard
directions: In a lg bowl, combine peas, celery, eggs, cheese, radishes and onion. In a small bowl, combine the miricle whip and the seasonings. Stir into the pea mixture. Cover and refridgerate until serving.

title: Chicken Fried Rice - Restaurant Style
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked long-grain rice (Jasmine Thai) 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon sugar 1/4 teaspoon white pepper 1/4 teaspoon msg 1/2 teaspoon oyster sauce 1 teaspoon soy sauce 1 egg 1/2 cup frozen peas and carrot 1/2 sweet vidalia onion, finely chopped 1/2 lb chicken breast 1 teaspoon cornstarch 1/8 teaspoon garlic powder 4 tablespoons vegetable oil
directions: Wash rice and cook with a couple pinches of salt. Then, put it on a plate and cover with saran wrap and allow to cool in fridge for at least 1 hour. Slice the chicken to the size of 3 quarter dollars put together, or cut to your preference. Partially freeze the meat to make meat easier to cut small. Put the chicken in a small bowl. Add the cornstarch, garlic powder, 1/2 the salt, 1/2 the sugar, 1/2 the white pepper, 1/2 the MSG and 2 teaspoons of water. Mix by hand to coat the meat. This step keeps the meat juicy while cooking in hot oil. Heat 3 tablespoons oil in your wok at 80% heat. Add the chicken and cook until white. Drain off the oil and set meat aside. Add the remaining tablespoon of oil to the wok. Heat to 60% heat and add the beaten egg. Allow the egg to cook before stirring it. Stirring the egg while it is setting will make the egg more fluffy, like scrambled eggs. Turn the heat up to 80% and add the onion. Cook for 30 seconds and then add the cooled rice. Keep flipping or turning the rice over to heat it evenly in the pan for 1 minute. Add the remaining salt, sugar, white pepper, and MSG. Continue turning the rice for another minute. Add the chicken, oyster sauce, soy sauce, and peas and carrots. Continue turning and flipping for 3 minutes.

title: Nancy'S Whoopie Pies
ingredients: 1/2 c. shortening 1 c. milk 1 c. sugar 2 c. flour 2/3 c. cocoa 2 eggs 1 tsp. soda 1 tsp. baking powder 1/2 tsp. salt 1/2 tsp. vanilla
directions: Mix all ingredients together in bowl. Drop by small spoonfuls on cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes; cool. Put together with filling in between.

title: Crispy Rosemary Hummus
ingredients: 2 (15 ounce) cans garbanzo beans, drained 1/3 cup plain Greek yogurt 2 1/2 tablespoons olive oil 3 -4 sprigs fresh rosemary 1 teaspoon lemon juice 1 large garlic clove 1 teaspoon salt pepper
directions: Place the oil in a small skillet over high heat. Once smoking, flash-fry the rosemary sprigs for 30 seconds per side. Remove and place on a paper towel, reserving the oil. Place the garbanzo beans in the food processor with the yogurt, rosemary-infused oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt and pepper. Puree to desired consistency. Pull the crispy rosemary leaves off the stems and place them in the food processor. Pulse until the rosemary has worked through the hummus. Makes 2 1/2 cups.

title: Warm Quinoa Breakfast Porridge
ingredients: 1/2 cups Cooked Quinoa 1/2 cups Almond Milk 2 Tablespoons Ground Flax Seeds 2 Tablespoons Sunflower Seeds 2 Tablespoons Raisins Sprinkle Of Ground Cinnamon
directions: Add all ingredients to a medium pot and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until creamy. Add more almond milk if it looks dry. Serve topped with a few extra sunflower seeds and raisins (and a drizzle of maple syrup if you want it a wee bit sweeter).

title: Harvest Baked Apples
ingredients: 4 braeburn apples or 4 gala apples 13 cup dried currant 14 cup almonds, chopped 2 tablespoons brown sugar 2 teaspoons all-purpose flour 12 teaspoon ground cinnamon 12 lemon, juiced salt, to taste 12 cup apple cider, divided 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, cut into 8 cubes 14 cup rolled oats 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour 2 tablespoons sugar 1 tablespoon unsalted butter, cold, cubed 1 tablespoon water 12 teaspoon ground cinnamon 14 teaspoon almond extract 14 cup plain yogurt, divided
directions: Preheat oven to 350F; lightly coat a 9" glass pie plate or square aking dish with nonstick spray. Scoop the core and enough flesh out of each apple with a melon baller to hold about 1/4 c of filling. Combine chopped apple, currants, almonds, brown sugar, 2 t. flour, 1/2 t. cinnamon, lemon juice and salt in a bowl. Stuff filling into apples and arrange in the prepared dish. Pour 1 T. cider into each cavity, then top with a cube of butter; add remaining cider and butter to tthe baking dish. Blen doats, 2 T. Flour, sugar, 1 T. butter, water, 1/2 t. cinnamon, almond extract, and salt to taste in a bowl until crumbly using your fingers. Top each apple with a generous tablespoon of the mixture, packing so it sticks. Bake applses 35-45 minutes, or until easily pierced with a knife, but not mushy. Let apples cool in the pan 10 minutes. To serve, transfer apples to small plates, top with yogurt, and drizzle with pan juices.

title: Fruit Salad with yogurt
ingredients: 1 medium banana 1/3 cup walnuts 1 small Plum 1 kiwi 1 cup low bulgarian yogurt (or greek yogurt)
directions: Slice all the fruits and place them on top of the yogurt in a bowl. Sprinkle the walnuts on top.

title: Easy Marinated Roast Pork
ingredients: 500 grams Pork butt (shoulder or roast) or pork belly block 50 grams Sugar 100 ml Soy sauce 50 ml Sake 2 tsp Dashi stock granules 2 tsp Grated ginger 1 tsp Grated garlic
directions: Pierce the surface of the pork several times with a fork to make it easier for the flavors to penetrate. If you're not making marinated eggs, you can cook two 500 g blocks of pork in the sauce. Put all the ingredients except for the pork in a plastic bag and mix the sauce through the bag. Be careful not to poke a hole in the bag or let the contents leak out. Put the meat in the bag and cover with the macerating sauce. Press out the air from the bag, tie it closed and leave in the refrigerator overnight. If you're worried that the bag will leak, double-bag it. Preheat the oven to 390F/200C. Line an oven sheet with a generous sheet of parchment paper. Drain off as much macerating sauce as you can from the pork and bake for 30 to 40 minutes. Transfer the sauce to a small pan and bring to a boil. Skim off the scum. When the pork is baked, leave it on the oven sheet until it has cooled down. The excess fat that has rendered will coagulate on the paper, so throw out. If you slice the meat on a cutting board the board will get really oily, so open up a milk carton to use as a cutting board. You can just throw the carton out when you're done and save yourself time. Arrange the slices on a plate, and spoon the sauce over. Put the leftover sauce from step 8 and boiled eggs in a plastic bag, and leave to macerate overnight in the refrigerator to make flavored eggs. If you want to eat the pork and the marinated eggs on the same day, double the amount of macerating sauce and take out half of it after the meat has been macerating for an hour. Bring to a boil, and use to macerate the eggs. If you want to simmer the pork, brown the surface of the pork after step 1, and put into a pot with the marinade ingredients and plenty of water. Cover with a small lid or aluminum foil that sits on top of the contents of the pan (a drop lid or otoshibuta) and simmer for 2 hours. As it simmers, the liquid will reduce, so check on it occasionally and add water if needed. At the end the simmering liquid should have reduced and become sauce-like.

title: Dip
ingredients: 2 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese 3/4 c. chopped walnuts 2 Tbsp. honey 3/4 c. chopped dates
directions: Mix and serve with party crackers.

title: Slow Roasted Fall Vegetables
ingredients: 3 parsnips 6 carrots 1 bulb celery root 4 potatoes 5 stalks celery 1 onion 8 whole cloves garlic About 1/2 cup olive oil (or more as needed) 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary leaves 1 tablespoon fresh thyme leaves Coarse sea salt and freshly ground pepper to taste Rosemary sprigs to garnish
directions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees. Peel the parsnips, carrots, celery root and potatoes and cut them into one-inch cubes. Slice the celery and onion. Leave the garlic cloves whole in their skins. Put the vegetables in one layer in one or two large baking dishes and toss them in the oil so they are thoroughly coated. Sprinkle them with rosemary, thyme, salt and pepper. Bake the vegetables for an hour and a half (turning them from time to time so they brown on all sides). Do not let them get too dark or they will develop a bitter taste. Put the vegetables on a serving platter, correct seasoning and garnish with rosemary sprigs.

title: Spinach Balls
ingredients: 2 pkg. chopped spinach, cooked and drained 3 c. Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing mix 4 eggs, beaten 1/2 c. Parmesan cheese 1 chopped small onion 1/2 butter 1/2 tsp. garlic powder 1/2 tsp. poultry seasoning
directions: Chill overnight. Roll into small balls. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes or done.

title: Lemon Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into strips 1 medium onion, chopped 1 large carrot, thinly sliced 1 garlic clove, minced 2 Tbsp. butter or margarine 1 Tbsp. cornstarch 1 (4 1/2 oz.) can chicken broth 2 to 3 Tbsp. fresh lemon juice 1 tsp. grated lemon peel 1/2 tsp. salt (optional) 1 1/2 c. uncooked instant rice 1 c. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed 1/4 c. minced fresh parsley
directions: In a skillet, cook chicken, onion, carrot and garlic in butter until chicken is lightly browned, about 5 minutes.

title: Italian Chicken Sandwich
ingredients: 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour 12 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper 4 chicken breast halves, boneless and skinless natural olive oil nonstick cooking spray 6 tablespoons fresh lemon juice 4 garlic cloves, minced 4 teaspoons Worcestershire sauce 1 teaspoon italian seasoning 1 dash hot pepper sauce 2 tablespoons walnuts, toasted and chopped 4 teaspoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese 4 wheat sandwich buns, sliced lengthwise 4 romaine lettuce leaves
directions: Combine flour and pepper. Coat chicken with flour mixture, shaking off excess. Spray a 10-inch skillet with cooking spray for 2 seconds; over medium heat, lightly brown chicken on both sides. Combine lemon juice, garlic, Worcestershire and hot pepper sauce and italian seasoning; pour over chicken. Cover; simmer for 15 minutes or until chicken is done. Sprinkle walnuts and cheese over chicken. Arrange lettuce on sandwich rolls; top with chicken. Serve immediately.

title: Chicken Dan-Dan Noodles
ingredients: 1/2 pound fresh, thin Chinese-style egg noodles (chow mein)* or dried chow mein 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger 2 teaspoons minced garlic 2 tablespoons cornstarch 3 tablespoons reduced-sodium soy sauce 3/4 pound ground chicken 2/3 cup low-sodium chicken broth 2 tablespoons creamy old-fashioned peanut butter 1 tablespoon unseasoned rice vinegar 2 teaspoons Asian chili garlic sauce, plus more to taste 2 teaspoons hot chili oil, plus more to taste 2 teaspoons toasted sesame oil 2 tablespoons canola or safflower oil 1/4 cup sliced green onions, plus more for garnish 1 1/2 red bell peppers, seeded and cut into slivers 1/2 pound snow peas, trimmed 1/2 cup chopped roasted salted peanuts
directions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add noodles, stir to separate, and cook until very tender, 5 to 8 minutes or according to package instructions. Drain and rinse with cold water. Meanwhile, thoroughly mix ginger, garlic, cornstarch, soy sauce, and chicken in a bowl. In another bowl, whisk together broth, peanut butter, vinegar, chili garlic sauce, chili oil, and sesame oil. Heat a large (not nonstick) frying pan over high heat and swirl in canola oil. Add green onions and chicken mixture, stirring to break up the meat, until chicken is lightly browned and no longer pink, 4 to 5 minutes. Add bell peppers and stir for 1 minute. Add chicken broth mixture; stir until slightly thickened, 2 minutes. Add snow peas and noodles to pan. With tongs, toss just until snow peas are brighter green and noodles are well combined and heated through, 1 to 2 minutes. Add 1/4 cup peanuts and toss. Top with more green onions and remaining peanuts, and serve with more chili garlic sauce and chili oil. *Look for fresh or dried Chinese-style egg noodles at well-stocked supermarkets or Asian markets. Wine pairing: A slightly off-dry white such as Zocker 2013 Paragon Vineyard Riesling (Edna Valley; $20), with vibrant florals that tame the heat. --Sara Schneider

title: Baked Beans
ingredients: 2 c. beans 6 c. water 1 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. baking soda 1/2 c. ketchup 1 Tbsp. vinegar 1/4 c. brown sugar 1 tsp. dry mustard 2 Tbsp. molasses 1/2 lb. bacon, crisp and crumbled 1/2 c. onion, chopped
directions: Combine all ingredients in a slow cooker. Cook until beans are tender.

title: Truth Serum 2.0 Margarita
ingredients: 1 cup fresh lime juice 1 cup tequila (anything decent like Sauza Silver, Cazadores, Hornitos...) 1 cup water 5 -6 tablespoons agave syrup 2 teaspoons orange liqueur (such as Grand Marnier, Cointreau, Origine) 1 lime wedge salt, & sugar for the glass rim (equal parts of sea salt and sugar)
directions: Mix the lime juice, tequila and, water agave syrup in a measuring cup. Stir until the syrup is fully incorporated with the liquids. Take a lime wedge and run it around the rim of a glass; dip the glass into the salt/sugar mixture; take any excess salt/sugar off rim to make it look pretty! Fill the glass just halfway with margarita mix, fill the glass the rest of the way with ice cubes and stir. Pour a small "dollop" of orange liqueur on top of the ice (about 2 teaspoons). Add a lime wedge and serve! Make the concoction to suit your taste by adding more agave syrup (if you like it sweeter) or lime juice (for a more sour flavor). Enjoy!

title: Cottage Cheese Pakoras
ingredients: 1/2 lb. cottage cheese 1 c. graham flour salt to taste 1/2 tsp. red pepper powder oil for deep frying water to make a batter of coating consistency
directions: Sift graham flour; add water to make a batter of coating consistency. Beat the batter until it floats in the water; add seasonings. Cut the cottage cheese into small pieces size 1 1/2 x 3/4-inch and sprinkle seasonings on it. Coat the cheese pieces with batter and deep-fry to golden brown.

title: Veggie Pasta
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil 1 medium sweet onion, diced 8 ounce package baby portobella mushrooms (sliced) 1 tablespoon garlic 1/8 teaspoon salt 1/8 teaspoon pepper dash of red pepper flakes (or more, if you prefer more) 1/2 teaspoon Italian Seasoning (marjoram, thyme, rosemary savory, sage, oregano, and basil blend) 4-5 ounces fresh spinach 1/4 cup reduced sodium chicken broth 24 ounce can tomato sauce (Bertolli Olive Oil and Garlic) 13.25 ounce box of whole wheat angel hair pasta gouda cheese
directions: Prepare veggies. Saute onions, mushrooms and garlic in olive oil, over medium high heat. Once tender, add in salt, pepper, seasonings, spinach, and chicken broth. Let it simmer for 5 minutes, reducing the liquid a little bit. Turn the heat down to low/medium low and stir in the tomato sauce. Boil the noodles. Serve with chunks of gouda cheese and enjoy!

title: Homemade Pop Sickles
ingredients: 1 ice cube tray wax paper pop sickle sticks 1 pkg. favorite cool-aide sugar
directions: Mix cool-aide and sugar together. Pour into cubed ice tray. Put wax paper over tray. Cut holes in the middle of the cube, just big enough to fit a stick in. Put in freezer until well set. Take out of freezer; remove wax paper. Take as many out as you would like and enjoy. Put remainder in freezer.

title: Fudge Sauce
ingredients: 1 sq. chocolate 1 Tbsp. butter 1/3 c. boiling water dash of salt 1 c. sugar 2 Tbsp. light corn syrup 1/2 tsp. vanilla
directions: Melt chocolate and butter; add boiling water. Bring to the boiling point; add sugar, then syrup, vanilla and salt. Simmer for 5 minutes.

title: Undercover Brown Beans
ingredients: 1 lb. hamburger 2 c. cooked brown beans 1 small onion, diced 1 can Cheddar cheese soup 1 can tomato sauce 1 small can chopped chilies, drained corn bread
directions: Brown meat; season to taste and drain. Add other ingredients and mix well. Pour into baking dish. Mix up corn bread and spread evenly over entire mixture. Bake at 400° until corn bread is browned. Great for left over beans. Can use ground turkey.

title: Sweetened Condensed Milk
ingredients: 3 Tbsp. butter, melted 2/3 c. sugar pinch of salt 1 c. instant dry milk 1/3 c. boiling water
directions: Put all ingredients in a blender and process until smooth. This thickens quickly. It should be used as soon as it is cool. This makes the equivalent of 1 can of Eagle Brand milk.

title: Root Vegetable Gratin
ingredients: 25 g butter 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard 100 ml beer 100 ml double cream 100 g vegetarian cheddar cheese 450 g potatoes, thinly sliced 225 g turnips, thinly sliced 225 g sweet potatoes, thinly sliced 2 teaspoons caraway seeds
directions: Heat oven to 190C. Grease an ovenproof dish. Melt the butter and add the mustard, beer and cream. Mix well and bring to the boil. Remove from the heat and stir in three quarters of the cheese mixing well. Bring a pan of water to the boil and cook the potatoes for 4 minutes Remove and pat dry. Cook the turnips and sweet potatoes in the same water for 4 minutes and remove and pat dry. Layer the vegetables in the greased dish alternating with the sauce and a sprinkle of caraway seeds. Finish with the sauce and the rest of the cheese. Bake for 35 minutes until golden and bubbly.

title: Mouthwatering Chicken Strips #RSC
ingredients: 1 (16 ounce) bottle Hidden Valley Original Ranch Dressing, divided in half 1 lb boneless chicken breast, trimmed and cut into 1-inch wide strips 2 cups breadcrumbs 1 12 cups flour 12 cup parmesan cheese 3 tablespoons fresh chives 14 teaspoon white pepper 1 teaspoon hot sauce
directions: set oven to 375 deg. line a baking sheet with non stick foil. wash and trim chicken, set aside. in a shallow bowl, combine half of the ranch dressing, hot sauce, white pepper, chives and parmesan cheese, stir well. put bread crumbs in separate shallow bowl. place flour in a zip lock bag. place all chicken strips in flour zip lock bag, shake well until completely coated. dip each piece of chicken into the ranch dressing mixture, then into the bread crumb mixture. lay each piece on top of foil on baking sheet. bake for 12 minutes, then turn each piece over and bake an additional 12 minutes. Serve with remaining ranch dressing, enjoy!

title: Fresh Apple Cake
ingredients: 2 c. sugar 3 c. flour 3/4 tsp. soda 2 tsp. cinnamon pinch of salt 1 c. oil 1 tsp. vanilla 2 eggs 3 c. sliced apples 1 c. chopped pecans
directions: Mix sugar, flour, soda, cinnamon and salt and set aside. Mix remaining ingredients and add to dry ingredients. Pour into a loaf pan. Bake at 350° for approximately 1 hour.

title: Dishpan Cookies Ii
ingredients: 2 cups margarine 2 cups white sugar 2 cups packed brown sugar 4 eggs 4 cups all-purpose flour 2 teaspoons baking soda 1 teaspoon baking powder 1 teaspoon salt 4 cups cornflakes cereal 1 1/2 cups rolled oats 2 cups flaked coconut 3 cups semisweet chocolate chips
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). In a large bowl, cream together the margarine, brown sugar, and white sugar until smooth. Beat in the eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition. Sift together the flour, baking soda, baking powder, and salt; stir into the creamed mixture until just blended. Then mix in the corn flakes cereal, rolled oats, coconut, and chocolate chips. Drop by heaping spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are lightly browned. Cool on wire racks.

title: Goulash
ingredients: macaroni green peppers, chopped chopped celery 1/4 to 1/2 tsp. cayenne pepper hamburger chopped onion salt and pepper to taste tomato sauce or canned tomatoes
directions: Boil macaroni, then drain. While macaroni is cooking, brown meat in a frying pan. Drain off most of grease. Next, add celery, onion, peppers, seasonings and tomato sauce. Heat good, then add drained macaroni. Heat good, making sure to stir well.

title: Lemony White Bean Skordalia with Grill-Toasted Pita
ingredients: 1 cup (about 6 1/2 ounces) dried Great Northern beans 1 tablespoon chopped garlic 1/3 cup fresh lemon juice 1/4 cup tahini (sesame seed paste) 1/4 cup olive oil (preferably extra-virgin) 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh parsley 3 tablespoons finely chopped fresh mint 6 6-inch-diameter pita bread rounds, cut into wedges
directions: Place beans in heavy medium saucepan. Add enough water to cover by 2 inches. Let stand at room temperature overnight. Drain beans. Return to saucepan. Add enough cold water to cover beans by 2 inches. Bring to boil. Reduce heat to medium. Cover partially and simmer until beans are very tender, stirring occasionally, about 1 hour 10 minutes. Drain beans, reserving 1/4 cup cooking liquid. Place beans, 2 tablespoons reserved cooking liquid and garlic in processor. Process until beans are coarsely chopped. Add lemon juice, tahini and oil.
