ingredients: 2 c. diced, cooked turkey 3/4 c. chopped celery 1 can water chestnuts, sliced 1 can mushrooms, drained 1 (2 oz.) pimiento, drained and sliced 1 (1 1/4 oz.) chicken gravy mix 1 c. milk 2 Tbsp. mayonnaise or dressing 1/2 tsp. seasoned salt 1 (3 1/2 oz.) can French fried onions
directions: Combine turkey, celery, water chestnuts, mushrooms and pimiento in a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Stir gravy mix, milk and mayonnaise together until smooth. Add seasoned salt. Add to turkey mixture and stir to coat evenly. Bake in preheated 350° oven 35 to 40 minutes. Sprinkle with onions and continue baking 3 to 5 minutes or until browned.

title: Tunnel Of Fudge Cake
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. soft butter 6 eggs 1 1/2 c. sugar 2 c. flour 1 can (2 layer size) Dutch Fudge butter cream frosting 2 c. chopped walnuts
directions: Cream butter in a large bowl at high speed. Add one egg at a time; beat well after each. Add sugar. Beat at high speed until light and fluffy. By hand, stir in flour, frosting mix and walnuts until blended. Pour batter into greased (10 inch) tube pan or Bundt pan. Bake at 350° for 60 - 65 minutes. Cool 2 hours. Remove from pan. Cool completely before serving.

title: Choco-Peanut Toppers
ingredients: 2 c. all-purpose flour 1 c. butter, softened 1/2 c. sugar 2 tsp. vanilla
directions: In large mixing bowl, combine all ingredients and mix well. Drop by level teaspoon onto greased cookie sheets. Flatten to 1/4-inch with a glass, greased on the bottom, then dipped in sugar. Bake at 325° for 15 to 18 minutes. Spread warm cookies with Peanut Butter Topping. Drizzle with Chocolate Glaze. Let stand until glaze is set. Makes 54 to 60 cookies.

title: Wet Burritos Recipe
ingredients: 1 1/2 to 2 pound hamburger 1/2 c. minced onion 2 teaspoon taco seasoning 1 teaspoon green chilies 1/2 teaspoon crushed red peppers 1/2 c. warm salsa 1/3 c. tomato juice 1 to 1 1/2 c. mild salsa 1 can refried beans Finely minced raw onions Finely minced tomatoes Grated cheddar cheese Tortilla shells Lowfat sour cream
directions: Brown hamburger with onions, season with salt and pepper. Take out 2/3, and put in another pan. To remaining 1/3, add in taco seasoning, green chilies, crushed red peppers, and warm salsa. Heat tortilla shells according to directions on package. Hot refried beans. In center of each tortilla shell, put a spoonful of refried beans, another of grnd beef mix, then onions and tomatoes. Fold and put in microwave pan. To reserved 2/3 hamburger, add in tomato juice and mild salsa. Pour over top of burritos. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Microwave till cheese is melted. Top with lowfat sour cream.

title: Low Calorie Chicken And Rice
ingredients: 1 1/4 c. rice 1 pkg. Lipton onion soup mix 1 can cream of chicken soup 2 1/2 c. water 2 to 3 lb. skinned chicken
directions: Mix all ingredients together and microwave on High 30 minutes.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup By Pat Schaub
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. cornstarch 3 1/2 qt. water 1 tsp. salt 1 tsp. pepper 2 sticks margarine 2 c. celery 2 c. chopped onion 2 (10 oz.) pkg. chopped broccoli 1 c. milk 2 1/2 lb. Velveeta cheese
directions: Boil water, then add salt, pepper, broccoli, celery and onions and cook until tender. Lower heat to simmer and add margarine, cheese and milk. Stir cornstarch with a little water and add to thicken just a little.

title: Potato Casserole
ingredients: 8 to 10 potatoes, sliced 1 small onion, sliced (optional) 1 c. milk 1 to 2 lb. ground beef 3 eggs salt and pepper
directions: Precook potatoes for 5 minutes; drain. In oblong casserole, put layer of potatoes and layer of beef. Mix eggs and milk together, pour over layer and add salt and pepper. Repeat layers and egg mixture as many times as you want. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until burger is done.

title: Christmas Cookies
ingredients: 1 lb. margarine 3 c. powdered sugar 2 eggs 2 tsp. vanilla 5 c. plain flour 1 1/2 tsp. soda 1/2 tsp. salt 2 tsp. cream of tartar
directions: Cream butter; add beaten eggs, sugar and vanilla. Add dry ingredients. Bake 10 to 15 minutes in a 300° oven.

title: Steak, Sun-Dried Tomato, And Mozzarella Couscous Salad
ingredients: 2 teaspoons extravirgin olive oil 2 garlic cloves, minced 2 1/2 cups water 1 cup uncooked couscous 1/2 cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, packed without oil (about 1 ounce) 1/2 cup (2 ounces) cubed part-skim mozzarella cheese 1/2 cup chopped drained bottled roasted red bell peppers 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar 1/4 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
directions: Combine olive oil and garlic in a small nonstick skillet; cook over medium-low heat 2 minutes or just until fragrant. Remove from heat; set aside. Bring 2 1/2 cups water to a boil in a medium saucepan. Add couscous and sun-dried tomatoes; reduce heat to medium, and cook 5 minutes or until water is absorbed. Remove from heat; fluff with a fork. Spoon couscous into a large bowl. Add Basic Grilled Flank Steak, cubed mozzarella cheese, roasted red bell peppers, and chopped fresh basil; toss well to combine. Combine garlic mixture, vinegar, salt, and black pepper, stirring with a whisk. Drizzle dressing over couscous mixture; toss gently to coat. Cover and chill.

title: Apple Cream Pie
ingredients: 1/2 CUP BROWN SUGAR 1/2 CUP WHITE SUGAR 2 TBLS FLOUR 1 CUP CREAM 1 CUP SHREDDED APPLE 1 TSP. VANILLA 1 UNBAKED PIE SHELL
directions: MIX ALL INGREDIENTS TOGETHER AND POUR INTO UNBAKED PIE SHELL. BAKE AT 350 DEGREES FOR 15 MINUTES, THEN 300 DEGREES FOR 40 MINUTES OR UNTIL SET.

title: Lemon Nut Cake
ingredients: 1 lb. butter (real) 2 c. sugar 6 eggs 1 (2 oz.) bottle lemon extract 4 c. flour 1 tsp. baking powder 1 middle size bottle maraschino cherries, drained and chopped 1 c. raisins 1 lb. pecans
directions: Mix as listed in order. I omit raisins. Bake 2 hours at 275° or until done.

title: Brisket Roast
ingredients: 1/3 c. liquid smoke 3 Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce onions flakes pepper and salt
directions: Baste meat with ingredients. Cover and let stand overnight. (Leave covered with foil.) Cook about 4 hours at 275°. Remove cover and drain almost all liquid. Baste with barbecue sauce. Continue cooking uncovered 1 hour.

title: Easiest Green Beans
ingredients: 1 pound Green Beans 1 Tablespoon Olive Oil 1 whole Shallot, Thinly Sliced 1 teaspoon Pepper 2 teaspoons Garlic Powder 1 cup Low Sodium Chicken Broth
directions: 1. Trim ends off of the green beans. Add olive oil to a large frying pan. Preheat to medium high heat. Once hot, add shallot, pepper and garlic powder. Stir and cook until softened, about 2 minutes. 2. Add green beans. Mix together. Add chicken broth and cover. Reduce heat to medium and let beans cook until tender, about 10 minutes. 3. Serve and enjoy!

title: Molasses Cake
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown sugar 1/2 cup butter or 1/2 cup shortening 1 cup blackstrap molasses 1 teaspoon baking soda 2 cups flour 1 teaspoon allspice 1 cup hot water 1 egg (optional)
directions: Cream together brown sugar and butter. Add molasses and baking soda disolved in hot water. Add dry ingredients to mixture. Beat well. Put into greased, floured 9x9x2 inch pan, Bake at 350 F for 35 minutes. The following may also be added to this recipe- rasins, chopped nuts or candied fruit for fruit cake.

title: Celeriac Remoulade With Trout Roe
ingredients: 1 12 lbs celeriac 34 cup Greek yogurt 2 tablespoons Dijon mustard 1 teaspoon lemon juice 1 garlic clove 2 tablespoons dill salt pepper 6 tablespoons trout, roe
directions: Peel the celeriac, cut it into six sections, and grate them using a box grater or the grater attachment of a food processor- this will yield about 6 cups, loosely packed. (Don't let the grated celeriac stand for too long or it will start to brown). Combine with the yoghurt, mustard, lemon juice, garlic, and dill in a large salad bowl. Season with salt and pepper and mix with a fork to blend. Taste and adjust the seasoning. Cover and refrigerate for at least 20 minutes, an hour if possible, or up to a day. Remove from the fridge, stir, and divide the celeriac mixture among six plates (use cylindrical serving moulds if you have them) or transparent glasses. Top with 1 tablespoon roe and garnish with the reserved dill fronds. Serve immediately.

title: Chicken And Broccoli
ingredients: 6 chicken breasts, boil and cut into pieces 2 pkg. frozen broccoli spears, cook as directed 2 cans cream of chicken soup 1/2 can milk 1/2 c. mayonnaise 1 Tbsp. lemon juice 1 1/2 c. grated Cheddar cheese 1 1/2 c. butter flavored bread crumbs
directions: Mix soup, mayo, milk and lemon juice. Heat and stir. Place in 9 x 13-inch pan, broccoli on bottom, some sauce, cut up chicken, remainder of sauce, grated cheese, bread crumbs on top. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: German Potatoes Simply Flavored with Salt and Butter
ingredients: 6 Potatoes 1 Onion 1 Wiener sausages, bacon or ham 1 tbsp Olive oil 1/2 tsp x 2 Salt 20 grams Butter
directions: Prepare the ingredients. You could use bacon or ham instead of wieners sausages. If you don't have a lot of sausages, slice thinly to make them seem like more. Cut the potatoes into large chunks. Cover the cut potatoes with plastic wrap and microwave. For 100 g, cook for about 1 minute at 600W. If 1 potato weighs about 100 g, for 6 to 7 you should microwave for 6-7 minutes. Slice the wiener sausages. Slice the onion very very thinly - this is key. The generous amount of sauteed onions in this dish is key to the flavor. Put 1 tablespoon of olive oil (or vegetable oil) in a heated frying pan. Add onions and saute. After 2-3 minutes when the onions have started to wilt, add 1/2 teaspoon of salt and continue sauteing. After about a minute, they become a nice color. Add sausages and keep sauteing. Add potatoes and the remaining 1/2 teaspoon of salt, and saute. Turn off the heat, and mix in the 20 g of butter (2 pats). Sprinkle parsley or black pepper to taste and enjoy! Aonori seaweed powder is delicious, too. A handy tip to have pats of butter at hand. Each bar of butter is 200 g, so first quarter, then divide each quarter into 5 pieces. You will have pats of butter that weigh about 10 g each. Please also see"Hearty Breaded Chicken Cutlets", which is also cheap and delicious and a loved by my husband and kids!

title: Bourbon Balls Recipe
ingredients: 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter (melted) 3 1/2 cups confectioners sugar 7 tablespoons top-shelf bourbon 1/4 cup crushed pecans 3/4 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips 2 tablespoons whole milk 20 to 30 pecan halves
directions: Combine butter, sugar, and bourbon in a bowl and beat with a wooden spoon or an electric mixer on low speed until smooth. Refrigerate mixture for one hour. Using a melon baller, form mixture into 1-inch balls. Place balls on a baking pan lined with parchment paper. Refrigerate until firm. Remove balls, wrap individually with plastic wrap, and freeze for a minimum of two hours. Combine chocolate chips and whole milk in double boiler over medium heat, stirring until melted. One at a time, use a dipping fork (or toothpick) to submerge buttercream balls in chocolate, coating on all sides. Place on baking pan lined with parchment paper, garnish with pecan half. Allow balls to completely harden before eating.

title: Green Jello Salad
ingredients: 1 large pkg. lime Jello 2 c. boiling water 1 1/2 c. small marshmallows 1 large cream cheese, softened 1 can crushed pineapple, drained 1 c. walnuts, chopped 1 3/4 c. cold water, or less if you use pineapple juice
directions: Pour boiling water over Jello to dissolve. Add marshmallows to melt. Add cream cheese and beat until broken up. Add remaining ingredients and chill.

title: Bonnie'S Baked Beans
ingredients: 3 (21 oz.) pork and beans, mostly drained 6 slices bacon, cut up and cooked crisp 1 onion, chopped and cooked until tender 1/3 c. hickory flavored barbecue sauce 1/2 tsp. liquid smoke
directions: Mix together in 2-quart casserole and bake until hot. These are more barbecue flavored and less sweet than regular baked beans.

title: Philly Cheeseburger Pizza
ingredients: 3/4 pounds Ground Beef 1/2 whole Green Bell Pepper 8 whole White Button Mushrooms 1/2 whole Yellow Onion 1 package Pizza Dough 1 cup Pizza Sauce Or Marinara Sauce 1/2 cups Shredded Mozzarella Cheese 1 teaspoon Garlic Salt Or Adobo Seasoning 8 slices American Cheese
directions: 1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees (or according to directions on your pizza dough package) 2. Brown the ground beef and then drain and set aside. 3. While beef is cooking, chop the peppers and thinly slice the mushrooms and onions. 4. Roll out pizza dough and place on cookie sheet. 5. Spread sauce on dough (as much or little as you like, I use about 3/4 of a cup) then sprinkle mozzarella cheese on top. 6. Saute the veggies and add the beef and then veggies to the pizza. 7. Sprinkle with Adobo or garlic salt, then lay American cheese slices on top of pizza. 8. Cook pizza for 15-17 minutes and enjoy!

title: Chocolate-Hazelnut Meringue Kisses
ingredients: 1/4 cup finely chopped hazelnuts, toasted 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa 1 ounce bittersweet chocolate, finely chopped 1/4 cup sifted powdered sugar 1 1/2 tablespoons cornstarch 3 large egg whites 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar Dash of salt 2/3 cup granulated sugar 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
directions: Preheat oven to 325°. Combine first 3 ingredients in a food processor; process until finely ground. Combine hazelnut mixture, 1/4 cup powdered sugar, and cornstarch in a medium bowl, stirring with a whisk. Place egg whites, cream of tartar, and salt in a large bowl; beat with a mixer at high speed until soft peaks form. Add granulated sugar, 1 tablespoon at a time, beating at high speed until stiff peaks form. Gently fold hazelnut mixture and vanilla into egg mixture. Cover two baking sheets with parchment paper. Spoon egg white mixture into a pastry bag fitted with a 1/2-inch round tip. Pipe 48 (1 1/2-inch-round) mounds onto prepared baking sheets. Bake at 325° for 25 minutes or until meringues are done and dry to the touch. (Meringues are done when surface is dry and meringues can be removed from paper without sticking to fingers.) Turn oven off; partially open oven door. Cool meringues in oven 30 minutes. Remove from oven; carefully remove meringues from paper.

title: Delicious Biscuits Recipe
ingredients: 1 c. lowfat sour cream 1 c. self-rising flour 1 stick melted butter (no substitute)
directions: Mix well. Put in smallest (approximately 1 1/2 inch pans) muffin pans. Preheat oven. Bake at 425 degrees approximately 15 to 20 min. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Tropical Nut Bark
ingredients: 1-1/2 pounds white baking chocolate, chopped 2/3 cup coarsely chopped macadamia nuts, toasted 1/3 cup sweetened shredded coconut, toasted 1/3 cup chopped crystallized ginger 1/3 cup dried mangoes, chopped
directions: In a large microwave-safe bowl, melt chocolate; stir until smooth. Combine the macadamia nuts, coconut, ginger and mangoes. Remove 1/2 cup and set aside. Stir remaining nut mixture into melted chocolate. Spread onto a waxed paper-lined . Sprinkle with reserved nut mixture. Refrigerate for 1 hour or until firm. Break into pieces. Store in an airtight container.

title: Black Quinoa Salad With Mango And Avocado
ingredients: 2 cups Black Quinoa 1 cup White Wine 1/4 teaspoon Salt, plus more to taste 2 Mangoes, chopped 2 Avocados, chopped 1/3 cup Lime Juice (approx 2 limes) 1/2 cup Cilantro, chopped 1/2 cup Mint, chopped 3/4 cup Red Onion, diced (approx 1/2 large red onion) 1 1/5 tablespoons Olive Oil Pepper, to taste
directions: Rinse the quinoa and soak in water for 10 minutes. Drain the quinoa and add to a pot with 1 C white wine, 1/4 tsp salt and 1 1/2 C water. Bring to a boil on the stove top, then cover and reduce the heat to low. Cook for 20 minutes. Drain any residual water from the quinoa. Combine the chopped mango, avocado, cilantro, mint and red onion in a large bowl and toss to combine. Whisk together the lime juice and olive oil and add to the mango/avocado mixture. Stir in the quinoa and season with salt and pepper.

title: Better Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 3 to 3 1/2 lb. sprouts 2 1/2 Tbsp. butter 2 1/2 Tbsp. olive oil 8 cloves coarsely chopped garlic 1 c. chicken broth salt and pepper to taste 2 Tbsp. butter, melted 2 Tbsp. chopped parsley freshly squeezed lemon
directions: Cut off stems from sprouts and remove outer yellow layer. Cut small x in bottom of each. Rinse in cold water; drain and pat dry.

title: Chermoula (Moroccan Marinade)
ingredients: 2 -3 garlic cloves, chopped 1 -2 teaspoon ground cumin 1 pinch saffron thread 4 tablespoons olive oil 1 lemon, juice of 1 small red chili pepper, seeded and chopped 1 teaspoon salt 1 bunch fresh cilantro, finely chopped
directions: Place the garlic, cumin, saffron, olive oil, lemon juice, chili and salt in a mortar and pound with a pestle. Or alternatively put all the above in a food processor and whiz until finely chopped, I have little baby processor which makes this a doddle. Add the fresh cilantro and mix in or give an additional quick whiz to combine. Spread the mixture over the fish of your choice and leave to marinade for at least 15 minutes.

title: Jerusalem Artichoke Soup With Crispy Sage Leaves
ingredients: 1/4 cup olive oil 1 leek, rinsed and chopped 1/2 cup chopped white onion 2 pounds Jerusalem artichokes 5 cups vegetable stock 1 teaspoon sea salt
directions: heat olive oil in soup pot over medium heat. Add leek and onion and saute 5 minutes. Add artichokes, broth and salt and bring to a boil. Decrease heat, simmer covered 30 minutes. Remove from heat and cool. Process in blender, reheat before serving.

title: Cheesy Hash Browns
ingredients: 1 1/2 large pkg. hash browns 1 stick oleo 2 cans cream of mushroom soup 8 oz. grated Cheddar cheese 8 oz. sour cream 1 onion, chopped salt, pepper and garlic salt to taste corn flakes
directions: Melt butter (save 1/2 for topping). Mix all ingredients together. Top with 2 to 3 cups crushed corn flakes mixed with the reserved butter. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Cheater'S Coffee Cake
ingredients: Betty Crocker yellow cake mix 1/2 c. packed brown sugar 1/2 c. chopped nuts 1 tsp. cinnamon
directions: Prepare cake mix as directed on package, using 2 tablespoons less water. Pour half the batter into greased and floured tube pan, 10 x 4-inch. Mix brown sugar, nuts and cinnamon. Sprinkle 1/2 of mixture over batter in pan. Cover with remaining batter. Sprinkle remaining filling on top.

title: Sweet Melon & Romaine Salad
ingredients: 8 cups chopped romaine lettuce 1 honeydew melon, sliced 1 cantaloupe, sliced 1/2 cup KRAFT Lite CATALINA Dressing 3/4 cup PLANTERS Sunflower Kernels 8 SNACKWELL'S Sugar Free Lemon Creme Sandwich Cookies 32 fl oz (4 cups) fat-free milk
directions: Place 2 cups lettuce on each plate; top each with 1/4 of each melon. Drizzle each salad with 2 Tbsp. dressing; sprinkle each with 1/4 of the sunflower kernels. Enjoy 2 SNACKWELL'S cookies per serving for dessert. Serve each salad with an 8 fl oz glass of milk.

title: Candy Coated Carrots
ingredients: 1 lb. carrots, peeled and sliced 1 tsp. lemon juice 1/4 c. (1 stick) oleo 1/8 tsp. salt 1/4 c. firmly packed brown sugar 1/4 tsp. Tabasco sauce
directions: Cook carrots until tender; drain. Combine sugar and oleo; stir over medium heat until bubbly. Add Tabasco sauce and salt. Remove from heat. Add lemon juice and hot drained carrots. Toss gently until coated evenly.

title: Play Dough Recipe
ingredients: 3 c. flour 1 1/2 c. salt 6 tsp. cream of tartar 3 c. water food coloring 3 Tbsp. cooking oil
directions: Mix dry ingredients together. Mix wet ingredients together. Blend both batches, then stir over low heat until it forms a ball. Knead a bit. Let cool. Store in a plastic container. Serves 6.

title: Tuna Ala King
ingredients: 1 can creamed mushroom soup (soup only; no water) 1 can tuna 2 hard-boiled eggs (save 1 yolk for garnish) 1 small jar pimento
directions: Heat soup in saucepan. Add chopped, hard-boiled eggs, pimento and tuna. Peel the crust from 12 slices of bread. Gently press into muffin tin. Fill bread with tuna mixture. Grate the remaining egg yolk and garnish each cup. Place in hot oven at 400°. Leave only until bread is toasted. Good for ladies' luncheons. Serve with salad.

title: Chinese Style Skewered Chicken
ingredients: 1 (8 ounce) can tomato sauce 14 cup light brown sugar, firmly packed 14 cup soy sauce 1 tablespoon fresh ginger, minced 1 teaspoon garlic, minced 2 lbs boneless chicken breasts 8 (10 inch) bamboo skewers 2 medium green bell peppers, cubed 2 medium onions, cubed 1 tablespoon olive oil hot cooked rice
directions: In a bowl, mix the tomato sauce, brown sugar, soy sauce, ginger and garlic. Stir in the chicken. Cover and refrigerate 2 to 8 hours. Heat the broiler. Skewer the chicken and broil 7 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned. Turn and broil 7 minutes longer or to desired doneness. Meanwhile, in a medium skillet, saute the bell peppers and onions in the olive oil for 5 minutes. Serve the chicken and vegetables over the rice.

title: Tarragon Lime Bay Scallops Over Angel-Hair Pasta
ingredients: 3/4 lb dried angel-hair pasta (capelli d'angelo) 1 1/2 lb bay scallops or quartered sea scallops, tough muscle removed from side of each if necessary 3/4 stick (6 tablespoons) unsalted butter 3 tablespoons fresh lime juice, or to taste 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh tarragon, or to taste
directions: Cook pasta in a 6- to 8-quart pot of boiling salted water until al dente. Reserve 1/4 cup cooking water, then drain pasta in a colander. While pasta is cooking, pat scallops dry and season with salt and pepper. Heat 3 tablespoons butter in a 12-inch nonstick skillet over moderately high heat until foam subsides, then saute half of scallops, stirring, until golden, about 3 minutes. Transfer with a slotted spoon to a bowl. Cook remaining scallops in remaining 3 tablespoons butter in same manner. Return first batch of scallops to skillet and stir in lime juice and tarragon. Toss pasta in a bowl with half of scallops and 1/4 cup pasta cooking water. Top pasta with remaining scallops and sauce and season with salt and pepper.

title: Cottage Tuna Spread
ingredients: 1 (6 ounce) can tuna, well drained 1 green onion, chopped finely 1 cup cottage cheese 1/4 cup finely chopped celery 1/4 cup mayonnaise salt & pepper, to taste
directions: Put all ingredients into bowl, Mix well to blend.

title: Speedy Tuna "Casserole"
ingredients: 1 pkg. (7-1/4 oz.) KRAFT Macaroni & Cheese Dinner 1 cup frozen mixed vegetables (carrots, corn, peas) 1 can (5 oz.) white tuna in water, drained, flaked 8 RITZ Crackers, crushed (about 1/3 cup)
directions: Prepare Dinner in large saucepan as directed on package, adding vegetables to the boiling water for the last 2 min. Add tuna; mix lightly. Top with cracker crumbs.

title: Chicken Ratatouille Or (What'S-It-To-Ya)
ingredients: 1/4 c. olive oil 2 large onions 1 clove garlic 1 lb. eggplant, peeled and cubed 3/4 zucchini, sliced 1 bell pepper, sliced 4 lb. chicken breasts and thighs 2 Tbsp. flour 1/2 c. water 1 (28 oz.) can tomatoes with liquid 1 tsp. basil 1 tsp. oregano 1 lb. potatoes, cut in cubes pinch of salt, sugar and pepper
directions: In a Dutch oven, cook onions and garlic in olive oil until brown; add eggplant, bell pepper and zucchini. Cook for 5 minutes. Remove from pot; set aside. Bone chicken, cut into pieces. Add to pot, cook until browned. Stir in flour. Gradually add water and tomatoes with liquid from the can. Add potatoes and seasonings, bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 30 minutes. Add eggplant, zucchini and bell pepper, cook 5 more minutes. Mix well, cover and remove from heat. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Fig, Carrot, And Ginger Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 (8.8-ounce) pouch microwaveable cooked brown rice (such as Uncle Ben's Ready Rice) 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 cup matchstick-cut carrots 1 tablespoon minced peeled fresh ginger 2 garlic cloves, minced 1/2 cup small dried figs, quartered
directions: Heat rice according to package directions; keep warm. While rice cooks, heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat; add carrots, ginger, and garlic. Saute 3 minutes or until browned. Add figs; saute 2 minutes or until hot. Remove from heat; stir in rice. Serve immediately.

title: Easy Dip
ingredients: 1 - 8 oz. pkg. cream cheese 1/3 C. French dressing 1/3 C. catsup 1 sm. onion (or instant minced onion)
directions: Beat above ingredients with electric mixer. Mix well. Chill and serve with your favorite chips or crackers.

title: Ham And Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. ham 1 c. cheese 1 can cream of chicken soup 1 can cream of mushroom soup 1 pkg. hash brown potatoes (frozen) 1 small sour cream
directions: Put ham in chunks in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer potatoes on top. Mix soups and sour cream. Pour over potatoes. Grate cheese and top. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Amaretto Punch
ingredients: 18 -20 ounces orange juice 1 (2 liter) bottle 7-Up soda 1 (20 ounce) can pineapple 1 cup Amaretto
directions: Mix together and freeze.

title: Easy Tuna Pasta Salad With Artichokes And Croutons
ingredients: 1 (12 ounce) box tri-color spiral pasta 2 (8 ounce) cans tuna, drained 1/2 cup grape tomatoes 1 (12 ounce) jar marinated artichoke hearts, use only 1/3 jar 2 tablespoons mayonnaise, heaping 1/2 cup parmesan cheese, shredded 1 cup crouton, Caesar is a good choice
directions: Cook the pasta as directed on the box. Rinse pasta with cold water and transfer to a large mixing bowl. Add tuna, grape tomatoes,artichoke hearts, and mayo. You may use more or less artichokes as you like -- I find that 1 jar of artichoke hearts is good to make this recipe 3 times, which is why I say use a third of it. Same with mayo -- use more or less to your tasting. Mix well. sprinkle cheese and croutons. enjoy :).

title: Mary Kay'S Gypsy Round-A-Layer Cake
ingredients: 3/4 c. shortening 1 1/2 c. sugar 3 eggs, well beaten 1 3/4 c. flour 1 tsp. soda 1/2 tsp. baking powder 1/2 tsp. salt 3/4 tsp. nutmeg 1 tsp. cinnamon 2 Tbsp. cocoa 3/4 c. buttermilk 1 tsp. vanilla 1/2 c. toasted pecans
directions: Cream shortening; add sugar gradually. Blend in eggs. Sift flour, soda, salt and baking powder with the spices and cocoa; then add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk. Blend in flavoring and nuts. Pour into two well greased 9-inch cake pans and bake 30 minutes at 350°.

title: Roasted Turkey Drumsticks With Vegetables
ingredients: 4-6 tbsp olive oil 1/2 tsp chilli powder 4 None turkey drumsticks (about 300g each) 400 g carrots, peeled and cut into chunks 800 g potatoes, peeled and quartered 250 g cherry tomatoes 1/2 None small savoy cabbage (about 500g) 1/2 bunch fresh thyme, leaves finely chopped 1 tsp vegetable stock powder
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. For the marinade, mix 2 tbsp of the oil with the chili powder and season. Roll the turkey drumsticks in the marinade, making sure that they are coated all over. Place in a roasting pan. Roast for 1 to 1 1/4 hours. After about 30 mins of the cooking time, place the carrots and potatoes in the roasting pan, then 15 mins later add the tomatoes, cabbage and thyme, reserving some for garnish. Drizzle with the remaining olive oil and season to taste. Meanwhile, dissolve the granulated vegetable bouillon in 1/2 cup of hot water and pour into the roasting pan. Return the roasting pan to the oven for the remaining cooking time (15-30 mins). Garnish with the reserved thyme.

title: Strawberry Wine-Freeze
ingredients: 1 can pink lemonade (frozen) 1 1/2 cans red wine 1 c. crushed ice 1/2 pkg. frozen strawberries 1 can 7-Up or ginger ale
directions: Blend all ingredients at high speed. Prepare 1/2 hour before serving. The lemonade can may be used for measurement tool.

title: Emergency Chocolate Cake
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cake flour or 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour 2 tablespoons sugar 1/2 teaspoon baking powder 2 teaspoons cocoa powder 1 pinch salt 2 tablespoons milk 1/2 teaspoon vanilla 1 teaspoon oil
directions: Put it all in a small microwave-safe dish/mug. Microwave for 60 seconds. Turn out onto a plate. Devour.

title: Beef Flank Steak, Roasted
ingredients: 4 oz. extra lean beef flank steak, fat trimmed 1 peeled garlic clove, minced 1 Tbsp. balsamic vinegar 1 tsp. extra virgin olive oil 1 tsp. dried basil leaves 1 carrot, peeled and thinly sliced 1 , thinly sliced 1 leek, thinly sliced 1 small whole wheat dinner 1 cup frozen unsweetened strawberries, thawed 8 fl oz (1 cup) drinking water
directions: PLACE a large piece of foil inside a shallow baking dish. Place meat on foil. Mix garlic, vinegar, oil, and basil in small bowl to make marinade; pour evenly over steak. Place carrots, parsnips and leeks over and around steak. Seal foil tightly around steak and vegetables. Bake at 425F for 15 to 20 min., or to desired doneness. Complement each meal with a roll. Enjoy strawberries for dessert. Serve meal with a glass of water.

title: Christmas Punch
ingredients: 1 can frozen lemonade 1 can frozen orange juice 1 (2 liter) 7-Up 1 bottle ginger ale 1 pkg. red Kool-Aid 1 c. sugar
directions: Mix together in a punch bowl. Add about a quart of water. Then put in 1 (32 ounce) can of pineapple juice. Freeze half and then put back in when served.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake And Frosting
ingredients: 1 lb. box graham crackers, unbroken 2 (3 3/4 oz.) boxes French vanilla or vanilla instant pudding 3 c. cold milk 12 oz. Cool Whip 2 1/2 oz. sq. semi-sweet chocolate 3/4 c. softened butter or margarine 2 tsp. vanilla 2 Tbsp. light corn syrup 1 1/2 c. confectioners sugar 3 Tbsp. milk
directions: Line cake pan with graham crackers. Mix pudding with milk. Add Cool Whip. Pour mixture over graham crackers. Add another layer of graham crackers and then pudding mixture. End layers with graham crackers.

title: Mmm Mmm Good Meatloaf
ingredients: 1 12 lbs extra lean ground beef 1 slice light bread 1 egg 1 small onion, finely chopped 1 teaspoon salt 14 teaspoon pepper 4 tablespoons low-carb ketchup 12 cup fat-free half-and-half 4 tablespoons apple cider vinegar 3 tablespoons brown sugar substitute 12 cup low-carb ketchup
directions: Combine meatloaf ingredients and place in loaf pan or baking dish. Sauce: Combine sauce ingredients and pour over top of meatloaf. Bake for 1 hour at 350 Degrees.

title: Sardine and Bread Crumb Pasta with Puttanesca Salad
ingredients: 1 pound linguine, fresh or dried, cooked al dente in salted water 4 vine-ripe tomatoes, seeded and chopped 1/2 red onion, chopped 3 tablespoons capers 1/2 cup kalamata olives, pitted and coarsely chopped 6 anchovies (1 tin of flat fillets), chopped 3/4 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley tops (4 or 5 handfuls), divided; half coarsely chopped, half finely chopped Juice of 1/2 lemon 1/4 cup plus 3 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil (EVOO), plus more for drizzling 12 to 15 fresh basil leaves, cut or torn into a chiffonade Coarse salt and coarse black pepper, to taste 8 garlic cloves, chopped 1 1/2 cups bread crumbs 2 4-ounce tins of sardines, drained and chopped 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
directions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. When the water boils, add the linguine and cook just until al dente. Drain well. Combine the tomatoes, onions, capers, olives, anchovies, and the coarsely chopped parsley in a medium bowl. Dress with the lemon juice and a healthy drizzle of EVOOenough to lightly coat the salad (1 to 2 tablespoons). Sprinkle in the basil and salt and pepper, toss again, and adjust the seasonings. Preheat a large, deep skillet over medium heat. To the hot pan, add the 1/4 cup of EVOO (4 times around the pan), and half the chopped garlic cloves. When the garlic speaks by sizzling in the oil, add the bread crumbs. Stir the bread crumbs until they are deeply golden in color. Add the finely chopped parsley and a liberal amount of salt and coarse black pepper. Transfer the bread crumbs to a dish and reserve. Return the same skillet to the heat and add the 3 tablespoons of EVOO, 3 times around the pan. Add the remaining garlic, the sardines, and red pepper flakes to the pan and saute over medium heat for 2 or 3 minutes. Add the hot, cooked pasta to the skillet and toss with the sardines. Add the bread crumbs to the pot and toss thoroughly to combine and evenly distribute the mixture. Taste to adjust seasonings and serve with the puttanesca salad alongside.

title: Peanut Brittle
ingredients: 3 c. peanuts 1 c. white Karo 3 tsp. baking soda 3 c. sugar 1/2 c. water 1 tsp. salt
directions: Mix sugar, Karo and water. Bring to a boil. Add peanuts. Cook. Remove from heat and add soda. Stir. Pour on buttered cookie sheet. Cool and break into pieces.

title: Spicy Mapo Tofu Dumplings
ingredients: 7 ounces firm tofu, drained 4 dried chiles de arbol, stemmed 1 teaspoon Sichuan peppercorns 1/2 pound fatty ground pork, preferably pork butt 2 garlic cloves, minced 1 scallion, thinly sliced 1/4 cup minced peeled fresh ginger 1/2 cup finely chopped flowering chives 1/4 cup black bean paste with chile 1 tablespoon ground bean sauce 1 tablespoon tobanjan (fermented broad-bean paste) 3 tablespoons Shaoxing wine 1 large egg white 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt 2 tablespoons cornstarch 36 Basic Dumpling Wrappers Canola oil, for frying
directions: Cut the tofu into 1/4-inch-thick slices; put them on a paper towellined plate and press dry with paper towels. Finely chop the tofu and transfer to a large bowl. In a spice grinder, combine the chiles and Sichuan peppercorns and finely grind. Add to the tofu in the bowl along with all of the remaining ingredients except the cornstarch, dumpling wrappers and canola oil. Fold gently until well blended. Fold in the cornstarch just until incorporated. Lay a wrapper in the palm of one hand. Using your finger, brush the outer edge with water. Spoon 1 heaping tablespoon of filling in the center. Fold the wrapper over the filling to form a half-moon; pinch at the top to adhere. Fold a pleat in the wrapper on the top left, angling back toward the center. Press with your fingers to adhere. Repeat the pleating on the top right of the wrapper to meet the first pleat in the center. Transfer the dumpling to a parchment paperlined baking sheet and cover with plastic wrap; repeat with the rest of the wrappers and filling. Pour enough canola oil into a large nonstick skillet to cover the bottom. Arrange some of the dumplings in the skillet with a non-pleated side down (you will need to work in batches). Cook over low heat until golden on the bottom, about 3 minutes. Carefully pour in enough water to reach halfway up the dumplings. Cover and cook until almost all of the water is absorbed and the filling is cooked through, about 4 minutes. Uncover and cook until all of the liquid has evaporated and the dumplings are crispy on the bottom, about 2 minutes longer. Carefully invert onto a plate. Repeat the process with the remaining dumplings. Serve warm.

title: Cocoa Brownies Supreme
ingredients: 1/2 c. shortening (1 stick oleo) 1 c. sugar 1 tsp. vanilla 2 eggs, unbeaten 1/2 c. Hershey's cocoa 3/4 c. sifted all-purpose flour 1/2 tsp. salt 1/2 tsp. double-acting baking powder 3/4 c. nuts
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease 8-inch square pan. Cream shortening and sugar. Add vanilla and eggs; beat until fluffy. Add cocoa and mix. Sift flour, salt and baking powder. Stir in dry ingredients. Add nuts. Bake 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Lamb Chops with Harissa-Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup plain Greek-style yogurt 1 1/2 tablespoons harissa 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice Salt and freshly ground pepper 8 lamb rib chops, about 1 inch thick Finely grated lemon zest, for serving
directions: Light a grill. In a small bowl, combine the yogurt with the harissa and lemon juice and season with salt and pepper. Season the lamb chops with salt and pepper and grill over high heat, turning once, about 4 minutes for medium-rare. Sprinkle the lamb chops with lemon zest and serve with the yogurt sauce.

title: Crock-Pot Apple Butter
ingredients: 8 c. applesauce 5 c. sugar 1/2 c. vinegar 1/2 c. cinnamon candy or 3 or 4 drops cinnamon oil and food coloring (red)
directions: Place all ingredients in crock-pot. Cook on high 8 to 10 hours. During last half of cooking time, remove lid and cook uncovered. Stir occasionally.

title: Sausage Balls
ingredients: 2 c. Bisquick 1 lb. sausage 1 c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese 2 or 3 drops Tabasco sauce
directions: Mix the ingredients together and roll into 1-inch balls. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Home Made Pizza Sort Of Recipe
ingredients: Already shredded mozzarella cheese Spaghetti or possibly pizza sauce from the jar (1/2 c.) Already sliced pepperoni (or possibly favorite meat) Cooked Italian sausage Sliced vegetables: Broccoli, use cooked & liquid removed frzn Red, green pepper, squash Mushrooms, onions, etc.
directions: Use any of the following: Already baked pizza crust sold by grocery stores. Or possibly Pizza crust package mix, made by directions. Or possibly Frzn bread, thawed and shaped into pizza round. Then brush with extra virgin olive oil.

title: Squash Dressing
ingredients: 1 stick butter 2 c. fresh squash, chopped 1 med. onion, chopped 2 c. cornbread or 23 frozen hush puppies 2 eggs 1 can cream of chicken soup 1/4 tsp. celery salt salt and pepper
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Saute squash and onion in butter until tender. Onion will be clear. Use a potato masher or fork to mash up squash and onion mixture. Crumble cornbread or hush puppies in the food processor. Add egg, cornbread, soup and spices to the squash mixture. Mix thoroughly. Place in 13 x 9-inch Pyrex dish. Bake, uncovered 20 - 25 min. Serves 4 - 6.

title: Festive Fruitcake
ingredients: 3/4 c. evaporated milk 3 c. midget marshmallows (or 24 large, chopped) 1/3 c. orange juice 6 c. graham cracker crumbs 1/2 tsp. cinnamon 1/2 tsp. nutmeg 1/4 tsp. ground cloves 1 1/2 c. seedless raisins 3/4 c. dates, finely chopped 1 c. walnuts, broken (or pecans) 1 1/4 c. candied fruit (ready mix)
directions: In a bowl mix marshmallows, orange juice, and milk; let stand, stirring occasionally while preparing remainder of fruitcake.

title: Broccoli-Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli 1 head cauliflower 1 pkg. dry Hidden Valley Ranch dressing mix 1 c. sour cream 1 c. mayonnaise 1 large purple onion
directions: Cut up broccoli and cauliflower into bite size pieces. Pour package of Ranch dressing over broccoli and cauliflower. Let stand in refrigerator overnight. Before serving, mix sour cream and mayonnaise, then mix into vegetables. Cut the onions into small strips. Add to other vegetables. Keep cold until ready to eat.

title: Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 2 c. raw cauliflower, cut in small pieces 3 hard-cooked eggs, chopped 1/4 c. minced onion 1 c. celery 1/2 c. chopped green pepper 1 (4 oz.) can pimiento, minced 1 tsp. salt pepper to taste 1/3 c. mayonnaise
directions: Cook cauliflower in boiling water 2 minutes. Combine all ingredients. Chill before serving. Serves 7. One half cup serving equals 126 calories. Exchange is 1 vegetable and 2 fats.

title: tortillas de maiz ( corn tortillas)
ingredients: 2 cup maseca 1 1/4 cup water 1/4 tsp salt
directions: combine all ingredients and mix until soft dough is formed roll dough into 16 equal size balls, place one ball at a time in press until tortilla measures about 5" in diameter. prepare tortilla press and 2 pieces of plastic . on ungreased griddle or comal cook tortillas about 1 min on each side. cover cooked tortillas with a cloth to keep warm

title: Easy Beef Enchiladas
ingredients: 12 corn tortillas 1 cup or more shredded cheese 1 cup or more cooked ground beef 1 cup refried beans 1 cup or more enchilada sauce
directions: Preheat oven to 350F. Heat tortillas and put a little sauce, ground beef, refried beans, and cheese on each. Roll them up and put them in a baking dish that has a little of the sauce in the bottom. Pour some sauce around the top, sprinkle on a little cheese and bake for 15 minutes.

title: Classic BBQ Kalbi for Outdoor Grilling
ingredients: 12 ribs Bone-in beef short ribs (sliced) 120 ml Soy sauce 2 tbsp Sugar 2 tbsp Sake 1 tbsp Sesame oil 1 tsp Doubanjiang 3 stalks Chopped spring onion 4 clove Garlic (grated) 3 tbsp Ground sesame seeds
directions: Let the short ribs marinate for 2 hours to half a day. Then all you have to do is cook them on the barbecue grill! If you freeze the ribs in the marinade, the frozen pack will act like an ice pack and keep your meat cold on your way to a picnic or camping! (Kill two birds with one stone!)

title: Cheese Ball
ingredients: 2 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese 8 oz. smoky Cheddar cheese 1 stick oleo 2 Tbsp. milk 2 tsp. steak sauce
directions: Mix all ingredients together. Chill for 1 hour. Shape into a ball. Roll in crushed nuts. Chill overnight.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
ingredients: 1 box frozen chopped broccoli 1 stick margarine 1 box Jiffy corn meal mix 2 eggs 1 small onion, chopped 1 c. cottage cheese
directions: Microwave broccoli and margarine 8 minutes; stir. Cook 4 minutes; cool completely. Add corn meal mix, eggs, onion and cottage cheese. Bake in greased Pyrex dish at 400° for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Enchiladas(Makes 10; Microwave)
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can chili 10 tortillas chopped onion (desired amount) 2 c. shredded cheese picante sauce (optional)
directions: Heat chili, soften tortillas so you can roll them without cracking. Fill each tortilla with chili, onion and cheese. Roll and place in 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish. Pour remaining chili over top of tortillas. Top with cheese and some of the onion. Bake in microwave for 5 minutes.

title: Escalloped Ham And Asparagus
ingredients: 7 to 8 baking potatoes, sliced 1 lb. smoked ham, diced 3 c. asparagus, chopped 1 1/2 c. milk 1 c. flour 1 tsp. black pepper 1/2 tsp. salt 1 tsp. parsley 1 Tbsp. onion, minced
directions: Layer potatoes, ham and asparagus in casserole dish. Combine milk, flour and seasonings. Mix until flour dissolves. Pour evenly over casserole dish. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Tatsoi & Avocado Salad With Roast Garlic Dressing
ingredients: 3 tatsoi, leaves picked, washed, dried 100 g baby spinach leaves, washed, dried 4 large ripe avocados, halved, stone removed, peeled, thinly sliced crossways Roast garlic dressing 3 heads garlic 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar salt & freshly ground black pepper 1/3 cup extra virgin olive oil 3 -4 tablespoons hot water
directions: *You can make the roast garlic dressing (steps 1-2) up to 1 day ahead. Keep in an airtight container in the fridge. Remove the dressing from the fridge 1 1/2 hours before serving to bring to room temperature. Roast garlic dressing: Preheat oven to 180°C To make roast garlic dressing, place garlic on a baking tray and roast in preheated oven for 30-35 minutes or until the garlic cloves are soft. Remove from the oven and set aside for 10 minutes to cool slightly. Cut tops off garlic heads, squeeze soft garlic from each bulb, and place in a blender. Add red wine vinegar and season with salt and pepper. Blend until well combined. With motor running, gradually add oil in a thin steady steam until mixture is thick. Gradually add enough hot water to make a pouring consistency. Salad: Place the tatsoi, spinach and avocado in a large serving bowl and toss gently to combine. Drizzle the dressing over the salad.

title: Pride Of Iowa Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. shortening 1 c. brown sugar, packed 1 c. white sugar 2 eggs, beaten until frothy 2 c. flour 1 tsp. baking soda 1 tsp. baking powder 1/4 tsp. salt 1 tsp. vanilla 1 c. coconut 1 c. nuts 3 c. quick cooking oats
directions: Cream shortening and sugars; add eggs, then dry ingredients and mix. Drop on cookie sheets. Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Eggplant & Basil Stir Fry
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut oil 1/2 cup thinly sliced hot pepper (use sweet peppers if you prefer) 6 garlic cloves 1 lb purple eggplant 1 cup basil leaves (1 good-sized bunch, either Thai basil or sweet will work) 2 cups bean sprouts, rinsed 2 tablespoons soy sauce (use low sodium if desired) 1 tablespoon mirin 2 tablespoons peanut butter (smooth or crunchy) 8 ounces dried rice vermicelli
directions: Bring a pot of salted water to boil. Cook rice noodles 2-4 minutes (or as directed on the package), till tender. Drain, reserving 1/4 Celsius cooking water. Slice eggplant in half lengthwise, then quarter each piece lengthwise again. Slice horizontally into 1/2" planks (they'll be roughly 1/2" by 1" pieces). You may peel the eggplant first if you don't like the skin. Remove stems and roughly chop basil leaves (so they're bite size--if they are all small, no need to chop). In a large wok, heat oil til it smokes. Toss in garlic and peppers and stir fry till fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add eggplant, basil, & bean sprouts and stir fry till tender, about 3 minutes. While eggplant cooks, whisk soy sauce, mirin, peanut butter, and reserved pasta water together into a thin sauce. Once eggplant is tender, remove wok from flame, toss in noodles and sauce and stir briefly to coat. Serve.

title: No Roll Sugar Cookies Recipe
ingredients: 1 c. powdered sugar (confectioners') 1 c. granulated white sugar 1 c. butter 1 c. salad or possibly peanut oil 2 Large eggs, beaten 2 tsp. vanilla 1 tsp. baking soda 1 tsp. cream of tartar 1/4 tsp. salt 5 c. flour
directions: Combine all ingredients except for the flour. Add in flour gradually mixing in using a wooden spoon. When dough is mixed, roll into small balls between your hands. Drop onto an ungreased cookie sheet 2 inches apart. Press each cookie flat using a glass dipped in granulated sugar (dip once for each cookie pressed). If you like, decorate with crushed pecans, walnuts, macadamia nuts, slivered almonds or possibly pistachios for the adults, or possibly sprinkle with colored sugars and sprinkles, chocolate chips or possibly cherries for the children. For a variation, use rum or possibly brandy instead of vanilla. Coconut or possibly banana rum add in an exciting hint of tropical flavor to boost a holiday standard out of the doldrums!

title: Waxy Pecan Bars
ingredients: 6 egg whites, unbeaten 2 c. brown sugar 1 c. white sugar 3 c. pecans, chopped 2 c. flour 1 tsp. baking powder 1 tsp. vanilla
directions: Mix egg whites, sugar and vanilla. Stir, but do not beat. Next add pecans, flour and baking powder. Bake in a slow oven at 300° for 45 minutes in a long greased baking dish. Cut in squares or bars.

title: Company Pot Roast
ingredients: 1 (3 1/2 lb) boneless chuck roast 2 tablespoons vegetable oil 1 medium onion 1 small carrot 1 celery rib 2 teaspoons sugar 1 (16 ounce) can beef broth 1 (16 ounce) can chicken broth 2 -3 sprigs thyme 14 cup red wine 2 medium garlic cloves salt pepper
directions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Dry roast and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Heat oil in dutch oven. Brown roast on all sides, reducing heat if fat begins to smoke; 8 to 10 minutes. Transfer roast to plate. Reduce heat. Saute vegetables until they begin to brown, 6 to 8 minutes. Add garlic and sugar and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add broth, thyme & return roast to pan. Bake 3 1/2 to 4 hours, turning every thirty minutes or so. Remove roast, skim fat and discard thyme. Add wine and reduce to about 1 1/2°C. Can add potatoes, carrots or other root vegetables about 45 minutes before finishing.

title: Reese'S Cup Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 c. butter 1/2 c. peanut butter 1/2 c. sugar 1/2 c. brown sugar 1 egg 1 tsp. vanilla 1 1/2 c. flour 3/4 tsp. baking soda 1/2 tsp. salt 2 small bags or 1 large bag Reese's miniature cups
directions: Combine all ingredients and shape in 1-inch balls. Put into small muffin tins and bake for 8 to 10 minutes at 370°. Take out of oven and insert miniature Reese's cup until just the top shows. Cool in tins about 10 minutes and remove. Makes 48.

title: Pizza Potatoes
ingredients: 1 pkg. scalloped potato mix 16 oz. canned tomatoes, chopped or pureed 1 1/2 c. water 1/4 tsp. oregano pepperoni 4 oz. Mozzarella cheese, shredded
directions: Empty scalloped potato mix, including seasoning, into a greased 2-quart casserole. Heat tomatoes, water and oregano to boiling. Stir into potatoes. Arrange pepperoni on top and sprinkle with shredded cheese. Bake, uncovered, 30 to 35 minutes at 400°.

title: Garden Vegetable Pizza
ingredients: 1/4 cup cider vinegar 3 tablespoons olive oil 1 clove garlic, peeled and minced or pressed 1 tablespoon minced shallots 1 tablespoon chopped fresh basil leaves or 1 teaspoon dried basil 1 teaspoon fresh thyme leaves or dried thyme 1 teaspoon chopped fresh rosemary leaves or 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary 2 thin, baked pizza crusts (10 oz. each, 12 in. wide) 2 cups thinly sliced mushrooms 2 cups thinly sliced yellow crookneck squash 1 1/2 cups thinly sliced Roma tomatoes 1 cup diced orange or red bell peppers 1 cup thinly sliced green onions Salt 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese (1/2 lb.) 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese
directions: In a bowl, mix vinegar, oil, garlic, shallots, basil, thyme, and rosemary. Set pizza crusts in 2 pizza pans (12 in. wide) or on 2 baking sheets (12 by 15 in.). Brush crusts equally with all but 2 tablespoons of the vinegar-oil mixture. Layer mushrooms, squash, tomatoes, peppers, and onions equally over crusts. Sprinkle lightly with salt, then equally with mozzarella and parmesan cheeses. Bake in a 425° regular or convection oven until cheese is lightly browned, 15 to 20 minutes. Drizzle with remaining vinegar-oil mixture. Cut into wedges.

title: Beef-Barley Soup
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. olive oil 1 lb. beef stewing meat 8 c. water 2 beef bouillon cubes 1/2 c. hot water 1 (14 oz.) can stewed tomatoes 1 c. sliced carrots 1 c. chopped onion 1 c. sliced celery 1/2 c. barley 1/4 c. fresh parsley, chopped fine 1/2 tsp. salt 1 1/2 tsp. pepper
directions: In a large soup pot, heat the oil. Add beef; cook until browned. Add 8 cups of water; bring to a boil. Cover and simmer 1 hour, or until meat is tender. Remove meat; shred into small pieces. Dissolve bouillon in hot water. Add bouillon, tomatoes, carrots, onion, celery, barley, parsley, shredded meat, salt and pepper. Cover; simmer for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, or until vegetables are tender. Serves 8.

title: Spaghetti And Meat Sauce(About 10 Servings)
ingredients: 3 lb. ground beef* 1 lb. sliced smoked sausage (optional)* 1 large onion 1 small chopped bell pepper 3 cloves chopped garlic 16 oz. tomato paste 16 oz. herbal-seasoned tomato sauce 4 c. water 2 tsp. seasoning salt 1 tsp. oregano 1 tsp. basil 1/2 tsp. black pepper 2 tsp. sugar spaghetti
directions: *Substitute turkey or chicken for less fat.

title: Vickys Very Berry Fruit Smoothie
ingredients: 1 banana, chopped into chunks and frozen overnight 75 grams raspberries 75 grams blueberries 150 ml light coconut milk or milk of choice 1 tbsp milled flaxseed
directions: Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth. Adjust the milk to your desired thickness. Pour into a glass and enjoy!

title: White Potato Pie
ingredients: 1 c. mashed white potatoes 2 eggs, well beaten 3/4 c. sugar 1 tsp. vanilla 1/3 c. milk pinch of salt
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Pour into 8-inch pie shell. Bake in preheated oven at 400° for 30 minutes.

title: Cauliflower Baked With Tomatoes And Feta
ingredients: 3 tablespoons olive oil 1 onion, sliced 2 cloves garlic, crushed 6 tomatoes, seeded and chopped 1 pinch ground cinnamon 1 -2 teaspoon dried oregano salt freshly ground black pepper 1 large cauliflower, cut in to florets 1 tablespoon lemon juice 3 ounces feta cheese, crumbled
directions: Heat 2 Tbsp olive oil in a heavy based fry pan and saute the onion and garlic for 3-4 minutes, or until the onion has softened. Add the tomatoes, cinnamon and oregano and season with the salt and pepper. Stir then simmer covered for 5 minutes. Preheat oven to 375F degrees. Add cauliflower to the tomato mixture, cover and simmer for a further 10 minutes, or until cauliflower is just tender. Remove from heat. Transfer mixture to a large shallow dish and drizzle over the remaining 1 Tbsp olive oil. Sprinkle over the lemon juice and crumbled feta. Bake for 40 minutes or until the cauli is soft and cheese has melted.

title: White Cake
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. fresh milk 3 c. sugar 3/4 c. butter or margarine 8 egg whites 4 1/2 c. flour 3 tsp. baking powder 1 tsp. salt 1 tsp. vanilla
directions: Cream butter and sugar. Add milk alternately with dry ingredients. Add vanilla, then fold in beaten egg whites. Frost with favorite icing.

title: Sauteed Chicken Breast With Ham & Cheese
ingredients: 3 tablespoons vegetable oil 2 tablespoons margarine or 2 tablespoons butter 4 chicken breast halves 1/2 cup all-purpose flour 1/4 teaspoon black pepper 1 (4 ounce) package sliced fully cooked ham, cut into halves 1 (2 1/2 ounce) jar mushrooms, sliced,drained (reserve liquid) 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese 1/4 cup sweet white wine
directions: Cut chicken breast halves in half. Heat oil& margarine in a skillet until hot. Combine the flour& pepper and coat the chicken. Cook chicken until brown, about 4 minutes on each side. Arrange in ungreased baking dish. Top with ham slices and sprinkle with mushrooms and cheese Pour reserved mushroom liquid into skillet. Cook over medium heat, about 30 seconds, stirring occasionally. Stir in wine and cook 30 seconds more. Pour over cheese. Cook uncovered in a 400 degree oven until cheese is melted, about 8 minutes.

title: Cabbage Soup
ingredients: 1 head cabbage 1 large onion 2 sliced tomatoes 2 bell peppers 1 stalk celery
directions: Cut up onion and cabbage. Combine all ingredients in a large pot and cook on high for about 10 minutes. Then cover and simmer for a while longer until vegetables are tender. Salt, pepper and herbs to taste.

title: Cottage Cheese Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 c. small curd cottage cheese 1 egg, lightly beaten 1/4 c. ketchup 2 Tbsp. chopped onion 1 Tbsp. prepared mustard 1/2 c. quick cooking oats 1 tsp. salt 1/8 tsp. pepper 1 lb. lean ground beef 1/3 c. grated Parmesan cheese
directions: In a bowl, combine the first eight ingredients. Add beef and mix well. Press into an ungreased 8-inch square baking pan. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake 10 to 15 minutes longer or until meat is no longer pink. Drain. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting. Yield: 4 servings.

title: Gluten Free Spicy Mac & Cheese
ingredients: 1 (12 ounce) box Barilla(R) Gluten Free Elbows 2 cups heavy cream 2 cups organic milk 1 tablespoon cornstarch 1 pound shredded pepperjack cheese Salt and black pepper to taste 1 small fresh jalapeno pepper, minced 4 egg yolks, lightly beaten
directions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and pre-heat oven to 400 degrees F. Cook pasta 2 minutes shorter than recommended cook time. In a small pot, heat milk and cream until begins to simmer. Mix corn starch with 2 tablespoons water to create a slurry. Add slurry to the cream mixture to thicken, then season with salt, pepper and jalapeno. Slowly add 3/4 of the cheese into the sauce, whisking constantly. Add pasta to the mixture and let it sit for 5 minutes. Stir in yolks and place in a 9 x 9 greased baking dish. Bake in the oven for approximately 15 minutes or until bubbling and slightly caramelized on the top.

title: Hand Lotion For Face, Hands, Legs And Feet
ingredients: 6 Tbsp. glycerin 1 c. rose water 3 Tbsp. Witch Hazel
directions: Mix well and put in a pretty bottle.

title: Refried Black Beans (
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive or vegetable oil 1/3 cup finely chopped white onion 1 (15 1/2-ounce) can black beans, including liquid 1 medium garlic clove, pressed or finely grated 1/2 teaspoon arbol chile powder or cayenne pepper
directions: Heat the oil in a medium pan over medium-high heat until it shimmers. Add the onion and cook, stirring often, until it's soft and browned at the edges, about 5 minutes. Add the beans, garlic, and chile powder. Let the beans come to a brisk simmer, then lower the heat to maintain a gentle simmer. Cook, stirring and mashing often until the beans resemble a very coarse puree and have thickened, 15 to 20 minutes. When you tip the pan, the beans should creep forward like lava. The beans will thicken a little more once they cool. Add salt to taste. Use warm or at room temperature.

title: Santa Fe Skillet
ingredients: 1 lb. lean ground beef 1 (16 oz.) can whole tomatoes, cut up and drained 2 c. hot water 2 c. Golden Grain Egg Twisties 1 (7 oz.) can whole kernel corn, drained 1/4 c. sliced olives 1 (1.25 oz.) taco seasoning mix 1/2 c. shredded Monterey Jack cheese
directions: Brown ground beef in 10-inch skillet; drain. Return beef to skillet. Add tomatoes and water. Bring to boil. Stir in remaining ingredients except cheese. Reduce heat; simmer over medium heat 8 to 10 minutes or until Twisties are tender, stirring occasionally. Sprinkle with cheese. Serve immediately. Serves 6.

title: Fez Carrots
ingredients: 4 carrots, sliced thin (about 1/4 inch) 1/4 cup butter 1/2 onion, sliced paper thin 1/4 cup white wine 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg 1/2 cup raisins, soaked in warm water and drained 2 tablespoons brown sugar
directions: Combine the carrots through nutmeg in a saucepan and cook over low heat until tender. Stir in the raisins and brown sugar. Cook another 1/2 minute, stirring gently to warm through.

title: Mexican Rooster
ingredients: 3 cups cooked chicken, cubed 1 (8 ounce) bag corn chips 1 (10 1/2 ounce) can cream of chicken soup 1 (10 1/2 ounce) can condensed golden mushroom soup 1 (10 ounce) can tomatoes and green chilies 1 teaspoon pepper 2 teaspoons salt 1 medium onion, chopped 2 cups sharp cheddar cheese, shredded
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Grease a 3- quart casserole dish. Crush the corn chips and place in the bottom of the casserole. Spread chicken over chips. Mix soups, tomatoes, pepper and salt. Pour over chicken. Evenly spread onion on top. Bake 40-45 minutes Spread cheese on top. Bake 15 more minutes or until cheese is melted. Goes well with Mexican Cornbread.

title: Easy Time Holiday Squares
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. sugar 4 eggs 1 Tbsp. vanilla 2 sticks margarine 2 c. flour 1 can any kind pie filling
directions: Cream margarine and sugar on medium speed until light and fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time; beat well after each. At low speed, add flour and vanilla. Pour batter into well-greased cookie sheet. Mark off twenty squares, placing 1 tablespoon of pie filling in center of each. While warm, sprinkle with confectioners sugar. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Alla Carbonara
ingredients: 1 pound dry spaghetti 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil 4 ounces pancetta or slab bacon, cubed or sliced into small strips 4 garlic cloves, finely chopped 2 large eggs 1 cup freshly grated Parmigiano-Reggiano, plus more for serving Freshly ground black pepper 1 handful fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped Read more at: http://www.foodnetwork.com/recipes/tyler-florence/spaghetti-alla-carbonara-recipe.html?oc=linkback
directions: Prepare the sauce while the pasta is cooking to ensure that the spaghetti will be hot and ready when the sauce is finished; it is very important that the pasta is hot when adding the egg mixture, so that the heat of the pasta cooks the raw eggs in the sauce. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil, add the pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until tender yet firm (as they say in Italian "al dente.") Drain the pasta well, reserving 1/2 cup of the starchy cooking water to use in the sauce if you wish. Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a deep skillet over medium flame. Add the pancetta and saute for about 3 minutes, until the bacon is crisp and the fat is rendered. Toss the garlic into the fat and saute for less than 1 minute to soften. Add the hot, drained spaghetti to the pan and toss for 2 minutes to coat the strands in the bacon fat. Beat the eggs and Parmesan together in a mixing bowl, stirring well to prevent lumps. Remove the pan from the heat and pour the egg/cheese mixture into the pasta, whisking quickly until the eggs thicken, but do not scramble (this is done off the heat to ensure this does not happen.) Thin out the sauce with a bit of the reserved pasta water, until it reaches desired consistency. Season the carbonara with several turns of freshly ground black pepper and taste for salt. Mound the spaghetti carbonara into warm serving bowls and garnish with chopped parsley. Pass more cheese around the table. Recipe courtesy Tyler Florence Read more at: http://www.foodnetwork.com/recipes/tyler-florence/spaghetti-alla-carbonara-recipe.html?oc=linkback

title: King Ranch Casserole
ingredients: 1 chicken, cooked, boned and cut-up 1 chopped green pepper 1 chopped onion 2 cans cream of mushroom soup 2 cans cream of chicken soup 1 can Ro-Tel Doritos Cheddar cheese, shredded chicken broth
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients. Layer with Doritos and cheese. Pour 1 can chicken broth (saved from chicken) over casserole. Bake until bubbly at 375°.

title: Chicken And Corkscrew Macaroni
ingredients: 2 c. corkscrew or elbow macaroni 1 (7 oz.) can tomatoes 1 (15 oz.) can tomato sauce 1 (4 oz.) can sliced mushrooms 1 green pepper, chopped 1/2 tsp. sugar 1/2 tsp. Italian seasoning 2 c. chunk-style chicken 1 c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
directions: Cook macaroni. Cut up tomatoes in a large saucepan or 10-inch skillet. Stir together undrained tomatoes, tomato sauce, mushrooms, green pepper, drained canned chicken and macaroni. Mix together and add cheese. Cook together for about 15 minutes.

title: Brown Sugar Cherry Cookies
ingredients: 2 c. brown sugar 1/2 c. shortening 1/2 c. butter 1/2 c. milk 2 eggs 3 1/2 c. flour 1 tsp. baking soda 1/2 tsp. salt 2 c. cherries (1 c. chopped, 1 c. halved)
directions: Mix together first 8 ingredients. Stir 1 cup chopped cherries into dough. Drop by spoonful on cookie sheet.

title: Vinegar Taffy
ingredients: 1 cup sugar 1/2 cup water 1/4 cup corn syrup, light 1/2 teaspoon salt 2 tablespoons vinegar 1 teaspoon vanilla extract or other flavoring such as orange or lemon, or use1/2 ts , peppermint or 1 oz bitter chocolate, grated
directions: Cook sugar, water, corn syrup, salt and vinegar until a few drops of the mixture will make a hard ball in cold water, 260 cup degrees on a candy thermometer. Pour onto a greased dish or platter, sprinkle flavoring over top and turn the outer edges of the candy in toward the center until cool and firm enough to handle. Best results are obtained in pulling if the tips of the thumbs and fingers are dipped in cornstarch or fat. Use only the fingertips to pull taffy. When mixture can be handled, take up and pull out with both hands. Fold over and pull out again. As the mixture becomes cooler and the longer it is pulled, it will become stiffer and can be pulled out in a longer strand. Pull until it is difficult to pull out and the mixture seems quite firm. Pull into long thin strips and cut immediately with greased scissors and roll each piece in powdered sugar or wrap in wax paper. Store cooled taffy in an air tight container in a cool dry place. If the taffy crystallizes, it can be recooked by putting it in a pan with 2 tablespoons corn syrup and 1/4 cup water. Stir until dissolved and then recook according to original directions. Note: Finely chopped nuts or fruit, as well as other flavorings, are added as the taffy is being pulled.

title: Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 lb. lima or baby lima beans 1 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. pepper 1 tsp. mustard 1 (14 oz.) bottle ketchup 1/4 tsp. paprika 1 c. brown sugar 2 Tbsp. molasses 1 small onion, chopped 1/2 lb. bacon, diced
directions: Rinse and sort beans. Soak overnight. Cook until tender. Place beans in casserole with other ingredients. Cover and bake at 350° for 2 hours.

title: Peanut Butter Balls(No Bake Confection)
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) pkg. peanut butter chips 1 (14 oz.) can sweetened condensed milk 1 small pkg. lite cream cheese, softened 1 c. finely ground pecans 1/2 c. chopped raisins or 1/2 c. finely chopped dried fruit
directions: Melt peanut butter chips and condensed milk in heavy saucepan. Stir constantly and do not scorch. Blend in cream cheese. Mix in the ground nuts, raisins or dried fruit. Chill at least 2 hours.

title: Sauerkraut And Sausage Bake
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. bulk pork sausage 1 (27 oz.) can sauerkraut, rinsed and drained 1 Tbsp. sliced green onions with tops instant mashed potatoes for 4 4 Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
directions: In skillet, brown sausage; drain off fat. Stir together sauerkraut and green onions. Turn into a 1 1/2 quart casserole. Spoon sausage over sauerkraut mixture. Prepare mashed potatoes according to package directions. Stir 2 tablespoons of the cheese into potatoes. Spread potatoes over sausage; sprinkle remaining 2 tablespoons cheese. Bake, uncovered, at 400° until heated through, 35 to 40 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Party Punch
ingredients: 1 (46 oz.) can Hi-C Hula Punch, chilled thoroughly 4 c. Sprite 2 pt. pineapple sherbet
directions: Mix Hula Punch and Sprite. Add sherbet by the spoonful. Mix and serve. Serves 12 to 24.

title: Crab Cake Balls
ingredients: 2 pounds imitation crabmeat 10 eggs - beaten 2 cups breadcrumbs - plain or Italian style 2 cups cornmeal 1 cup buttermilk 3 tablespoons rice wine vinegar 1 bunch Italian parsley - chopped 6 cloves garlic 2 oil 4 stalks celery - chopped 1 dash red pepper flakes 1 dash fresh ground black pepper 1 dash sea salt 1 onion medium, - chopped cornmeal for rolling the balls in vegetable oil for frying 1/2 cup ketchup 2 tablespoons horseradish 1/2 teaspoon garlic chili paste tsp., or 1 desired hot sauce 1 teaspoon teriyaki sauce 1/2 juice lemon
directions: Shred the crabmeat in a large bowl. Add the celery, onions, garlic, parsley and seasonings and mix together well. In a separate bowl combine the eggs, bread crumbs, 1 cup of cornmeal, buttermilk and the rice wine vinegar combine this together and then combine this with the crabmeat. Set the other cup of cornmeal in a dish. Roll the crabmeat mixture into desired size balls and then coat the crab balls in the cornmeal. Heat a large frying pan with about 1 inch of vegetable oil and 2 cloves of garlic. Carefully place the crab balls in the hot oil. When the balls become golden on one side, carefully turn them to become golden on the other side. Prepare a plate with paper towels to drain the crab balls. Combine all of the ingredients and mix.

title: Mexican Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. ground meat tortilla chips 1 can cream of mushroom soup 1 jar picante sauce 1 large onion Velveeta cheese
directions: On large cookie sheet, spread tortilla chips to cover. Brown the ground meat and sprinkle over the chips. Mix the soup and picante sauce and pour over the ground meat. Cut the onion and cheese (in chunks). Sprinkle over the casserole. Put in medium oven until cheese melts and onion is done.

title: Smugullian
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef 1 large onion, diced 1 large green pepper, diced 2 cloves garlic, minced 1 large can tomatoes or juice 2 c. cooked spaghetti 1 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. pepper 1 tsp. sweet basil
directions: Brown the beef with diced onion, green pepper, minced garlic and tomatoes. Add cooked spaghetti (not too done). You should have approximately 2/3 meat mixture and 1/3 spaghetti.

title: Gayle'S Pie
ingredients: 1 can condensed milk 1/4 c. lemon juice 1 to 1 1/2 c. chopped nuts 2 cans mandarin oranges, drained 8 oz. Cool Whip 2 graham cracker crusts
directions: Mix together and pour into 2 crusts. Chill.

title: Peanut Brittle(Microwave High Setting)
ingredients: 1 c. raw peanuts 1 c. sugar 1/2 c. white corn syrup 1/8 tsp. salt 1 tsp. butter (or oleo) 1 tsp. vanilla 1 tsp. vanilla
directions: Stir together peanuts, sugar,	syrup and salt in a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Place in oven and cook for 7 to 8 minutes, stirring well after 4 minutes. After 8 minutes, add butter and vanilla, blending well. Return to oven and cook for 1 to 2 minutes. Peanuts will be lightly browned and syrup very hot. Remove from oven and add soda. Gently stir until light and foamy.	Pour mixture onto lightly greased cookie sheet. Let cool for 1/2 to 1 hour. Break in small pieces and store in airtight container.

title: Asparagus Roll Ups Recipe
ingredients: 4 ounce Blue Cheese 4 ounce Roquefort Cheese 8 ounce Cream Cheese 1 x Egg 1 Tbsp. Mayonnaise 2 can Asparagus Spears 40 piece Sandwich Bread, crust removed 1 stk Margarine Paprika, as desired
directions: Mix cheeses, egg and mayonnaise with an electric mixer. Flatten each piece of bread with a rolling pin till almost paper thin. Spread cheese mix on each side, lay one spear of asparagus on each piece, and roll up. Heat the margarine and add in paprika for color. Dip each roll in the margarine, and place on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350 for 15 min. Serves: 10 to 12 as an hors d'oeuvre. Can be frzn and reheated.

title: Puree Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1 tomatoes (seeded, chopped) 1 potato (peeled, chopped) 2 stalks celery (chopped) 2 leeks (cut below the dark green part, chopped) 2 carrots (peeled, chopped) 1 cup cauliflower (cut into small florets) 1 red pepper (seeded, chopped) 1 teaspoon fresh basil (diced) 2 zucchini (chopped) 12 teaspoon fresh parsley (diced) 12 teaspoon garlic powder (diced) or 12 teaspoon fresh garlic (diced) 12 teaspoon chili powder (berbere) 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil 2 bay leaves 6 cups water salt and black pepper
directions: Rinse well all vegetables before chopping. Put all chopped vegetables, basil, fresh garlic, two tablespoons of oil in a big pot; Add 6 cups of water or more; cover and cook for 30 minutes. Strain the water from the cooked vegetables; set aside the vegetable stock (it will be about 4 cups). Puree (mash) the cooked vegetables in a blender or food processor. In a lower heat, bring to boil three cups of the vegetable stock; add one tablespoon of oil. Pour the blended vegetables to the boiling pot; add chili powder (berbere), garlic powder, black pepper, salt and bay leaves; if desired add one cup of vegetable stock; cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat; sprinkle fresh parsley and serve it hot.

title: Tomato Soup Salad
ingredients: 1 can tomato soup 1 1/2 Tbsp. gelatin 1/2 c. cold water 2 (3 oz.) pkg. cream cheese 1 c. mayonnaise 1 c. chopped celery 2 Tbsp. bell pepper onion flakes
directions: Soften gelatin in cold water. Add to heated soup along with other ingredients. Cream cheese may be diced before adding. Put in bowl and chill.

title: Pepper Steak
ingredients: 1 1/4 lb. beef top round or sirloin steak (about 1-inch thick) 1/4 c. vegetable oil 1 c. water 1 medium onion, cut into 1/4-inch slices 1/4 tsp. garlic salt 1/4 tsp. ground ginger 2 medium green peppers, cut into strips uncooked instant rice 1 Tbsp. cornstarch 2 or 3 tsp. sugar (optional) 2 Tbsp. soy sauce 2 medium tomatoes
directions: Cut beef into strips. Heat oil in large skillet; add beef. Cook, turning frequently, until brown, about 5 minutes. Stir in water, onion, garlic salt and ginger. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 12 to 15 minutes for round steak, 5 to 8 minutes for sirloin. Add green pepper during last 5 minutes of simmering. While beef is simmering, cook rice as directioned on package.

title: Blueberry Pie
ingredients: 1 c. fresh blueberries, mashed (not frozen) 1/2 c. sugar 2 Tbsp. cornstarch 1/4 c. water 2 Tbsp. lemon juice dash of salt dash of cinnamon
directions: Combine ingredients. Stir constantly on medium heat until thickened and boiling. Boil 1 minute or microwave until clear and thickened. Cool slightly. Add 3 cups fresh blueberries; fold in. Pour into 9-inch baked pie shell. Spread whipped cream or Cool Whip around outer edge of pie, leaving center uncovered. Chill 3 hours.

title: Old Fashioned Barley Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil 1 cup chopped onion 12 cup chopped bell pepper (either green or red or you can use any type pepper) 2 cups sliced mushrooms (can be any type of 'shrooms, I find standard supermarket button mushrooms work well) 2 23 cups water 1 cup barley, rinsed (I use pearled barley) 1 teaspoon salt 12 teaspoon black pepper (preferably freshly ground)
directions: Heat the oil in a 2-quart saucepan. Add the onion and chopped pepper and cook , stirring often, over medium-high heat until softened(approximately 5 minutes). Add mushrooms and continue to cook, stirring often, until softened(approximately 3 minutes). Stir in water and bring to a boil over high heat(approximately 7 to 10 minutes). Add barley, salt and pepper. Return to boiling. Cover and simmer for 45 minutes longer, or until liquid has been absorbed.

title: Cinnamon Apple Latkes
ingredients: 2 eggs 3 tablespoons sugar 1 teaspoon salt 2 teaspoons cinnamon 13 cup water 3 cups cooking apples, chopped 34 cup flour, unsifted 1 teaspoon lemon peel, grated peanut oil 12 cup sugar
directions: Beat eggs until light and foamy. Mix in 3 tablespoons sugar, salt, 1 teaspoons cinnamon, and water until well blended. Stir in chopped apple, flour and grated lemon peel; mix well. Heat the oil in skillet. Drop 1/4 cup apple mixture into hot oil. Flatten slightly. Fry on each side until golden brown. Drain on paper towels. Combine 1/2 cup sugar and cinnamon to make the topping. Sprinkle sugar-cinnamon mixture over hot latkes. Serve immediately.

title: Eggs Portugal
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. butter 3/4 lb. shredded Cheddar cheese 3/4 Tbsp. dry mustard 1 lb. sausage, browned 6 slices white bread, cubed 2 1/2 c. milk 6 eggs
directions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Mix the cheese, mustard, sausage and bread; pour in dish. Add the milk and eggs just before baking. (May be assembled the night before, except for milk and eggs.)

title: Shrimp, Chicken, and Pinapple Kebabs
ingredients: 3/4 cup jalapeno baste ** 2 tablespoons lemon juice fresh 36 x shrimp shelled, jumbo 1 1/2 pounds chicken breasts boneless 1 x pineapple 1 x vegetable oil
directions: **Jalepeno baste: Seed and coarsely chop 2 jalepeno peppers. Saute in oil until soft, and add 1 heaping tablespoons of sugar. Puree. Add a little oil if the mixture seems too thick. Cut chicken into 3/4 inch chunks. Peel and core pinapple and cut into chunks. Combine jalepeno baste with with lemon juice and heat through. Thread the shrimp, the chicken, and the pinapple, alternating them, onto the skewers. Brush with the jalepeno mixture, sprinkle with salt and pepper, and grill for 6 to 7 minutes over glowing coals until done. OR broil in the oven. OR cook 10 minutes in the Jet-Stream Oven.

title: Cream Cheese Frosting
ingredients: 1 oz. imitation cream cheese 1 tsp. skim milk 1 Tbsp. confectioners sugar dash of salt 1/2 tsp. Sweet 'N Low 1 drop vanilla extract
directions: Cream the cream cheese and milk. Add sugar, salt, Sweet 'N Low and vanilla. Blend well. Makes 3 tablespoons. Contains approximately 8 calories per teaspoon.

title: Mexican Baked Pasta
ingredients: 2 cups Uncooked Small Pasta, Such As Shells, Penne, Rotini, Etc. 1 pound Ground Beef 2 cups Salsa 1 cup Corn Kernels 3/4 cups Canned Black Beans, Rinsed 2- 1/2 cups Shredded Cheese, Such As Monterey Jack, Cheddar, Mozzarella, Or A Combination Of All Three
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. In a large pot of boiling, salted water, cook pasta until al dente (dont overcook or it will become mushy during baking). Drain well. In a large skillet over medium heat, cook beef until it is no longer pink, about 5 minutes. Drain grease. Add salsa, corn kernels, and beans and stir to combine. Cook, stirring for another 35 minutes to blend the flavours. Add to pasta and stir to combine. Spoon half of pasta mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle half of cheese over top. Add the rest of pasta mixture in an even layer and cover with remaining cheese. Bake for 3035 minutes until hot and bubbling. Alternatively, you can prepare the dish then cover and refrigerate until ready to bake. You will need to add 510 minutes to the baking time. This pasta dish also freezes well. Prepare the dish, then cover well and freeze for up to 3 months. Thaw before baking.

title: Strawberry Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. white cake mix 1 Tbsp. flour 1 pkg. strawberry Jell-O (dry) 3/4 c. cooking oil 4 eggs 1/2 c. water 1/2 c. frozen strawberries, thawed or fresh ones, sliced and sweetened
directions: Combine cake mix, flour and dry Jell-O. Add oil, water and strawberries. Blend well. Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition. Bake in 3-layer pans, greased and floured, at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Bavarian Pot Roast
ingredients: 1 (3 lb.) beef chuck roast 2 Tbsp. flour 2 Tbsp. vegetable oil 1 (6 oz.) can frozen apple juice concentrate, thawed 1 medium onion, cut in wedges 1 Tbsp. beef flavor instant bouillon or 3 beef flavor bouillon cubes 1/2 tsp. caraway seed 1/2 tsp. ground cinnamon 2 medium carrots, pared and sliced 2 medium potatoes, pared and quartered 2 all-purpose apples, cored and cut in wedges
directions: Coat meat with flour. In large kettle, brown in oil. Add juice concentrate, onion, bouillon and spices. Cover and simmer 1 hour and 30 minutes. Add carrots and potatoes, cover and simmer 45 minutes. Add apples, cover and simmer 15 minutes. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Apple Coffee Cake
ingredients: 4 c. chopped apples, peeled and diced 2 1/2 tsp. cinnamon 1/4 tsp. nutmeg 1/3 c. sugar 4 1/2 c. flour 4 tsp. baking powder 3 c. sugar 1 tsp. salt 6 large eggs 1 1/2 c. Wesson oil 1/3 c. undiluted frozen orange juice, thawed grated rind of orange
directions: To chopped apples, add cinnamon, nutmeg and 1/3 cup sugar; add orange rind. Let stand.

title: Chinese Pepper Steak
ingredients: 1 lb. round, flank or chuck steak 1/4 c. corn oil or canola 1 clove garlic 1/2 c. coarsely chopped onion 2 c. green pepper or any color, cut into bite size pieces 1 tsp. salt (optional) 1/4 tsp. pepper 1/4 tsp. ginger root (optional) 1 Tbsp. cornstarch 1 Tbsp. soy sauce 1 tsp. brown sauce (Gravy Master) 1 c. stock or bouillon
directions: Slice steak thinly across grain and cut into strips 2 inches long. Place garlic in hot oil and remove after a few minutes. Brown meat in oil. Add onion, green pepper, salt, pepper and ginger. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until just tender.

title: Cashew Crickle Candy
ingredients: 2 cups sugar 1 cup light corn syrup 1/2 cup water 3 tablespoons butter 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 1/2 teaspoon baking soda 2 cups salted cashews
directions: In a large saucepan, combine the sugar, corn syrup and water. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly, until sugar is dissolved. Cook, without stirring, over medium heat until a candy thermometer reads 300° (hard-crack stage). Remove from the heat; stir in butter, vanilla and baking soda. Add cashews. Pour into a buttered 15x10x1-in. pan. Cool; break into pieces.

title: Bourbon Barbecue Chicken Tacos
ingredients: 1 cup ketchup 1 small red onion, finely chopped 1/4 cup packed brown sugar 2 tablespoons Worcestershire sauce 2 tablespoons maple syrup 2 tablespoons cider vinegar 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley 2 garlic cloves, minced 1/4 teaspoon pepper 3 tablespoons bourbon, divided 1-1/2 pounds boneless skinless chicken breasts SALSA: 2 cups fresh or thawed frozen corn 1 cup chopped sweet red pepper 1/2 cup finely chopped red onion 2 medium limes, zested and juiced 1/8 teaspoon hot pepper sauce 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon pepper 8 flour tortillas (8 inches) Minced cilantro, optional
directions: In a 3-qt. slow cooker, combine the first 9 ingredients and 2 tablespoons bourbon. Add chicken; turn to coat. Cook, covered, on low until a thermometer reads 165°, 3-4 hours.
