directions: Combine pecans, sugar and orange juice in 9x12 inch Pyrex dish. Mix together in 9x12 inch Pyrex dish. Cook in microwave on ROAST for 7 min. Remove from microwave and stir well. Return to microwave for 7 min on ROAST. Pour on buttered cookie sheet and separate pecans.

title: Sweet Potato Bread
ingredients: 1 c. margarine 2 c. sugar 3 eggs 1 tsp. soda 1 tsp. vanilla 2 c. sweet potatoes, baked 2 1/2 c. flour (plain) 1 1/2 tsp. salt (I use less) 1 1/2 tsp. cloves 1/2 tsp. nutmeg
directions: Cream margarine; add sugar. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Add potatoes. Sift together all dry ingredients. Blend into potato mixture. Mix 1/4 cup flour with 1 cup nuts and 1 cup raisins. Add to other mixture. Bake at 350° for 60 minutes in 2 bread pans (greased and floured). Let cool for 15 minutes. Remove from pans. Wrap and store in refrigerator. May bake less time.

title: Venison Stew
ingredients: 3 lb. tender venison (hind quarter) 3 to 5 large potatoes, quartered 3 to 4 large carrots 3 large onions, quartered 1 tsp. garlic salt or powder 1 tsp. black pepper 1 tsp. salt 1/2 c. corn oil or olive oil
directions: Clean venison well. Trim and discard all membrane. Cube venison and salt and pepper well. Quick fry in oil using 5-quart pot. Add potatoes, carrots and onions. Cover all with water. Simmer for 2 hours or until venison is fork-tender. Enjoy!

title: Spicy Pepperoni Stuffed Crust Pizza
ingredients: 100 ml warm water 1 tsp dried yeast 180 grams plain flour 1 tsp brown sugar 1/2 tsp salt 1 tbsp virgin olive oil 50 grams tomato paste 100 grams Grated Processed Mozarella 8 dozen Jalapeno Pepper Slices 175 grams pizza sauce 150 grams grated mild cheddar cheese 8 slice pepperoni 2 mushrooms 1/2 red bell pepper 1 red chilli
directions: Preheat oven to 200 Centigrades (the hotter the oven, the better the pizza will cook) Mix the water, yeast, sugar and salt in a large bowl then leave for 10 minutes Stir in the flour until mixed into a dough, pour over the oil then knead until you have a firm ball. Cover and leave to rise for one hour. Chop the bell pepper into thin strips and slice the much rooms and chilli. Chop the pepperoni into smaller pieces and leave to one side for the topping. On a well floured surface, roll out the pizza dough so that it is a cm or so thick and a few cm larger than your pizza tray. Place the pizza tray or stone over the dough. Trim the edges of the dough so that the base is round. This is your pizza base. Place the pizza base on the tray, so the excess is hanging over the edge. Spoon out the tomato paste around the edges of the tray and, using the back of a teaspoon, spread the paste out around the edges of the tray to form a narrow ring of paste around the edge of the base.. Evenly place the mozzarella and jalapeno slices (halved) on top of the ring of paste. Fold over the excess crust and firmly press the edges down to form a tightly sealed stuffed crust around the edges of the pizza base. Place in the hot oven for 3-4 minutes to firm up the base. Spread pizza sauce over the pizza base and crust then evenly sprinkle over the cheddar cheese and toppings. Cook for 8-10 minutes. The pizza is cooked when the cheese is starting yo bubble and the crust is firm to the touch.

title: Loaded Potato Pasta Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs baby potatoes 8 sliced bacon, diced 1/2 lb tri color rotini pasta, cooked according to package directions and cooled 2 cups broccoli florets, steamed 1 cup cubed sharp cheddar cheese, plus 1/2 cup 4 tablespoons chopped chives, divided 1/2 cup sour cream, plus more for topping 1/2 cup mayonnaise 1/3 cup buttermilk 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar 2 teaspoons sugar kosher salt ground black pepper
directions: Equipment: Large mixing bowl, Small bowl, whisk. Place potatoes in a medium pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, then reduce to a simmer and cook until tender, about 12-15 minutes. Drain potatoes, cut into quarters and place in a large mixing bowl. Cook bacon in a medium skillet over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until crisp. Drain onto a towel-lined plate. Transfer half of bacon to the bowl with potatoes and reserve the other half to garnish the final salad. Add cooked pasta, broccoli, 1 cup cubed cheddar cheese and 2 tablespoons chopped chives to the bowl and toss to combine. In a medium bowl, whisk to combine sour cream, mayonnaise, buttermilk, apple cider vinegar, sugar and salt and pepper to taste. Pour over salad and toss to combine. Season to taste with salt and pepper and transfer to serving bowl. Garnish with remaining bacon, cheese, a dollop of sour cream and sprinkle of chives.

title: Pizza Casserole
ingredients: 2 lb. ground beef 1/2 c. chopped onion 2 c. twisted macaroni 1/2 tsp. sugar 1 can pizza sauce 1 can tomato paste 1 small can tomato sauce oregano onion salt garlic salt Mozzarella cheese Parmesan cheese pepperoni
directions: Brown ground beef and onion. Cook macaroni. Add to browned ground beef, sugar, pizza sauce, tomato sauce and tomato paste. Season with oregano, onion salt and garlic salt. Add macaroni to meat mixture. In casserole dish layer 1/2 meat mixture. Cover with Mozzarella cheese; repeat. Top with Parmesan cheese and pepperoni. Put in microwave for 5 minutes or conventional oven at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Quick Fruit Cobbler
ingredients: 1 stick butter or margarine 1 c. self-rising flour 1 c. sugar 1 c. milk 4 c. prepared fruit (peaches, apples, cherries)
directions: Heat oven to 325°. Put 1 stick margarine in a baking dish. Put in oven and allow margarine to melt.

title: Almond Crusted Chicken Fingers
ingredients: 12 cup sliced almonds 14 cup whole wheat flour 1 12 teaspoons paprika 12 teaspoon garlic powder 12 teaspoon dry mustard 14 teaspoon salt 18 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper 1 12 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil 4 egg whites 1 lb chicken tenders canola oil cooking spray, as required
directions: Preheat oven to 475F. Put a foil-lined baking sheet on a wire rack. Coat it with cooking spray. In your food processor, process together almonds, flour, paprika, dry mustard, garlic powder, salt and pepper until the almonds are finely chopped and the paprika is mixed throughout(takes about a minute). Drizzle in the oil and process until combined. Transfer to a shallow dish. In another shallow dish, whisk the egg whites, one at a time. Add chicken tenders and turn 'em over in the egg whites to coat well. Transfer each chicken tender to the almond mixture. Toss well to coat with it. Discard immediately any remanining egg white and almond mixture. Place the tenders on the prepared rack. Coat with cooking spray, turn and spray the other side. Bake until golden brown, crispy and no longer pink in the middle. This takes about 20-25 minutes. Enjoy!

title: Puppy Chow
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) pkg. chocolate chips 1 c. peanut butter 1 stick margarine 1 large box Crispix 1 lb. box powdered sugar
directions: Melt the chocolate chips, margarine and peanut butter together. Pour this mixture over 1 large box of Crispix. Stir. In a large paper bag, pour in 1 box powdered sugar. Put chocolate cereal mixture in bag also. Close bag and shake until cereal is well covered. Store in well-closed container.

title: Mushroom And Sausage Sourdough Stuffing
ingredients: INGREDIENTS 2 tablespoons butter 3 tablespoons olive oil 3 shallots, minced 2 pints cremini mushrooms, quartered 2 garlic cloves, minced 2 tablespoons chopped fresh rosemary 1 tablespoon chopped fresh sage 1 pound Italian sausage, cooked and diced 1 loaf sourdough bread, cubed (about 8 cups) 4 cups turkey, chicken or vegetable broth Kosher salt Freshly ground black pepper
directions: DIRECTIONS 1. Preheat the oven to 350°. Lightly grease a large baking dish with nonstick spray. 2. Cook the vegetables: Heat the butter and olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the shallots and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add the mushrooms and cook until they are lightly golden, 5 to 6 minutes more. 3. Add the garlic to the pan and cook until fragrant, 1 minute more. Stir in the rosemary, sage and sausage; cook, tossing occasionally, until heated through, 1 to 2 minutes. Transfer the mixture to a large bowl. 4. Prepare the stuffing: Add the bread to the bowl and toss with the mushroom mixture to combine. Gradually pour in the broth, tossing well as you pour to ensure it coats the bread mixture evenly. Season with salt and pepper. 5. Pour the stuffing into the prepared baking dish and bake until the stuffing is heated through and the top is golden brown, 30 to 40 minutes. Let cool slightly; serve warm.

title: Bali Baked Fish
ingredients: 2 pounds red snapper fillets salt to taste freshly ground black pepper to taste 1 onion quartered 3 garlic cloves chopped 1 tablespoon gingerroot chopped 1 tablespoon tamarind paste 1 tablespoon sesame oil Oriental 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin 2 tablespoons water fresh lemon juice to taste 3 tablespoons fresh mint minced, or to taste
directions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Pat dry the fish fillets, season with salt and pepper, and arrange in a shallow baking dish. In a blender or food processor combine the onion, garlic, gingerroot, tamarind paste, sesame oil, cumin, salt to taste, and 2 tablespoons water and blend until smooth. Pour mixture over fish, coating both sides. Bake fish, covered with foil, in the oven for 20 to 25 minutes, or until it flakes easily with a fork. Transfer fillets to a serving dish, correct seasoning, adding more salt if necessary, and drizzle with lemon juice. Garnish with mint.

title: Pea Cashew Salad
ingredients: 2 boxes frozen peas, thawed 10 slices bacon, fried and crumbled 1/2 c. chopped green onion 1 c. cashew pieces 1 c. chopped celery 1 c. sour cream
directions: Mix well. Place in serving container. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Remove from refrigerator 15 minutes before serving and stir.

title: 20-Minute Spicy Sriracha Ramen
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame oil 1 1/2 tablespoons sriracha hot sauce 1 small onion, diced 1 small roma tomato, diced 1 tablespoon ginger, grated 5 garlic cloves, minced 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder 1/2 teaspoon celery salt 4 cups vegetable broth 2 cups water 1 tablespoon soy sauce 1/2 teaspoon rice vinegar 3 (3 ounce) packages ramen noodles 1/2 cup scallion, chopped 1/2 cup cilantro, chopped 4 poached eggs (optional) or 4 soft-boiled eggs (optional)
directions: Add the sesame oil and sriracha to a large stockpot and bring to a simmer over medium-heat. Add the onion and tomato and cook for 4 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the ginger, garlic, and seasonings; cook for 2 minutes or until fragrant. Add 2 cups of water and transfer mixture to a blender or food processor and pulse until smooth. Return mixture to the pot and add the broth. Bring to a simmer; add soy sauce and vinegar (if using), and simmer for 8-10 minutes. Taste and adjust seasoning as needed. Add the ramen noodles to the broth and simmer for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the noodles have softened. Add the scallions, stir to combine. Remove pan from heat, ladle soup into bowls, and top with cilantro and eggs.

title: Buttermilk Pie
ingredients: 1 c. thick buttermilk 1 2/3 c. sugar 2 eggs, well beaten 1 stick margarine 4 Tbsp. flour 1 Tbsp. lemon flavoring
directions: Mix ingredients well. Pour into a 9-inch pie shell and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until firm.

title: Creamed Cottage Cheese Pie
ingredients: 1 (9 inch) pie shell 1 1/2 cups cottage cheese, creamed 4 tablespoons melted butter 1/2 cup white sugar 1/4 teaspoon salt 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour 1 tablespoon lemon zest 2 eggs 1/2 cup raisins 1/2 cup chopped walnuts (optional) 1/4 cup milk
directions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F (205 degrees C). Separate the eggs. Press the cheese through a sieve 2 times. Add the butter, sugar, salt, flour, lemon zest, unbeaten egg yolks, raisins, chopped walnuts and milk. Stir well. Beat the egg whites until stiff peaks form. Fold the egg whites into the cream cheese mixture. Bake at 400 degrees F (205 degrees C) for 30 minutes or until browned and firm.

title: Pink Pickled Onions
ingredients: 2 lbs red onions, thinly sliced,separated into rings 6 sprigs fresh rosemary (4-inch) 2 cups champagne vinegar or 2 cups white wine vinegar 1 1/2 cups water 1 cup sugar 1 1/2 tablespoons whole mixed pickling spices 2 teaspoons kosher salt
directions: Place 1/3 of onions in large (at least 2-quart) jar with tight-fitting lid. Add 2 rosemary sprigs. Repeat layering twice more with remaining onions and rosemary. Bring vinegar, 1 1/2 cups water, sugar, pickling spice, and salt to boil in medium saucepan over high heat, stirring until sugar dissolves. Reduce heat and simmer 2 minutes, stirring often. Pour hot liquid over onions, pushing onions down into liquid. If necessary, add just enough cold water to cover onions. Cool. Place lid on jar; refrigerate at least 1 day. (Can be made 2 weeks ahead; keep chilled.).

title: Crazy Corn
ingredients: 3 c. popped corn 1/4 stick butter 1/8 c. honey (2 Tbsp.) 1/3 c. peanuts
directions: Heat oven to 350°. Pop popcorn, then melt butter and honey together and stir. Put popcorn and peanuts in a small bowl. Pour honey-butter mixture over corn and stir it up. Pour popcorn in a baking dish and spread it out. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes. Cool and eat.

title: Blissful Banana Pie Recipe
ingredients: 1 c. vanilla wafer crumbs 1/4 c. minced pecans 1/3 c. butter, melted 1 (6 ounce.) pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips 1/2 c. lowfat milk 3 c. Kraft miniature marshmallows, divided 1 (3 1/4 ounce.) pkg. vanilla pudding and pie filling 1/2 c. heavy cream, whipped 2 bananas, thinly sliced
directions: Combine crumbs, nuts, and butter; press into 9 inch pie plate. Bake at 375 degrees for 5 min and cold. Combine chocolate pcs, lowfat milk, and 1 c. of the marshmallows; stir over low heat till melted. Pour into crumb crust. Chill. Prepare pudding as directed on package, except using only 1 1/2 c. lowfat milk. Cover with waxed paper; chill. Mix in whipped cream and remaining marshmallows. Arrange bananas over chocolate layer; pour marshmallow mix over bananas. Refrigerateseveral hrs. Garnish with additional banana slices and dollops of whipped cream, if you like. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Chicken Taco Patties - Rachael Ray
ingredients: 1 lb ground chicken 1 cup chopped onion, plus more onion, for serving 2 tablespoons jalapeno chiles, finely chopped canned 1 tablespoon chili powder 1 tablespoon grill seasoning 1 garlic clove, finely chopped 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese 4 whole wheat hamburger buns 1 romaine lettuce hearts, shredded 1 cup taco sauce
directions: In a medium bowl, combine the chicken, 1 cup onion, jalapenos, chili powder, grill seasoning and garlic. Form four patties. Heat the EVOO, 1 turn of the pan, in a skillet over medium heat. Add the patties and cook for 4 minutes on each side. When they're almost done, top each patty with a mound of cheese and cook until melted. Layer the bun bottoms with the lettuce, a chicken patty, taco sauce, extra onion and a bun top.

title: Chilies Rellenos
ingredients: 1 lb chorizo sausage 1 small onion 12 cup raisins 12 cup slivered almonds 1 teaspoon dried oregano (Mexican if you can find it) 1 cup salsa 6 large poblano chiles 12 cup flour 4 eggs, seperated vegetable oil
directions: In a large fry pan combine first 6 ingredients and cook until chorizo is cooked. Remove from heat. Cut chilies open lengthwise and remove seeds. Fill chilies equally and roll in flour. Heat the oil over medium high heat. Whip the whites to medium peaks and fold in yolks. Dip the chilies into the batter-holding the stems and gently slide into the hot oil-cook 3 at a time-turning so that they are golden brown on all sides. Repeat. Serve with fresh salsa.

title: Rice Pie
ingredients: 5 large eggs 1/2 lb. Ricotta cheese 1/2 c. rice (1 1/2 c. cooked) 1/2 c. sugar 1/2 pt. light cream 1/2 tsp. vanilla 1/2 can crushed, drained pineapple
directions: Beat all together, then add rice. Line a 10-inch deep-dish pan with a thin crust or spray with cooking spray. Pour in filling and bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until center is set.

title: Herbed Potato Soup
ingredients: 8 medium potatoes, peeled 2 Tbsp. dry onions 4 Tbsp. butter 2 Tbsp. chopped parsley 1/2 tsp. crushed basil 4 Tbsp. flour 2 tsp. salt 1/2 tsp. pepper 2 c. cold milk 4 c. scalded milk 2 c. hot potato water
directions: Cook potatoes and onions together until tender. Drain; save potato water. Put potatoes through coarse strainer. While potatoes cook, melt butter in 6-quart saucepan. Add parsley and basil. Blend flour, salt and pepper in, gradually add the cold milk. Add scalded milk and potato water. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens slightly. Stir in potatoes and onions. Serve with chopped parsley and dust with paprika. Makes 12 cups. This soup freezes successfully.

title: Sweet Freezer Pickles
ingredients: 4 c. sliced cucumbers 1 sliced green pepper 1 c. chopped onion 1 tsp. celery seed 1 c. white vinegar 2 c. sugar 1 tsp. salt
directions: Mix sugar, vinegar, salt and celery seed. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Add veggies. Put in container; set in refrigerator overnight. Now put in small containers and freeze.

title: Peanut Butter Icing
ingredients: 6 tbsp peanut butter 4 1/2 to 4 3/4 cups of powdered sugar 1/4 cup milk 1 1/2 tsp vanilla
directions: Mix all ingredients together and mix until spreadable consistency.

title: Meat Loaf
ingredients: 2 lb. ground chuck 1 medium chopped bell pepper 1 medium chopped onion 2 ribs chopped celery 1 can tomatoes 1 small can tomato sauce 3 eggs 1 strip saltine crackers garlic to taste salt and pepper to taste
directions: Saute pepper, onion and celery in 1 tablespoon margarine. Add to ground chuck, tomatoes, tomato sauce and eggs. Mix altogether well. Add crumbled crackers. To make ingredients, stick together. Add garlic, salt and pepper. Add catsup to top and I add about 1/2 cup water poured over.

title: Calfs Liver with Balsamic Vinegar
ingredients: 2 pounds calfs liver 1 pound white onions 1 tablespoon sugar 4 bay leaves 3 tablespoons olive oil 1/2 teaspoon salt Freshly ground pepper to taste 1 teaspoon flour 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar 1 tablespoon white wine 5 tablespoon vegetable oil
directions: Trim the liver of its outer covering, blood vessels, and any blemishes. Pat dry, cut in julienne strips (2 x 1/2 x 1/2), and set aside. Slice the onions thin, working with the grain. In a nonreactive skillet, melt the sugar until it caramelizes, add the onions and bay leaves, and mix well. Add 3 tablespoons of olive oil, the salt and pepper, and saute over moderately high heat until the onions are golden brown but not limp. Stir in the flour, blending well, add the vinegar and wine, and simmer about 2 minutes, until the sauce thickens. Meanwhile, in a skillet large enough to hold the strips of liver in a single layer (use two pans if necessary), heat the vegetable oil, add the liver, and saute, stirring occasionally, about 2 minutes. With a slotted spoon, drain the liver and transfer it to the sauce, tossing gently until well coated, about 1 minute. The sauce should be quite adhesive, not runny. Serve immediately with boiled or fried polenta.

title: Chocolate Donut Holes
ingredients: FOR THE DONUT HOLES: 2-1/2 cups All-purpose Flour 1 cup Unsweetened Cocoa Powder 2 teaspoons Baking Powder 1/2 teaspoons Baking Soda 1/4 teaspoons Salt 3/4 cups Low-fat Buttermilk 2 whole Large Eggs 1 cup Granulated Sugar 1/4 cups Unsalted Butter, melted 2 teaspoons Vanilla Extract Vegetable Oil, For Frying FOR THE GLAZE: 2-1/2 cups Powdered Sugar 1/4 teaspoons Vanilla Extract 4 Tablespoons Milk
directions: In a large bowl, sift together flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, soda and salt. In a smaller bowl, whisk together buttermilk, eggs, sugar, melted butter and vanilla extract. Add the wet ingredients to the flour mixture, stirring with a large spoon until a dough forms. Line a baking sheet with wax or parchment paper, and roll dough into balls just slightly smaller than golfball size. Add vegetable oil to a large pot and heat over medium heat. Once it reaches 350°F, add 2-3 donut holes at a time, frying for 2-3 minutes. I tossed mine a few times during the frying process, just using a slotted spoon to continually flip them over. One finished, remove with a slotted spoon and let drain on a paper towel. Once all the donut holes have been fried, dip in the glaze them set on wire rack. Allow to set for 10-15 minutes for simple glazed donuts. If you want sprinkled donuts, immediately roll in sprinkles after glazing and let sit until set. This recipe makes about 3 dozen. For the glaze: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and whisk well. If too runny, add more powdered sugar. If too thick, add more water about 1/2 teaspoon at a time, whisking well for at least 30-60 seconds. Recipe slightly adapted from Martha Stewart.

title: Apple Cobbler
ingredients: 7 to 8 McIntosh apples 1 1/2 Tbsp. sugar 1 tsp. cinnamon dash of nutmeg 2 tsp. lemon juice 1 1/2 sticks margarine 1 c. sugar 1 egg 1 c. sifted flour 1/2 c. walnuts, broken up 1/2 c. raisins
directions: Peel and cut apples into pieces. Place in 9-inch ungreased pie plate. Sprinkle with sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg and lemon juice.

title: Lemon-Oregano Lamb Chops
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice 1 teaspoon extra-virgin olive oil 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano 1 garlic clove, minced 8 (4-ounce) lamb loin chops, trimmed 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper Cooking spray
directions: Combine lemon juice, olive oil, oregano, and garlic in a large zip-top plastic bag. Add lamb to bag, turning to coat. Seal and marinate at room temperature 15 minutes, turning occasionally. Heat a grill pan over medium-high heat. Remove lamb from marinade; discard marinade. Sprinkle lamb evenly with salt and pepper. Coat pan with cooking spray. Add lamb to pan, and cook for 3 minutes on each side or until desired degree of doneness. Orzo pilaf: Combine 2 cups cooked orzo, 1/4 cup crumbled feta cheese, 1/4 cup finely chopped red onion, 1/4 cup finely chopped carrot, 3 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley, 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar, 1 tablespoon extra-virgin olive oil, 1/4 teaspoon salt, and 1/8 teaspoon black pepper; toss well to coat.

title: Cowboy Beans
ingredients: 2/3 c. chopped celery 2/3 c. chopped green bell pepper 1/2 tsp. minced garlic 1 1/3 c white beans, cooked 1/3 c. barbecue sauce 1 tsp. hot pepper sauce 2/3 c. chopped onions 2 tsp. vegetable oil 1 1/3 c. pinto beans, cooked 1 1/3 c. rice, cooked 1/3 c. tomato sauce
directions: Saute celery, onion, pepper and garlic in oil until soft. Add beans, rice, barbecue sauce and pepper sauce; heat through, about 20 minutes.

title: Roasted Lamb Chops Stuffed with Black Olives and Goat Cheese
ingredients: 12 large-eye lamb chops, frenched Drizzle olive oil Creole seasoning 26 Greek or Nicoise olives, pitted and quartered 2 teaspoons minced shallots 1 teaspoon minced garlic 2 ounces goat cheese Salt Freshly ground black pepper 1/2 cup Dijon mustard 2 cups fine dried bread crumbs 1/4 cup olive oil 16 large fresh spinach leaves
directions: Preheat the grill. Make a 1-inch slit on the side of each chop. Season with olive oil and Creole seasoning. Place on the grill and cook for 2 minutes on each side. Remove and cool completely. In a mixing bowl, combine the olives, shallots, garlic and cheese. Season with salt and pepper. Mix well. Stuff the pocket of each lamb chop with about 1 tablespoon filling. In another mixing bowl, combine the bread crumbs and olive oil. Season with Creole seasoning and mix well. Smear each chop with the mustard. Dredge the chops in the seasoned bread crumbs, coating completely. Place on a parchment lined baking pan and place a preheated 375 degree oven. Roast for 8 to 10 minutes for medium-rare. Remove from the oven and let the chops rest for a couple of minutes before serving. Fry the spinach until crispy, about 30 seconds. Remove and drain on paper towels. Season with salt. Spoon the White Bean Ragout mixture in the center of each plate. Lay 3 of the chops in the center of each plate, crossing the bones. Garnish with the fried spinach leaves.

title: Creamy Asparagus Soup With Lobster
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped sweet onion 2 tablespoons butter, melted 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour 2 1/2 cups chicken broth 3 pounds fresh asparagus, cut into pieces 1 cup peeled and chopped potato 1 cup milk 1/2 cup whipping cream 1/2 teaspoon salt 3 cups (about 10 ounces) cooked and chopped lobster Toasted sliced almonds
directions: Cook onion in butter in a Dutch oven over medium heat 5 minutes or until onion is tender. Stir in flour; gradually add chicken broth, stirring constantly. Add asparagus and potato, and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat, and simmer 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Let cool slightly. Puree asparagus mixture in a blender or food processor in batches until smooth, scraping down sides, if necessary. Add milk, whipping cream, and salt, stirring well. Cook over medium heat just until thoroughly heated. Ladle soup into individual serving bowls. Top evenly with chopped lobster, and sprinkle with toasted almonds. Note: Substitute cooked crab or shrimp for the lobster, if desired.

title: Banana Nut Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. banana cake mix 1 small pkg. banana Jell-O pudding mix 3 ripe bananas, mashed 4 eggs 1 c. water 1/3 c. cooking oil 1 c. chopped pecans or walnuts
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Spray angel food pan with Pam or any cooking spray. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Beat 2 to 3 minutes until bananas are blended with cake mix. Pour into pan and bake for 50 to 60 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Serve plain or with ice cream. I like it best fresh from the oven with a cup of hot tea.

title: Lemon Poppy Seed Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. lemon cake mix 1 pkg. instant lemon pudding 4 eggs 1 c. water 1/2 c. oil 1/4 c. poppy seed
directions: Mix all ingredients except poppy seed until well blended. Stir in poppy seed. Bake in greased and floured Bundt pan for 35 to 40 minutes at 350°.

title: Banana Nut Cookies
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. flour 1 tsp. salt 1/2 tsp. nutmeg 1 tsp. cinnamon 1/2 tsp. salt 3/4 c. shortening 1 c. sugar 1 egg 1 c. mashed bananas 1 3/4 c. rolled oats 1 c. nuts
directions: Sift flour mixture together 3 times. Cream shortening, sugar and egg; mix well. Add mashed bananas. Add flour mixture, oats and nuts. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

title: Jam Cake
ingredients: 1/2 c. butter 1 1/2 c. blackberry jam, thick 1 tsp. baking soda 1 c. sugar 4 eggs, well beaten 1/4 c. sour milk 2 1/2 c. flour 1 tsp. cinnamon 1/2 tsp. allspice 1/2 tsp. nutmeg 3/4 tsp. salt
directions: Cream sugar and butter. Add eggs and jam. Beat thoroughly. Sift flour, measure and sift with baking soda, salt and spices. Add alternately with milk to first mixture, beat thoroughly. Pour into well-oiled pan. Bake at 375° about 45 minutes. Use brown sugar icing.

title: Picadillo Dip
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef 1/2 cup chopped onion 2 lbs Velveeta cheese 1 (10 ounce) can tomato and green chile mix 8 ounces mushrooms (chopped) 6 ounces black olives (chopped) 1/4 teaspoon cumin 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt and pepper
directions: In a skillet, brown meat and drain. Add onion and sautee until tender. In a casserole dish melt cheese, add tomato and chile mix. Add ground beef mixture, mushrooms, olives, and spices. Mix together and heat through. Serve with chips.

title: Coffee Punch
ingredients: 3 c. strong chilled coffee 1 qt. chocolate milk 1 pt. white milk 1 gal. vanilla ice milk or ice cream
directions: Mix coffee, chocolate milk and white milk together. Cut ice cream into small chunks and pour mixture over ice cream. Stir until desired consistency is reached. Serves 40 cups.

title: Mexican Cornbread
ingredients: 1 lb. hamburger, browned 3 chopped green onions 1 jalapeno pepper, cut fine 1/2 c. grated cheese 1 c. yellow cornmeal 2 eggs, beaten 1 c. milk 1/2 tsp. soda 1/2 tsp. salt 1/3 c. oil or bacon grease 1 c. creamed corn
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour in greased pan. Cook at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Yum Yum Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. yellow cake mix 1 large container Cool Whip (9 oz.) 1 small pkg. regular vanilla pudding (not instant) 1 c. milk at room temperature 8 oz. cream cheese 1 c. crushed walnuts 1 small can moist coconut 1 large can crushed pineapple
directions: Grease and flour pan. Bake cake 15 to 20 minutes. Use 1/2 sheet cake or 1-inch cookie sheet (deep). Cook cake completely and leave in pan. Prepare pudding with 1 cup milk. Cool completely. Soften cream cheese and add pudding. Add Cool Whip last. Sprinkle well with drained pineapple on top, then coconut and walnuts.

title: Stroganoff Casserole
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. unsalted butter 1 lb. ground chuck 8 oz. sliced fresh mushrooms 1 c. chopped onion 1 small clove garlic, minced 1/2 tsp. marjoram 1/4 tsp. thyme 1/2 c. tomato sauce 1/2 c. Ricotta cheese 4 oz. cream cheese, cut up 1 1/4 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. pepper 10 oz. pkg. frozen spinach, thawed and drained 6 oz. pkg. medium egg noodles, cooked al dente 1/2 c. grated Parmesan cheese
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Butter shallow 2.5-quart casserole and set aside. Melt butter in large heavy skillet over moderately high heat. Add beef, mushrooms, onions, garlic, marjoram and thyme. Cook, stirring and breaking up chunks of meat about 10 minutes. Reduce heat to low; add tomato sauce. Cook and stir 1 to 2 minutes. Add all remaining ingredients except noodles and cheese. Cook, stirring until cream cheese melts. Fold in noodles. Turn into casserole dish, spreading evenly and top with cheese. Bake, uncovered, until bubbly and tipped brown, about 20 minutes.

title: Sweet Corn Velouté With Chili Ciabatta Crisps
ingredients: 2 tbsp butter 4 ears sweet corn, kernels removed 1/2 None onion, chopped 1 stalk celery, chopped 1 large sprig thyme 2 None bay leaves 1 cup vegetable stock 2 cups milk 6 slices slightly stale ciabatta 1 tbsp olive oil 1/4 tsp chili flakes 1/2 tbsp cream
directions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Melt butter in medium saucepan over medium-high heat. Add the corn, onion, celery and thyme to the pan and cook for 8 mins, until softened. Add the bay leaves, stock and milk and season to taste. Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to medium-low and cook gently for 10 mins. Meanwhile, place the ciabatta on a parchment paper-lined baking sheet. Drizzle with the olive oil, sprinkle with chili flakes and season to taste. Bake for 8-10 mins, until crisp and golden. Remove the bay leaves and thyme. Pour soup and cream into a blender and puree until very smooth. Pour through a fine sieve into a clean saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a simmer, then remove from heat. Ladle into bowls, sprinkle with pepper and serve with the chili ciabatta crisps.

title: Grilled Pork Loin With Rosemary-Breadcrumb Crust
ingredients: 2 (3-pound) pork loins 2 teaspoons salt 1 teaspoon pepper 1/4 cup coarse-grained Dijon mustard 1/2 cup olive oil 2 cups soft breadcrumbs 5 tablespoons finely chopped fresh rosemary 1/4 cup chopped garlic Garnishes: sliced fresh pears, fresh rosemary sprigs
directions: Sprinkle pork loins evenly with salt and pepper. Stir together mustard and 1/4 cup oil; spread evenly over pork. Stir together remaining oil and next 3 ingredients. Light one side of a grill, heating to medium-high heat (350° to 400°); leave other side unlit. Place pork over lit side, and grill, covered with grill lid, 8 minutes on each side or until browned. Remove pork from grill. Press breadcrumb mixture evenly over the top of each pork loin. Grill over unlit side of grill, covered with grill lid, 35 to 40 minutes or until a meat thermometer inserted in thickest portion registers 155°. Let stand 10 minutes before slicing. Garnish, if desired.

title: Dark Chocolate Frosting
ingredients: 14 ounces bittersweet chocolate 1 1/2 cups whipping cream
directions: Roughly chop the chocolate and put into a food processor. Pulse briefly to chop fine. Heat the cream in a saucepan just to the boiling point. With the motor running, pour the hot cream into the chocolate and process until they are completely melted/blended. Transfer the frosting to a bowl. If you plan to use it immediately, chill the frosting by placing it over a bowl of ice or let it cool at room temperature. It must be cool, not cold, to be spreadable. Once cooled, the frosting can be whipped to create a lighter frosting variation or used as is. Refrigerate the cake after applying the frosting. Makes enough to frost a 2 layer cake, about 2-1/2 cups.

title: No Name Spread
ingredients: 1 pkg. frozen chopped spinach, well drained 1 c. mayonnaise 1 small can chopped Ortega green chilies, drained 1 small jar marinated artichokes, drained and chopped 1/2 c. grated Parmesan cheese
directions: Reserve 2 tablespoons cheese to top with. Place into small baking dish. Top with 2 tablespoons cheese and sprinkle with paprika. Cover and put in refrigerator until ready to use. Bake at 250° for 30 minutes. Serve with crackers.

title: Strawberry Lemonade Cupcakes
ingredients: 1 box Strawberry Cake Mix (18 Ounce Box) 1 box Lemon Cake Mix (18 Ounce Box) 6 whole Eggs, Divided Use, For The Above Cake Mixes 2/3 cups Vegetable Or Olive Oil, Divided Use, For The Above Cake Mixes 4-1/2 cups Water, Divided Use, For The Above Cake Mixes 2 tubs Store Bought Strawberry Cake Frosting, 12 Ounce Tubs 1/4 cups Decorative Sprinkling Sugar Pink, Yellow, Or White 1/2 cups Dry Lemonade Mix 36 whole Fresh Strawberries
directions: - Prepare both cake mixes according to instructions on the box (each will require eggs, oil and water) and put them into separate Ziploc or piping bags. - Fill cupcake pan with cupcake papers and pipe both batters into each cup to create a mixed color cupcake - Make sure each paper cup is only 2/3 of the way full to prevent overflow when baked. - Bake according to box directions at 350 degrees for 18 to 25 minutes and allow baked cupcakes to cool completely. - Pipe strawberry frosting onto cupcakes. - Mix 1 part sprinkling sugar with 2 parts dry lemonade mix and sprinkle onto frosting. - Place washed and sliced or whole small fresh strawberries onto cupcakes and sprinkle again with sugar/lemonade mix and serve. Cupcakes can be refrigerated after preparation, and strawberries re-sprinkled with sugar and lemonade mixture just before serving Enjoy!

title: Garlic Cheese Grits
ingredients: 2 cups quick-cooking grits 1 cup butter 1 package kraft garlic cheese rolls 1 package kraft jalapeno jack cheese 1 teaspoon Worcestershire sauce 12 cup milk 2 eggs, beaten paprika
directions: Cook the grits according to the package directions. To the hot grits, add the butter, garlic cheese, jalapeno cheese, and Worcestershire sauce; stir until butter and cheese are melted and mixture is smooth. In a bowl, combine the milk and beaten eggs; stir mixture into the grits. Pour grits mixture into a lightly greased 13x9 inch baking pan. Sprinkle lightly with paprika. Bake at 350 for 25 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Bourbon Franks
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) bottle catsup 1 c. dark brown sugar 1 c. bourbon 4 (8 oz.) pkg. miniature cocktail franks or 2 lb. frankfurters, cut in small pieces
directions: Mix all ingredients in large saucepan, except frankfurters. Cover and simmer for at least 2 hours, stirring occasionally. Add franks; simmer about 5 minutes.

title: Homemade Peanut Butter
ingredients: 2-1/2 cups Dry, Unsalted Peanuts 4 Tablespoons Oil (vegetable, Peanut, Canola, Or I Use Coconut Oil) 2 Tablespoons Honey
directions: In a food processor, grind the peanuts fine. Add the oil and process again until very well blended. Add the honey and blend again.

title: Tropical Lemon Pie
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. vanilla wafer crumbs (about 35 cookies), crushed 1/3 c. margarine or butter, melted 1 c. lemonade 1/3 c. sugar 3 oz. pkg. lemon jello 3 oz. cream cheese, softened 8 oz. can crushed pineapple (with juice) 1/2 c. chopped nuts 1/2 c. flaked coconut 1/4 c. maraschino cherries, chopped 2 c. frozen whipped topping, thawed
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. In small bowl, combine vanilla wafer crumbs and margarine. Mix well. Press firmly onto bottom and sides of 9-inch pie plate. Bake at 350° for 5 minutes. Cool completely.

title: Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 (29 oz.) can sliced peaches, cut in half 1 (20 oz.) can pineapple chunks 1 can mandarin oranges 1 small jar maraschino cherries 2 c. reserved fruit juice 1/2 c. sugar 3 Tbsp. cornstarch 2 Tbsp. white syrup 4 Tbsp. apricot gelatin
directions: Drain fruit. Save juice from peaches and pineapple. Mix juice, sugar, cornstarch and white syrup. Boil until clear. Add gelatin to hot mixture. Cool and pour over fruit. Then add about 4 bananas, cut in fairly large pieces.

title: Tacos (Soft)
ingredients: 1 lb. ground meat 1 pkg. taco seasoning 3/4 c. water 1 pkg. corn tortilla Cheddar cheese lettuce tomatoes onion sour cream taco sauce
directions: Brown hamburger; drain fat. Add seasoning and water. Mix and simmer for 5 minutes. Heat 1/4 inch of oil in skillet. Fry tortillas for 2 seconds, then turn and fry 2 more seconds. Drain on paper towel. Top tortillas with:

title: New Year'S Champagne Cocktail: The Chic French 75 Recipe
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cold gin 1 tablespoon lemon juice 1 or 2 sugar cubes Champagne, chilled Lemon twists for garnish
directions: Pour the cold gin and lemon juice in a champagne flute. Top with cold champagne. Garnish with a lemon twist. As you serve the cocktail, drop a sugar cube to the bottom of the glass, and watch the cocktail come to life as it fizzes and pops.

title: Chocolate Pie *
ingredients: 2 c. sugar 2 tsp. flour 2 heaping Tbsp. cocoa dash of salt 2 c. milk 3 eggs
directions: Mix dry ingredients into milk. Pour into uncooked pie shell. Cook at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Martha Stewart'S Monkey Bread
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable shortening 1/4 cup warm water 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar 1 tablespoon yeast 3 1/2 cups warm milk 1 teaspoon salt 1 large egg 4 1/4 cups all-purpose flour 8 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted 3 1/2 cups firmly packed light-brown sugar 2 teaspoons ground cinnamon 1/2 cup pecans, coarsely chopped 1/4 cup milk 2 cups powdered sugar
directions: Lightly coat a 10-inch Bundt pan and a medium bowl with (extra) shortening and set aside. Place warm water and a pinch of sugar in small bowl. Sprinkle with yeast, stir and leave to dissolve 5 minutes. Place shortening, milk, sugar, salt and egg in another bowl. Add yeast mixture to shortening mixture and beat with electric mixture fitted with dough hook until combined. Slowly add flour, then knead with dough hook 1 minute. Transfer dough to greased bowl and leave to rise, covered with cling film, 20 minutes. For brown sugar coating, place melted butter in a bowl. In another bowl, combine sugar, cinnamon and nuts. Sprinkle Tbsp of this mixture into prepared Bundt pan. Cut dough into 1/2 inch pieces. Roll into balls. Coat dough balls in butter, then sugar mixture and place in prepared Bundt pan until all dough is used up. Cover with cling film and let rise in a warm place until doubled in size, about 1 hour. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. Bake 30-35 minutes. Leave to cool in pan 15 minutes, then invert onto serving plate and cool 20 minutes more. For icing, in a small bowl, combine milk and icing sugar and stir until smooth. Drizzle over bread, to serve.

title: French Breakfast Puffs
ingredients: 1/2 c. sugar 1/4 c. shortening 1 egg 1 1/2 c. sifted all-purpose flour 1 1/2 tsp. baking powder 1/2 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. nutmeg 1/2 c. sugar 1/2 c. milk 1 tsp. cinnamon 6 Tbsp. butter or margarine, melted
directions: In mixer bowl, cream together the first 1/2 cup sugar, shortening and the egg. Sift together the flour, baking powder, salt and nutmeg; add to creamed mixture alternately with milk, beating well after each addition. Fill a 12-cup greased muffin pan 2/3 full. Bake in a 350° oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Combine remaining sugar and cinnamon. Remove muffins from oven; immediately dip muffins in melted butter or margarine, then in cinnamon-sugar mixture until coated. Serve warm. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Grilled Pastrami, Swiss, And Sweet Onion Marmalade On Rye
ingredients: Onion Marmalade 1 tablespoon butter 1 tablespoon vegetable oil 2 medium red onions, thinly sliced 1 large garlic clove, minced 1/2 cup sugar 1/2 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 1/2 cup red-wine vinegar 1/2 cup dry but fruity red wine, such as Zinfandel or Grenache Sandwiches 4 slices extra-sour rye or caraway rye bread 2 tablespoons softened unsalted butter 4 thin slices pastrami, uncured if available 4 ounces coarsely shredded Swiss cheese 2 tablespoons whole-grain mustard
directions: Make marmalade: Melt butter with oil in a large heavy frying pan over medium-high heat. Add onions, garlic, sugar, salt, and pepper, stirring well to combine. Reduce heat to medium and cook, stirring occasionally, until onions have softened and browned, about 20 minutes. Add vinegar and wine. Cook, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until most of the liquid has been absorbed and onions are soft and sticky, about 10 minutes. Let marmalade cool slightly. Make sandwiches: Evenly spread one side of each bread slice with 1/2 tbsp. butter. Spread unbuttered side of 2 slices with 1 1/2 tbsp. marmalade each, then top with pastrami and cheese. Spread mustard on unbuttered side of remaining 2 bread slices and place each, buttered side up, on pastrami- and cheese-topped slices. Heat a large nonstick frying pan over medium heat. Add sandwiches and cook, turning once, until golden brown on both sides and cheese is melted, about 5 minutes total. Make ahead: Marmalade keeps up to 2 weeks, covered and chilled. Note: Nutritional analysis is per sandwich.

title: Sesame Vinaigrette
ingredients: 12 lb granulated sugar 2 ounces sesame seeds 34 teaspoon paprika 34 teaspoon Worcestershire sauce 1 12 cups olive oil 1 cup rice vinegar
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a bowl (should look gritty). Wisk together the oil and vinegar. While stirring the dry ingredients slowly add the wet mixture. Stir quickly for 3 minutes to make sure sugar has dissolved.

title: Yeast Biscuits To Freeze
ingredients: 2 pkg. dry yeast 1/4 c. warm water 2 c. buttermilk 5 c. all-purpose flour 1/2 c. sugar 1 Tbsp. baking powder 1 tsp. soda 1 1/4 tsp. salt 1 c. shortening
directions: Combine yeast and warm water. Let stand 5 minutes or until bubbly. Add buttermilk to yeast mixture and set aside. Combine dry ingredients in a large bowl. Cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse meal. Add buttermilk mixture, mixing with a fork until dry ingredients are moistened. Turn dough out onto a floured surface and knead lightly 3 or 4 times. Roll dough to 1/2 inch thick and cut with a 2 3/4-inch biscuit cutter. Place on lightly greased baking sheets. Cover and let rise 1 hour. Bake at 450° for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes about 2 dozen.

title: Deer Ratatouille
ingredients: 1 lb ground deer meat 2 pints tomato sauce 1 zucchini 1 squash 1 teaspoon salt
directions: Brown deer meat in a large skillet. Pour 1/4 of sauce in a 9x13 casserole dish. Thinly slice the zucchini and squash. Alternate squash and zucchini slices in the dish. Add tomato sauce and salt to meat and pour over the squash and zucchini slices. Bake 30 minutes at 350 degrees.

title: Northwood'S Buttermilk Cake Or Rice-Paddy Bundt Cake
ingredients: 2/3 c. wild rice or 2 c. cooked wild rice 2 c. boiling water 2 c. whole wheat flour 1 c. all-purpose flour 2 tsp. baking soda 1/2 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. ground nutmeg 1 c. butter or margarine 1 c. packed brown sugar (light brown) 1 tsp. vanilla 5 eggs 1 c. buttermilk 1 recipe powdered sugar icing 1 c. sifted powdered sugar 1/4 tsp. vanilla about 1 1/2 Tbsp. milk
directions: Stir powdered sugar and vanilla together. Add enough milk or brandy to make of drizzling consistency.

title: Auntie Mickey'S Zucchini Fritters(Italian)
ingredients: 2 eggs 2 heaping c. flour 2 heaping tsp. baking powder 2 1/2 c. shredded, drained zucchini squash 1/4 c. sugar salt and pepper to taste
directions: Put everything in a large bowl and mix well with a fork. Put salad oil in a frying pan (I use a Teflon coated pan) to cover the bottom about 1/4-inch high. Heat until hot. Drop tablespoonful of mixture into pan; cook until brown and carefully turn and cook second side. Drain on brown paper bag or paper towels. These taste wonderful warm or cold. (I like them the second day cold from the refrigerator.) This is great at a picnic.

title: Fudge Frosting
ingredients: 5 Tbsp. butter 1 c. sugar 1/3 c. milk 6 oz. chocolate chips
directions: Put butter, sugar and milk on stove; boil 1 minute. Take off heat; add chocolate chips. Stir until thick. Spread on any cake, warm or cool.

title: Cruschickies
ingredients: 3 eggs 3 tablespoons white sugar 1/2 cup sour cream 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 2 tablespoons rum 1/4 teaspoon salt 3 1/3 cups all-purpose flour 4 cups vegetable oil for frying 1/2 cup confectioners' sugar
directions: Beat together the eggs and sugar. Blend in sour cream, vanilla and rum or brandy. Fold in sifted flour and salt. Knead dough on floured surface until the dough is smooth. Cut off a small portion of dough and roll out as thin as possible (almost paper thin). The dough will spring back as you roll it if you treat it like a pie crust. Cut into 2-inch wide strips. Cut the strips diagonally every 4 inches. In the middle of each cookie cut a one inch slit. Pull one of the pointier corners through the slit. If you are making these alone, it is suggested that you do all of the rolling and cutting all the dough before frying, or in two batches. If two people are making the cookies, the roller/cutter should get a "stockpile" before frying begins. Heat oil to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). An electric skillet works well, especially if you are working alone. Slide about seven or eight cookies into the oil. They should pop up to the top of the oil after a second. Very soon, the cookies should be a light brown (or very dark tan) on the bottom. Flip the cookies; a two-tined carving fork works well. When the second side is browned, remove from the oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. When the paper towel is filled with cookies, shake confectioner's sugar over the cookies and move the cookies, paper towels and all, to a cookie sheet.

title: Crab Dip
ingredients: 1 can mushroom soup 8 oz. cream cheese 1 can crab meat 2 green onions 2 stalks celery red pepper to taste 1 Tbsp. unflavored gelatin 1 can shrimp meat 3 Tbsp. cold water 1 c. mayo
directions: Heat soup and cream cheese until soup is dissolved. Soften gelatin in cold water. Add the gelatin mix and other ingredients to cheese mixture. Refrigerate until hard.

title: Mexican Dip
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese, softened (room temperature) 1 can chili (Hormel-type) 1 small can green chili peppers 1 pkg. (8 oz.) Monterey Jack cheese 3 or 4 chopped scallions small can sliced black olives bag of taco chips
directions: Spread ingredients in order given so that you start with cream cheese on the bottom of glass Pyrex dish. Microwave on High for 5 minutes, until bubbly. Enjoy!

title: Dried Apple Cake
ingredients: 1 c. dried apples 1 c. dark syrup 1 egg 3/4 c. sour cream 1 c. sugar 1 3/4 c. all-purpose flour 1 tsp. baking soda 1 tsp. cinnamon 1/2 tsp. cloves 1/2 tsp. salt
directions: Soak dried apples overnight. In the morning, chop in small pieces and cook slowly in the syrup for 45 minutes. While apples cool, pour sour cream into a bowl. Add egg and beat thoroughly. Add sugar and continue to beat. Sift flour; measure and add salt, soda and cloves. Sift again. Add sifted dry ingredients to mixture. Beat thoroughly and then add apples. Blend together. Pour into a 5 x 9 x 4-inch greased loaf pan. Bake at 325° for 1 hour. Yield: 1 loaf.

title: Grilled Corn on the Cob with Chile and Lime
ingredients: 6 tablespoons crema mexicana, creme fraiche, or sour cream 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice 1/4 teaspoon chipotle chile powder or ancho chile powder** 1/4 teaspoon coarse kosher salt 8 ears of corn with husks 2 limes, halved or quartered 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro *Crema mexicana (Mexican creme fraiche) is available at some supermarkets and in the refrigerated section of Latin markets. Creme fraiche is sold at some supermarkets and at specialty foods stores. **Chipotle and ancho chile powders are available in the spice section of many supermarkets and from adrianascaravan.com.
directions: Mix crema mexicana, fresh lime juice, chile powder, and coarse kosher salt in small bowl to blend. DO AHEAD Can be made 6 hours ahead. Cover and chill. Prepare barbecue (medium heat). Remove outer husks from corn, leaving inner pale green husks attached. Fold back inner husks; remove corn silk. Sprinkle corn with salt and pepper. Rewrap inner husks around corn. Grill corn until husks are charred and beginning to pull away and corn is tender, turning frequently, about 10 minutes. Grill lime quarters until lightly charred, about 5 minutes. Pull husks away from corn to expose kernels. Place corn and lime on platter. Brush corn with crema-lime mixture. Sprinkle with cilantro.

title: Pear And Goats' Cheese Bruschetta
ingredients: pear, chopped into wedges knob butter 30g/11/4oz brown sugar sprig fresh rosemary 50g/13/4oz asparagus 50g/13/4oz goats' cheese, sliced 2 slices white bread 1 tbsp olive oil 1 shallot
directions: 1. Heat the butter in a frying pan. Saute the pears with the brown sugar and rosemary for 2-3 minutes. 2. Add the asparagus and cook for two additional minutes. 3. Preheat the grill to medium. Lay the goats' cheese on a piece of foil and grill for three minutes or until golden. 4. In a separate frying pan, fry the bread in the oil until crisp and golden on each side. 5. Place the bread with the pears and asparagus on top. Finish with the goats' cheese. 6. Serve warm.

title: Caesar Salad
ingredients: 1 egg 8 cups torn romaine lettuce leaves 3 tablespoons lemon juice 3 cloves garlic,minced 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard 1/3 cup olive oil 1/3 cup Parmesan cheese, freshly grated 1 cup croutons 6 pieces anchovy fillets, drained & mashed
directions: Place egg on a spoon and lower it into a small pan of boiling water.Immediately remove pan from heat;let egg stand in water 1 min. Remove egg and place in cold water.Place lettuce in a large bowl.In a med bowl,mix lemon juice,garlic and mustard,using a whisk or fork,gradually beat in oil.Mix in anchovies.grind pepper over lettuce add dressing to greens and mix gently.Break in prepared egg and mix well.Sprinkle with cheese and croutons and mix again.Serve at once.

title: Magic Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef 1/4 c. oats (uncooked) 1/4 c. onion, chopped 1/4 tsp. pepper 1 can Ro-Tel tomatoes 1 egg, beaten 1 1/2 tsp. salt
directions: Combine all ingredients; mix well. Press firmly into ungreased 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan. Bake in preheated 350° oven about an hour. Let stand 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Tot'S Rolls
ingredients: 4 Tbsp. yeast plus 2 Tbsp. sugar, dissolved in 2 c. lukewarm water 4 eggs, beaten 2 c. shortening, dissolved in 2 c. boiling water 2 c. sugar 2 tsp. salt 12 c. plain flour
directions: Stir sugar and salt into first 3 ingredients. Add eggs and stir. Add yeast. Add flour and mix thoroughly. Cover with foil and set aside in warm place for 2 hours. Dough should be double in size within 2 hours. Punch down. Roll to 1/4-inch thickness and cut rolls. Dip 1/2 of each roll in melted oleo and fold over like envelope. Place on baking sheets. Let rise 2 hours. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes. Brush with melted oleo. Takes 3 sticks of oleo. Rolls can be frozen. Remove from freezer and wrap in foil and heat.

title: Tuna Pate
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened 2 Tbsp. chili sauce 2 Tbsp. snipped parsley 1 tsp. instant minced onion 1/2 tsp. hot pepper sauce 2 cans tuna, drained
directions: Blend all ingredients together. Place in mold and refrigerate for 3 hours. Serve with crackers.

title: ** Cucumber Sandwiches Everyone Loves **
ingredients: 2 loaves of soft white bread 4 cucumbers 12 cup chives 12 cup dill 2 bricks of softened cream cheese 14 cup mayonnaise salt & pepper
directions: Peel cucumbers & remove the seeds (the easiest way is cut them in half lengthwise and scoop with a spoon.) chop cukes into very small pieces put aside. Combine cream cheese, mayo & all spices in a large bowl & mix well. You can do this by hand or a mixer. It's ok to have lumps. it won't matter. Add chopped cucumber into the mixture. Cut crust off of bread and carefully put into large zip shut baggies to keep from drying out. You can also use seasonal cookie cutters for a cute touch. YOU WILL GET MORE FLAVOR IF YOU MAKE THIS THE NIGHT BEFORE, TO LET ALL INGREDIENTS SET. But it is still delicious made the day of. Serve the bread separate from spread and have your company make their own little sandwiches. Because nobody wants mushy ones :) ** You may also slice the cucumbers very thin & spread the mix right onto the bread moments before serving. (but the other way is a LOT easier and tastes the same. ).

title: Lemon-Maple Icebox Cake
ingredients: 2 1/4 cup nonfat plain Greek yogurt 1 tablespoon maple syrup 1/2 teaspoon lemon peel, plus more for garnish 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract 1/8 teaspoon no-calorie sweetener 6 full sheet low-fat whole-grain graham crackers, broken into halves
directions: 1. Line 8 1/2" by 4 1/2" loaf pan with plastic wrap, leaving overhang on two long sides. 2. In bowl, stir yogurt, syrup, lemon peel, vanilla, and sweetener to blend. 3. Line bottom of loaf pan with 3 graham cracker halves. Spread one-third of yogurt mixture over crackers. Repeat layering twice. Top with remaining 3 crackers. 4. Using plastic overhang, wrap cake. Refrigerate at least 2 hrs. or up to 4 hrs. Unwrap; using overhang, pull cake out of pan. With serrated knife, gently cut into 6 slices to serve. Garnish with lemon peel.

title: Baked Chicken Fingers
ingredients: 8 strips Chicken (you Can Used Halved Chicken Breast) 2 Tablespoons Vegetable Oil 1 cup Bread Crumbs 2 Tablespoons Grated Parmesan Cheese 1 teaspoon Crumbled Dried Oregano 1 teaspoon Chipotle Chili Powder 1/2 teaspoons Salt 1/4 teaspoons Black Pepper
directions: 1. Start by preheating the oven to 400 degrees F. If youre not using a non-stick baking sheet, spray your pan with a non-stick vegetable spray. 2. Cut each of the chicken breasts into long strips, creating fingers. 3. Place chicken in a bowl and add oil and coat breasts thoroughly. 4. In a separate bowl, stir together bread crumbs, Parmesan, oregano, chili powder, salt and pepper. 5. Add bread crumb mixture to chicken and mix to coat thoroughly. Dont be afraid to use your hands. If you want to be cleaner, transfer chicken and bread mixture to a Ziploc bag and shake to coat thoroughly. Arrange on your baking sheet. 6. Bake for 10 minutes, turn each finger over and bake for an additional 5 to 10 minutes. Cook until they are nicely browned and cooked through. Feel free to use the broiler for a few minutes to get an extra crisp on the top! Serve with dipping sauce of your choice (I prefer honey-honey mustard) and enjoy!

title: Chili Pork Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil 1 1/3 pounds pork thinly sliced 1 onion peeled and cut into wedges 1 carrot peeled, halved lengthways, thinly sliced diagonally 2 stalks celery sliced 3 1/2 ounces green beans trimmed, cut in half diagonally 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce 2 tablespoons fish sauce 1 lime juiced 2 teaspoons brown sugar 1/2 cup peanuts crushed 1/3 cup cilantro chopped, plus extra to serve cooked rice to serve
directions: Heat half of the oil in a wok or large frying pan over a medium heat. Stir-fry the pork, in batches, for 1-2 mins, until browned. Transfer to a bowl. Add the remaining oil to the wok and heat. Stir-fry the onion, carrot and celery for 2-3 mins, until softened. Add the pork and beans and stir-fry for 2-3 mins, until the beans are just tender. Whisk together the sweet chili sauce, fish sauce, lime juice and sugar. Add to the wok and stir-fry for 1-2 mins, until heated through. Remove from the heat. Add the peanuts and cilantro and toss to combine. Serve with rice and extra cilantro, if desired.

title: Chess Pie
ingredients: 1 c. sugar 1/2 c. brown sugar 2 tsp. flour 2 tsp. corn meal 1 Tbsp. vinegar 1/4 c. milk 1/4 c. margarine 2 eggs 1 Tbsp. vanilla
directions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour in unbaked pie shell and bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

title: Rosemary Lemonade
ingredients: 1 cup sugar 6 sprigs fresh rosemary 2 cups fresh lemon juice, from about 8 lemons
directions: In a small saucepan, combine 1 cup water and sugar. Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally to dissolve sugar. Remove from heat and add rosemary. Cover saucepan and let cool, about 2 hours. Strain syrup into a pitcher. Stir in lemon juice and 3 cups cold water. Serve lemonade over ice.

title: Sweet Potato Cheesecake Recipe
ingredients: 6 to 7 (1/4-inch) slices Cream Cheese Poundcake (recipe follows) 2 cups (about 1 pound) sweet potatoes, mashed 3 (8-ounce) packages cream cheese 1 1/2 cups sugar 3 large eggs 1 cup half and half 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 1 teaspoon fresh ground nutmeg Fresh berries 1 1/2 cups (3 sticks) butter 1 (8-ounce) package cream cheese 3 cups sugar 6 eggs 2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract 2 teaspoons pure lemon extract 3 cups unbleached flour, sifted
directions: Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan. Using a mixer, cream together the butter, cream cheese and sugar until the mixture is light and fluffy. Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. Stir in the lemon and vanilla extracts. With the mixer set to low speed, gradually add the sifted flour until the mixture is smooth. Beat until just combined. Pour the batter into the prepared pan. Place the pan in a cold oven and bake at 325°F for 1 1/2 hours, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Remove from the oven and allow the cake to cool in the pan for 10 minutes before turning out onto a wire rack. Cool completely before serving. Boil the sweet potatoes for 40 to 50 minutes, or until tender. Drain the potatoes, and run them under cold water to remove the skin. Mash the sweet potatoes in a bowl, set aside and allow them to cool completely. Preheat the oven to 350°F. Line the bottom of a 9-inch round cake pan with parchment and spray the sides with nonstick spray. Place the 1/4-inch slices of the Cream Cheese Poundcake in the bottom of the pan. Beat the cream cheese until fluffy, gradually adding the sugar until it is well blended. Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. Stir in the mashed sweet potatoes. Add the half and half, vanilla and nutmeg and mix well. Pour the mixture into the prepared pan and bake for 1 hour or until the center is almost set. Remove from the oven and allow the cheesecake to cool. When the cake is cool, run a knife along the edges and remove it from the pan by inverting it onto a plate. Then transfer the cheesecake to a serving platter, crust-side down, and refrigerate until ready to serve. Garnish with fresh berries.

title: Strawberry Pecan Cake
ingredients: 1 box yellow or white cake mix 1 (3 oz.) box strawberry jello 2/3 c. Wesson oil 1/2 c. milk 4 eggs 1 c. strawberries 1/2 c. coconut 1/2 c. chopped nuts
directions: Mix together cake mix, jello, oil and milk. Add eggs and strawberries and beat really good. Stir in coconut and floured nuts. Makes a 3 layer cake. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Diabetic Pumpkin Pie
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can pumpkin 1 egg 1/2 c. Bisquick mix 11 to 12 packs sugar substitute (Sweet 'N Low) 13 oz. can evaporated milk (skim) 2 Tbsp. pumpkin pie spice (or 1/2 tsp. ginger, 1/8 tsp. cloves, 1 1/2 tsp. cinnamon)
directions: Spray 9-inch pie pan with Pam. Place all ingredients in blender, food processor or mixing bowl. Blend 1 minute; pour into sprayed pan and bake approximately 50 minutes until center puffs out and knife comes out clean.

title: Mary Eckley'S Jellied Cranberry Mold
ingredients: 2 large navel oranges 4 c. (1 lb.) fresh cranberries 1 c. sugar 1 envelope unflavored gelatin 1/2 c. orange juice
directions: Peel oranges; reserve 1/4 of the peel. Remove white membrane and seeds, then chop the oranges coarsely. Wash cranberries; drain. Remove stems. Put cranberries through coarse blade of food chopper. Chop orange peel; it should measure about 3 tablespoons. Add cranberries. Add oranges and sugar; mix well and set aside. Sprinkle gelatin over orange juice in small saucepan to soften. Place over low heat, stirring, until gelatin is dissolved. Add gelatin mixture to cranberry-orange mixture; mix well. Turn into a 1-quart mold. Refrigerate until firm, 6 to 8 hours.

title: Turkey Casserole
ingredients: 2 c. turkey, cooked 1 can cream of chicken (or mushroom) soup 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli 3/4 c. mayonnaise 1 tsp. lemon juice 3/4 c. sharp Cheddar cheese, shredded 1 c. bread crumbs
directions: Mix all ingredients together. Top with additional shredded cheese, if desired. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. A great way to use leftover turkey.

title: 2smile Breakfast hash
ingredients: 1 medium potato 1 cup uncooked breakfast sausage 1 cup cut up peppers/onions 1/2 tbsp chilli powder 1 salt/pepper to taste 1 tbsp garlic salt
directions: cook sausage in medium size pan, make sure you stir it to brake it apart while is cooking. while that's cooking wash, cut up potato and peppers/onions into tiny bite size pieces. after a few minutes of cooking sausage add potatos and seasonings..stir..cover and cook for about 5 minutes..or untill the potatos are to your liking. add peppers onions..mix well..cover remove from heat..keep cover untill ready to serve. I made it a breakfastbowl, added eggs and cheese on top..yum..enjoy!

title: Mashed Potatoes with Leeks and Garlic
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups finely chopped white and pale green part of leek, washed well and drained 3/4 stick (6 tablespoons) unsalted butter 3 pounds russet (baking) potatoes (about 6 large) 6 garlic cloves, unpeeled 1/2 cup of milk
directions: In a large heavy skillet cook the leeks and 4 tablespoons of the butter, covered, over moderate heat, stirring occasionally, for 8 to 10 minutes, or until they are very tender, and keep them warm. In a kettle combine the potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces, the garlic, and enough water to cover the potatoes by 1 inch, bring the water to a boil, and simmer the potatoes for 10 to 15 minutes, or until they are tender. Drain the potatoes and garlic in a large colander, return the potatoes to the kettle, reserving the garlic, and cook them over moderate heat, shaking the kettle, for 30 seconds to let any excess liquid evaporate. Peel the reserved garlic, force the garlic and the potatoes through a ricer or the medium disk of a food mill into a bowl, and stir in the remaining 2 tablespoons butter, the leeks, the milk, and the salt and pepper to taste.

title: Spanish Rice
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef 2 large diced onions 1 large diced celery stalk 1/2 diced green pepper 2 slices small diced bacon 3 Tbsp. Mazola oil salt and pepper to taste
directions: Cook all together until onions are glossy. Lower fire. Add 1 can tomato paste and 2 cans water. Simmer about 5 minutes. Fold into cooked rice (1 cup when raw). Pack into casserole dish and add 1 can tomato soup diluted with 1/2 can water. Mix and bake 1/2 hour at 350°.

title: Corn Fritters
ingredients: 1 1/3 c. sifted flour 1 1/2 tsp. baking powder 2/3 c. milk 3/4 tsp. salt 1 egg, well beaten 1 1/2 c. drained whole kernel corn
directions: Sift together flour, baking powder and salt. Blend milk and egg. Add dry ingredients. Drop by spoonfuls into deep fryer. Sprinkle with powdered sugar, if you want. Serve with maple syrup.

title: Whipping Cream Pound Cake
ingredients: 1/2 lb. butter (may use unsweetened) 3 c. sugar 3 c. cake flour 1/2 pt. whipping cream 6 eggs 2 tsp. vanilla
directions: May use 1 teaspoon lemon if desired.

title: Cajun-Style Broiled Shrimp
ingredients: 1 garlic clove 1 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon cayenne 1 teaspoon paprika 1 tablespoon lemon juice 2 tablespoons olive oil lots of black pepper 1/2 pounds peeled shrimp Lemon wedges
directions: Turn on the broiler, and put the rack close to heat. Mash 1 garlic clove with 1 teaspoon salt until it forms a paste. Add to it 1/2 teaspoon cayenne, 1 teaspoon paprika, 1 tablespoon lemon juice, 2 tablespoons olive oil and lots of black pepper. Rub paste all over1 1/2 pounds peeled shrimp. Broil, 2 to 3 minutes per side.

title: Peanut Blossom Cookies
ingredients: 1 3/4 c. flour 1 tsp. soda 1/2 tsp. salt 1/2 c. white sugar 1/2 c. brown sugar, packed 1/2 c. shortening 1/2 c. peanut butter 1 egg 2 Tbsp. milk 1 tsp. vanilla 48 chocolate Kisses
directions: Combine all ingredients except Kisses in large mixing bowl. Mix on lowest speed of mixer until dough forms. Shape dough into balls, using a rounded teaspoon for each. Roll balls in sugar. Bake at 375° on ungreased cookie sheet. Top each cookie immediately with candy Kiss; press down firmly so cookie cracks around edge.

title: Corned Beef Casserole
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) can corned beef 1 pkg. medium or wide noodles, cooked 1 can cream of mushroom soup 1 can cream of chicken soup 1 soup can milk 1 lb. grated Cheddar cheese 2 Tbsp. grated onion potato chips
directions: Break up corned beef, mix with noodles, soups, milk, onion and about 1/3 of the grated cheese. Pour into a buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Crush potato chips and sprinkle over the top, along with remaining cheese. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Captain's Table Rolled Roast Recipe
ingredients: 5 lb Rolled roast 1/2 c. Extra virgin olive oil 1/4 c. Lime juice 1/4 c. Dijon mustard 1/2 c. Chablis 1 Tbsp. Minced fresh tarragon 1 Tbsp. Minced fresh dill 1 tsp Cumin 1 Tbsp. Fresh grnd black pepper 6 x Garlic cloves* 2 Tbsp. Extra virgin olive oil 1/3 c. Lite soy sauce 3/4 c. Honey 1 Tbsp. Fresh ginger, grated 1 lrg garlic clove, chopped 2 Tbsp. Lemon juice 3/4 Tbsp. Crushed Thai chili peppers
directions: *Sliver the garlic cloves into 20-25 pcs. MARINADE: Combine first eight ingredients in a mixing bowl, stir well and pour into a durable plastic bag. With the tip of a sharp knife, penetrate the outer skin of the roast and insert the slivered garlic cloves. Add in beef to the bag, seal and turn to thoroughly coat. Let stand a minimum of 1 1/2 hrs, turning several times. THE GLAZE: Add in honey to sauce pan, heat gently. Add in all remaining glaze ingredients, stir frequently. Don't BRING TO A BOIL! Remove from heat. PREPARATION: Preheat grill to minimum 325 degrees. Remove beef from marinade, reserve for future use. Set beef on rack. Insert meat thermometer so which probe is in the center of the meat. Cover with tinfoil tent and place on grill or possibly spit. For rare meat, roast for 33 min per lb. or possibly up to an internal temperature of 140 degrees F. for rare meat, 160 degrees for medium. GLAZE after 30 min. Remove foil for last 1/2 hour. Remove from grill and let stand for fifteen min before slicing thinly. Remaining glaze can be re-heated and used as a sauce. Garnish with greens and serve with asparagus and new small potatoes.

title: Weight Watcher Pudding Jello Fruit Fluff (Ww)
ingredients: 16 ounces fat-free cool whip, thawed 1 (1 ounce) package fat-free sugar-free instant vanilla pudding mix 1 (1/3 ounce) package sugar-free raspberry gelatin 1 (20 ounce) can no-sugar-added pineapple (no sugar added) 1 (16 ounce) can no-sugar-added fruit cocktail (no sugar added) 1 (16 ounce) can no-sugar-added mandarin oranges (no sugar)
directions: drain all fruit. mix jello and pudding into thawed cool whip. gently fold drained fruit into cool whip mixture. chill.

title: Garlic Roasted Chicken
ingredients: 1 whole chicken fryer, 3 to 4 lb., split into 2 halves 12 garlic cloves crushed or 12 tsp. crushed garlic 2 Tbsp. butter or margarine, softened 1/2 tsp. grated lemon peel 1/4 tsp. dry thyme leaves 1/8 tsp. dry Italian seasoning 1/8 tsp. oregano leaves
directions: Carefully work fingers under skin of chicken around breast and legs. Combine with butter, lemon peel, thyme, oregano and Italian seasonings. Lightly season chicken all over with salt and pepper. Spread garlic butter under skin. Broil chicken for 50 to 55 minutes. Place chicken in oven at level below top rung. Take care not to burn by putting aluminium foil on top for second 20 minutes. Set aside 2 teaspoons garlic butter. Add a teaspoon water and use for basting.

title: Cumin and Chili Lamb Burgers
ingredients: 1 pound ground lamb meat 2 tablespoons ground cumin 2 tablespoons ground chili powder 1 tablespoon minced garlic Salt and pepper Southwest seasoning 4 slices Jalapeno Monterey Jack cheese 1/2 cup roasted garlic aioli 1 cup roasted corn and roasted pepper salsa 4 beer bread buns 2 cups shoestring potatoes
directions: Preheat the fryer. Preheat the grill. In a mixing bowl, combine the ground lamb with the cumin, chili powder, and garlic. Mix until thoroughly incorporated. Season with Southwest seasoning. Form into 4-ounce patties. Place on the grill and cook for 3 to 4 minutes on each side for medium-rare. Place the cheese on the burgers about a minute before removing from the grill, so the cheese will melt. Fry the shoestring potatoes for 3 minutes or until golden. Remove from the fryer and drain on a paper-lined plate. Season with salt and pepper. Spread the aioli in-between the bun. Place the burger in-between the bun and top with the salsa. Garnish with the fried shoestrings.

title: Chocolate Cake Iii
ingredients: 1/4 cup butter, softened 1 cup white sugar 2 eggs 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder 1/2 cup milk
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease and flour a 9 inch round pan. Sift together the flour and cocoa. Set aside. In a large bowl, cream together the butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in the eggs one at a time. Beat in the flour mixture alternately with the milk, mixing just until incorporated. Pour batter into prepared pan. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 to 35 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center of the cake comes out clean. Allow to cool.

title: Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 small onion, chopped 1 1/2 lb. lean ground beef 1 tsp. pepper 1 c. bread crumbs or crackers 1 egg 2/3 c. tomato juice 2 Tbsp. butter dash of salt
directions: Saute onion in butter for 5 minutes. Add to ground beef in large bowl. Sprinkle in salt and pepper; mix well. Stir in crumbs, eggs and juice. Shape into a loaf. Place in a greased pan. Bake at 300° for 60 to 90 minutes or until browned. Remove loaf and place on platter. Serve with brown gravy.

title: Punch
ingredients: 1 large can Hawaiian Punch 1 qt. ginger ale or 7-Up 1 small can crushed pineapple with juice 1 pt. vanilla ice cream 1 large container frozen strawberries
directions: You may crush the strawberries if you wish. Combine all ingredients. Stir and mix well. Enjoy!

title: Balsamic Bistro Sauce
ingredients: 1-1/4 qt. GREY POUPON Bistro Sauce 1-1/4 cups sweet pickle relish 1 cup balsamic vinegar 1 cup green onions, chopped
directions: Mix all ingredients until well blended; cover. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Spoon 2-Tbsp. portions of sauce over each 4-oz. portion of cooked fish, steak, chicken or pork.

title: AJIACO
ingredients: 7 cups water 1/2 each tomatoes chopped without skin 3 stalks onions chopped 2 cloves garlic 2 each chicken breasts 2 pounds potatoes peeled and sliced 2 pounds potatoes Creole (yellow), cut in pieces 4 each corn cobs tender, chunk in items 1 cup cream 1 x salt to taste
directions: Heat the water in a large pot, add tomato, onion, garlic, salt and chicken. Cook for 15 minutes from when it starts off steam. Remove chicken, let cool a little and slice it. Reserve it. Add the corn cobs and potatoes and let cook for 10 minutes from when it starts off steam. It is possible that the Creole potato fade away, but this is what makes giving consistency and thickness to the soup that is key. Serve and decorate with sliced chicken and cream. The result will be this: Really hope you enjoy it and sometime you can do it directly from my city. Victoria Guzman An expert in good food and cooking My Website: www. recipesdrinksandfood. com

title: Oven Baked Cheez-It Chicken Tenders
ingredients: 3 cups Cheez-It crackers (or similar, small cheddar flavored crackers) 2 eggs 1/4 cup water nonstick cooking spray (such as Pam) 1 lb chicken tenders (or boneless skinless breasts, cut into strips)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line a cookie sheet with aluminum foil (or silpat if you have it). Place the Cheez-it's in a zip-lock baggie and give it to your kid to play catch, touch football, whatever. Smack the back a few times with a rolling pin... get the cheese-it's crushed, but don't worry if there are some larger pieces. Pour into a shallow bowl or plate. Crack the eggs into a bowl and add the water. Whisk together until combined well. (something else your child can do!). Dip the chicken in the egg mixture, then roll around in the crushed Cheez-it's (kids love this part!) Place on the cookie sheet, continue until all the chicken is coated. Lightly spray all coated chicken with the cooking spray. Bake at 350°F about 15 -20 minutes (start checking the smaller ones after 10 minutes. I always pull them out as they get cooked through so that the smallest isn't incinerated by the time the largest piece is done cooking).

title: Soft Gingerbread Cookies Recipe
ingredients: 1/2 c. softened butter 1/2 c. brown sugar 1 egg, beaten 3/8 c. molasses 3/8 c. sour lowfat milk 2 1/2 c. flour 1 teaspoon soda 1/2 teaspoon ginger 1/2 teaspoon salt
directions: Cream together butter, brown sugar, egg, molasses and sour lowfat milk. Sift together flour, soda, ginger and salt. Add in to batter and mix well (makes a very soft batter). Refrigeratefor 1 hour. Roll 1/4" thick (only remove a little of batter from refrigerator, must be hard to be able to work with). Cut out with cutter and bake at 350 degrees till done. Will be soft. Frost when cold.

title: Baking Powder Biscuits
ingredients: 2 c. flour 1 tsp. salt 3/4 c. milk 3 tsp. baking powder 1/4 c. shortening
directions: Decrease baking powder to 2 teaspoons and add 1/4 teaspoon baking

title: Balsamic Vinnagrette
ingredients: 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar 1 pinch sea salt (I like to use morton) 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil thyme (optional) water, bottle
directions: Mix 3 tablespoons of olive oil and 1 tablespoon of balsamic vinegar in the water bottle. Add a pinch of salt (or to taste) and thyme if you have it. Close the water bottle and shake vigorously. Serve immediately and enjoy on your favorite saled.

title: Easy Chili
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef or sausage, cooked 1 (15 oz.) can light kidney beans 1 (15 oz.) can dark kidney beans 2 lb. can crushed tomatoes 6 oz. can tomato paste 12 oz. can mixed vegetables 3 Tbsp. chili powder 1 Tbsp. Frank's hot sauce 1 tsp. salt 1 tsp. pepper dash of Worcestershire sauce dash of red pepper dash of garlic salt 1 tsp. celery flakes 1 tsp. oregano
directions: Mix all ingredients together. Simmer on stove 3 to 4 hours or 4 to 5 hours in crock-pot.

title: Trio Salad
ingredients: 1 large pkg. lime jello 1 large pkg. lemon jello 1 large pkg. strawberry jello 1 can pineapple 1 (8 oz.) Cool Whip 1 (3 oz.) pkg. cream cheese 1/4 c. mayonnaise 2 c. marshmallows 1/2 c. pecans
directions: Mix lime jello by directions on box. Pour in large bowl. Let set in refrigerator until jelled. Mix lemon jello with 2 cups boiling water. Add marshmallows. After they are dissolved (let cool), then add pineapple, Cool Whip, cream cheese, mayonnaise and pecans to lemon mixture and pour over lime jello. Let it set until it is jelled. Mix strawberry jello and pour over lemon mixture. Let set in refrigerator until jelled.

title: Cajun Chowder
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. roasted garlic butter (Land O' Lakes) 1 Tbsp. oil 2/3 c. chopped onion 2 c. peeled and cubed potatoes 2 c. water 1 (15 oz.) can Veg-All Cajun mixed vegetables 1 1/2 c. half and half 1/4 tsp. black pepper 1 (14 3/4 oz.) can cream style corn 2/3 c. chopped smoked sausage Salt, to taste
directions: In a soup pot, combine the roasted garlic butter, oil and onions. Saute until onions are tender but not browned. Add potatoes and water. Cook until potatoes are fork tender but not mushy. Add the mixed vegetables, half & half, black pepper, corn and sausage. Cook over medium heat until slightly thickened. This will probably take about 8 to 10 minutes. If the chowder seems to thicken too much, simply add a little more half and half or water. Taste and add salt, as needed. I usually add about 1 teaspoon to my pot of chowder but always taste before adding salt and add a little at a time until you get it just right for your palate. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Penny'S Punch(2-Quart)
ingredients: 1/4 c. sugar 1 1/2 c. boiling water peel of 1/2 lemon 1 (3-inch) cinnamon stick 5 whole cloves 1/2 tsp. ground allspice 1 c. apple juice 1/5 Burgundy wine 1/2 tsp. ground nutmeg
directions: In large saucepan, dissolve sugar in water, lemon, cinnamon, cloves, allspice and apple juice. Cook over medium-high heat for 15 minutes. Add wine; heat, but do not boil. Sprinkle with nutmeg.

title: Coleslaw
ingredients: grated cabbage diced celery diced cucumbers diced radishes chopped tomatoes salt and pepper 1 c. sugar juice of 1/2 lemon 4 Tbsp. vinegar
directions: Combine vegetables. Add salt and pepper to taste. Add 1 cup sugar and toss. Add juice of 1/2 lemon and vinegar. Toss again.

title: Buttermilk Biscuit Rolls
ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour 2-1/2 teaspoons baking powder 1/8 teaspoon salt 1/3 cup butter-flavored shortening 3/4 cup buttermilk
directions: In a bowl, combine flour, baking powder and salt. Cut in the shortening until crumbly. Stir in the buttermilk just until moistened. Knead on a floured surface for 1 minute. Roll out to 1/2-in. thickness; cut with a 2-1/2-in. biscuit cutter. Place on a greased . Bake at 450° for 10-12 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Crunchie Pecan Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. melted butter 1/2 c. brown sugar 1/2 c. white sugar 1 egg 1/4 tsp. almond flavoring 2 c.sifted flour 1/2 tsp. baking powder 1/2 tsp. salt 1/2 tsp. cinnamon 1/2 c. chopped pecans
directions: Combine butter, sugars, egg and flavoring; beat about 3 minutes. Sift dry ingredients and add to sugar mixture. Add pecans and stir in. Shape in long roll. Chill several hours. Slice thin and bake on ungreased tin at 400° for about 10 minutes. Dough will keep in refrigerator several weeks. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Potato Bake
ingredients: 1 egg 1 Tbsp. milk 1 (2 1/2 oz.) envelope seasoned coating mix for chicken, fish, pork or hamburger 1 Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese 2 (16 oz. each) cans whole new potatoes, drained
directions: Heat oven to 350°. Beat egg and milk. Blend coating mix and cheese. Roll potatoes in egg mixture, then in coating mixture. Place potatoes in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake uncovered 30 minutes.

title: Frosty Strawberry Pie
ingredients: 1 pkg. strawberry jello 1 1/4 c. boiling water 1 pt. vanilla or strawberry ice cream 1 to 1 1/2 c. sliced strawberries (fresh strawberries or 10 oz. frozen, thawed and drained) 1 baked 8 or 9-inch pastry shell, cooled
